chapters.title: Chapter 251 - 203: Terrifying Methods!
paragraphs: At this moment, in Xingyu City.
The five people all looked at the vast expanse of red light ahead with solemn expressions.
They saw that from the last Evil God Altar, a monstrous ten-thousand-meter-long tentacle had appeared!
The tentacle frantically danced in the air, spraying torrential blood.
Moreover, more of its body continued to squeeze out from the altar.
The size of this monster far exceeded everyone’s imagination.
Just one tentacle was ten thousand meters long, how gigantic its main body must be was simply beyond imagination!
And Han Xing, at the moment the countdown reached zero, felt a violent, bloodthirsty terrifying aura descend!
Everyone seemed to be enveloped by this aura, recalling the most horrifying scenes they had ever experienced in their lives.
In the Lord’s Mansion, those relatives’ eyes turned pale, and their bodies convulsed uncontrollably.
The next moment, their bodies stiffened, losing all feeling.
Even Han Xing and others held their heads in agony.
At the crucial moment, Shen Yun, enduring the immense pain, cast ’Angel’s Shelter’ and ’Purification Technique’ one after another.
The intense pain in their minds finally eased.
At this point, Han Xing glanced at his status panel.
[Status]: Corrosion by Evil God’s Aura, Spirit Attribute decreased by 50%, suffering severe mental attack every second.
Upon seeing this status, everyone gasped in shock.
Legendary Level Creatures, without even taking action, had an aura that was enough to render every creature within a hundred kilometers combat-ineffective.
Shen Yun’s Angel’s Shelter could block the subsequent mental state attacks.
However, the initial 50% reduction in Spirit Attribute could not be removed.
This meant the two spiritual series professions in the team were rendered useless.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed beside them, "Damn, so this is the true power of a Legendary Level Creature?"
"This oppressive feeling far surpasses that of Dominator Level Creatures by countless times!"
Everyone felt the same as Cheng Jianyong.
They had thought that no matter how strong a Legendary Creature was, it was just one level higher than a Dominator Level Creature.
Now, they realized this was a completely erroneous understanding.
Between Dominator and Legend, there is a vast chasm!
Totally not the same class of existence.
Can Han Xing really deal with such a terrifying creature?
And at this moment, Shen Yun seemed to spot something and quickly reminded them.
"Brother Xing, the monster’s body looks like it has only partially emerged, hasn’t it fully descended yet?"
"Will it help if we destroy the Evil God Altar right now?"
Upon hearing this, everyone had a moment of realization.
They also realized this point.
The Legendary Creature only extended a few tentacles at the moment, while the rest of its body was still within the altar.
They knew this could be their last chance!
Han Xing also nodded.
The next moment, eighty-five Hellfire Missile Silos simultaneously launched an attack.
Rumble!
Eighty-five blazing flames of destruction rose into the sky.
Everyone watched that string of firelight, their eyes full of hope.
However.
Just as the hellfire was about to contact the terrifying ten-thousand-meter-long tentacle.
An attack method that always proved successful before.
Faced its first setback.
The huge entity near the altar seemed to sense something, and the next moment directly swung its tentacle!
Whoosh!
The massive tentacle danced with the wind, and the hellfire exploded violently, mushroom clouds rising into the air.
Yet the effect was like using fireworks to bombard an ancient tree reaching the sky.
Aside from slightly scorching the surface of the tentacle to a charred black, it had no significant effect.
At this moment.
Han Xing and others fell into utter despair.
Even his greatest trump card had no significant impact.
The Legendary Creature was powerful enough to drive one to despair.
And just then.
The monster, having its tentacle attacked, seemed slightly taken aback.
It thought that coming to the Land of the Abandoned Gods meant a one-sided massacre.
But it never expected these insects to have means that could harm it!
At this moment, the Evil God Commander became more and more frenzied.
Han Xing watched in horror as more and more tentacles emerged from the altar.
Four, five...
Finally.
A monster with thirteen tentacles and a gigantic human brain appeared prominently.
Its body length exceeded fifty thousand meters, the giant exposed brain had no skin, and various blood vessels and nerve tissues were laid bare to the air.
Like some ancient evil entity, it exuded an aura of terror.
Whoosh, whoosh...
As the tentacles waved, torrents of blood splattered across the sky, making it seem like a downpour of blood rain.
The next moment.
Its eerie human brain suddenly rotated one hundred and eighty degrees on the spot.
A pair of pale eyes fixed on Han Xing.
At this moment, everyone seemed to have suffered a heavy blow, spitting out mouthfuls of blood!
In front of everyone, a system prompt appeared simultaneously.
[You have been affected by the Evil God Commander’s skill: Evil God’s Gaze, reducing your Constitution limit by 10% every second, losing 10% of Life Force every second, until death...]
"Hiss..."
Seeing the effect of this skill, everyone gasped in shock!
Anyone targeted by its gaze, ten seconds later, would be dead.
This horrifyingly unreasonable and perverse skill plunged everyone into complete despair.
At this moment, they suddenly understood.
Why the system said all humanity should escape quickly and not think about resisting!
Because this guy is simply not an existence that can be defeated at the current stage!
No matter the number of people, it would only be sending them to their deaths.
Now, only Han Xing was slightly better off.
Because of the Divine Artifact level armor he wore.
The Shield of Calamity special effect on it reduces 80% of negative state effects.
Therefore, the life drain caused by the Evil God’s Gaze each second had been reduced to its minimum.
However, at this moment, the terrifying creature seemed to have also noticed everyone.
The next moment, two or three tentacles crossed dozens of kilometers, shooting over in an instant!
Such a terrifying creature could probably blow up Han Xing’s Sky Island with just one strike!
Everyone felt an overwhelming sense of impending death!
Han Xing took a deep breath.
Preparing to launch the second round of Hellfire for a life-and-death fight!
Just then, a voice suddenly appeared next to Han Xing and the others.
A crisp female voice!
"Oh? Have the minions of the Evil God already descended?"
"Seems I still arrived a step too late..."
They heard a sigh, seemingly containing a trace of regret.
However, at this moment, Han Xing and the others, including the Legendary Level Evil God Commander.
Were like being subjected to an Immovable Spell, frozen in place.
They all looked towards the direction the voice originated.
There seemed to be the position of the Evil God Commander’s altar.
Shen Yun and others lay on the ground with difficulty, asking, "Brother Xing... Brother Xing, what’s happening now?"
Han Xing shook his head; he also didn’t know what was happening.
At this time, the Evil God Commander in the sky seemed to have come to its senses.
Its pair of ghastly white fish eyes suddenly glared, activating the Evil God’s Gaze.
After that gaze moved away, everyone felt a sense of relief.
As if a mountain pressing down on their heads had been lifted, the terrifying pressure disappeared.
Now the Evil God Commander had changed its target.
It stared firmly at the altar, its body instantly swelling several times.
Originally exceeding fifty thousand meters in size, it now seemed to have transformed into the size of a small planet.
The next moment.
It directly extended a dozen tentacles, binding the altar layer by layer!
In everyone’s eyes, the altar was like a giant’s little toy, being squeezed at will.
Yet just then, everyone suddenly heard a crisp, slightly angry voice.
"Ugly creature... Daring to attack me, are you rushing to your death?"
With the voice disappearing the next moment.
Everyone saw, from the blood pool of the altar, a delicate jade hand suddenly reached out.
That palm seemed to possess unimaginable mighty power.
The Evil God Commander was just about to unleash, yet saw one of its ten-thousand-meter tentacles gripped tightly by the small palm!
An unimaginable, frightening force came.
In Han Xing’s shocked gaze.
The enormous body of the Evil God Commander began to tilt downward slowly, as if about to be sucked into a black hole.
At this time, fear surprisingly showed in its ghastly white eyes.
"Goo... Goo..."
A low roar like bubbles raging came.
The next moment, the body of the Evil God Commander sank thousands of meters!
One tentacle had already been devoured by the altar more than halfway.
The Evil God Commander let out an earth-shattering roar.
However, everyone heard a trace of fear in its voice.
At this moment, the remaining ten tentacles of the Evil God Commander flailed wildly in the air, seeming to want to make a final struggle.
"Disgusting bug..."
"I don’t have much time to pester with you here, you’d better behave."
"If you resist again, I will get angry!"
As soon as the words fell.
The Evil God Commander shuddered, as if it had heard something terrifying.
However, as a Legendary Creature, it certainly wouldn’t just surrender.
The Evil God Commander began to struggle frantically.
Everyone heard a cold snort.
From that blood pool, a burst of dazzling blue light suddenly erupted.
This blue light, upon contact with the body of the Evil God Commander, transformed into energy Secret Patterns, binding its enormous body.
Then, it seemed to wilt instantly, its whole strength seemingly drained, a dozen tentacles drooped down.
Its enormous body started sinking uncontrollably.
At this moment, the fear in the Evil God Commander’s eyes intensified.
"I told you, behave!"
Then, in the expressions of Han Xing and the others, shocked beyond belief.
They witnessed firsthand, that enormous entity over a hundred thousand meters in size was forcibly dragged back into the Evil God Altar.
Plop! Plop, plop, plop!
Torrential blood rain poured, the flesh and blood of the Evil God Commander continually compressed, squeezed.
In this process, it seemed to endure unimaginable pain.
Yet the Evil God Commander was unable to make any further movements.
Until its huge head was squeezed into a strip, several large eyeballs also burst directly.
With the continuous sound of plop, plop, plop.
Finally, the Evil God Commander completely disappeared into the altar.

chapters.title: Chapter 252 - 204: Blood Tide Calamity, Officially Ended!
paragraphs: After the Evil God Commander was forcefully stuffed back into the altar.
At the same time.
A system notification echoed in the ears of humans worldwide.
"Attention all Survivors."
"The Evil God Commander has been banished, the plot of the Otherworldly Evil God has been thwarted."
"The Blood Tide disaster officially ends!"
"Survivors, you have completed a great battle, the Human Race’s reputation increases by 5000."
"This is a victory for all humanity, to commend your efforts, you will receive the following rewards."
"All Survivors level +1, Battle Merit +10000, for the next ten days, all Survivors’ attributes increase by 10%, experience gain speed increases by 50%."
"Ranking rewards for the Battle Merit list will be settled for all Survivors later..."
After the notification ended.
A great stir rose among the billions of Survivors globally!
"Just now...did you hear it? The Evil God Commander has been banished! We humans won!!!"
"I heard it, it feels like a dream, so unreal..."
Just a few minutes ago, humans worldwide were engulfed in the crisis of racial extinction, even preparing for a final stand.
Yet now, a system notification brought along earth-shattering good news!
Survivors sighed one after another.
"Indeed, it has really been banished..."
"Too unbelievable, what exactly happened?"
"Could it be that the Star God did this?"
Since finding the last Evil God Altar location, Han Xing hadn’t spoken a word.
No one knew his progress on this front.
Many even felt in their hearts that Han Xing had already failed.
"It must be, other than him, I can’t think of anyone else who could banish the Evil God Commander."
"Exactly! The Star God always manages to do things beyond our imagination!"
For a moment, all Survivors were awestruck.
"This time again, the Star God saved countless lives."
"Star God, humanity’s savior!"
However, at this time, Han Xing wanted to say: "This has nothing to do with me..."
But before he could speak.
He saw the altar full of cracks in front of him instantly shatter.
When the blood rain in the air dispersed.
A graceful figure hovered in mid-air.
From afar, everyone could see a woman standing in the air.
She had bare jade feet, and under the light gauze, a petite yet curvaceous figure.
Sleek black hair hung down to her ankles, at least nearly two meters long.
This silhouette, at first glance, gave a feeling of harmlessness to humans and animals.
As if she were simply the girl-next-door type.
Yet, everyone knew this wasn’t just any girl-next-door, but a woman who forcefully stuffed the Evil God Commander back into the Alternate Space.
A terrifying woman!
At this moment, everyone bore unimaginable psychological pressure.
After all, facing the Evil God Commander had already brought them the crisis of death.
And this woman was even more terrifying than the Commander.
They were truly afraid she might suddenly rush over.
Then treat them like she did the Evil God Commander, forcefully stuffing them somewhere.
Han Xing could only pray that this girl would ignore them.
Just like ignoring bugs by the roadside...
However, heaven didn’t grant his wish, and that graceful figure seemed to take notice of them.
Before Han Xing could react.
That silhouette flashed, instantly crossing dozens of kilometers to appear before everyone.
Han Xing only felt a powerful aura sweeping over.
At this time, everyone finally saw the woman’s face clearly.
It wasn’t exceptionally beautiful but had a unique character, with refined features, lively eyes, and a strange blue secret pattern between her brows.
She dressed very revealingly, with transparent gauze clothing under which were two perfectly symmetrical legs.
But the most distinctive was her light brown skin, like a layer of caramel chocolate under the moonlight, exuding an enticing aroma.
At this moment, Han Xing and the others saw the lengthy titles above this woman’s head.
’Evil God Terminator,’ ’Storm Ripper,’ ’Shadow Nightmare,’ ’Legendary Mage’...
[The twenty-third Witch Race Saintess]: Wu Ling’Er.
So, this woman was called Wu Ling’Er.
Among her long list of titles, the most striking was her position as the twenty-third Witch Race Saintess.
Everyone simultaneously fell into shock.
However, at this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but ponder.
The Witch Race...isn’t it the one that first performed a ritual, summoning the four Otherworldly Evil Gods?
They almost faced extinction because of that, and the Witch Race was greatly weakened afterward, failing to recover since then.
Since Wu Ling’Er is the Saintess of the Witch Race.
That means she’s not from the Land of the Abandoned Gods?
Han Xing’s mind quickly raced through numerous thoughts.
Yet, before Han Xing and the others could speak, Wu Ling’Er first asked: "Are you the last Survivors of the Human Race?"
Her voice was clear, without the killing intent she had when dealing with the Evil God Commander, just an ordinary inquiry tone.
Shen Yun and the others exchanged glances.
Based on the woman’s words just now and her action patterns.
The other party should have no malice towards the Human Race.
In fact, they might be here to help the Human Race.
If it weren’t for this woman, they might have already been severely injured or even killed by that Legendary Level Evil God Commander.
So, Han Xing took a step forward and replied, "We are not the last survivors of the Human Race; in the Land of the Abandoned Gods, there are still many active humans."
This woman was a bit stunned after hearing this.
A moment later, she asked, "You mean, many humans have survived this Evil God disaster?"
Han Xing nodded.
The other party carefully looked into Han Xing’s eyes, seemingly to confirm if Han Xing was lying.
A moment later, she slowly said, "Well, that’s not bad."
"For so many to survive the Evil God’s invasion, your generation of the Human Race truly exceeds my expectations."
From her words, it seemed Han Xing captured some key information.
However, before he could think further, he heard her ask again.
"If that’s the case, please tell me the location of the nearby Evil God Altars."
"My time is quite tight, and after resolving this Evil God crisis, I must leave quickly."
She seems extremely knowledgeable about the Blood Tide crisis, even knowing that the key to this disaster lies in the altars.
Everyone looked at each other and shook their heads, saying, "There are no altars left."
Wu Ling’Er also looked puzzled, asking, "None left?"
Han Xing nodded.
Wu Ling’Er watched the crowd.
After confirming they were not lying.
Wu Ling’Er had a new understanding of the strength of this group of humans.
She had thought that after experiencing this Blood Tide disaster, humans were almost on the brink of extinction.
For this, she even paid a certain price, forcibly using Alternate Space channels to teleport into the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
As a result, she found that not only did they live well, but they also destroyed all the Evil God Altars.
At this time, Wu Ling’Er seemed to think of something.
Her expression changed, and in the next instant, she disappeared from the spot.
Everyone looked at each other in bewilderment.
Han Xing and the others were left baffled by this Witch Race Saintess.
However, now was not the time to be stunned.
Because.
After the system update, a white light rose from everyone.
System reward: Global human level +1 level!
Han Xing was already at level 33.
After the Third Transformation, each level’s attribute increase would soar, now turning into a random attribute bonus of 30 to 40 points.
However, this was not his greatest gain this time!
Because, at this time, the Battle Merit leaderboard reward was already settled.
Han Xing heard a system notification in his ear.
"Battle Merit leaderboard ranking has ended, and rewards will be distributed based on personal ranking."
"Your current ranking: First place."

"You have received the Battle Merit leaderboard reward: Philosopher’s Stone*100, Ancient Spirit Wood*10, Ancient Fire*10, High-Level Teleportation Array Construction Plan*1, Advanced Energy Shield Construction Plan*1, Oracle Throne Design Map (Red)*1."
This is the reward for first place!
The reason why it didn’t stir discussion among the crowd was because the rewards were all brand-new items.
The system also didn’t provide a clear introduction, so everyone didn’t know the function of these items.
This includes the Philosopher’s Stone, Ancient Spirit Wood, Ancient Fire.
Before this, these things were unheard of by everyone.
However, Han Xing had obtained them from Bright Moon Treasure Chest and Sun Treasure Chest.
Among them, the Philosopher’s Stone is the main material for crafting Divine Artifacts, and this time, the first place rewarded a full 100 pieces.
To know, even when Han Xing opened the Sun Treasure Chest, he only obtained 7 pieces of Philosopher’s Stone.
Which required a billion battle merits!
Now, the first reward on the leaderboard directly gave 100 pieces, showing how abundant this reward was.
As for the second material, Ancient Spirit Wood, naturally, there’s no need to say more.
Also exclusive to Sun Treasures.
It can be used to repair the Holy Artifact of the Elf Race, the World Tree.
It’s an extremely precious item.
And the Ancient Fire behind it, on the other hand, serves as the key item for finding the Path of the Giant Dragon.
Although its specific function is not yet known, it is certainly not too far off.
However, the blueprint rewards for buildings this time are indeed not many.
There are only two.
High-Level Teleportation Array and Advanced Energy Shield Construction Plan.
The former can teleport more people at the same time, and the cooldown is shorter.
However, there is an extra note on it.
[Can perform cross-space teleportation.]
Han Xing doesn’t know what this cross-space teleportation means, but presumably, it should not be simple.
As for the Advanced Energy Shield, compared to the Intermediate level, it increased the Defense Value tenfold.
100,000 points of Defense Value, even comparable to an Evil God Altar, can withstand a considerable amount of damage.
After reviewing these rewards, Han Xing nodded in satisfaction.
Then, Han Xing held a red piece of paper in his hand.
It records a pattern of a large throne carved with gems and luxurious in design.
This is the major reward from the leaderboard.
[Oracle Throne Design Map (Red)]: Special Divine Artifact item can be crafted by collecting materials: Oracle Throne.

"I heard it, it feels like a dream, so unreal..."
Just a few minutes ago, humans worldwide were engulfed in the crisis of racial extinction, even preparing for a final stand.
Yet now, a system notification brought along earth-shattering good news!
Survivors sighed one after another.
"Indeed, it has really been banished..."
"Too unbelievable, what exactly happened?"
"Could it be that the Star God did this?"
Since finding the last Evil God Altar location, Han Xing hadn’t spoken a word.
No one knew his progress on this front.
Many even felt in their hearts that Han Xing had already failed.
"It must be, other than him, I can’t think of anyone else who could banish the Evil God Commander."
"Exactly!
The Star God always manages to do things beyond our imagination!"
For a moment, all Survivors were awestruck.
"This time again, the Star God saved countless lives."
"Star God, humanity’s savior!"
However, at this time, Han Xing wanted to say: "This has nothing to do with me..."
But before he could speak.
He saw the altar full of cracks in front of him instantly shatter.
When the blood rain in the air dispersed.
A graceful figure hovered in mid-air.
From afar, everyone could see a woman standing in the air.
She had bare jade feet, and under the light gauze, a petite yet curvaceous figure.
Sleek black hair hung down to her ankles, at least nearly two meters long.
This silhouette, at first glance, gave a feeling of harmlessness to humans and animals.
As if she were simply the girl-next-door type.
Yet, everyone knew this wasn’t just any girl-next-door, but a woman who forcefully stuffed the Evil God Commander back into the Alternate Space.
A terrifying woman!
At this moment, everyone bore unimaginable psychological pressure.
After all, facing the Evil God Commander had already brought them the crisis of death.
And this woman was even more terrifying than the Commander.
They were truly afraid she might suddenly rush over.
Then treat them like she did the Evil God Commander, forcefully stuffing them somewhere.
Han Xing could only pray that this girl would ignore them.
Just like ignoring bugs by the roadside...
However, heaven didn’t grant his wish, and that graceful figure seemed to take notice of them.
Before Han Xing could react.
That silhouette flashed, instantly crossing dozens of kilometers to appear before everyone.
Han Xing only felt a powerful aura sweeping over.
At this time, everyone finally saw the woman’s face clearly.
It wasn’t exceptionally beautiful but had a unique character, with refined features, lively eyes, and a strange blue secret pattern between her brows.
She dressed very revealingly, with transparent gauze clothing under which were two perfectly symmetrical legs.
But the most distinctive was her light brown skin, like a layer of caramel chocolate under the moonlight, exuding an enticing aroma.
At this moment, Han Xing and the others saw the lengthy titles above this woman’s head.
’Evil God Terminator,’ ’Storm Ripper,’ ’Shadow Nightmare,’ ’Legendary Mage’...
[The twenty-third Witch Race Saintess]: Wu Ling’Er.
So, this woman was called Wu Ling’Er.
Among her long list of titles, the most striking was her position as the twenty-third Witch Race Saintess.
Everyone simultaneously fell into shock.
However, at this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but ponder.
The Witch Race...isn’t it the one that first performed a ritual, summoning the four Otherworldly Evil Gods?
They almost faced extinction because of that, and the Witch Race was greatly weakened afterward, failing to recover since then.
Since Wu Ling’Er is the Saintess of the Witch Race.
That means she’s not from the Land of the Abandoned Gods?
Han Xing’s mind quickly raced through numerous thoughts.
Yet, before Han Xing and the others could speak, Wu Ling’Er first asked: "Are you the last Survivors of the Human Race?"
Her voice was clear, without the killing intent she had when dealing with the Evil God Commander, just an ordinary inquiry tone.
Shen Yun and the others exchanged glances.
Based on the woman’s words just now and her action patterns.
The other party should have no malice towards the Human Race.
In fact, they might be here to help the Human Race.
If it weren’t for this woman, they might have already been severely injured or even killed by that Legendary Level Evil God Commander.
So, Han Xing took a step forward and replied, "We are not the last survivors of the Human Race; in the Land of the Abandoned Gods, there are still many active humans."
This woman was a bit stunned after hearing this.
A moment later, she asked, "You mean, many humans have survived this Evil God disaster?"
Han Xing nodded.
The other party carefully looked into Han Xing’s eyes, seemingly to confirm if Han Xing was lying.
A moment later, she slowly said, "Well, that’s not bad."
"For so many to survive the Evil God’s invasion, your generation of the Human Race truly exceeds my expectations."
From her words, it seemed Han Xing captured some key information.
However, before he could think further, he heard her ask again.
"If that’s the case, please tell me the location of the nearby Evil God Altars."
"My time is quite tight, and after resolving this Evil God crisis, I must leave quickly."
She seems extremely knowledgeable about the Blood Tide crisis, even knowing that the key to this disaster lies in the altars.
Everyone looked at each other and shook their heads, saying, "There are no altars left."
Wu Ling’Er also looked puzzled, asking, "None left?"
Han Xing nodded.
Wu Ling’Er watched the crowd.
After confirming they were not lying.
Wu Ling’Er had a new understanding of the strength of this group of humans.
She had thought that after experiencing this Blood Tide disaster, humans were almost on the brink of extinction.
For this, she even paid a certain price, forcibly using Alternate Space channels to teleport into the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
As a result, she found that not only did they live well, but they also destroyed all the Evil God Altars.
At this time, Wu Ling’Er seemed to think of something.
Her expression changed, and in the next instant, she disappeared from the spot.
Everyone looked at each other in bewilderment.
Han Xing and the others were left baffled by this Witch Race Saintess.
However, now was not the time to be stunned.
Because.
After the system update, a white light rose from everyone.
System reward: Global human level +1 level!
Han Xing was already at level 33.
After the Third Transformation, each level’s attribute increase would soar, now turning into a random attribute bonus of 30 to 40 points.
However, this was not his greatest gain this time!
Because, at this time, the Battle Merit leaderboard reward was already settled.
Han Xing heard a system notification in his ear.
"Battle Merit leaderboard ranking has ended, and rewards will be distributed based on personal ranking."
"Your current ranking: First place."

"You have received the Battle Merit leaderboard reward: Philosopher’s Stone*100, Ancient Spirit Wood*10, Ancient Fire*10, High-Level Teleportation Array Construction Plan*1, Advanced Energy Shield Construction Plan*1, Oracle Throne Design Map (Red)*1."
This is the reward for first place!
The reason why it didn’t stir discussion among the crowd was because the rewards were all brand-new items.
The system also didn’t provide a clear introduction, so everyone didn’t know the function of these items.
This includes the Philosopher’s Stone, Ancient Spirit Wood, Ancient Fire.
Before this, these things were unheard of by everyone.
However, Han Xing had obtained them from Bright Moon Treasure Chest and Sun Treasure Chest.
Among them, the Philosopher’s Stone is the main material for crafting Divine Artifacts, and this time, the first place rewarded a full 100 pieces.
To know, even when Han Xing opened the Sun Treasure Chest, he only obtained 7 pieces of Philosopher’s Stone.
Which required a billion battle merits!
Now, the first reward on the leaderboard directly gave 100 pieces, showing how abundant this reward was.
As for the second material, Ancient Spirit Wood, naturally, there’s no need to say more.
Also exclusive to Sun Treasures.
It can be used to repair the Holy Artifact of the Elf Race, the World Tree.
It’s an extremely precious item.
And the Ancient Fire behind it, on the other hand, serves as the key item for finding the Path of the Giant Dragon.
Although its specific function is not yet known, it is certainly not too far off.
However, the blueprint rewards for buildings this time are indeed not many.
There are only two.
High-Level Teleportation Array and Advanced Energy Shield Construction Plan.
The former can teleport more people at the same time, and the cooldown is shorter.
However, there is an extra note on it.
[Can perform cross-space teleportation.]
Han Xing doesn’t know what this cross-space teleportation means, but presumably, it should not be simple.
As for the Advanced Energy Shield, compared to the Intermediate level, it increased the Defense Value tenfold.
100,000 points of Defense Value, even comparable to an Evil God Altar, can withstand a considerable amount of damage.
After reviewing these rewards, Han Xing nodded in satisfaction.
Then, Han Xing held a red piece of paper in his hand.
It records a pattern of a large throne carved with gems and luxurious in design.
This is the major reward from the leaderboard.
[Oracle Throne Design Map (Red)]: Special Divine Artifact item can be crafted by collecting materials: Oracle Throne.

chapters.title: Chapter 253 - 205: Oracle Throne (Red)
paragraphs: [Oracle Throne (Red)]: Special equipment.
[Equipment Effect]: After binding to the Oracle Throne, the Survivor can use it to fly.
In flight mode, Movement Speed increases by 1000%, Defense increases by 100%, and Attack Power increases by 100%.

[Unique Effect]: Divine Oracle Summon. Allows carrying four team members for an instant long-distance teleportation, ignoring space, location, and other restrictions. Maximum teleportation range: 1 million kilometers.
Effect cooldown: 24 hours.
[Required Materials]: Philosopher’s Stone*1000, Shadow Divine Stone*500, Shimmering Terra Stone*500, Rhythm Black Iron*1000, Divine Oracle Scripture*5...
After reading the lengthy attributes introduction of the blueprint, Han Xing couldn’t help but sigh.
Should it be said that it’s indeed a Divine Level item?
Though not actual equipment, its attached characteristics can indeed be called terrifying.
Just by sitting on the throne, Movement Speed increases tenfold and it also doubles Defense and Attack!
Moreover, it includes an ultra-long-distance teleportation, which can definitely be considered a divine skill for escape!
One million kilometers, this range is simply too far.
At Han Xing’s current Movement Speed, it would take at least nearly two hundred hours!
The key point is, this is actually a group teleportation effect!
If used well, the actual effect that can be achieved is beyond imagination!
Of course, the materials needed are also quite terrifying.
Just the Philosopher’s Stone alone requires a full thousand pieces.
Han Xing even doubted whether the combined resources held by all humans globally amount to a thousand Philosopher’s Stones.
Besides, he had never even heard of the Shadow Divine Stone and Shimmering Terra Stone that followed.
At the same time.
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong also walked over excitedly and said.
"Brother Xing, our leaderboard rewards have also been issued!"

"Apart from the High-Level Teleportation Array and Advanced Defense Shield, each of us received 50 Philosopher’s Stones, 100 pieces of Rhythm Black Iron, and an Orange Weapon Blueprint of our choice!"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing was also taken aback.
This time the system rewards were indeed very generous.
Except for the first place, the rewards for the top ten were the same, and everyone even received an Orange Weapon Blueprint of their choice.
If all these were to be fully utilized, everyone’s strength would skyrocket significantly!
At this moment, as if Shen Yun remembered something.
"By the way, Brother Xing, once we decide on the blueprints, we’ll all trade them to you, and when you have time, could you make them for us?"
By now, everyone knew that when Han Xing crafted equipment, it seemed to have a different effect.
So, whenever someone had a good blueprint, they would bring it to Han Xing first.
Han Xing nodded in agreement.
A few minutes later, his backpack had a few more weapon blueprints.
They were.
[Flumeg’s Sword]
[Triumph Knight’s Holy Hammer]
[Valkyrie Longbow]
[Flame Dominator Staff]
A total of four weapon blueprints, all Level 35 Orange Equipment, and Han Xing directly learned them.
He didn’t immediately check the crafting materials for these weapons.
Because right now, he felt waves of exhaustion washing over him like a tide.
At this moment, it was already deep into the night.
After a whole day of life-and-death moments, coupled with the psychological pressure from directly facing Legendary Creatures.
After the extreme ups and downs, everyone felt a wave of exhaustion.
After clearing the leaderboard rewards, everyone felt mentally and physically exhausted.
Then, they all went back to the Lord’s Mansion to rest...
That night, the chat channel was unusually quiet.
All humans, after a day of battles, were already exhausted.
Throughout the Land of the Abandoned Gods, except for occasional disturbances in some places, all the Sky Islands unanimously stopped in their tracks to rest and recuperate.
The next day...
When the first ray of dawn appeared in the morning, the vast majority of Survivors came out of their houses in unison.
They clearly felt that today’s Sun looked different from before.
Previously, the oppressive and despair-inducing red blood light was nowhere to be seen.
Now, it had turned into a golden hue symbolizing hope and purity...
That is the Sun, the normal color...
In the chat channel, some Survivors exclaimed.
"Brothers, come out and take a look!"
"The Sun is back to normal, and no monsters appear in the sky."
"The Blood Tide has really ended completely!"
After this person spoke, the chat channel erupted in a tsunami of cheers.
They were madly flooding the channel, with messages appearing at a rate of a million per second.
The chat channel was almost getting overloaded!
But this time, Zhou Huang did not activate the admin privileges to stop them but instead let everyone indulge in the celebration.
They were wildly venting their excitement, sadness, and pain in the chat channel...
The 26-day Blood Tide disaster had brought indelible pain to humanity.
Almost one-third of the human population perished in this calamity.
Those who survived now bear more responsibility and must strive to live better.
At this moment, some couldn’t help but burst into tears.
"Wooo... it’s finally over."
"Dad, did you see this?"
The Blood Tide had completely ended.
However, within the Land of the Abandoned Gods, some monsters were still wandering.
Without the Evil God Altar, these Blood Tide Monsters are now like rootless duckweed.
Not only can they no longer level up, but they also don’t have Dominator Level monsters directing them.
In the eyes of the Survivors, they now appear as clusters of active Battle Merits!
Indeed, Battle Merits.
Even after the Blood Tide ended, the Battle Merit Store remained open.
Now, everyone can still exchange their Battle Merits for various items in the shop, such as Silver and Golden Treasure Chests.

chapters.title: Chapter 254 - 205: Oracle Throne (Red)
paragraphs: And this time, the surviving humans all received a reward of ten thousand battle merits!
Equivalent to a piece of Golden Equipment!
This gave the survivors more or less a boost in strength.
Everyone was extremely excited.
This blood tide made them deeply realize the importance of strength.
However, at this moment, Han Xing looked at the remaining 600 million battle merits he had and fell into deep thought.
This time, he had amassed a total of 1.5 billion cumulative battle merits.
Midway, he consumed 900 million to exchange for various resources.
Now, 600 million remains.
These battle merits are equivalent to a vast amount of resources!
At this time, Han Xing pondered, "After this blood tide ends, there won’t be such a good opportunity to obtain resources later."
"I can wait until I level up a bit more before using these 600 million battle merits to exchange for a batch of Golden Treasure Chests."
"By then, the golden equipment obtained will be of a higher level, and selling them will yield more resources, thus maximizing benefits."
Besides these battle merits, Han Xing also had a reward item he hadn’t utilized yet.
And that is a Sacred Artifact Fragment.
At this moment, Han Xing eagerly checked the 10,214 Sacred Artifact Fragments in his backpack.
These were the biggest reward from the calamity of this blood tide!
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
"Do you want to consume *10,000 Sacred Artifact Fragments to exchange for a Human Race exclusive Holy Artifact?"
So far, Han Xing still didn’t know what the Human Race exclusive Holy Artifact was.
But given it’s a holy artifact of a race, it couldn’t be bad.
So, Han Xing directly clicked ’yes’.
The system prompt appeared.
"Exchange successful, you have obtained the Human Race exclusive Holy Artifact: Corona Monument Construction Plan (Number 1)."
"214 Sacred Artifact Fragments are remaining, automatically converted to 2.14 million battle merits for you."
Hearing that the system had converted his extra Sacred Artifact Fragments to battle merits, Han Xing wasn’t too surprised,
only, when he saw the strange name of the document, he was taken aback for a moment.
"Corona Monument? What’s this?"
"And why is there a number?"
With a strange expression, Han Xing checked the attributes of this blueprint.
[Holy Artifact: Corona Monument 1]: Special-type building.
[Building Effect]: Makes all buildings within territory upgradable.
Each level up of the Corona Monument raises the level of all buildings by lv1 (range, firing rate, attack range, armor, attack power, all increased by 10%).
Note: The current level cap is level 10, more Corona Monuments can be combined to increase the level cap.
After reading the description of the attributes, the bewilderment in Han Xing’s eyes turned into shock.
Then it completely turned into ecstasy!
This thing can actually change the attributes of territory buildings, making them upgradable buildings!
This accompanying function is truly heaven-defying!
Upon reaching level 10, it’s equivalent to a 100% all-round enhancement of all building attributes in the territory.
And it’s not simply doubling them.
This includes the attack range, charge time, damage range of defense towers, and many more!
The actual enhancement effect far exceeds 100%!
It’s simply a heaven-defying Divine Artifact!
"Great, with this thing, a Thunderbolt Tower is at least equivalent to the firepower of three previous towers."
"Moreover, the stronger the defense tower, the more evident the effect!"
"This thing truly lives up to the name of a Holy Artifact!" Han Xing exclaimed with heartfelt admiration.
As long as it can be leveled up to the maximum level, based on estimates, with his current defense tower strength, he might even have means to deal with Legendary levels!
Of course, the premise is that Han Xing can construct it.
Even the construction requirements for the Divine Artifact blueprint, ’Oracle Throne’, are quite challenging.
Presumably, the Corona Monument will be even more demanding.
With an anxious mind, Han Xing checked the construction requirements for the Corona Monument.

[Materials required to construct Corona Monument 1]: Permanent Gold Ingot *100,000, Shadow Divine Stone *50,000, Shimmering Terra Stone *10,000, Philosopher’s Stone *10,000, Giant Dragon Soul (Legendary Level) *1...
After reading the construction materials, Han Xing directly rolled his eyes.
Fine, among the five required materials listed above, aside from the Permanent Gold Ingot that he can produce, he can’t gather any of the other materials.
It could even be said that it’s a distant prospect.
The Philosopher’s Stone alone requires ten times that needed to craft the Oracle Throne.
Not to mention the extravagant number of Terrastones and Shadow Divine Stones.
Helpless, he could only temporarily abandon this idea.
Currently, both items in his hands require a large quantity of rare materials.
At this time, Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong, along with others, have almost finished their rest.
Everyone’s faces were filled with relaxed smiles.
Han Xing spoke.
"Alright, in the coming days, everyone can relax a bit; no need to fight with nerves on edge every day."
"You can travel freely, and do whatever you like."
Upon hearing this, everyone shouted in unison, "Hooray!"
In the following days, humans across the globe entered a phase of recuperation and recovery.
Having gone through the blood tide calamity, the strength of tens of billions of people ushered in a transformation.
Combined with everyone being in team mode, the area of the Sky Island that could be explored became increasingly vast.
The speed of resource gathering for everyone gradually accelerated.
During this period, Han Xing also collected various resources.
He gathered the materials for four Orange Weapons, crafted two of them completely, and forged them.
These two weapons were: [Flumeg’s Sword (Orange)], [Valkyrie Longbow (Orange)].
As for the other Magic Staff and Holy Hammer, due to the lack of key materials, Han Xing planned to deal with them later.
At this moment, a deep blue longsword appeared in Han Xing’s hand.
Faint celestial airs shimmered on its surface.
At the moment the longsword appeared, everyone felt the hair on their skin rise, as if swept by a fierce Sword Qi.
That sound only occurs when a Divine Weapon is unsheathed!
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong, who was mingling with a group of Minotaurs in the territory, seemed also to have spotted that trace of deep blue.
The next moment, he flung the Minotaur brother beside him aside and dashed over instantly.
Then, eagerly gazing at the deep blue longsword in Han Xing’s hand, he asked tremblingly, "Brother Xing, is it completed?"
At this moment, others also gathered around, their eyes filled with curiosity.
Han Xing nodded with a smile, "This longsword has very impressive attributes, even I’m a bit envious."
Hearing Han Xing say this, Cheng Jianyong’s pupils widened, breathing heavily, "Brother Xing, my dear Brother Xing!"
"I, Old Cheng from the countryside, have never seen such a superb weapon in my life, please, let me touch it just once!"
Seeing Cheng Jianyong still acting shamelessly, everyone was somewhat speechless.
But fortunately, everyone was accustomed to his personality.
Then, Han Xing tossed the longsword over to him.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong immediately dropped his expression and leaped up to catch the longsword.
He couldn’t wait to check the attributes of this weapon and instantly exclaimed.
"Whoa! It’s epic quality again!"
Listening to this, Shen Yun and the others were also a bit surprised.
By now, everyone already knew how difficult it was to craft an epic-quality piece of equipment.
Even with an Orange Blueprint, and abundant resources, one had to bear the pitifully low success rate of Orange Armor crafting.
In recent days, Boundless and Zhou Huang, along with others, have also received top ten rewards.
They spent heavily in the trading channel, purchasing various precious materials in bulk to craft the weapons in their hands as quickly as possible.
However, even with their wealth, a single failure would entail tremendous loss to both of them.
Not to mention, hitting the maximum potential of an Orange Weapon Blueprint with epic quality depended on luck as well.
So, little wonder Cheng Jianyong was so astonished.
[Flumeg’s Sword]’s attributes were extremely powerful, with an attack power reaching over 500 points, and an additional 150 points of Power.
Compared to the Level 30 Golden Armor Cheng Jianyong currently held, Flumeg’s Sword increased actual attack power by over 25%.
Additionally, it came with an epic effect, Star Attraction.
[Star Attraction]: When attacking, there’s a 28.8% chance to draw nearby enemies within ten meters to the front, inflicting 288% physical damage on them.

Note: The current level cap is level 10, more Corona Monuments can be combined to increase the level cap.
After reading the description of the attributes, the bewilderment in Han Xing’s eyes turned into shock.
Then it completely turned into ecstasy!
This thing can actually change the attributes of territory buildings, making them upgradable buildings!
This accompanying function is truly heaven-defying!
Upon reaching level 10, it’s equivalent to a 100% all-round enhancement of all building attributes in the territory.
And it’s not simply doubling them.
This includes the attack range, charge time, damage range of defense towers, and many more!
The actual enhancement effect far exceeds 100%!
It’s simply a heaven-defying Divine Artifact!
"Great, with this thing, a Thunderbolt Tower is at least equivalent to the firepower of three previous towers."
"Moreover, the stronger the defense tower, the more evident the effect!"
"This thing truly lives up to the name of a Holy Artifact!" Han Xing exclaimed with heartfelt admiration.
As long as it can be leveled up to the maximum level, based on estimates, with his current defense tower strength, he might even have means to deal with Legendary levels!
Of course, the premise is that Han Xing can construct it.
Even the construction requirements for the Divine Artifact blueprint, ’Oracle Throne’, are quite challenging.
Presumably, the Corona Monument will be even more demanding.
With an anxious mind, Han Xing checked the construction requirements for the Corona Monument.

[Materials required to construct Corona Monument 1]: Permanent Gold Ingot *100,000, Shadow Divine Stone *50,000, Shimmering Terra Stone *10,000, Philosopher’s Stone *10,000, Giant Dragon Soul (Legendary Level) *1...
After reading the construction materials, Han Xing directly rolled his eyes.
Fine, among the five required materials listed above, aside from the Permanent Gold Ingot that he can produce, he can’t gather any of the other materials.
It could even be said that it’s a distant prospect.
The Philosopher’s Stone alone requires ten times that needed to craft the Oracle Throne.
Not to mention the extravagant number of Terrastones and Shadow Divine Stones.
Helpless, he could only temporarily abandon this idea.
Currently, both items in his hands require a large quantity of rare materials.
At this time, Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong, along with others, have almost finished their rest.
Everyone’s faces were filled with relaxed smiles.
Han Xing spoke.
"Alright, in the coming days, everyone can relax a bit; no need to fight with nerves on edge every day."
"You can travel freely, and do whatever you like."
Upon hearing this, everyone shouted in unison, "Hooray!"
In the following days, humans across the globe entered a phase of recuperation and recovery.
Having gone through the blood tide calamity, the strength of tens of billions of people ushered in a transformation.
Combined with everyone being in team mode, the area of the Sky Island that could be explored became increasingly vast.
The speed of resource gathering for everyone gradually accelerated.
During this period, Han Xing also collected various resources.
He gathered the materials for four Orange Weapons, crafted two of them completely, and forged them.
These two weapons were: [Flumeg’s Sword (Orange)], [Valkyrie Longbow (Orange)].
As for the other Magic Staff and Holy Hammer, due to the lack of key materials, Han Xing planned to deal with them later.
At this moment, a deep blue longsword appeared in Han Xing’s hand.
Faint celestial airs shimmered on its surface.
At the moment the longsword appeared, everyone felt the hair on their skin rise, as if swept by a fierce Sword Qi.
That sound only occurs when a Divine Weapon is unsheathed!
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong, who was mingling with a group of Minotaurs in the territory, seemed also to have spotted that trace of deep blue.
The next moment, he flung the Minotaur brother beside him aside and dashed over instantly.
Then, eagerly gazing at the deep blue longsword in Han Xing’s hand, he asked tremblingly, "Brother Xing, is it completed?"
At this moment, others also gathered around, their eyes filled with curiosity.
Han Xing nodded with a smile, "This longsword has very impressive attributes, even I’m a bit envious."
Hearing Han Xing say this, Cheng Jianyong’s pupils widened, breathing heavily, "Brother Xing, my dear Brother Xing!"
"I, Old Cheng from the countryside, have never seen such a superb weapon in my life, please, let me touch it just once!"
Seeing Cheng Jianyong still acting shamelessly, everyone was somewhat speechless.
But fortunately, everyone was accustomed to his personality.
Then, Han Xing tossed the longsword over to him.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong immediately dropped his expression and leaped up to catch the longsword.
He couldn’t wait to check the attributes of this weapon and instantly exclaimed.
"Whoa!
It’s epic quality again!"
Listening to this, Shen Yun and the others were also a bit surprised.
By now, everyone already knew how difficult it was to craft an epic-quality piece of equipment.
Even with an Orange Blueprint, and abundant resources, one had to bear the pitifully low success rate of Orange Armor crafting.
In recent days, Boundless and Zhou Huang, along with others, have also received top ten rewards.
They spent heavily in the trading channel, purchasing various precious materials in bulk to craft the weapons in their hands as quickly as possible.
However, even with their wealth, a single failure would entail tremendous loss to both of them.
Not to mention, hitting the maximum potential of an Orange Weapon Blueprint with epic quality depended on luck as well.
So, little wonder Cheng Jianyong was so astonished.
[Flumeg’s Sword]’s attributes were extremely powerful, with an attack power reaching over 500 points, and an additional 150 points of Power.
Compared to the Level 30 Golden Armor Cheng Jianyong currently held, Flumeg’s Sword increased actual attack power by over 25%.
Additionally, it came with an epic effect, Star Attraction.
[Star Attraction]: When attacking, there’s a 28.8% chance to draw nearby enemies within ten meters to the front, inflicting 288% physical damage on them.

chapters.title: Chapter 255 - 206: Rebirth and the Marvelous Underground World
paragraphs: ’Star Attraction’ as an epic effect, this damage coefficient doesn’t seem as powerful as imagined.
But it’s important to know that this effect has no cooldown.
In other words, as long as your attack frequency is high enough, theoretically, you can continuously trigger this effect.
Imagine, with Cheng Jianyong’s current attack speed, plus the boost from the [Vim Divine Power Horn], and other triggered effects.
When he wields the [Flumeg’s Sword] and charges into the horde.
The scene created would be incredibly astonishing.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong is holding this exquisitely shaped deep blue longsword, unwilling to let it go, and even wants to equip it on the spot.
However, he is only at level 31, still a while away from level 35.
Even now, Han Xing is only at level 34.
He’s still 1 level away from equipping the other orange weapon he crafted, the [Valkyrie Longbow].
So far, the attributes of these two crafted weapons are quite good.
Everyone also has high expectations for the other two blueprints.
At this time, Han Xing said, "Next, let’s focus on leveling up, strive to reach level 35 as soon as possible, and then everyone can equip the new weapons."
"By then, our strength will increase further."
Upon hearing this, everyone responded one after another.
The powerful orange weapons once again motivated everyone to upgrade!
Xingyu City began to move, drifting around the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Han Xing resumed the previous exploration mode.
Entered the Cloud Sky Island, eliminated the monsters inside, and merged territories.
Because everyone had completed the Third Transformation, compared to before, their strength had greatly improved.
It’s worth mentioning.
This time, Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and others also gained four to five million battle merits.
Since there was no need to exchange for other items.
They used all these battle merits to exchange for Bright Moon Treasure Chests.
Each person opened four to five Bright Moon Treasure Chests.
From them, they obtained a total of eight pieces of orange equipment, plus three golden equipment blueprints, and a War Goddess Statue Construction Plan.
These orange armors significantly boosted their strength.
So now, the Sky Islands they can challenge are getting larger and larger.
A million-square Sky Island is quite common.
Various high-level terrains appeared.
Such as temples in the desert, abandoned ancient battlefields, dark forests hiding banshees, etc.
These Sky Islands all contain background stories.
With the arrival of Han Xing and others, these long-sealed histories are gradually being uncovered.
Everyone fought monsters while enjoying the exploration fun.
In the blink of an eye, five days passed...
In these days, through everyone’s efforts.
The area of Han Xing’s Sky Island expanded several times.
Now, the total area has reached more than forty square kilometers!
The space has become very vast.
Besides the increase in Sky Island area.
During this period.
The relatives’ levels have also started to rise rapidly.
And with the help of Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong and others, they have also established their own Sky Island Territory.
Now, many relatives have already become independent.
Apart from Lanlan and other survivors who signed the Lord Contract.
Other relatives, after completing the First Transformation, chose to start anew.
They also want to have the ability to live independently in this world like everyone else.
Instead of always relying on the help of Han Xing and others.
Everyone supports this idea.
As long as you have an unconquerable heart, it’s equivalent to never growing old.
These relatives have been reborn in this new world.
Especially after experiencing the catastrophe of the Blood Tide, they are more eager to live actively.
At noon.
The massive Xingyu City stopped in front of a gigantic black mountain range.
This mountain range was barren, with no vegetation in sight.
It looked as if it had been scorched by fire, covered in various black soot.
At the foot of the mountain range, there was a deep cave entrance.
A few hours ago, Han Xing and others jumped into the cave one after the other holding Dark Fire Stone Torches.
At this time.
In Xingyu City, Lanlan and others who didn’t participate in the battle suddenly felt the massive mountain range tremble violently.
The next moment, they heard a sound like a volcanic eruption.
Rumble!
At this moment in the depths of the cave.
The five people advanced one by one.
Cheng Jianyong volunteered, saying he wanted to go ahead and scout the way.
Shen Yun followed behind, Han Xing walked in the middle, followed by two girls.
As they went deeper into the cave, everyone was surprised to find.
This passage seemed to have signs of artificial excavation.
Underfoot was a disused railway track, occasionally you could see one or two rusty mine carts.
It turned out to be an abandoned mine shaft!
The five exchanged looks, seeing surprise in each other’s eyes.
The existence of a mine shaft indicated that it might contain rich mineral resources!
And on such a large Sky Island, there was a high probability of producing relatively rare ores!
Cheng Jianyong, walking at the front of the team, excitedly said: "Wow, we’ve discovered a great place again!"
"Do you think we’ll find some treasure in there?"
"What treasure do you want?" Shen Yun asked.
"Of course, an entire vein of Philosopher’s Stone!" Cheng Jianyong said exaggeratedly.
These days, everyone knew that Han Xing was eagerly collecting the material ’Philosopher’s Stone’.
The entire trading channel was almost swept clean by him.
However, this time’s leaderboard reward gave Philosopher’s Stones to the top ten.
Plus, other survivors occasionally stumbled upon some opportunities.

chapters.title: Chapter 256 - 206: Rebirth and the Marvelous Underground World
paragraphs: Through these five days of trading, Han Xing collected a total of 134 Philosopher’s Stones.
Counting his own reserves, he barely reached 241 pieces.
There’s still a long way to go to create the Divine Artifact [Oracle Throne].
Not to mention the even more extravagant demand for [Holy Artifact: Sun Crown Stele].
Everyone knew how precious this material was, after all, it’s one of the main materials for crafting a Divine Artifact.
Shen Yun rolled his eyes and said, "Still talking about a Philosopher’s Stone vein, finding a Purple Gold Ore vein here would already make us rich."
"And I bet a material like the Philosopher’s Stone isn’t something that can just be mined easily."
Cheng Jianyong paused for a moment, "Can’t you mine Philosopher’s Stones?"
"Then how do you get this material?"
Shen Yun shrugged, indicating he didn’t know either.
Cheng Jianyong sighed, "Alright then, without Philosopher’s Stones, wouldn’t mind getting a Sun Treasure Chest!"
Although Cheng Jianyong’s wish was like a dream, everyone still held onto a bit of hope.
Then, as they continued further, they suddenly saw a blaze ahead.
Illuminating the deep mine tunnel.
Then they saw a shocking scene.
At the end of the mine tunnel.
It was a very spacious cave.
And at the bottom of the cave was a pool.
The pool was flowing with scorching lava.
It turned out to be a hidden lava pool deep within the mountain range!
Sizzle... sizzle...
Occasionally, a few pieces of rock would fall into the lava pool below, making a sizzling sound.
"Geez... Is this, did we dig to the earth’s core?" Cheng Jianyong was amazed.
Everyone was also shocked, looking at this magical underground world.
Deep in the mountains, there was such a vast lava pool, truly miraculous.
No wonder, from the outside, the whole range looked as if it had been burned by fire.
The peculiar terrain also produced a variety of rare minerals.
On the edge of the lava pool, everyone could see three or four pieces of stone gleaming green like jade.
And at the top of the cave, they could occasionally see a bit of golden and purple light.
Those were Constant Gold Ore and Purple Gold Ore buried deep within.
Besides those, the natural mine cave also contained many scattered rare minerals.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong pointed to the center of the lava pool, surprised.
"Hey, Brother Xing, look over there, doesn’t it look like Lava Crystal Stones?"
Everyone followed the sound, seeing above the bubbling pool.
On the cave’s ceiling, a couple of glowing red stones could be faintly seen embedded within the crevices.
The stones resembled glowing glass beads, crystal clear, varying in size.
Han Xing thought for a moment, compared it to the materials in his hand, and nodded, "Seems like it."
Everyone was overjoyed.
Lava Crystal Stones are considered advanced materials.
Their uses are also quite broad, able to be enchanted onto equipment to slightly enhance fire element attack damage.
They can also be used in equipment creation, being one of the main materials for crafting Orange Weapon, [Flame Dominator Staff].
But since their drop rate is extremely low, they only appear in extreme environments.
So on the entire trading channel, they are priceless and without a market.
Yet here, they could spot several at a glance.
This signaled a rich reserve of Lava Crystal Stones within the entire mine.
If all could be extracted, it would mean a fortune!
Just when everyone thought they discovered a treasure.
They suddenly felt the ground underneath them tremble violently.
Then they saw the center of the lava pool starting to surge violently.
Blub... blub...
The lava pool bubbled like boiling water, occasionally releasing scalding bubbles.
As if some creature was awakening inside, about to burst out!
Everyone’s expression turned serious, sensing a bad omen.
"Something’s off, let’s retreat." Han Xing immediately ordered.
Then, Han Xing gestured to Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang to go to the front.
The two women understood, turned around, and rushed into the mine tunnel.
Then, Han Xing and Shen Yun followed.
Cheng Jianyong brought up the rear.
Due to the narrow space of the mine tunnel, which barely allowed one adult to pass at a time.
Thus, everyone’s speed was similarly limited.
They hadn’t gone far.
When they suddenly felt the ground underneath them shake more intensely, as if the whole mine tunnel was about to collapse!
And just then, everyone suddenly heard a violent gushing sound from the lava pool behind them.
Wave after wave of scorching heat surged toward them.
Rumble!
After a strong tremor.
They vaguely felt that something extraordinary seemed to have emerged from the lava pool!
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but look back.
The next moment, he cried out, "Holy crap, level 40 Leader Monster!"
"Run!"
At that, everyone didn’t think twice, turning around to flee.
The 40th level Leader Monster was equivalent to a 39th level Lord-level creature.
Additionally, they were in a narrow mine tunnel, an area unsuitable for combat.
For the moment, the five began to frantically find an escape route.
Behind them, the Leader Monster seemed to notice them.
And launched an attack.
A massive magma ball surged forward, brightening up the dark mine tunnel.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong was at the rear, and with low agility, was almost hit directly by the magma ball.
Bang!!!
The magma ball hit Cheng Jianyong’s back, exploding with the sound of a cannonball!
The enormous impact caused Cheng Jianyong to fall flat on his face.
Though, he was clad in top-grade equipment, significantly reducing the damage he received.
However, the attack from the Four-star Leader was not that simple.
After the magma ball exploded, it stuck to Cheng Jianyong’s back, constantly sizzling.
The burning heat penetrated through his armor, continually corroding his body.
Instantly, Cheng Jianyong’s back turned charred black.
Everyone even smelled a savory meat aroma wafting over.
"Hiss..."
Cheng Jianyong sucked in a breath of cold air, feeling the burning pain on his back, he quickly poured an Intermediate Life Secret Elixir into his mouth to heal the wounds.
Although the magma ball didn’t cause as much damage as imagined.
The pain was real!
He didn’t want to endure another magma ball explosion.
Yet, things didn’t go as planned.
The mine tunnel continued to shake.
Just after Cheng Jianyong recovered from his injuries, he suddenly felt waves of heat coming from his back again!
This was a precursor of the creature preparing for an attack.
At this time, his eyes darted around.
Cheng Jianyong suddenly shouted, "Guys, wait a moment, I just saw a huge treasure chest!"
Everyone in the front stopped at his words.
Then they all turned around to look.
Shen Yun asked, "A huge treasure chest, where?"
Cheng Jianyong gestured behind him, at a fork in the mine tunnel, "Over there, inside."
Everyone was skeptical, slowly edging closer.
Yet just as Shen Yun was about to approach Cheng Jianyong.
Cheng Jianyong suddenly grabbed Shen Yun’s armor, yanking him over and kicking him forward.
Shen Yun, suddenly kicked, was a bit confused.
The next moment, Cheng Jianyong shouted, "Brother Xing, the Leader inside is about to attack, run!"
With those words, he started sprinting forward.
Upon hearing this, Han Xing instantly grabbed Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, rushing towards the tunnel exit.
Shen Yun: "I^&%;*"
"Cheng Jianyong, you bastard, I’m going to beat you to a pulp!"
However, seeing this, Cheng Jianyong laughed, "Hahaha, Xiaoyunzi, you’re tough, help block this for me!"
At this moment, the magma ball attacked once more.
Shen Yun looked furious.
Despite that, he immediately cast a Holy Light Shield on himself, holding the Shield of Yellow Sand, steadfastly withstood the fiery impact from behind!
Rumble!
The terrifying heat wave was firmly blocked by Shen Yun.
After the Third Transformation, the Radiant Knight’s constitution doubled once again.
Adding in his formidable equipment, enduring an attack from a Four-star Leader was no difficult task.
Taking advantage of this gap.
Everyone managed to rush out of the tunnel.

Cheng Jianyong sucked in a breath of cold air, feeling the burning pain on his back, he quickly poured an Intermediate Life Secret Elixir into his mouth to heal the wounds.
Although the magma ball didn’t cause as much damage as imagined.
The pain was real!
He didn’t want to endure another magma ball explosion.
Yet, things didn’t go as planned.
The mine tunnel continued to shake.
Just after Cheng Jianyong recovered from his injuries, he suddenly felt waves of heat coming from his back again!
This was a precursor of the creature preparing for an attack.
At this time, his eyes darted around.
Cheng Jianyong suddenly shouted, "Guys, wait a moment, I just saw a huge treasure chest!"
Everyone in the front stopped at his words.
Then they all turned around to look.
Shen Yun asked, "A huge treasure chest, where?"
Cheng Jianyong gestured behind him, at a fork in the mine tunnel, "Over there, inside."
Everyone was skeptical, slowly edging closer.
Yet just as Shen Yun was about to approach Cheng Jianyong.
Cheng Jianyong suddenly grabbed Shen Yun’s armor, yanking him over and kicking him forward.
Shen Yun, suddenly kicked, was a bit confused.
The next moment, Cheng Jianyong shouted, "Brother Xing, the Leader inside is about to attack, run!"
With those words, he started sprinting forward.
Upon hearing this, Han Xing instantly grabbed Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, rushing towards the tunnel exit.
Shen Yun: "I^&%;*"
"Cheng Jianyong, you bastard, I’m going to beat you to a pulp!"
However, seeing this, Cheng Jianyong laughed, "Hahaha, Xiaoyunzi, you’re tough, help block this for me!"
At this moment, the magma ball attacked once more.
Shen Yun looked furious.
Despite that, he immediately cast a Holy Light Shield on himself, holding the Shield of Yellow Sand, steadfastly withstood the fiery impact from behind!
Rumble!
The terrifying heat wave was firmly blocked by Shen Yun.
After the Third Transformation, the Radiant Knight’s constitution doubled once again.
Adding in his formidable equipment, enduring an attack from a Four-star Leader was no difficult task.
Taking advantage of this gap.
Everyone managed to rush out of the tunnel.

chapters.title: Chapter 257 - 207: Magma Worm, Valkyrie’s Fury
paragraphs: At this moment, in Xingyu City, Lanlan and the others saw Han Xing and the team coming out and also breathed a sigh of relief.
However, before they could relax for long.
They suddenly saw the entire mountain range in front of them start to shake wildly.
Boom!
Rumble!
In the shocked eyes of the crowd.
A jet of flames soared from the charred mountain range.
A terrifying creature, over a kilometer long and two meters thick, emitting radiant flames all over its body, burst out from the earth.
When it appeared, it was as if half the sky was illuminated.
Globules of lava, carrying a scorching aura, splattered onto the ground, making hissing sounds.
In front of everyone, the attributes of this creature also appeared.
[Magma Worm: (Four-star Leader Level)]
[Level]: Level 42.
[Attributes]: Power 1532, Agility 1347, Spirit 1754, Constitution 1496.
[Skills]: Molten Rock Shell, Flame Breath, Explosive Flame Spray.
Just the outward appearance of this monster gives off an overwhelmingly shocking vibe!
Plus, its level far exceeds that of the current survivors.
If it were an ordinary survivor team, one encounter might lead to total annihilation.
However, Han Xing and the team have been baptized by the Blood Tide, and their equipment quality has surpassed the current level standards.
Additionally, after everyone’s third transformation, two powerful skills have been newly learned.
Dealing with the four-star leader monster at a higher tier isn’t a difficult task.
The previous retreat was only due to the unfavorable terrain for battle beneath.
If one accidentally falls into a lava pool, it would be a great disaster.
But now, everyone has returned to an open area, entirely unafraid of this four-star leader monster!
From the sky, a great sword descended, carving a huge wound on the Magma Worm’s body.
It was Cheng Jianyong’s attack, ’Sky Sword’.
The next moment, a massive ice spear shot forth, striking the Magma Worm and making hissing sounds.
Han Xing and Su Xiaoyang’s arrow attacks also erupted at this moment.
Puff, puff, puff!
Each attack carried immense lethal power.
The Magma Worm was beaten until its body convulsed constantly, occasionally spitting fiery lava bombs from its mouth.
Snap! Snap, snap!
These lava bombs landed in the mountains, creating large black pits.
And some of the lava bombs fell above Xingyu City.
Blocked by the advanced defense shield, producing a series of explosive sounds.
Ripples appeared on the energy shield.
Han Xing noticed.
The defense value of the shield dropped by more than six thousand points.
Before, he might have panicked.
But now, with the advanced defense shield boasting a hundred thousand defense value, it’s utterly negligible.
At this moment.
Coal Ball flickered, appearing above the head of the Magma Worm.
The next instant, ten Void Spikes erupted.
The Magma Worm’s defense was significantly weakened.
After so many days of cooperation.
When everyone saw Coal Ball appear, they knew what they should do next.
All the while.
Everyone unleashed their burst skills.
In the sky, a meteor with a diameter exceeding five meters and a height over twenty meters descended from the sky, striking fiercely on the massive body of the Magma Worm.
It was Zhang Lianmeng’s newly learned advanced skill after the third transformation, meteor technique.
Boom!
With a dull explosive sound.
The Magma Worm was struck by this giant meteor, its body collapsing to the ground, spraying hot liquid from its mouth.
Though the meteor technique is a fire-based burst skill, weakened by the Magma Worm’s shell.
However, just the terrifying impact of the giant meteor was enough to greatly injure the Magma Worm.
Then, Su Xiaoyang’s Elf Arrow and Cheng Jianyong’s Sword Qi also struck the massive body of the Magma Worm.
Each time the Magma Worm struggled to get up.
It was suppressed back to the ground by Coal Ball and Shen Yun.
Alongside, there was Han Xing occasionally delivering fatal damage.
After being ravaged by everyone.
The Magma Worm perished.
The system prompts appeared.
[Successfully killed ’Magma Worm’, Four-Star Leader-level creature, gained 8.42 million experience points.]
The formidable combat power displayed by the five people left Lanlan and the others watching in shock.
Even such a formidable existence was handled by them as if dealing with ordinary monsters, being ravaged unilaterally.
Moreover, it seemed that these five hadn’t fully showcased their strength.
In full burst mode, just how strong are they?
Everyone couldn’t help but speculate in their hearts.
However, Han Xing and the team didn’t feel much, in these days, they’ve already killed many powerful monsters like the Magma Worm.
Looking at the massive corpse on the ground, Han Xing also skillfully stepped forward.
Then, clicked on decomposition.
The system prompts appeared.
"Decomposition successful: obtained thick skin of fire-based creature*1024, obtained Lava Crystal Stone*72, obtained Magma Worm Heart*1..."
As the entire body was decomposed, the corpse of the Magma Worm vanished.
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
[This Sky Island is currently unclaimed, would you like to merge it?]
"Yes."

[Successfully merged, your territory area has expanded, and you have acquired territory resources: charred black soil, lava pool*1, refined iron ore vein (rich)*1, green jade gemstone ore vein (rich)*1, lava crystal stone ore vein (rich)*1, purple gold ore vein...]
The system gave tips on over a dozen types of ores.
This means that everyone’s speculation was correct.
The mountain indeed contains very rich mineral resources.
Han Xing picked up a few bright red stones from the ground, and there was a hint of joy at the corner of his mouth.
[Lava Crystal Stone]: A stone containing intense power of flame, which seems to be used for embedding into equipment, slightly enhancing fire element damage, and can also be used to craft equipment.
This type of crystal had been introduced before, and its preciousness goes without saying.
Moreover, among the global survivors, the Mage profession was the majority.
Therefore, items like these that can increase magic damage were also sold at extremely high prices.
On the trading channel, a single lava crystal stone even reached over ten thousand spirit cores apiece.
Still, money couldn’t necessarily buy it.
Han Xing initially thought that underneath this Sky Island, there would at most only be dozens of scattered lava crystal stones.
Unexpectedly, he directly obtained a whole ore vein!
If fully mined, at least a thousand ’lava crystal stones’ could be obtained!
For a moment, Han Xing also felt fortunate about his luck.
Of course, not all Sky Islands contain such precious minerals.
This was the most valuable Sky Island they had explored in these five days.
Then, he looked again at the giant mountain in front of him.
The overall area of this mountain was almost equal to that of Han Xing’s Sky Island.
If it were merged, the territory area could expand again by a factor of two.
However, Han Xing felt that the mountain looked charred black and was not very aesthetically pleasing on the Sky Island.
Thus, he chose to merge the mountain at the very bottom of the Sky Island, as a keystone.
Now the entire Sky Island’s area hadn’t changed, but it was visibly thicker by a significant amount.
Its height even exceeded four kilometers!
From afar, everyone could see that this massive Sky Island had a rich geological structure.
The bottom was charred black, containing a huge lava pool.
The middle layers were deep red, which was also valuable mineral resources.
Further up, one could even see a faint gold color.
Currently, Han Xing didn’t plan to mine all the ores from his territory.
After all, as the person with the most resources among global survivors now.
He could just take a round in the trading channel to get what he wanted.
After merging this Sky Island,
Han Xing was also satisfied, looking at his current territory.
Through exploration and expansion over the past few days, various new terrains were constantly appearing above.
Now, Han Xing’s Sky Island looked more and more like a large scenic area.
The overall area already exceeded sixty square kilometers, with all kinds of terrains.
Mountains, forests, lakes, rivers...
And at the center of these primitive landscapes,
There was a brightly lit, luxuriously decorated small town.
Like a modern city suddenly appearing amidst the deep mountains, giving a strong sense of contrast.
If someone accidentally stumbled upon it, they would probably be amazed.
After that, everyone continued to start fighting again.
Five hours later.
Dusk began to fall.
Han Xing also announced that today’s battle was over.
Everyone wore relaxed smiles, beginning to organize the day’s harvest.
After a full day of combat, Han Xing finally leveled up to level 35!
This means he could now equip that brand new orange longbow!
His face showed a look of anticipation.
Then he took out from his backpack a longbow with an overall white jade color, incredibly lightweight.
Next, the attributes of this weapon appeared before him.
[Valkyrie Longbow (Orange) lv35, Quality: Epic, Attack Power: 513~547, Agility+150, Power+100, Hit Rate+20%.]
Attached Effect: Illusion-Breaking (ignores 300 Armor), Night Chasing (increases Movement Speed by 40%), War Instinct (Legendary Effect, reduces all skill cooldowns by 50%)
Note: Legendary Skills’ cooldowns cannot be shortened.

[Valkyrie’s Fury]: Epic Effect, upon activation, skill damage increases by 50%; each attack additionally ignores 50% of the opponent’s armor (for creatures above Legendary Level, the Armor Piercing Effect is halved.)
Effect Duration: 300 seconds, Cooldown: 600 seconds.
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but marvel.
This thing truly deserves the name Valkyrie Longbow.
All the attributes enhance the personal combat capability of a survivor.
Including those effects, all aimed at strengthening damage and improving attributes, each more powerful than the last.
Especially that final Epic Effect, all attacks additionally ignore 50% of the armor!
Han Xing was surprised; it completely ignores armor based on a percentage.
For instance.
Currently, among everyone, Shen Yun had the highest armor, with as much as 842 armor points.
The first Illusion-Breaking effect on the [Valkyrie Longbow] directly ignores 300 armor points, increasing the damage dealt by more than 30% (armor-piercing attributes are not diluted.)
At this moment, Han Xing activated Valkyrie’s Fury again.
It directly reduced Shen Yun’s armor to below 300.
Each of Han Xing’s arrows was nearly a fatal attack!
The actual damage dealt even exceeded 90%!
