chapters.title: Chapter 258 - 208: Interview, All Gods Daily
paragraphs: The key point is that the duration of this epic effect can last up to five minutes, and its cooldown time isn’t long either.
It can be used as a regular effect.
Moreover, Han Xing found out.
When it comes to equipment above level 30, effects become increasingly simple.
Even epic effects mostly apply to survivors.
Just like Han Xing is now using the level 20 Orange Weapon, the two effects of [Ice Burial] are all area damage effects, enhancing clearing abilities.
And all the effects of the [Valkyrie Longbow] lean towards combat effectiveness.
Han Xing joyfully equipped it.
At this moment, he glanced at Su Xiaoyang in the distance.
Being in the same Hunter Profession, she can naturally equip the Valkyrie Longbow as well.
Moreover, because of the profession’s characteristics, Su Xiaoyang is actually more suited to this weapon than he is.
However, because Su Xiaoyang’s current level is only level 32, which is still a bit away from level 35.
And Han Xing has only gathered materials to forge one longbow.
So he’s not in a rush for now.
During this time, Han Xing can slowly collect materials.
He should be able to forge it before Su Xiaoyang reaches level 35.
At this time.
It was getting late at night.
Han Xing was just about to return to the Lord’s Mansion to rest.
When he saw the flashing information in the chat window, it was sent by a friend.
Han Xing was a little surprised, as he only had a few friends.
Who would be messaging him at this time?
Curious, Han Xing opened the private chat message.
He saw the sender’s ID was Tangxin Mumu.
At this moment, a look of realization appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
He remembered this woman.
Around two months ago, at the beginning of entering Sky Island Paradise.
Han Xing obtained an invaluable item from her.
The Chapter of Freedom.
It was precisely with this seal that Han Xing triggered hidden conditions and transitioned to the Wild Ranger!
This profession brought him great combat power.
Tangxin Mumu asked: "Hello Star God, do you remember me?"
Her tone carried a hint of unease, along with some nervousness.
Han Xing replied: "Of course, I remember. Thank you for your seal."
A moment later, the other party slowly replied: "Wonderful, it is truly an honor that the busy Star God remembers this humble lady."
She seemed to have breathed a sigh of relief, with a tone revealing a sense of ease.
Then, there was a moment of silence.
Both seemed unsure of what to say next.
The atmosphere became somewhat awkward.
At this moment, Tangxin Mumu broke the silence first and asked.
"Do you remember the request you once promised this humble lady?"
Han Xing recalled.
He had once said he would accept Tangxin Mumu’s request for an interview.
However, due to various events, it slipped his mind.
He thought Tangxin Mumu would have forgotten by now.
But, surprisingly, she still remembered.
Nevertheless, since it was a promise he made, Han Xing wouldn’t go back on his word.
Thus, he directly replied: "I remember, are you now planning to interview me?"
Tangxin Mumu gently replied: "Yes!"
"Just wondering... if the Star God is available recently, do you have time?"
"Yes."
Han Xing replied concisely, as he hadn’t had anything major happening lately.
Tangxin Mumu’s tone was filled with even more joy upon hearing this.
She happily asked: "That’s wonderful! May I ask if tomorrow is okay?"
That soon?
Han Xing paused for a moment.
However, he still nodded in agreement.
"Sure."
Upon receiving Han Xing’s affirmative answer, Tangxin Mumu breathed a sigh of relief from across the way.
"Great, then could you kindly let me know the teleportation array number on your side?"
"Tomorrow, I’ll come over with my column group friends, please be aware of that, Star God."
"Column group?"
Han Xing was puzzled and then asked: "Is it the All Gods Daily?"
Tangxin Mumu’s tone seemed slightly surprised, "Oh, does Star God know about this column too?"
Han Xing nodded, "Of course, among the global survivors, only your ’All Gods Daily’ and ’Voice of Dust Contract’ are the biggest columns."
Voice of Dust Contract is run by a survivor named Dust Contract.
It mainly focuses on materials related to celebrities and strong figures.
Its founder is named Dust Contract.
He seems to have a wide network, with connections to many leader-level figures.
Even well-known leaders like Dragon Abyss and Anders have promoted Voice of Dust Contract.
This column’s operational style has a very studio-like approach.
They select a few popular figures among survivors.
Then start glorifying them, widely promoting their combat power and contributions to humanity.
Above that, there’s their various achievements and team strength.
Much like the modern entertainment industry model, it quickly gathered a large number of loyal fans.
Moreover, Voice of Dust Contract also helps those major teams post recruitment information.
Until today, daily traffic is astounding.
Compared to the various strength data collection by Voice of Dust Contract.
Gods Daily by Tangxin Mumu pays more attention to the affairs of ordinary survivors.
They occasionally publish survival strategies aimed at ordinary people.
For instance, how to collect moisture from the air and conserve resources.
How to use the characteristics of certain items, like monster venom, sharp fangs, etc., to enhance personal combat power.
And other various life tips.
For a time, it received praise from many ordinary survivors.
Moreover, after the Blood Tide disaster ended,
Tangxin Mumu spent a considerable amount of time, using the combined efforts of the entire column team, to collect countless virtual IDs and real names of the victims.
In addition, they created a separate column listing these victims’ names.
It recorded their ancestral origins on Blue Star, in which battle they died, and what contributions they made to all humanity.
Although it was only a brief few words, it allowed everyone to feel their dedication.
This was a major project, and after nearly five days, they had only gathered information on about ten to twenty million people.
However, Tangxin Mumu promised that no matter how much more time it took, they would definitely continue updating this column.
This brought an unknown amount of popularity to her Gods Times.
Currently, it competes with the Voice of Dust Contract.
At this moment, Tangxin Mumu said with a sincere smile, "The Star God is joking. No matter how high the popularity of our Gods Daily is, it’s not comparable to yours."
"This time, if it weren’t for the Star God, humanity might have been wiped out."
"We all owe you a huge favor!"
Tangxin Mumu’s words carried gratitude, and she was genuinely thankful to Han Xing.
This Blood Tide disaster can be said that Han Xing turned the tide.
Single-handedly, he destroyed hundreds of Evil God Altars.
No one can erase this achievement.
Moreover, when the final Evil God Commander descended, he was the one who bravely intervened, sacrificing himself to stop it.
Of course, other survivors did not know that the final Evil God Commander was not resolved by Han Xing.
Han Xing did not specifically explain either.
Now among the remaining billions of people globally, the most popular survivor is undoubtedly Han Xing.
Countless people desperately want to meet Han Xing, and any information about him would garner a huge number of clicks!
Especially the "Voice of Dust Contract" program group.
They clearly know how terrifying the traffic Star River carries now.
If they could get him to promote their program...
No, even just a brief appearance.
It could elevate "Voice of Dust Contract" to an unprecedented height.
Then, it could surpass "Gods Daily" to become the most popular program globally.
Thus, every time Han Xing appeared on the trading channel, their program group would crazily private message him.
They even offered an Orange Weapon Blueprint as compensation.
Just in hopes of inviting Han Xing to join their program group.
He didn’t even need to do much, just say a few words.
However, he still refused.
After all, he did not lack Orange Weapon Blueprints.
If they offered something like a Philosopher’s Stone or a Shadow Divine Stone, he might consider it.
But clearly, they couldn’t provide that.
And at this time, Tangxin Mumu suddenly found Han Xing,
and brought up the agreement from two months ago.
Han Xing wasn’t sure if she had forgotten or was deliberately waiting.
If it were the latter, then this woman’s foresight and vision are truly a bit frightening.
Han Xing couldn’t help but think about this, then told her his Teleportation Array number.
Amidst Tangxin Mumu’s heartfelt thanks, Han Xing closed the private chat window.
Next day.
Early in the morning, Han Xing told everyone about this matter.
They wouldn’t need to fight today.
Because the people from "Gods Daily" were coming to interview him.
Everyone was momentarily stunned.
"Interview?" Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion.
Han Xing nodded.
This time, everyone found it a bit strange.
After all, they were familiar with Han Xing’s character.
He usually doesn’t interact much with other survivors.
Not to mention, he’s willing to accept interviews from those program groups.
Could there be something more to this?
However, Han Xing did not explain further.
Nor did anyone ask more questions.
Instead, like Han Xing, they casually found a spot in front of a small café beside Xingyu City and sat down.
Speaking of which.
This café was opened by a female Holy Profession in that group of girls led by Lanlan, named Mu Qing.
She seems to have a unique study of coffee.
A few days ago, she found Han Xing, saying she wanted to apply for a shop in Xingyu City to open a small coffee shop.
To add some liveliness to everyone’s monster fighting life.
Without much consideration, Han Xing directly agreed.
After all, the entire Xingyu City was his.
So many shop spaces were empty anyway,
Mu Qing, after getting permission, excitedly chose a location for the shop.
Located on the street closest to Town Square, the third storefront.
After a few days of decoration and arranging,
this small shop was designed to be very beautiful and cozy by her.
Every time people passed by, they could smell the faint aroma of coffee beans wafting out.

sentences.text: The key point is that the duration of this epic effect can last up to five minutes, and its cooldown time isn’t long either.
It can be used as a regular effect.
Moreover, Han Xing found out.
When it comes to equipment above level 30, effects become increasingly simple.
Even epic effects mostly apply to survivors.
Just like Han Xing is now using the level 20 Orange Weapon, the two effects of [Ice Burial] are all area damage effects, enhancing clearing abilities.
And all the effects of the [Valkyrie Longbow] lean towards combat effectiveness.
Han Xing joyfully equipped it.
At this moment, he glanced at Su Xiaoyang in the distance.
Being in the same Hunter Profession, she can naturally equip the Valkyrie Longbow as well.
Moreover, because of the profession’s characteristics, Su Xiaoyang is actually more suited to this weapon than he is.
However, because Su Xiaoyang’s current level is only level 32, which is still a bit away from level 35.
And Han Xing has only gathered materials to forge one longbow.
So he’s not in a rush for now.
During this time, Han Xing can slowly collect materials.
He should be able to forge it before Su Xiaoyang reaches level 35.
At this time.
It was getting late at night.
Han Xing was just about to return to the Lord’s Mansion to rest.
When he saw the flashing information in the chat window, it was sent by a friend.
Han Xing was a little surprised, as he only had a few friends.
Who would be messaging him at this time?
Curious, Han Xing opened the private chat message.
He saw the sender’s ID was Tangxin Mumu.
At this moment, a look of realization appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
He remembered this woman.
Around two months ago, at the beginning of entering Sky Island Paradise.
Han Xing obtained an invaluable item from her.
The Chapter of Freedom.
It was precisely with this seal that Han Xing triggered hidden conditions and transitioned to the Wild Ranger!
This profession brought him great combat power.
Tangxin Mumu asked: "Hello Star God, do you remember me?"
Her tone carried a hint of unease, along with some nervousness.
Han Xing replied: "Of course, I remember.
Thank you for your seal."
A moment later, the other party slowly replied: "Wonderful, it is truly an honor that the busy Star God remembers this humble lady."
She seemed to have breathed a sigh of relief, with a tone revealing a sense of ease.
Then, there was a moment of silence.
Both seemed unsure of what to say next.
The atmosphere became somewhat awkward.
At this moment, Tangxin Mumu broke the silence first and asked.
"Do you remember the request you once promised this humble lady?"
Han Xing recalled.
He had once said he would accept Tangxin Mumu’s request for an interview.
However, due to various events, it slipped his mind.
He thought Tangxin Mumu would have forgotten by now.
But, surprisingly, she still remembered.
Nevertheless, since it was a promise he made, Han Xing wouldn’t go back on his word.
Thus, he directly replied: "I remember, are you now planning to interview me?"
Tangxin Mumu gently replied: "Yes!"
"Just wondering... if the Star God is available recently, do you have time?"
"Yes."
Han Xing replied concisely, as he hadn’t had anything major happening lately.
Tangxin Mumu’s tone was filled with even more joy upon hearing this.
She happily asked: "That’s wonderful!
May I ask if tomorrow is okay?"
That soon?
Han Xing paused for a moment.
However, he still nodded in agreement.
"Sure."
Upon receiving Han Xing’s affirmative answer, Tangxin Mumu breathed a sigh of relief from across the way.
"Great, then could you kindly let me know the teleportation array number on your side?"
"Tomorrow, I’ll come over with my column group friends, please be aware of that, Star God."
"Column group?"
Han Xing was puzzled and then asked: "Is it the All Gods Daily?"
Tangxin Mumu’s tone seemed slightly surprised, "Oh, does Star God know about this column too?"
Han Xing nodded, "Of course, among the global survivors, only your ’All Gods Daily’ and ’Voice of Dust Contract’ are the biggest columns."
Voice of Dust Contract is run by a survivor named Dust Contract.
It mainly focuses on materials related to celebrities and strong figures.
Its founder is named Dust Contract.
He seems to have a wide network, with connections to many leader-level figures.
Even well-known leaders like Dragon Abyss and Anders have promoted Voice of Dust Contract.
This column’s operational style has a very studio-like approach.
They select a few popular figures among survivors.
Then start glorifying them, widely promoting their combat power and contributions to humanity.
Above that, there’s their various achievements and team strength.
Much like the modern entertainment industry model, it quickly gathered a large number of loyal fans.
Moreover, Voice of Dust Contract also helps those major teams post recruitment information.
Until today, daily traffic is astounding.
Compared to the various strength data collection by Voice of Dust Contract.
Gods Daily by Tangxin Mumu pays more attention to the affairs of ordinary survivors.
They occasionally publish survival strategies aimed at ordinary people.
For instance, how to collect moisture from the air and conserve resources.
How to use the characteristics of certain items, like monster venom, sharp fangs, etc., to enhance personal combat power.
And other various life tips.
For a time, it received praise from many ordinary survivors.
Moreover, after the Blood Tide disaster ended,
Tangxin Mumu spent a considerable amount of time, using the combined efforts of the entire column team, to collect countless virtual IDs and real names of the victims.
In addition, they created a separate column listing these victims’ names.
It recorded their ancestral origins on Blue Star, in which battle they died, and what contributions they made to all humanity.
Although it was only a brief few words, it allowed everyone to feel their dedication.
This was a major project, and after nearly five days, they had only gathered information on about ten to twenty million people.
However, Tangxin Mumu promised that no matter how much more time it took, they would definitely continue updating this column.
This brought an unknown amount of popularity to her Gods Times.
Currently, it competes with the Voice of Dust Contract.
At this moment, Tangxin Mumu said with a sincere smile, "The Star God is joking.
No matter how high the popularity of our Gods Daily is, it’s not comparable to yours."
"This time, if it weren’t for the Star God, humanity might have been wiped out."
"We all owe you a huge favor!"
Tangxin Mumu’s words carried gratitude, and she was genuinely thankful to Han Xing.
This Blood Tide disaster can be said that Han Xing turned the tide.
Single-handedly, he destroyed hundreds of Evil God Altars.
No one can erase this achievement.
Moreover, when the final Evil God Commander descended, he was the one who bravely intervened, sacrificing himself to stop it.
Of course, other survivors did not know that the final Evil God Commander was not resolved by Han Xing.
Han Xing did not specifically explain either.
Now among the remaining billions of people globally, the most popular survivor is undoubtedly Han Xing.
Countless people desperately want to meet Han Xing, and any information about him would garner a huge number of clicks!
Especially the "Voice of Dust Contract" program group.
They clearly know how terrifying the traffic Star River carries now.
If they could get him to promote their program...
No, even just a brief appearance.
It could elevate "Voice of Dust Contract" to an unprecedented height.
Then, it could surpass "Gods Daily" to become the most popular program globally.
Thus, every time Han Xing appeared on the trading channel, their program group would crazily private message him.
They even offered an Orange Weapon Blueprint as compensation.
Just in hopes of inviting Han Xing to join their program group.
He didn’t even need to do much, just say a few words.
However, he still refused.
After all, he did not lack Orange Weapon Blueprints.
If they offered something like a Philosopher’s Stone or a Shadow Divine Stone, he might consider it.
But clearly, they couldn’t provide that.
And at this time, Tangxin Mumu suddenly found Han Xing,
and brought up the agreement from two months ago.
Han Xing wasn’t sure if she had forgotten or was deliberately waiting.
If it were the latter, then this woman’s foresight and vision are truly a bit frightening.
Han Xing couldn’t help but think about this, then told her his Teleportation Array number.
Amidst Tangxin Mumu’s heartfelt thanks, Han Xing closed the private chat window.
Next day.
Early in the morning, Han Xing told everyone about this matter.

chapters.title: Chapter 259 - 209: Vision for a Commercial City
paragraphs: Han Xing and the others sat at the entrance of the coffee shop, admiring the shop’s decor.
At this moment.
A young girl with twin buns and wearing an apron pushed open the wooden door and slowly walked out.
Then, she served each person a steaming cup of coffee and silently retreated.
This young girl was Mu Qing, not very talkative, with a somewhat shy personality.
No one paid much attention.
Instead, they skillfully picked up their coffee cups.
A refreshing aroma filled their nostrils.
Making them indulge in the moment.
Everyone took a sip and couldn’t help but praise it.
Cheng Jianyong sighed, "Speaking of which, Mu Qing’s coffee grinding skills are quite impressive. Even in those popular cities, just this craft alone would be enough to make a name."
Shen Yun also nodded, seemingly remembering something, then asked.
"Brother Xing, what do you think about the idea I mentioned earlier, about creating a commercial city?"
Han Xing was stunned for a moment, and he seemed to remember it as well.
Previously, Shen Yun had proposed a suggestion to open Xingyu City to attract a large number of ordinary people to settle, turning it into a commercial city.
Then Han Xing could collect rent from it, without needing to fight, and still acquire a lot of resources every day.
However, at that time, Xingyu City wasn’t very large, and the defense forces weren’t strong.
So the idea was temporarily shelved.
But now, Han Xing could reconsider it.
Although his Sky Island now has tens of kilometers of square area,
most of it is still primitive terrain.
Xingyu City hasn’t expanded much yet. It’s not too big, at most comparable to a town’s size currently.
However, Han Xing now has plenty of resources, plus he has various building blueprints in hand.
In a short time, he could expand Xingyu City’s size by dozens of times.
Now, he could consider Shen Yun’s proposal.
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing said.
"Let’s wait a bit. Right now, we still need to rely on the defense towers on Xingyu City to help with battles, and we can’t fix it in one place."
Shen Yun nodded at this.
Then Cheng Jianyong joked, "Xiaoyunzi, what are you hurrying for?"
"Now, survivors worldwide are busy leveling up and expanding territories, not even considering developing commercially."
"You’re already thinking about retiring with the few store spaces Brother Xing gave you?"
Shen Yun gave him a look, "What do you know? Precisely because others haven’t thought about this yet, it gives us an opportunity."
"You must know, most people’s nature is to like stability. If they can settle somewhere safely, who knows how many will come willingly."
Shen Yun shook his head, "But Brother Xing is right, now isn’t the time to settle down."
"Unless we have the capability to build a large Sky Island in a short time."
Everyone listened, a thoughtful look in their eyes.
Time flew by quickly.
Soon after.
They saw beside the Town Square, a bright light rising from the Intermediate Teleportation Array.
Last time, when Han Xing opened a batch of Golden Treasure Chests,
besides the equipment, he also got a bunch of blueprints.
Among them were various Intermediate Buildings.
For instance, the Intermediate Teleportation Array, Defense Shield, Mid-Level Arrow Tower, etc...
Han Xing had already built the Intermediate Teleportation Array.
Compared to the Basic Teleportation Array, the Intermediate Teleportation Array can teleport ten people simultaneously, and the cooldown period shortens to half an hour.
Now, he still holds a High-Level Teleportation Array blueprint, which can teleport more people and has a shorter cooldown.
However, building a High-Level Teleportation Array requires a key material, ’Void Soul Stone.’
Han Xing hadn’t seen this item in the entire trading channel until now.
So he could only make do with the Intermediate Teleportation Array for now.
At this moment.
They noticed the teleportation array emitting waves of light.
Then, they knew.
The ’All Gods Daily’ people were coming over.
Under the curious gazes of everyone,
after a while.
Several figures appeared.
A total of eight people, both male and female.
Their equipment looked decent.
At least Silver Equipment as a foundation, occasionally noticing one or two pieces of Golden Equipment.
But these weren’t the key points.
The key point was among them, they saw a familiar woman.
This woman had a tall, shapely figure with an alluringly small waist.
A beauty that could capture most people’s attention at a glance.
Before descending into this world, everyone had seen more or less on some short video platforms.
They recognized this woman as the well-known influencer from Xinyang City.
Tangxin Mumu.
It was discovered by everyone.
Compared to what was seen in the video, even after removing various beauty filters, this woman’s appearance and figure are still impeccable.
Across the street.
The people from ’All Gods Daily’ also looked at Han Xing and the others with curiosity.
Several of the survivors were looking around Star City, seemingly very curious about this magnificent town.
However, when they saw the two women standing behind Han Xing.
Regardless of gender, everyone’s gaze was instantly attracted, and they continuously let out soft exclamations.
Indeed, Tangxin Mumu’s figure and appearance were already flawless.
But compared to Zhang Lianmeng’s fiery allure and Su Xiaoyang’s ethereal grace, she was still a notch below.
Tangxin Mumu also noticed Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, a look of surprise flashing in her eyes.
But as an excellent host, she quickly adjusted her mood, placing her gaze on the man with the longbow among the five people.
Even though it was their first meeting, she recognized Han Xing at a glance.
In the next moment, a faint smile appeared on her face, and she softly said, "Star God, hello."
Han Xing nodded, "Hello."
Both sides stepped forward.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun also carried a bit of curiosity for these internet celebrities.
As the two sides drew closer.
At this moment, Tang Mu looked at Han Xing’s face with intense curiosity.
Before this, very few survivors had seen Han Xing.
Even if video clips leaked out, they only showed the might of Star City.
Han Xing’s face could only vaguely be seen from one or two angles.
So everyone was still in the dark about Han Xing’s appearance.
This included Tangxin Mumu as well.
In the unknown night, she had secretly watched those videos countless times.
Imagining Han Xing’s appearance from every angle.
She didn’t know why she was so curious about a man she had never met.
But whenever Han Xing did those astounding things and was praised by the survivors.
It would always make Tangxin Mumu feel a sense of pride.
Because she was a friend of Han Xing’s.
She had never told anyone about this, treating it as her little secret.
However, when she mentioned this yesterday, the entire All Gods Daily team was shocked.
Yet what Tangxin Mumu said next was even more astonishing!
That legendary figure, Star River, was actually going to accept their interview!
And it was happening tomorrow!
For a moment, everyone in the All Gods Daily team was stunned, then wildly ecstatic!
The scene returns to Star City.
At this moment, Tangxin Mumu was the first to speak: "I’ve long admired the Star God’s great name; seeing you today, it truly lives up to the reputation."
"With a dignified and confident aura, sword brows and bright eyes, the Star God is truly a remarkable person."
Tangxin Mumu’s flattering speech made even Han Xing feel a bit embarrassed.
However, the All Gods Daily team members didn’t think Tangxin Mumu was just flattering.
Instead, they fully agreed with her evaluation.
To be fair, Han Xing’s appearance could only be described as above average and would not stand out in a crowd.
But ever since he became a Wild Ranger and completed the Third Transformation, his aura underwent a tremendous change.
So, when Tangxin Mumu said he exuded an imposing aura, she wasn’t being insincere.
Han Xing seemed unable to handle this atmosphere, so he waved his hand and said, "There’s no need for polite words, when do you plan to start this interview?"

Tangxin Mumu seemed unprepared for Han Xing’s directness, paused for a moment, but quickly responded, "This is the situation, Star God, we’d like to discuss conducting the interview in a different way."
"A different way?" Han Xing seemed puzzled.
"Yes."
Tangxin Mumu nodded, "Instead of video recording and editing, we’d like to conduct a live interview face-to-face. What do you think?"
This left not only Han Xing but also others momentarily stunned.
Tangxin Mumu seemed to understand their surprise and quickly explained.
"This is the situation, Star God; before we came over, we received many requests from our fellow companions who wish to see your esteemed presence."
"They are all your ardent fans, myself included."
"Countless survivors worldwide want to witness the Star God’s elegance."
"They also really want to have a close interaction with the idol and savior they cherish."
"Of course, if the Star God doesn’t want to, we can also consider another interview method."
After saying this, Tangxin Mumu looked at Han Xing with some nervousness, seemingly awaiting his answer.
Han Xing thought for a moment.
For a moment, no one spoke.
After a pause, Han Xing nodded and said, "Okay."
Hearing this answer, a bewildered yet uncontrollable joy appeared in Tangxin Mumu’s eyes.
She wasn’t expecting much hope; even she thought the request was somewhat excessive.
After all, what she initially agreed upon with Han Xing was merely a video interview.
Now, it could be said that she unilaterally changed the agreement.
But unexpectedly, Han Xing agreed to this request.
At this moment, Tangxin Mumu’s breathing quickened a bit, looking at Han Xing with eyes full of gratitude.

chapters.title: Chapter 260 - 210: Global Livestream and Sky-High Popularity
paragraphs: Today, Tangxin Mumu was wearing a dark purple form-fitting magic robe, outlining her graceful body curves.
At this moment, she was so excited that her chest heaved violently, her waist swayed lightly, causing the crew members nearby to gulp involuntarily.
However, Han Xing didn’t feel much.
After all, in his team, there were two perfect women whose beauty was not inferior to hers, and in some aspects, even surpassed her.
One of them even maintained a rather close relationship with him.
Next, both sides chatted again for a moment, confirming some details for the livestream interview.
At this point, those working group members breathed a sigh of relief again.
On their first meeting, Han Xing left a very good impression on them.
He wasn’t at all the cold, silent figure they had imagined.
On the contrary, he was quite friendly during the conversation.
Now, the relaxed "All Gods Daily" crew members looked around curiously.
It seemed it was the first time they saw a Survivor build a city of such scale.
Moreover, every detail was impeccable.
Xingyu City was now different from the past.
Thanks to Han Xing’s expansion and re-planning, the overall area of Xingyu City was now three to four times larger than before.
Also, Lanlan and those young girls would often clean the streets and rooms and place flower pots on the balconies when they had nothing to do.
The entire town exuded a style of magic mixed with warmth.
At this time, Tangxin Mumu whispered, "Star God, the livestream interview will officially start at noon. Before that, could my friends here take a tour of your territory?"
"We also want to shoot more materials to prepare for the upcoming promotions and videos."
Han Xing pondered for a moment, there wasn’t really any secret in Xingyu City that needed to be concealed.
After all, his main fighting force, the Minotaur and Wolf Cavalry army, as well as most Defense Towers were outside the city.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Sure."
Tangxin Mumu showed a sincere smile on her face.
Those Survivors who got permission began to wander leisurely around Xingyu City.
From time to time, they glanced at the Goddess Statues in the Town Square.
Every so often, they would also look at the enormous Lord’s Mansion and the Thunderbolt Towers carrying electric currents, continuously exclaiming in amazement.
Time quickly reached noon.
Because Tangxin Mumu and others were creating buzz in the chat channel in advance.
Within the Survivors, word spread from one to ten, then ten to a hundred.
Now, the remaining over three billion people all knew that Star River was about to hold a livestream interview.
At this moment, the "All Gods Daily" column witnessed an unprecedented scale.
Over a billion people flooded the forum, eagerly anticipating the upcoming livestream content.
This level of heat could not be reproduced even on Blue Star.
And all these people came for that man.
That legendary man.
Countless people were eagerly anticipating.
At this moment inside Xingyu City.
Han Xing casually picked a bench in front of Mu Qing’s café to sit down.
The workers from "All Gods Daily" quickly set up the recording equipment, starting to film Han Xing from multiple angles.
Finally, as noon arrived.
The livestream screen turned on.
The viewers saw a somewhat ordinary but acceptable male face appear before them.
This man had a faint smile on his face, and even before he spoke, everyone could feel an extraordinary aura from him.
It was a kind of charisma that was confident yet slightly amiable.
Strong confidence transmitted through the screen into everyone’s hearts.
All viewers realized at this moment, this man must be the Star God.
Instantly, everyone marveled.
However, there were also some disappointed voices among the Survivors.
"So this is what the Star God looks like, although quite handsome, he’s a bit different from what I imagined, boohoo," said a girl’s voice.
Han Xing’s repeated miraculous deeds.
Made countless girls imagine him as one-of-a-kind being, unrivaled in heaven or on earth.
Yet the reality was, Han Xing’s appearance could only be described as ordinary.
However, someone in the chat channel immediately countered, "What nonsense are you spouting, upstairs? This is what true handsomeness is, okay? Much better than those flowery boys!"
Many people agreed with him.
"Exactly, a bunch of people with distorted standards of beauty."
"Exactly, exactly!"
"Hahaha, I admit Star God is handsome, but compared to me, he still falls short!"
"Star God, look at me, look at me, awoooo!"
At this point, Han Xing was also quietly paying attention to the livestream room.
Seeing everyone’s discussion about him, his facial expression remained unchanged.
Then.
The livestream screen switched to Tangxin Mumu.
With a gentle smile, she said softly, "Dear audience, thank you for waiting."
"Seeing is believing. Before this, everyone must have had many fantasies and guesses about Star God."
"To be honest, that includes me as well; I have always greatly admired the Star God."
Tangxin Mumu expressed her admiration openly in front of over a billion people.
However, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang beside her instantly glanced at this woman.
With a slight wariness in their eyes.
Tangxin Mumu sensed two slightly hostile gazes from behind.
The edges of her long eyebrows twitched slightly.
Then, she changed the topic, saying, "So now, let’s ask the Star God to introduce himself for us."
The screen switched back to Han Xing.
The livestream chat was once again filled with a frenzy of scrolling messages.
At this moment, Han Xing spoke up: "Hello everyone, I am Star River."
Tangxin Mumu had a smile on her face, seemingly waiting for Han Xing to continue.
Inside the livestream room, billions of eyes were also eagerly anticipating.
However, after waiting for over ten seconds, Han Xing remained silent.
Tangxin Mumu: "???"
Everyone: "???"
At this moment, Han Xing was also taken aback, wasn’t I supposed to introduce myself?
Besides stating my name, what else could I say?
Everyone seemed to have realized this point.
For a moment, the livestream became somewhat awkward.
Tangxin Mumu hurriedly smoothed over the situation.
"Star God, you sure have a sense of humor, naturally exuding a program effect."
"Leaving combat power aside, even if Star God pursued livestreaming, I bet it would thrive."
"However, with Star God’s strength, starting a livestream to increase popularity isn’t necessary."
Tangxin Mumu awkwardly praised, then deftly redirected the topic to Han Xing’s own strength.
"Everyone knows how mighty Star God is; surely, everyone’s curious about what level Star God has reached now."
"I wonder if Star God could clarify this for us."
This question involved some of Han Xing’s private details, and most people wouldn’t reveal them.
The other Survivors were also very curious.
However, Han Xing didn’t mind.
After a moment, he replied directly, "Level 35."
Upon hearing this number, all the viewers were stunned before a wave of shock kicked in.
At this stage, most Survivors’ levels range between 20 and 25.
Everyone knows that after the Second Transformation,
the Experience required for each level is vast.
Let alone the Third Transformation afterward.
And now, Han Xing is at least ten levels ahead of them.
This gap, even if they don’t sleep and keep leveling up relentlessly,
it’d still take Survivors at least another month to reach this level.
However, it’s only been slightly over two months since global humans arrived at Sky Island Paradise.
Tangxin Mumu was also filled with astonishment.
They knew Han Xing was strong.
But so far, Han Xing’s power had only shown in his territory buildings.
No one expected,
besides these Defense Towers,
Han Xing’s personal strength was also formidable.
Even those from the program crew looked at Han Xing with a bit of reverence in their eyes.
However, Tangxin Mumu had rich hosting experience.
She quickly adjusted her mindset and said, "I didn’t expect, besides powerful territorial strength, Star God’s own level is so high."
"Star God has already surpassed all of us in these aspects."
"As they say, the achiever comes first. Could Star God explain the precautions during the Third Transformation or provide insight into this world’s power?"
The camera switched again.

After a moment of thought, Han Xing slowly said, "There’s nothing particularly noteworthy for the Third Transformation. The advancement requirements are similar to the Second Transformation, requiring completion of a challenge task to gain the Master’s Emblem."
"However, once you complete the Third Transformation, you will receive the title of Master."
In the chat channel, those Survivors seemed very concerned about this title.
They expressed their astonishment one by one.
"Huh? There’s a title?"
"Ha! I’ll soon become a Master! From now on, you can call me Master Ma!"
"I’m Master Liu!"
"I’m Technician Number 18..."
Seeing the chat channel topic once again drifting off track.
Tangxin Mumu quickly diverted the topic: "Oh, I see. After the Third Transformation, you become a Master. What about the levels after the Fourth Transformation; does Star God know about them?"
Han Xing nodded.
Then, he briefly explained the subsequent level divisions to everyone.
After listening to Han Xing’s explanation.
Tangxin Mumu suddenly realized: "Oh, I see. Thank you, Star God, for introducing these titles to us."
"After the Third Transformation is Master, the Fourth is undecided, the Fifth is Legend, and the Sixth is Demigod."
"Even I am hearing this classification for the first time."
The chat channel, which had been off-topic, was redirected once again.
Everyone started actively discussing.
After a few more questions, the atmosphere became increasingly lively.
Everyone realized that Star River wasn’t as aloof as they thought.
On the contrary, he was quite friendly.
He chose to respond directly to most questions from Tangxin Mumu.
Of course, this was related to Tangxin Mumu presenting the script in advance, allowing Han Xing to review it.
Which questions could be answered and which couldn’t were briefly discussed between the two.
This gave everyone the impression of openness and honesty.
Of course, this wasn’t a bad thing.
The image of Han Xing in the minds of the Survivors became fuller.
The atmosphere of this livestream was quite harmonious.
The Survivors watching the livestream learned new knowledge and felt greatly benefited.

chapters.title: Chapter 261 - 211: The Witch Race Saintess’s Request
paragraphs: This live stream, unbeknownst to everyone, has already passed about an hour.
At this moment, Tangxin Mumu cleared her throat.
"Alright, this live stream has been going on for quite a while, and we don’t want to take too much of the Star God’s time."
"Now, I’m going to ask the Star God one final question."
The chat has gradually quieted down.
They all focused on the live stream.
Tangxin Mumu said, "During this time, I believe everyone among the survivors has learned about the history of this world."
"And has heard that our place is called the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
"If that’s so, does this mean there is a bigger world outside?"
"Could the Star God answer this question for us?"
The camera turned to Han Xing.
Han Xing spread his hands and said, "I guess this question doesn’t need me to answer."
"You all should know that besides us humans, there are many other races living in this world; they are the original inhabitants of this world."
"So, outside there must be an even larger world."
"Compared to these places, our Land of the Abandoned Gods is just the outskirts of this world."
Upon receiving Han Xing’s reply, many survivors were astonished.
Not everyone pays attention to the background stories while exploring those Sky Islands, unlike Han Xing and others.
Although, this is a real world.
But because of the existence of the system panel, most people still regard this as a game world.
For them, as long as they can level up and become stronger to obtain powerful equipment.
Those background stories can all be ignored.
At this point, Tangxin Mumu seemed to anticipate this answer as well.
"Is that so? Does the Star God have plans to leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods to explore outside?"
Han Xing thought for a moment, shook his head and said, "I don’t have such plans for now."
He still wants to slowly develop in the Land of the Abandoned Gods until he reaches the Legendary Level before venturing out.
This time, facing the Evil God Commander head-on made him realize.
Without becoming a Legend, all are ants.
Before mastering this level of power, Han Xing no longer dares to underestimate anyone.
The view turned to Tangxin Mumu.
Her face still carried a sweet smile, speaking softly.
"Thank you Star God for cooperating with our interview.
"So, that’s all for this episode of the live stream."
"Next, the All Gods Daily will edit this live stream and also bring some secrets from the Star God’s territory to everyone!"
Tangxin Mumu’s words once again piqued the curiosity in everyone’s hearts.
They are already starting to anticipate Tangxin Mumu releasing the video soon.
However, the secrets she mentioned are nothing more than some basic layouts within Xingyu City.
And occasionally exposed few Thunderbolt Towers.
Han Xing’s real trump cards, naturally, he would not allow them to be known.
Among them, includes the army composed of over one million Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs.
As well as the now numbering 112 Hellfire missile silos.
Amid Tangxin Mumu’s light laughter, this unprecedentedly grand live stream interview concluded.
Then, Tangxin Mumu did not linger.
After the interview ended, she left with the "All Gods Daily" team.
Shen Yun and others watched the direction in which Tangxin Mumu left.
This woman at the end still looked somewhat reluctantly at Han Xing.
Everyone’s expressions were somewhat peculiar.
However, after this live stream, Han Xing’s mysterious veil was unveiled.
Yet, this not only didn’t diminish his popularity.
On the contrary, it gained him more loyal fans.
Next, Han Xing and others resumed their usual routines.
Defeating monsters and leveling up, expanding territories.
But unlike before, no more high-intensity battles into the late night.
Han Xing took more time to focus on building the territory.
After all, the territory now is vast, but it’s full of mountains and lakes everywhere.
So, Han Xing decided to construct more buildings to add a modern touch.
Firstly, Xingyu City’s walls had been dismantled by him.
Then, he leveled the land around it, expanding the scale of Xingyu City.
A large number of houses and buildings sprang up.
The size of Xingyu City also expanded nearly sixfold in a mere two to three days.
From the previous small town size.
Gradually transforming into the size of a small county town.
Now, hosting a million people living here is not difficult.
If like Zhou Huang, fully utilizing every inch of space and compressing everyone’s living areas.
Accommodating several million, even tens of millions, is completely doable.
Today.
It’s the thirteenth day after the formal end of the Blood Tide.
Everyone woke from the Lord’s Mansion as usual, curiously looking at Han Xing.
Because Han Xing said last night that today he was going to do something big.
Everyone didn’t know what the big deal was.
They thought Han Xing was going to make some big move again.
For a moment, everyone’s anticipation was high.
Especially Cheng Jianyong, who hadn’t been able to sleep from excitement since last night.
At this point, he couldn’t contain his curiosity and ran over asking, "Brother Xing, what big deal are we talking about?"
Everyone simultaneously listened attentively.
Han Xing mysteriously smiled and didn’t hold back, directly saying, "Today, I plan to check out the Abyssal Rift."
"Abyssal Rift?"
Upon hearing this name, everyone was a bit surprised.
During the Blood Tide burst, Han Xing heavily collected Abyssal Magic Stones, which also attracted the attention of many survivors to this peculiar place.

chapters.title: Chapter 262 - 211: The Witch Race Saintess’s Request_2
paragraphs: Therefore, many survivors have already entered the Abyssal Rift.
From the information they brought back, we learned.
Some situations about the Abyssal Rift.
It’s a special dungeon area.
Inside, it looks like a world made up of layers of mist.
Upon entering, survivors are randomly placed in a certain area.
Only by defeating all enemies in this area can they proceed to the next scene.
As they progress, the monsters they encounter will become stronger.
However, correspondingly, the materials and equipment these monsters drop are increasingly valuable.
In fact, recently a team of survivors had incredible luck.
While clearing the tenth level area, they picked up three pieces of the Philosopher’s Stone from a leader monster.
According to market price, each Philosopher’s Stone is worth over a million Spirit Cores.
Three pieces amount to three million, enough to buy a piece of Golden Armor with decent attributes.
It’s truly an instant fortune!
However, the Abyssal Rift is equally challenging.
So far.
The team that’s progressed the furthest has reached the sixteenth level area.
That’s the sixteenth level.
According to them.
At this level, 25th-level Lord Creatures have appeared.
Aside from those at the top, ordinary survivors have almost no chance of passing before completing the Third Transformation.
However, for Han Xing and the others, a 25th-level Lord is nothing to be concerned about.
They also want to see what the so-called Abyssal Rift is really like.
Inside, the material like the Philosopher’s Stone can even be found.
Yet, before everyone could begin teleportation.
An unexpected visitor arrived in Xingyu City.
It was a woman.
She seemed to appear out of thin air.
Even the Advanced Defense Shield did not affect her.
Her petite body, yet with nearly two meters long, waterfall-like black hair.
Everyone immediately recognized her.
[Witch Race Saintess]: Wu Ling’Er.
After nearly half a month, Wu Ling’Er reappeared before everyone.
Her presence seemed somewhat elusive, completely lacking the intense oppressive aura from the first meeting.
However, everyone present didn’t dare to underestimate this woman in the slightest.
They had witnessed with their own eyes what terrifying power was contained within her petite body!
Truly, the kind of person who could forcibly push a Legendary-level monster back into the altar.
Yet, today Wu Ling’Er seemed to lack the invincible aura from the first meeting.
Instead, her starry eyes now had a touch of weakness and urgency.
Wu Ling’Er floated in mid-air, slightly tilting her head, looking at Han Xing.
"Human Race, please help me, I need your assistance."
Han Xing: "??? "
Everyone was baffled by her somewhat perplexing statement.
Wu Ling’Er seemed to realize that they had no idea what was happening.
So, she suppressed her anxiety and slowly began to explain.
"You should know, I am not a native resident of the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
Han Xing nodded.
Upon seeing her title, Han Xing knew this woman was from the outside world.
Wu Ling’Er breathed a sigh of relief, as this saved her from a lot of explanation.
"Since that’s the case, you should also know."
"Here, we outsiders are repelled by a mysterious force, our power is continuously diminishing and worsening by the day."
"Only by returning to the Witch Race Territory can this phenomenon be stopped."
Han Xing heard of a new region from her words.
Witch Race Territory.
However, given her status as a Saintess, this was understandable.
At this moment, Han Xing curiously said: "Why not just go back then."
"After all, now that the Blood Tide is over, there are no other Alternate Space creatures here, the human crisis has been resolved."
"You can leave anytime."
However, Wu Ling’Er shook her head.
"It’s not that simple, the Land of the Abandoned Gods is a special place, entering or leaving is extremely difficult."
Han Xing frowned and asked: "Can’t you use the method you came in with that day?"
Wu Ling’Er shook her head again.
"No, you should have seen, I appeared from an Evil God Altar that day."
"These altars were originally teleportation channels established by the Otherworldly Evil Gods to invade the Holy Spirit Realm."
"It took us nearly half a month using some forbidden techniques to find the location of the channels."
"Then, utilizing our tribe’s special teleportation methods, we forcibly entered the Alternate Space, and after another transfer, arrived at the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
"To go back, we would have to use this method again."
At this point, Wu Ling’Er sighed with regret and said.
"But, as you can see, now all the Evil God Altars in the Land of the Abandoned Gods have been destroyed, effectively cutting off all teleportation channels."
"And I, I can no longer go back..."
After listening to Wu Ling’Er’s explanation, everyone seemed to understand something, a look of realization in their eyes.
However, Han Xing keenly caught the information in her words.
Han Xing asked: "You mean the Witch Race had already detected the upcoming Blood Tide crisis here more than half a month ago?"
Wu Ling’Er was taken aback, not expecting Han Xing’s insight to be so sharp.
She had casually mentioned it, yet Han Xing still caught the key information.
Faced with Han Xing’s inquiry.
Wu Ling’Er seemed a bit hesitant.
After a moment, she nodded and frankly admitted.
"In fact, not only the Witch Race knew."
"Other major races, including the Elf Race, Giant Race, and Dwarf Race, also knew about the imminent Blood Tide outbreak in the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
Everyone’s expressions changed drastically.
This sentence contained a lot of information.
Among them was the fact that the powerful races outside the Land of the Abandoned Gods were watching the Blood Tide erupt without doing anything.
So, it seems the external races are not friendly towards humans.
Han Xing frowned and said: "What benefit do these guys get by watching the Blood Tide erupt and exterminating us humans?"
Wu Ling’Er sighed, "There is no benefit."

"If the Blood Tide is allowed to run rampant, the Otherworldly Evil Gods would establish their base in the Land of the Abandoned Gods. It won’t take long before the entire Holy Spirit Realm is impacted."
"It might even trigger a disaster sweeping through the Holy Spirit Realm."
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but ask: "So are these guys just watching?"
"Do they have to wait until we’re all dead to act?"
His tone carried some discontent.
Wu Ling’Er gave him a glance, her eyes showing a hint of regret.
"Actually, it’s not that they don’t want to; they simply can’t."
"In fact, the current Holy Spirit Realm is not as ideal as you imagine."
"Even, the situation outside is more chaotic than the Land of the Abandoned Gods, with major races all being drawn into war."
"War?" Everyone looked puzzled.
Han Xing asked: "Is there a war outside too?"
"Of course, there has always been war, although it’s been rare in the past few hundred years."
"However, after a few hundred years of peace, the Holy Spirit Realm is again facing chaos."
Shen Yun couldn’t help but ask: "What kind of war?"
Wu Ling’Er replied: "The Giant Race and Dwarf Race have formally split over the ownership of a Holy Artifact, both launching a full-scale war, even triggering several divine conflicts."
"The Elf Race’s Holy Tree was destroyed, and the Dark Elf Race is summoning Abyss Demons everywhere, posing threats across the entire Elf Realm."
"Moreover, the minions of the Dark Shadow are wreaking havoc in the Holy Spirit Realm."
"One could say the outside is complete chaos."
After listening, everyone couldn’t help but twitch their lips.
They had originally thought the Land of the Abandoned Gods was chaotic enough.
Yet, Wu Ling’Er’s few words painted a picture of a world seething in chaos.
Han Xing couldn’t help but sigh.
Sure enough, for a civilization, peace is just an accident, while war is the norm.

chapters.title: Chapter 263 - 212: Human Race Secrets That Make Your Skin Crawl...
paragraphs: At this moment, Wu Ling’Er explained again, "Our Witch Race has indeed received news that the Blood Curse has rekindled in the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
"As the ones who caused this trouble, we bear an unshirkable responsibility."
"However, recently outside, the Shadow Legion is concentrating its forces to fully invade our Witch Race Territory."
"Without the support of other strong races, our Witch Race could only barely sustain..."
"This time, my trip to the Land of the Abandoned Gods is indeed a huge risk."
"If our tribe loses a Legend like me and happens to encounter an attack by the Shadow Army, the consequences would be unimaginable!"
After hearing Wu Ling’Er’s explanation,
Han Xing caught onto a key piece of information.
That is, in the outside world, powerhouses of the Legendary level also belong to the top tier of strength.
Even in a large race like the Witch Race, Legendary powerhouses are few.
And this, indeed, made Han Xing breathe a sigh of relief.
He had thought that the outside world had already reached a level where Demigods roam everywhere, and Legends are as common as dogs.
In this light, he wasn’t too far off from those top-tier powerhouses.
After a moment, Han Xing slowly said, "It’s fine."
"We’re not even the same race, there’s really no need to help."
"If us humans go extinct because of this, it’s simply due to bad fortune."
Han Xing spoke very honestly.
His experiences from a young age had cultivated an independent personality.
Therefore, Han Xing did not harbor any resentment for other races not coming to help.
The root of it all is simply that the current Human Race’s power is too weak.
Wu Ling’Er looked deeply at Han Xing, seemingly surprised by his level of understanding.
Han Xing continued, "I’m just curious, what kind of place is the Land of the Abandoned Gods exactly?"
"Why is it that even a powerhouse of your level finds it so difficult to leave after entering?"
Wu Ling’Er seemed to know Han Xing would ask this question.
After a moment, she slowly said, "Regarding the background of the Land of the Abandoned Gods and some related legends of the Human Race, you should all have some degree of understanding."
Han Xing nodded; he had indeed heard some secrets from the NPCs here.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er looked at Han Xing and said, "However, there’s something you might not know."
"I don’t know if it’s appropriate to tell you."
"If you want to hear it, I can tell it."
"However!"
"If it has any impact on you, I will not be responsible."
Hearing such a solemn reminder from Wu Ling’Er, everyone frowned.
What secret is so serious?
Just hearing it would have an impact on everyone?
Although they knew Wu Ling’Er wouldn’t say such things to scare them for no reason,
the curiosity in everyone’s hearts had already been stirred.
At this point, there’s no pulling back.
Han Xing directly said, "Go ahead."
Wu Ling’Er looked at them deeply and then nodded.
After a moment, Wu Ling’Er seemed to be recalling something, a look of nostalgia in her eyes.
"In the records of our Witch Race, the Land of the Abandoned Gods is the origin place of successive generations of the Human Race..."
"Before your batch of humans, countless other batches of humans were born here."
"For tens of thousands of years, almost every so often, a batch of humans with different civilizations and talents would appear out of nowhere here."
"Just like you, they started as a group of weaklings without the strength to truss a chicken."
"But after a period of development, they gradually mastered the powers of this world and then left the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
"As far as we know, before you, there were at least close to...
However, the latter part of Wu Ling’Er’s statement was already unheard by Han Xing.
Just hearing the initial descriptions made him feel like his mind was about to explode!
Damn!
What does this woman mean?
Before Blue Star humans, countless other humans, just like them, suddenly arrived in this world?
What does this signify?
Where did those humans come from, and where did they go?
How many batches of humans died in this process?
Is there someone or some will orchestrating all of this behind the scenes?
It’s simply unimaginable!
Even Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong felt their scalps tingling.
They knew they couldn’t allow Wu Ling’Er to continue speaking.
If she continued, something major would truly happen!
Han Xing quickly interrupted, "Stop! Hurry and stop!"
Wu Ling’Er also ceased her narrative.
Then, she looked at everyone deeply.
"So, do you now understand the mystery of the Land of the Abandoned Gods?"
Everyone nodded with difficulty, and for a moment, all faces turned a bit pale.
Inadvertently, they had heard something extraordinary.
These things even overturned their understanding of this world.
No wonder Wu Ling’Er said that just hearing a few sentences could impact everyone.
Damn, just thinking about it is enough to make one’s hair stand on end, let alone hearing it!
Han Xing’s throat moved with difficulty, as if trying hard to adjust his emotions.
"I understand what you mean."
"The Land of the Abandoned Gods is truly a place beyond imagination..."
"This place likely holds a great secret!"
"A secret about our Human Race..."
Wu Ling’Er nodded in deep agreement.
"Yes, even those high and mighty Divine Spirits are always trying to uncover the secrets here."
Han Xing asked, "Can you tell us why the natives of this world cannot come in, and we cannot get out?"
"I can." Wu Ling’Er replied readily once more.
"Because of space turbulence."
"Space turbulence?"
Wu Ling’Er nodded, "The area of the Land of the Abandoned Gods is quite vast, at your current speed, it would take at least close to a year to explore to the edge of this world."
"Then, you will see, that vast space turbulence, which contains extremely terrifying chaotic Power of Rules."
"Even Legends, and those above the Legendary Level, cannot cross over."
"Moreover, even if there are some unparalleled powerhouses that forcefully arrive at the Land of the Abandoned Gods by other means, they will also be suppressed by the Power of Rules here."
"Over the years, we’ve also come to understand the triggering conditions of this Power of Rules."
"That is, the Land of the Abandoned Gods does not allow Legends, or powers above the Legendary Level, to appear..."
Wu Ling’Er talked a lot, almost without reservation about what Han Xing and others wanted to know.
Han Xing liked this kind of straightforward personality.
Before this, Han Xing hated those who spoke in riddles and left half of the story untold.
Damn it, stuff that could be explained in one sentence, they insist on making others guess exhaustively.
All the Riddlers should be sent to Gotham!
Under Wu Ling’Er’s explanation, Han Xing and the others heard many secrets.
It also gave them a clearer understanding of this world once again.
Han Xing digested this information in his mind, and then slowly asked, "So, you’re essentially trapped in the Land of the Abandoned Gods now?"
Wu Ling’Er nodded.
"Yes, and I can’t stay here too long."
"From the time I entered the Alternate Space Channel until today, it’s been half a month, and I feel the situation of my losing power becoming more and more serious."
"In a few days, I might even fall out of the Legendary Realm!"
There was a trace of fear in Wu Ling’Er’s words.
Falling out of the Legendary Realm is equivalent to dropping from the Divine Realm to a mortal.
And she would no longer be that high and mighty, fierce combat Witch Race Saintess.
At this time, everyone understood why Wu Ling’Er would be willing to lower her status to find Han Xing.
Han Xing seemed to be contemplating whether to agree to this woman’s request.
Wu Ling’Er didn’t rush, but waited silently.
After a moment, Han Xing sighed regretfully and said, "To be honest, if it was within my capability, I would indeed like to help you go back."
"But, even if a powerhouse like you can’t do anything, do you think I, a human with Third Transformation strength, can?"
However, Wu Ling’Er shook her head and said, "No, you can."
"I can?" Han Xing was stunned.
Wu Ling’Er nodded and slowly said a few words.
"Ancient Fireseed."
Han Xing seemed to suddenly remember something and exclaimed, "You mean the Path of the Giant Dragon?"
Listening to their strange conversation, Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and others were at a loss.

Wu Ling’Er revealed a smile at the corner of her mouth, "Yes, throughout generations, for the Human Race to leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods, they all need to pass through the Path of the Giant Dragon."
"However, the Path of the Giant Dragon is not a fixed area; it’s more like a special space field without a fixed position."
"Only by lighting the Ancient Fireseed can you follow the fireseed’s guidance to find the Path of the Giant Dragon."
"And on you, I’ve sensed the aura of this fireseed."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing took something out of his backpack.
Everyone looked at the small cluster of red flame in his hand, their faces filled with doubt.
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing directly threw the Ancient Fireseed to Wu Ling’Er.
Although such fireseed is precious and can only be obtained from the Bright Moon Treasure Chest,
these days, he had collected quite a few.
Including Cheng Jianyong and the others,
each had opened four to five Bright Moon Treasure Chests.
Now, they had about thirty or more Ancient Fireseeds combined.
Giving a few to Wu Ling’Er didn’t matter much.
Wu Ling’Er took the fireseed, but paused.
Then, she shook her head, her long black hair flowing in the wind.
"Giving me the fireseed is useless."
"The Path of the Giant Dragon, apart from the Human Race, even if other race beings possess the Ancient Fireseed, they cannot pass through."
Han Xing frowned and said, "You mean we need to escort you through the Path of the Giant Dragon? All the way back to the Witch Race Territory?"
Wu Ling’Er glanced at everyone, then nodded.
Before Han Xing could speak, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed from the side.
"What the heck! Does that mean, if we escort you back, we have to leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods?"
Others’ faces also changed.
Because so far, they hadn’t even fully explored the Land of the Abandoned Gods yet.

"Yes, even those high and mighty Divine Spirits are always trying to uncover the secrets here."
Han Xing asked, "Can you tell us why the natives of this world cannot come in, and we cannot get out?"
"I can." Wu Ling’Er replied readily once more.
"Because of space turbulence."
"Space turbulence?"
Wu Ling’Er nodded, "The area of the Land of the Abandoned Gods is quite vast, at your current speed, it would take at least close to a year to explore to the edge of this world."
"Then, you will see, that vast space turbulence, which contains extremely terrifying chaotic Power of Rules."
"Even Legends, and those above the Legendary Level, cannot cross over."
"Moreover, even if there are some unparalleled powerhouses that forcefully arrive at the Land of the Abandoned Gods by other means, they will also be suppressed by the Power of Rules here."
"Over the years, we’ve also come to understand the triggering conditions of this Power of Rules."
"That is, the Land of the Abandoned Gods does not allow Legends, or powers above the Legendary Level, to appear..."
Wu Ling’Er talked a lot, almost without reservation about what Han Xing and others wanted to know.
Han Xing liked this kind of straightforward personality.
Before this, Han Xing hated those who spoke in riddles and left half of the story untold.
Damn it, stuff that could be explained in one sentence, they insist on making others guess exhaustively.
All the Riddlers should be sent to Gotham!
Under Wu Ling’Er’s explanation, Han Xing and the others heard many secrets.
It also gave them a clearer understanding of this world once again.
Han Xing digested this information in his mind, and then slowly asked, "So, you’re essentially trapped in the Land of the Abandoned Gods now?"
Wu Ling’Er nodded.
"Yes, and I can’t stay here too long."
"From the time I entered the Alternate Space Channel until today, it’s been half a month, and I feel the situation of my losing power becoming more and more serious."
"In a few days, I might even fall out of the Legendary Realm!"
There was a trace of fear in Wu Ling’Er’s words.
Falling out of the Legendary Realm is equivalent to dropping from the Divine Realm to a mortal.
And she would no longer be that high and mighty, fierce combat Witch Race Saintess.
At this time, everyone understood why Wu Ling’Er would be willing to lower her status to find Han Xing.
Han Xing seemed to be contemplating whether to agree to this woman’s request.
Wu Ling’Er didn’t rush, but waited silently.
After a moment, Han Xing sighed regretfully and said, "To be honest, if it was within my capability, I would indeed like to help you go back."
"But, even if a powerhouse like you can’t do anything, do you think I, a human with Third Transformation strength, can?"
However, Wu Ling’Er shook her head and said, "No, you can."
"I can?" Han Xing was stunned.
Wu Ling’Er nodded and slowly said a few words.
"Ancient Fireseed."
Han Xing seemed to suddenly remember something and exclaimed, "You mean the Path of the Giant Dragon?"
Listening to their strange conversation, Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and others were at a loss.

Wu Ling’Er revealed a smile at the corner of her mouth, "Yes, throughout generations, for the Human Race to leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods, they all need to pass through the Path of the Giant Dragon."
"However, the Path of the Giant Dragon is not a fixed area; it’s more like a special space field without a fixed position."
"Only by lighting the Ancient Fireseed can you follow the fireseed’s guidance to find the Path of the Giant Dragon."
"And on you, I’ve sensed the aura of this fireseed."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing took something out of his backpack.
Everyone looked at the small cluster of red flame in his hand, their faces filled with doubt.
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing directly threw the Ancient Fireseed to Wu Ling’Er.
Although such fireseed is precious and can only be obtained from the Bright Moon Treasure Chest,
these days, he had collected quite a few.
Including Cheng Jianyong and the others,
each had opened four to five Bright Moon Treasure Chests.
Now, they had about thirty or more Ancient Fireseeds combined.
Giving a few to Wu Ling’Er didn’t matter much.
Wu Ling’Er took the fireseed, but paused.
Then, she shook her head, her long black hair flowing in the wind.
"Giving me the fireseed is useless."
"The Path of the Giant Dragon, apart from the Human Race, even if other race beings possess the Ancient Fireseed, they cannot pass through."
Han Xing frowned and said, "You mean we need to escort you through the Path of the Giant Dragon?
All the way back to the Witch Race Territory?"
Wu Ling’Er glanced at everyone, then nodded.
Before Han Xing could speak, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed from the side.
"What the heck!
Does that mean, if we escort you back, we have to leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods?"
Others’ faces also changed.
Because so far, they hadn’t even fully explored the Land of the Abandoned Gods yet.

chapters.title: Chapter 264 - 213: Commissioned Quest, Generous Rewards!
paragraphs: So far, they haven’t even figured out the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
This mysterious and incredibly vast place certainly still hides countless unimaginable opportunities.
Han Xing still plans to continue to advance steadily in the Land of the Abandoned Gods and develop slowly.
Perhaps even hide until reaching the Legendary Level, then find a way to contact the natives of this world.
However, because of Wu Ling’Er’s request, it’s necessary to return to the Witch Race Territory.
This means they will have to leave this place they’ve become familiar with and once again face an unfamiliar world.
For a moment, everyone was somewhat hesitant.
Wu Ling’Er seemed to notice their thoughts and shook her head, saying, "Actually, getting in touch with the outside world sooner is also good for you."
"I see that you already have the power of the Third Transformation."
"If you want to continue developing in the Land of the Abandoned Gods, although you can keep advancing to the Fourth Transformation and even the peak of Tier Four."
"But attempting to break through to the Legend, that’s impossible."
"As I mentioned before, the restrictions of the Land of the Abandoned Gods’ rules ensure you cannot break through to the Legend here."
Everyone was momentarily stunned upon hearing this.
They seemed unaware that breaking through to the so-called Legend had such stipulations.
But thinking about it, this woman probably wouldn’t lie to them.
At this time, Han Xing pondered for a moment and asked, "Do you mean that only by leaving the Land of the Abandoned Gods can you break through to the Legendary Level?"
Wu Ling’Er nodded.
"Yes."
"Legend is a completely different realm compared to below Legend."
"It requires mastering a critical power."
Everyone seemed to be thinking, contemplating something.
Wu Ling’Er continued.
"Actually, compared to the Land of the Abandoned Gods, the outside world is not essentially different."
"We also live on multiple Sky Islands."
"It’s just that compared to the desolation here, we have conquered vast areas, living in a collective survival mode."
"Usually, our main city does not move easily."
"Even if you go to the outside world, I don’t think it would affect you much."
Han Xing was lost in thought.
Because the clustered living mode described by Wu Ling’Er was similar to the suggestion made by Shen Yun.
That is to fix Xingyu City in one place and develop it as the main city for a race.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er swept her gaze over Han Xing’s territory, her pupils slightly moving, and a barely noticeable smile appeared at the corner of her mouth.
"I noticed that your strongest combat strength mainly relies on the Defense Towers in your territory, right?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, is there a problem?"
"There’s no problem," Wu Ling’Er said, "but I know that building such Defense Towers requires an enormous amount of materials."
"Moreover, the more advanced the construction, the more precious the materials needed."
"Some specific materials can’t even be found in the entire Land of the Abandoned Gods."
Han Xing suddenly raised his head, only to see a faint smile on Wu Ling’Er’s face.
The woman was right.
Now, he has two important blueprints that require materials not found anywhere in the trading channels.
Even Han Xing has almost no expectation of manufacturing them in the short term.
However, this woman, as the Witch Race Saintess, naturally knows many secrets.
"Do you mean that we have to leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods to find these materials?" Han Xing asked.
Wu Ling’Er nodded.
"Yes.
"The Sky Islands outside contain various rare mineral veins and treasures beyond count."
"Compared to the Sky Islands within the Land of the Abandoned Gods, the resources are of a much higher grade."
"This includes Black Gold Ore, Spirit Core Ore, Demonized Crystal Ore, and other scarce resources, all can be found."
"If you could go to the outside world, the pace of your development would be much faster."
Previously, Wu Ling’Er had described a Holy Spirit Realm full of wars and chaos.
Now, she presented the allure of the outside world to everyone once more.
For a moment, there was a glimmer of desire in everyone’s eyes.

Wu Ling’Er seemed to notice that Han Xing and the others were already somewhat moved. She took advantage of the opportunity and said, "Besides, if you are willing to escort me out of the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
"I can promise you that once we reach the Witch Race Territory, I will give you additional generous rewards."
When they heard about the rewards, everyone’s eyes lit up.
Is this... a quest?
As gamers, they have a keen sense of mission rewards.
"What rewards?" Han Xing couldn’t help but ask.
Wu Ling’Er glanced at the buildings in Han Xing’s territory and then chuckled, "Ancient Weapon: Demon Elephant War Chariot Blueprint..."
"Additionally, I’ll also give you a thousand Philosopher’s Stones, a thousand Shadow Divine Stones, and ten thousand pieces of Rhythm Black Iron, how about that?"
She knew that Han Xing’s strongest force was the buildings in his territory.
Therefore, she believed that Han Xing would surely understand the value of these items.
Wu Ling’Er was right; at that moment, Han Xing was indeed tempted, and very much so!
Just the Ancient Weapon Blueprint alone was enough to make him take a risk!
Before this, they already knew that any Ancient Weapon contained an overwhelmingly terrifying power!
If he had a blueprint, with Han Xing’s abilities, he could even produce them in batches!
At that time, when combined with his ’Holy Artifact: Sun Crown Stele’.
Perhaps, Han Xing will truly possess the power to deal with legendary creatures!
And now, Wu Ling’Er not only promises to give him a blueprint of an ancient weapon.
She also promises to provide them with thousands of Philosopher’s Stones and Shadow Divine Stones, as well as tens of thousands of Rhythm Black Iron!
These are the materials he urgently needs at present!
Whether it’s crafting the Divine Artifact [Oracle Throne], or building the [Holy Artifact: Sun Crown Stele].
The amount of materials required is quite vast.
At this moment, a system prompt appears.
[Saint Witch Ling’Er has issued you a commission quest, asking for your assistance in leaving the Land of the Abandoned Gods. As a reward, Ling’Er will pay you the corresponding compensation.]
[Quest Reward]: Ancient Weapon: Demon Elephant War Chariot Blueprint*1, Philosopher’s Stone*1000, Shadow Divine Stone*1000, Rhythm Black Iron*10000.
So many materials, except for the Shimmering Terra Stone which is missing.
He can even directly forge that Divine Artifact, [Oracle Throne]!
By then, his strength could soar once again.
At this moment, Han Xing, who originally said he would stay in the Land of the Abandoned Gods until becoming a legend, is completely shaken.
After all, everyone’s base is inside Xingyu City, and Xingyu City can move at any time, so does it make a difference where we are?
What homeland?
Does this have anything to do with us?
Blue Star is gone anyway, damn it!
At this moment, Han Xing and the others chose to look towards ancient weapons!
Han Xing directly clicked accept.
Wu Ling’Er gave a faint smile.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er asked, "Shall we set off now?"
She seemed very eager.
Han Xing thought for a moment, and after confirming he had nothing else to attend to, nodded.
However, before leaving, Han Xing gathered with Cheng Jianyong and others for a small meeting.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong had a look of excitement on his face.
"Brother Xing, are we really going with this Witch Race Saintess, to that Witch Race Territory?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, of course we are going."
"Didn’t you hear her say? If we want to break through to legendary, we must leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
"There is some kind of Power of Rules here, preventing the emergence of power above legendary."
Cheng Jianyong nodded, though there was still some worry on his face.
Han Xing continued, "Moreover, with our current strength, as long as we don’t encounter legendary-level beings, there shouldn’t be any danger."
"I heard her say that even for a great race like the Witch Race, there don’t seem to be many legendary powerhouses."
"So, as long as we don’t make too much of a commotion, there should be no danger."
At this moment, Shen Yun also chimed in, "Yes, and with Brother Xing here, what are you worried about?"
Cheng Jianyong quickly said, "I’m not worried about that, I’m worried about what will happen to our relatives after we leave."
Hearing Cheng Jianyong mention this, everyone was reminded of this concern.
Indeed, they were not like Han Xing.
They all had relatives in this world.
Though they had now chosen to start anew outside of Xingyu City.
But they kept in touch, ready to provide support in case of any situation.
But if... they leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Han Xing saw their concern and shook his head, saying, "You don’t need to worry about this, there are no large-scale wars right now, as long as they are careful, they won’t encounter any danger."
"Moreover, haven’t you exchanged for a Lord Puppet and a dozen or so Leader-level Puppets stationed in their territory?"
"With such a formidable force, even if they come across a survivor squad, there’s no panic."
Everyone nodded in agreement after hearing this.
Once they all came to an agreement, Han Xing returned to Wu Ling’Er’s side.
"We are ready, we can set off now."
"Now, how do we find the Path of the Dragons?"
Wu Ling’Er softly said, "Light the Ancient Fire."
Hearing this, Han Xing took the fire seed from his backpack and directly lit it.
Under everyone’s gaze.
The small flame in Han Xing’s hand grew stronger and turned into a flame about ten centimeters high.
Vaguely, they seemed to hear a dragon’s roar from a great distance.
The red flame began to drift forward slowly, but its speed increased rapidly.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er said, "Follow it."
Hearing this, Han Xing controlled Xingyu City to follow the fire seed drifting into the distance.
However, this small flame seemed slow but moved incredibly fast.
Han Xing proceeded at full speed, maintaining a pace of 5500 kilometers per hour, barely keeping up.
At this speed, the surrounding scenery flew by quickly.
Within just four or five hours, they had traveled tens of thousands of kilometers.
However, the Land of the Abandoned Gods was indeed vast.
According to Wu Ling’Er.
This distance might not even cover one percent of the Land of the Abandoned Gods!
