chapters.title: Chapter 265 - 214: Path of the Giant Dragon and Choices
paragraphs: In the following four days, everyone did nothing but kept following the moving flame.
Along the way, they encountered many survivors.
Now, the Land of the Abandoned Gods has become the main base for the Blue Star people.
Everyone is exploring the Sky Island, developing territories, and enhancing personal strength.
After the last interview and subsequent video release.
Survivors worldwide have been deeply impressed by Han Xing’s territory.
Some people wanted to come up and greet him, but Han Xing was busy rushing and had no time for interchanges.
Besides, their Sky Islands couldn’t keep up with Han Xing’s speed at all.
So they could only watch the back of Xingyu City, admiring the Star God’s aloofness.
Finally, on the seventh day.
They had advanced more than 800,000 kilometers.
Up until now, Han Xing didn’t know where he had arrived.
Since two days ago, they hadn’t encountered any other survivor’s Sky Island.
Following the guidance of the Ancient Fire, they had now arrived in a completely new territory.
The Sky Islands here were completely different from those they had encountered before.
There were no clouds covering them, nor any sign of life.
They were like barren meteors floating in the air.
Like a meteor belt in space.
At this moment, everyone was curiously looking at this strange scene around them.
However, as they were observing these giant meteors.
Wu Ling’Er found Han Xing, frowned and said: "I’ve fallen out of the legendary realm."
Han Xing was startled, "So soon?"
This was bad news because with this, if they encountered any danger next.
Wu Ling’Er wouldn’t be able to exert legendary-level strength to help them.
Wu Ling’Er sighed, "The Land of the Abandoned Gods has a severe exclusion force against us outsiders."
"Typical legends can’t remain here for more than seven days before falling out of the legendary realm."
Han Xing furrowed his brows.
A typical legend can only stay for seven days...
Yet, up to now, Wu Ling’Er had been here for over twenty days and just now fell out of the legendary realm.
This indirectly shows that Wu Ling’Er’s strength is much greater than that of ordinary legendary powerhouses.
"Is there a chance for recovery?" Han Xing furrowed his brows and asked.
Wu Ling’Er slightly nodded, her somewhat youthful features showing a gentle smile.
"Yes, as long as I leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods, using resources from my clan, I can recover quickly."
Everyone was relieved.
At this time, Han Xing asked: "Where are we now? How far is it to the Path of the Giant Dragon?"
Wu Ling’Er listened, lightly tapped her foot, and elegantly flew into the air.
She scanned around them and then slowly descended back to Han Xing’s side.
"Soon, I already sense that some space turbulence has appeared nearby."
"Advancing for another day should bring us close to the edge of the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
Another day?
Everyone was momentarily stunned.
Until now, they had already advanced hundreds of thousands of kilometers, but still hadn’t reached the end of this area.
The vastness of the Land of the Abandoned Gods truly surpassed everyone’s expectations.
Another day passed.
Xingyu City was steadily moving through various rock belts.
The surrounding environment was becoming increasingly hostile.
Strong winds blew, and black fog obscured the sky.
With their level of vision, visibility was less than five kilometers.
The surroundings had changed from the original black to a lifeless grey.
As if all vitality had been drained away.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er spoke.
"Alright, here we must change our mode of movement."
"You must abandon this Sky Island beneath you, at most, only keep a core territory for movement."
Han Xing listened and asked: "What did you say? You want us to abandon our current territory?
Shen Yun and others were also very surprised.
Wu Ling’Er nodded affirmatively.
"Yes, the environment within the Path of the Giant Dragon is too harsh, even I cannot pass safely."
"Only by holding the Ancient Fire Seed, using the protection of its flame, can we avoid being torn apart by the violent forces within."
"And the Ancient Fire Seed only influences an area less than a square meter around you."
"Therefore, if your territory forcibly enters the Path of the Giant Dragon, it may be shredded in an instant."
Han Xing listened and was also momentarily stunned.
After all, territory was his strongest asset.
To abandon his territory and move outside the Land of the Abandoned Gods,
This obviously wasn’t a good choice.
However, Wu Ling’Er seemed to sense his concern.
She softly said: "I’ve seen the scenes of your territory’s buildings in action before."
"Honestly, compared to levels below the legendary realm, this power is indeed quite strong."
"But you know as well, these defense towers can’t really harm us."
"Upon reaching the legendary level, you’ll find that such battle methods become ineffective."
"At our level of existence, we don’t rely on territory for fighting."
"Ultimately, power is internalized."
"Only by mastering all power in your own hands is the true path."
Wu Ling’Er’s eyes revealed confident determination.
Indisputably, Wu Ling’Er’s words made sense.
Yet, Han Xing knew where his advantage lay.
That was his unique Divine-level Talent.
The strength of this talent had been demonstrated during the recent Blood Tide disaster.
He might not be the strongest in individual combat among humans.
But he is certainly the most powerful existence overall.

Along the way, they encountered many survivors.
Now, the Land of the Abandoned Gods has become the main base for the Blue Star people.
Everyone is exploring the Sky Island, developing territories, and enhancing personal strength.
After the last interview and subsequent video release.
Survivors worldwide have been deeply impressed by Han Xing’s territory.
Some people wanted to come up and greet him, but Han Xing was busy rushing and had no time for interchanges.
Besides, their Sky Islands couldn’t keep up with Han Xing’s speed at all.
So they could only watch the back of Xingyu City, admiring the Star God’s aloofness.
Finally, on the seventh day.
They had advanced more than 800,000 kilometers.
Up until now, Han Xing didn’t know where he had arrived.
Since two days ago, they hadn’t encountered any other survivor’s Sky Island.
Following the guidance of the Ancient Fire, they had now arrived in a completely new territory.
The Sky Islands here were completely different from those they had encountered before.
There were no clouds covering them, nor any sign of life.
They were like barren meteors floating in the air.
Like a meteor belt in space.
At this moment, everyone was curiously looking at this strange scene around them.
However, as they were observing these giant meteors.
Wu Ling’Er found Han Xing, frowned and said: "I’ve fallen out of the legendary realm."
Han Xing was startled, "So soon?"
This was bad news because with this, if they encountered any danger next.
Wu Ling’Er wouldn’t be able to exert legendary-level strength to help them.
Wu Ling’Er sighed, "The Land of the Abandoned Gods has a severe exclusion force against us outsiders."
"Typical legends can’t remain here for more than seven days before falling out of the legendary realm."
Han Xing furrowed his brows.
A typical legend can only stay for seven days...
Yet, up to now, Wu Ling’Er had been here for over twenty days and just now fell out of the legendary realm.
This indirectly shows that Wu Ling’Er’s strength is much greater than that of ordinary legendary powerhouses.
"Is there a chance for recovery?" Han Xing furrowed his brows and asked.
Wu Ling’Er slightly nodded, her somewhat youthful features showing a gentle smile.
"Yes, as long as I leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods, using resources from my clan, I can recover quickly."
Everyone was relieved.
At this time, Han Xing asked: "Where are we now?
How far is it to the Path of the Giant Dragon?"
Wu Ling’Er listened, lightly tapped her foot, and elegantly flew into the air.
She scanned around them and then slowly descended back to Han Xing’s side.
"Soon, I already sense that some space turbulence has appeared nearby."
"Advancing for another day should bring us close to the edge of the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
Another day?
Everyone was momentarily stunned.
Until now, they had already advanced hundreds of thousands of kilometers, but still hadn’t reached the end of this area.
The vastness of the Land of the Abandoned Gods truly surpassed everyone’s expectations.
Another day passed.
Xingyu City was steadily moving through various rock belts.
The surrounding environment was becoming increasingly hostile.
Strong winds blew, and black fog obscured the sky.
With their level of vision, visibility was less than five kilometers.
The surroundings had changed from the original black to a lifeless grey.
As if all vitality had been drained away.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er spoke.
"Alright, here we must change our mode of movement."
"You must abandon this Sky Island beneath you, at most, only keep a core territory for movement."
Han Xing listened and asked: "What did you say?
You want us to abandon our current territory?
Shen Yun and others were also very surprised.
Wu Ling’Er nodded affirmatively.
"Yes, the environment within the Path of the Giant Dragon is too harsh, even I cannot pass safely."
"Only by holding the Ancient Fire Seed, using the protection of its flame, can we avoid being torn apart by the violent forces within."
"And the Ancient Fire Seed only influences an area less than a square meter around you."
"Therefore, if your territory forcibly enters the Path of the Giant Dragon, it may be shredded in an instant."
Han Xing listened and was also momentarily stunned.
After all, territory was his strongest asset.
To abandon his territory and move outside the Land of the Abandoned Gods,
This obviously wasn’t a good choice.
However, Wu Ling’Er seemed to sense his concern.
She softly said: "I’ve seen the scenes of your territory’s buildings in action before."
"Honestly, compared to levels below the legendary realm, this power is indeed quite strong."
"But you know as well, these defense towers can’t really harm us."
"Upon reaching the legendary level, you’ll find that such battle methods become ineffective."
"At our level of existence, we don’t rely on territory for fighting."
"Ultimately, power is internalized."
"Only by mastering all power in your own hands is the true path."
Wu Ling’Er’s eyes revealed confident determination.
Indisputably, Wu Ling’Er’s words made sense.
Yet, Han Xing knew where his advantage lay.
That was his unique Divine-level Talent.
The strength of this talent had been demonstrated during the recent Blood Tide disaster.
He might not be the strongest in individual combat among humans.
But he is certainly the most powerful existence overall.

chapters.title: Chapter 266 - 214: Path of the Giant Dragon and Choices
paragraphs: It was precisely by leveraging this talent that he continuously acquired a vast amount of resources.
Then he expanded the defense towers in his territory, enabling him to challenge even stronger enemies.
And obtain even more powerful equipment to amplify himself.
This achieved a virtuous cycle.
Moreover, Han Xing also had a holy artifact blueprint in his hand, which was related to territory structures.
Therefore, Han Xing would never abandon his territory.
At this moment, Han Xing asked, "Once at the Legendary Level, are there no territory structures that can threaten you anymore?"
Wu Ling’Er shook her head, "Of course there are, for example, those ancient weapons."
"Also, the Dwarf Race’s newly launched core technology and the Abyss Race’s top technology, which can pose a deadly threat to Legendary Level warriors."
"However, the cost of these things is too high."
"We need a lot of resources to enhance our strength and can’t manage both sides."
However, Han Xing asked, "Can’t I enhance both at the same time?"
"While crafting ancient weapons to strengthen the territory and improving my own strength."
Wu Ling’Er laughed upon hearing this, "It’s possible, but very difficult."
"These are two different paths, but if you actually succeed."
"You might become the most powerful Legendary Level warrior ever!"
Han Xing nodded at what he heard.
He believed he could do it.
Although, Wu Ling’Er’s words were quite exaggerated.
Han Xing also knew that reaching such a level would require an immense amount of resources.
But don’t forget, Han Xing had billions of humans standing behind him.
With the players’ terrifying ability to collect, no matter how many resources, they could get them.
And Han Xing, as long as he continued to maintain his leading edge and offer something to make the survivors excited.
Could continue to reap enormous benefits from it.
So Han Xing could never give up his advantage and choose the same path as these people.
But now, there was a problem in front of him.
That was, to leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods, he had to abandon the current Xingyu City.
Keep only a few core territories.
It was equivalent to starting over again.
At this time, everyone could see Han Xing’s worry and struggle.
Moments later, Cheng Jianyong said, "Brother Xing, you decide."
"Whether to go or stay, we are all with you."
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang also looked at him firmly.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing shook his head and said, "Let’s go. If we have to abandon it, so be it."
Shen Yun and others were also very surprised to hear this answer.
After all, Xingyu City had been infused with Han Xing’s efforts.
It was also his most powerful tool.
At this moment, saying to abandon it so easily was a bit hard to accept.
However, Han Xing said calmly, "But the abandonment is only temporary.
"At worst, start over elsewhere."
"As Wu Ling’Er also mentioned, the resources outside are much richer compared to the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
"At my pace, reproducing Xingyu City’s scale, or even surpassing it, will not be difficult."
Han Xing was not exaggerating.
Because he not only had divine-level talent but also an advantage that the natives of this world did not have.
Which is the trading function.
No matter how far apart or wherever.
Han Xing could obtain a large amount of materials through the trading function.
So, for him,
It would be quick to rise again.
Don’t forget, this time they were leaving with a few core territories.
They could rebuild the Sky Island at any time.
Besides, there were still large stores of resources in his Xingyu City.
Han Xing had even planned for his future development.
He only needed to leave Xingyu City in the Land of the Abandoned Gods and then leave a few people to manage Xingyu City.
Once Han Xing secured a foothold in the Witch Race Territory, he could quickly transfer all his assets to the new Sky Island.
After a discussion among everyone,
Han Xing decided.
To leave Lanlan and some young girls behind, transferring most of Xingyu City’s permissions to them.
Then, he took Zhang Lianmeng, Su Xiaoyang, and others to head to the Witch Race Territory together.
Going solo wasn’t an option.
If the situation allowed, Han Xing would not even abandon Xingyu City.
Blasting his way through with firepower was his way of fighting!
Under Lanlan’s surprised gaze, Han Xing independently granted her numerous permissions.
Then, he solemnly instructed a few things.
Lanlan became more serious as she listened.
A few minutes later, Han Xing had finished instructing.
The five people stood on a new core territory, holding the Ancient Fire Seed in their hands.
Following the Witch Race Saintess, they entered the Path of the Giant Dragon.
Lanlan and others, following Han Xing’s instructions, slowly maneuvered Xingyu City to move back.
Until they left this space turbulence area.
Only then did Lanlan and the young girls breathe a sigh of relief.
At this time, a few girls couldn’t resist their curiosity and asked, "Sister Lanzhi, what did Lord tell you? It seemed very serious."
Lanlan, with a delicate face, furrowed her brows slightly, shook her head, and said, "Lord opened Xingyu City’s permissions to me, including the resources in the warehouse."
"And he told me to open Xingyu City to other survivors during his absence.
The young girls were all surprised upon hearing this.
They didn’t expect that Han Xing would be so decisive, directly granting Lanlan management authority over Xingyu City.
This indirectly showed Han Xing’s trust in her.
For a moment, the young girls felt a warm feeling in their hearts.
Especially Lanlan, who was deeply moved.
But in truth,
It wasn’t that Han Xing unconditionally trusted these young girls.
It was because he had already signed a Lord Contract with these girls.
With the system’s strict regulations, Han Xing wasn’t worried that they would do anything bad to his territory.
At this time, Lanlan said, "However, the Lord also told me that when capable, I could use the resources in the warehouse to expand Xingyu City’s scale and strive towards commercial development."
Although Han Xing specifically instructed it to be conditional on capacity.
Lanlan made up her mind in her heart to accomplish Han Xing’s instructions well.
At this time, Mu Qing beside her asked, "Sister Lanzhi, the Lord said to develop Xingyu City commercially. In that case, would we have to deal with lots of strangers?"
"Now that the Lord isn’t here, what should we do if troublemakers come?"
The other young girls also showed worry on their faces.
Lanlan shook her head and said, "You don’t have to worry about that."
"Besides opening Xingyu City’s permissions to me, the Lord also opened the permissions of those military units and various defense towers on the territory."
"If troublemakers come, the Minotaurs and Wolf Cavalry will deal with them!"
Upon hearing this, the young girls finally breathed a sigh of relief.
They knew well how formidable Han Xing’s territory strength was.
Even in Han Xing’s absence, those miscreants could not act recklessly.
At this time, they all sighed in relief and said, "That’s great, with the Lord trusting us so much, we will work even harder!"
Lanlan encouraged herself, "That’s right, let’s work hard next. Even if the Lord goes to other places, we can’t slack off!"
"During this period, we have to manage Xingyu City well."
"When the Lord returns, we’ll give him a big surprise!"
The young girls, upon hearing this, also replied excitedly, "Yay!"
At this time, Han Xing and his team of five.
The deeper they penetrated the space turbulence, the more terrifying the surrounding environment became.
Besides the whistling gales, there were also destructive lightning flashes appearing constantly.
Whoosh—Whoosh—
Rumble!
These gales and thunder, carrying destructive power.
The group vaguely saw.
A massive meteorite drifting from somewhere in the distance being hit by a lightning strike, instantly turning to dust.
The gale swept it away, vanishing without a trace in an instant.

chapters.title: Chapter 267 - 215: Giant Dragons Quarrel, Relics Left by the Hunter...
paragraphs: Before entering the Path of the Giant Dragon, Han Xing was worried about other situations inside, so he first put Coal Ball into the Pet Space.
As it turned out, Han Xing’s decision was correct.
As everyone continued to delve deeper into the Path of the Giant Dragon.
The scenery inside grew increasingly terrifying.
Whistling winds and thick fog permeated the air.
Apart from these phenomena.
The surroundings occasionally revealed one or two massive figures, swiftly sweeping past from beneath their feet or above their heads in the mist.
At this moment, they realized Wu Ling’Er hadn’t lied to them.
The Land of the Giant Dragon is quite dangerous.
If it weren’t for the faint light emitted by the Ancient Fire, keeping these terrifying phenomena at bay.
They wouldn’t know how many times they would have died by now, just walking this path.
Not to mention, they also had to bring Xingyu City over.
With their deepening journey, it wasn’t just simple celestial attacks anymore.
They even saw shadows covering the sky and sun.
Each of these shadows was dozens of kilometers long, extraordinarily massive.
Han Xing vaguely caught a glimpse of their appearance.
With wings sprouting from their backs and long horns on their foreheads, their bodies were entirely covered in scales.
Giant Dragons!
The shadows were all just giant dragons.
Among them, Han Xing even saw the silhouette of an old friend.
Shadow Giant Dragon!
However, compared to the one they encountered in the Secret Realm.
This Shadow Giant Dragon was much larger, and its appearance had some subtle differences.
The presence emitted by these giant dragons was astonishing.
Han Xing believed that if they weren’t protected by the Ancient Fire now.
Just the terrifying aura emanating from them would be unbearable.
Even now, Wu Ling’Er remained silent, using the faint light from the Ancient Fire to hide behind Han Xing.
Wu Ling’Er didn’t seem to know why she had to stand on the same territory as Han Xing.
Since the core territory was only one square meter.
It barely accommodated two people standing side by side.
So, Wu Ling’Er inevitably pressed against Han Xing’s back.
Han Xing could feel the warmth emanating from this petite woman.
Her small body seemed to tremble slightly.
Han Xing turned his head and asked, "Are you very scared?"
Wu Ling’Er’s body shuddered, and she shook her head.
"These are not real giant dragons..."
"They are, the souls transformed from those dragons after their death."
"All giant dragons, after their death, come here."
"This place is called the Path of the Giant Dragon, also known as the Giant Dragon Graveyard..."
Upon hearing this name, Han Xing was quite surprised.
However, he understood the reason for Wu Ling’Er’s fear.
Compared to visible enemies, she seemed more afraid of these spiritual bodies.
Just like how we humans fear ghosts.
Even though she was such a powerful woman, she was scared of these things.
Han Xing was also a bit surprised.
At this moment, more and more spectral dragon silhouettes began to spiral in the air.
They all gathered near Han Xing and the others.
Although Wu Ling’Er said these dragons were just souls, existing in the form of spiritual bodies.
Their overwhelming appearance alone was immensely oppressive.
The flapping of their wings brought an onslaught of powerful wind.
Even the glow emitted by the Ancient Fire began to flicker.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er furrowed her brows and said, "Something doesn’t seem right.
"Not right?"
"Mm." Wu Ling’Er responded softly.
"There are too many spectral dragon silhouettes; they seem to be looking for something."
Han Xing was taken aback, "Looking for something, is it because of you?"
Wu Ling’Er shook her head, "It shouldn’t be."
"Centuries ago, I walked the Path of the Giant Dragon once, and there weren’t as many spectral dragon silhouettes nearby."
"Centuries ago?"
Han Xing asked in astonishment, "How old are you now?"
Han Xing blurted out, but immediately regretted the question.
However, Wu Ling’Er didn’t seem to mind and candidly replied.
"According to your human way of counting, I should have been born 742 years ago this year."
Han Xing was stunned.
years old...
How could she look like a fourteen or fifteen-year-old girl...
However, now was not the time to dwell on this.
Because.
Nearby, more and more spectral dragon silhouettes began to gather.
There were Red Flame Giant Dragons burning with fiery red light all over, Frost Giant Dragons covered in frost on their surface, and Green Dragons enveloped in venomous green light.
The next moment, all these dragons turned their heads simultaneously.
They then directed their gaze toward Han Xing.
Oppressed by the gazes of these dragons.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly felt like dozens of giant mountains were pressing down on him.
Even the firelight emitted by the Ancient Fire flickered under the pressure.
The pressure grew increasingly larger.
Han Xing felt it becoming harder and harder to breathe.
He gritted his teeth and said, "Wu Ling’Er, I’m about to falter! Do you have something on you? Quickly take it out!"
Wu Ling’Er, a bit speechless on the side, said, "I think you might be mistaken about something; these dragons aren’t targeting me."
"They’re targeting you, most likely."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing was stunned.
At this point, he saw dozens of enormous eyes, all staring straight at him.
He realized, Wu Ling’Er was telling the truth.
"Ha... haha... so that’s how it is."
Han Xing awkwardly scratched his head.
Then, he hurriedly began to check his backpack.
Han Xing knew he had quite a few treasures on him.
However, he didn’t know exactly what it was that caught the attention of these dragons.
Yet, at this moment, the group of dragons seemed to be in a commotion.
Whoosh—
Several dragons nudged each other.
Their massive bodies clashed like little planets colliding, and sparks flew from the contact of their scales.
Amidst them, a golden giant dragon stood unmoving.
It occasionally looked towards the agitated dragons and then at Han Xing.
Then, Han Xing faintly heard some strange notes.
"Abosav..."
The sound seemed to be coming from the golden dragon.
The other dragons were also uttering various notes constantly.
"Argentorium..."
"Bazaarwasi..."
At this moment, they seemed to be arguing over some issue.
Although Han Xing couldn’t understand, with the help of the system’s translation, he surprisingly grasped the meaning of their words.
"Is it him?"
"This human?"
"Looks like it. He has the aura of Hunter, and the power of that lineage.
"I sensed that Hunter fell this time in the Land of the Abandoned Gods. Should what he left behind be given to this human race?"
"No! He doesn’t have the Celestial Mandate, meaning he is not this generation’s Child of Destiny. Hunter’s things can’t be given to him."
"Why not? He is the one chosen by Hunter and should inherit the will of the Wild Ranger lineage and pass it on!"
"I said no, and it can’t be. This human doesn’t have the Human Emperor’s Destiny and doesn’t deserve such precious things!"
"Hmph! It’s not up to you. These are the conditions set by Hunter, and now, in the entire Holy Spirit Realm, only this person is the heir of that lineage, so this thing can only go to him."
"Is that so? What if I kill this kid?"
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly felt a threat of death.
Among them, he saw a giant dragon with red scales, its murderous gaze instantly locking onto him.
Han Xing’s hair stood on end, his expression slightly changed, and he hurriedly looked around.
But he found that, except for himself, everyone else’s expressions hadn’t changed, and they were instead a bit confused.
Han Xing’s heart stirred.
So... it seemed like only he could hear these dragons’ conversations?
And perhaps, because of something Hunter left here, it was causing these dragons to quarrel.
Under the dragon’s murderous intent, Han Xing was constantly under extreme pressure.
Cold sweat continued to drip down.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er seemed to notice something was wrong with Han Xing.
She gently tugged on Han Xing’s sleeve, "What’s wrong with you?"
Han Xing forced a smile and glanced at her.
At this moment, a green dragon blocked the red dragon’s view.
"Nelos, you’re as domineering as ever, that belongs to Hunter!"
Han Xing immediately felt the pressure on his body lighten.
In the air, the red dragon turned its head and said coldly, "Surmos, indeed that belongs to Hunter."
"But this time, he actually died in the Land of the Abandoned Gods to protect those weak humans, his brain must have been eaten by Beastmen!"
From their conversation, Han Xing learned some key information.
That is, the Wild Ranger Spirit is already dead.
Han Xing knew that their death was likely related to a previous commission of his.
At this moment, a trace of sadness emerged from Han Xing’s heart.
From a young age, he had never felt this emotion.
Though he had only met the Wild Ranger Spirit once.
But now, hearing of his death felt like an old friend, long absent, had suddenly departed.
At this time, the red dragon and green dragon in the air continued their argument.
Dozens of other dragons were also watching their quarrel.
"Hunter, utterly foolish!"
"He clearly had a chance to revive, yet chose to dissipate his soul to save these ants, a waste of effort!"
"This makes me seriously doubt his judgment, his chosen successor can’t bear the great responsibility!"
The roaring winds, the whispering dragons...
Except for Han Xing, everyone else, including Wu Ling’Er, was utterly confused.
They didn’t know why these dragons were blocking their way.
They only knew that if this situation continued, it wouldn’t be good.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly spoke up, "Hey, you called Nelos, right?"
Hearing Han Xing call its name.
In the air, the red dragon’s projection that was arguing with the green dragon suddenly looked over.
A pair of enormous, furious dragon eyes instantly locked onto Han Xing.
"Human race, are you calling me?"
In the air, the normal dragons quieted down.
Even Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun beside him were extremely bewildered.
But they sharply sensed that something unexpected might have happened without their knowledge.
At this moment, Han Xing nodded.
In the air, the red dragon blew out a breath of hot air from its nose,
"Human race, what do you want to say?"

sentences.text: Before entering the Path of the Giant Dragon, Han Xing was worried about other situations inside, so he first put Coal Ball into the Pet Space.
As it turned out, Han Xing’s decision was correct.
As everyone continued to delve deeper into the Path of the Giant Dragon.
The scenery inside grew increasingly terrifying.
Whistling winds and thick fog permeated the air.
Apart from these phenomena.
The surroundings occasionally revealed one or two massive figures, swiftly sweeping past from beneath their feet or above their heads in the mist.
At this moment, they realized Wu Ling’Er hadn’t lied to them.
The Land of the Giant Dragon is quite dangerous.
If it weren’t for the faint light emitted by the Ancient Fire, keeping these terrifying phenomena at bay.
They wouldn’t know how many times they would have died by now, just walking this path.
Not to mention, they also had to bring Xingyu City over.
With their deepening journey, it wasn’t just simple celestial attacks anymore.
They even saw shadows covering the sky and sun.
Each of these shadows was dozens of kilometers long, extraordinarily massive.
Han Xing vaguely caught a glimpse of their appearance.
With wings sprouting from their backs and long horns on their foreheads, their bodies were entirely covered in scales.
Giant Dragons!
The shadows were all just giant dragons.
Among them, Han Xing even saw the silhouette of an old friend.
Shadow Giant Dragon!
However, compared to the one they encountered in the Secret Realm.
This Shadow Giant Dragon was much larger, and its appearance had some subtle differences.
The presence emitted by these giant dragons was astonishing.
Han Xing believed that if they weren’t protected by the Ancient Fire now.
Just the terrifying aura emanating from them would be unbearable.
Even now, Wu Ling’Er remained silent, using the faint light from the Ancient Fire to hide behind Han Xing.
Wu Ling’Er didn’t seem to know why she had to stand on the same territory as Han Xing.
Since the core territory was only one square meter.
It barely accommodated two people standing side by side.
So, Wu Ling’Er inevitably pressed against Han Xing’s back.
Han Xing could feel the warmth emanating from this petite woman.
Her small body seemed to tremble slightly.
Han Xing turned his head and asked, "Are you very scared?"
Wu Ling’Er’s body shuddered, and she shook her head.
"These are not real giant dragons..."
"They are, the souls transformed from those dragons after their death."
"All giant dragons, after their death, come here."
"This place is called the Path of the Giant Dragon, also known as the Giant Dragon Graveyard..."
Upon hearing this name, Han Xing was quite surprised.
However, he understood the reason for Wu Ling’Er’s fear.
Compared to visible enemies, she seemed more afraid of these spiritual bodies.
Just like how we humans fear ghosts.
Even though she was such a powerful woman, she was scared of these things.
Han Xing was also a bit surprised.
At this moment, more and more spectral dragon silhouettes began to spiral in the air.
They all gathered near Han Xing and the others.
Although Wu Ling’Er said these dragons were just souls, existing in the form of spiritual bodies.
Their overwhelming appearance alone was immensely oppressive.
The flapping of their wings brought an onslaught of powerful wind.
Even the glow emitted by the Ancient Fire began to flicker.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er furrowed her brows and said, "Something doesn’t seem right.
"Not right?"
"Mm." Wu Ling’Er responded softly.
"There are too many spectral dragon silhouettes; they seem to be looking for something."
Han Xing was taken aback, "Looking for something, is it because of you?"
Wu Ling’Er shook her head, "It shouldn’t be."
"Centuries ago, I walked the Path of the Giant Dragon once, and there weren’t as many spectral dragon silhouettes nearby."
"Centuries ago?"
Han Xing asked in astonishment, "How old are you now?"
Han Xing blurted out, but immediately regretted the question.
However, Wu Ling’Er didn’t seem to mind and candidly replied.
"According to your human way of counting, I should have been born 742 years ago this year."
Han Xing was stunned.
years old...
How could she look like a fourteen or fifteen-year-old girl...
However, now was not the time to dwell on this.
Because.
Nearby, more and more spectral dragon silhouettes began to gather.
There were Red Flame Giant Dragons burning with fiery red light all over, Frost Giant Dragons covered in frost on their surface, and Green Dragons enveloped in venomous green light.
The next moment, all these dragons turned their heads simultaneously.
They then directed their gaze toward Han Xing.
Oppressed by the gazes of these dragons.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly felt like dozens of giant mountains were pressing down on him.
Even the firelight emitted by the Ancient Fire flickered under the pressure.
The pressure grew increasingly larger.
Han Xing felt it becoming harder and harder to breathe.
He gritted his teeth and said, "Wu Ling’Er, I’m about to falter!
Do you have something on you?
Quickly take it out!"
Wu Ling’Er, a bit speechless on the side, said, "I think you might be mistaken about something; these dragons aren’t targeting me."
"They’re targeting you, most likely."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing was stunned.
At this point, he saw dozens of enormous eyes, all staring straight at him.
He realized, Wu Ling’Er was telling the truth.
"Ha... haha... so that’s how it is."
Han Xing awkwardly scratched his head.
Then, he hurriedly began to check his backpack.
Han Xing knew he had quite a few treasures on him.
However, he didn’t know exactly what it was that caught the attention of these dragons.
Yet, at this moment, the group of dragons seemed to be in a commotion.
Whoosh—
Several dragons nudged each other.
Their massive bodies clashed like little planets colliding, and sparks flew from the contact of their scales.
Amidst them, a golden giant dragon stood unmoving.
It occasionally looked towards the agitated dragons and then at Han Xing.
Then, Han Xing faintly heard some strange notes.
"Abosav..."
The sound seemed to be coming from the golden dragon.
The other dragons were also uttering various notes constantly.
"Argentorium..."
"Bazaarwasi..."
At this moment, they seemed to be arguing over some issue.
Although Han Xing couldn’t understand, with the help of the system’s translation, he surprisingly grasped the meaning of their words.
"Is it him?"
"This human?"
"Looks like it.
He has the aura of Hunter, and the power of that lineage.
"I sensed that Hunter fell this time in the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Should what he left behind be given to this human race?"
"No!
He doesn’t have the Celestial Mandate, meaning he is not this generation’s Child of Destiny.
Hunter’s things can’t be given to him."
"Why not?
He is the one chosen by Hunter and should inherit the will of the Wild Ranger lineage and pass it on!"
"I said no, and it can’t be.
This human doesn’t have the Human Emperor’s Destiny and doesn’t deserve such precious things!"
"Hmph!
It’s not up to you.
These are the conditions set by Hunter, and now, in the entire Holy Spirit Realm, only this person is the heir of that lineage, so this thing can only go to him."
"Is that so?
What if I kill this kid?"
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly felt a threat of death.
Among them, he saw a giant dragon with red scales, its murderous gaze instantly locking onto him.
Han Xing’s hair stood on end, his expression slightly changed, and he hurriedly looked around.
But he found that, except for himself, everyone else’s expressions hadn’t changed, and they were instead a bit confused.
Han Xing’s heart stirred.
So... it seemed like only he could hear these dragons’ conversations?
And perhaps, because of something Hunter left here, it was causing these dragons to quarrel.
Under the dragon’s murderous intent, Han Xing was constantly under extreme pressure.
Cold sweat continued to drip down.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er seemed to notice something was wrong with Han Xing.
She gently tugged on Han Xing’s sleeve, "What’s wrong with you?"
Han Xing forced a smile and glanced at her.
At this moment, a green dragon blocked the red dragon’s view.
"Nelos, you’re as domineering as ever, that belongs to Hunter!"
Han Xing immediately felt the pressure on his body lighten.
In the air, the red dragon turned its head and said coldly, "Surmos, indeed that belongs to Hunter."
"But this time, he actually died in the Land of the Abandoned Gods to protect those weak humans, his brain must have been eaten by Beastmen!"
From their conversation, Han Xing learned some key information.
That is, the Wild Ranger Spirit is already dead.
Han Xing knew that their death was likely related to a previous commission of his.
At this moment, a trace of sadness emerged from Han Xing’s heart.
From a young age, he had never felt this emotion.
Though he had only met the Wild Ranger Spirit once.
But now, hearing of his death felt like an old friend, long absent, had suddenly departed.
At this time, the red dragon and green dragon in the air continued their argument.
Dozens of other dragons were also watching their quarrel.
"Hunter, utterly foolish!"
"He clearly had a chance to revive, yet chose to dissipate his soul to save these ants, a waste of effort!"
"This makes me seriously doubt his judgment, his chosen successor can’t bear the great responsibility!"
The roaring winds, the whispering dragons...
Except for Han Xing, everyone else, including Wu Ling’Er, was utterly confused.
They didn’t know why these dragons were blocking their way.
They only knew that if this situation continued, it wouldn’t be good.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly spoke up, "Hey, you called Nelos, right?"
Hearing Han Xing call its name.
In the air, the red dragon’s projection that was arguing with the green dragon suddenly looked over.
A pair of enormous, furious dragon eyes instantly locked onto Han Xing.
"Human race, are you calling me?"
In the air, the normal dragons quieted down.
Even Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun beside him were extremely bewildered.
But they sharply sensed that something unexpected might have happened without their knowledge.
At this moment, Han Xing nodded.
In the air, the red dragon blew out a breath of hot air from its nose,
"Human race, what do you want to say?"

chapters.title: Chapter 268 - 216: Ultimate Skill - Sunfall Arrow
paragraphs: "Human, what do you want to say?" The red dragon Nelos asked at this moment.
Han Xing slowly spoke, "Can you tell me what the Wild Ranger Spirit, also known as Hunter, left me in the end?"
In the air, Nelos snorted coldly, seemingly very angry at Han Xing for directly calling his name.
It opened its mouth like flames, spitting out a few notes.
"Weakling, unworthy to know."
Han Xing sighed regretfully, "I see..."
"Then I’ll personally come to get it when I become stronger in the future."
"However, I must remind you, insulting a deceased person behind their back is not a mark of a true strong being."
His tone was very calm.
However, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, who understood Han Xing, could hear a deeply hidden trace of anger in his tone...
The Wild Ranger Spirit, as Han Xing’s guide, is theoretically his teacher too.
However, the other party is dead, already dissipated, yet still insulted by this giant dragon.
If it weren’t for the lack of strength, Han Xing would’ve wanted to flip the table and take down this irritable red dragon right on the spot!
The dragons were silent.
In the air, the flames on the red dragon’s body suddenly surged greatly.
Han Xing felt a strong sense of killing intent and oppression.
"Lowly human, were you provoking me just now?"
Han Xing felt a wave of fire rushing towards him.
Wu Ling’Er noticed something was wrong, flashed, and instantly stood in front of Han Xing.
The deep blue secret patterns suddenly solidified.
However, Wu Ling’Er, who had already fallen from the Legendary Realm, couldn’t stop that terrifying flame at all.
The red giant dragon in the air snorted coldly.
In the next moment, Wu Ling’Er watched helplessly as the flame penetrated her body and then struck Han Xing.
Han Xing suddenly felt his blood ignite instantly.
At the same time, a terrible burning sensation spread throughout his body.
The system prompt appeared.
"You are under the Flame of Soul Burning from the fire dragon Nelos, reducing life limit by 50% for one hour."
Han Xing’s face turned pale, and the massive loss of life force made him feel like he was about to faint.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er quickly infused a soothing energy into him.
Han Xing regained consciousness instantly, and then a mouthful of blood flowed from his lips.
At this moment, the faces of everyone changed dramatically.
They were just about to take action when they saw Han Xing wave his hand, stopping them.
Wu Ling’Er looked at Han Xing and then at the red dragon in the air; a hint of killing intent appeared in her eyes too.
The blue energy in her body burst forth, and her black hair danced like living snakes!
This was a sign that she was angry.
In the air, Nelos disdainfully said, "Witch Race Saintess, I advise you not to provoke me."
"Don’t say that you have already fallen from the Legendary, even in your prime you were not my match."
Wu Ling’Er sneered, fearless. "As a demigod-level giant dragon, you still take issue with a third transformation human race, and even make a move on him, don’t you feel ashamed to speak of it?"
Nelos remained unmoved, "Make no mistake, it was this human who provoked me first."
"I merely imposed a light punishment on him."
At this time, Han Xing swallowed the blood at the back of his throat.
He gently patted Wu Ling’Er’s shoulder, indicating that she needn’t argue any further.
Han Xing cast a deep look at the red dragon in the air.
"If you take this reminder as a provocation, then let it be my fault."
"I apologize to the esteemed Lord Long here."
Han Xing squeezed out a forced smile on his pale face.
However, everyone noticed his tightly clenched fists, even beginning to tremble slightly.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun understood Han Xing well.
They recognized that in this state, Han Xing was forcefully suppressing the anger in his heart, showing no outward signs.
As Nelos said, he’s just a weakling at the moment.
Weaklings do not have the right to make demands of the strong.
However, Nelos in the air, seeing Han Xing’s smile, faintly felt a chill within it.
"Human, are you threatening the great Dragon Race?"
A burst of heat suddenly puffed out from its nostrils, and the next moment, it was about to pounce on Han Xing.
At this moment, the silhouette of a green giant dragon blocked it and angrily said, "Enough, Nelos!"
"What this human said is correct, Hunter is already dead, it was never honorable to insult him behind his back."

"If you have the guts, go to the Supreme Hall and curse him there. There’re still more than a dozen Heroic Spirits present; targeting someone who’s not even a Fourth Transformation weakling in this place, what’s the point?"
Beside them, a purple dragon also agreed.
"That’s right! If you actually kill their lineage’s inheritor, let’s see if you can withstand their lineage’s wrath."
In the air, the red dragon coldly snorted, "What revenge could they bring, they are already dead once, who knows which is stronger?"
However, despite saying this, the irritable red dragon didn’t prepare to act against Han Xing again.
At this point, Han Xing still wore a smile on his face, "Dear Lords Long, since you don’t want to give me Hunter’s things, how about letting us pass for now?"
"Otherwise, keeping me here isn’t doing any good either."
In the air, there was a stir among the dragons.
The giant dragon, which subtly exudes an aura of a king and is covered entirely in golden scales, stepped out from the crowd.
It looked at Han Xing and suddenly spoke.
"Human, I can let you leave, but before that, will you answer one more question for me?"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing pondered for a moment.
He did not agree immediately but instead asked, "If my answer is not satisfactory, what will you do to me?"
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong and the others could clearly decipher the implication in Han Xing’s words.
This golden giant dragon is very likely the leader of these dragons.
If the answer were wrong, there’s a possibility these giant dragons might make a move on him.
Cheng Jianyong and the others frowned, each remaining vigilant.
Even Wu Ling’Er, who was cowering behind Han Xing, couldn’t help but clench her fists.
The atmosphere suddenly became tense.
In the air, the golden dragon seemed surprised by Han Xing’s question, falling into hesitation.
A moment later.
The golden dragon slowly said, "Even if you answer incorrectly, I won’t do anything to you."
"Just consider it a small inquiry from me."
Hearing this, Han Xing knew.
He was no longer in mortal danger.
These giant dragons wouldn’t harm him.
Without hesitation, Han Xing replied, "Alright, then ask your question."
The golden dragon slowly said, "Do you think it’s right for the strong to protect the weak?"
Upon hearing this question, Han Xing’s brow slightly twitched.
He knew this was the golden giant dragon borrowing this question.
To probe Han Xing’s stance on the sacrifice made by the Wild Ranger to save the Human Race.
As a beneficiary, Han Xing should acknowledge the Wild Ranger’s actions.
However, he candidly stated.
"Of course, it’s not a given."
"Strength is something acquired through one’s efforts."
"It doesn’t mean sacrificing oneself to save more lives is the correct choice."
"So, all of humanity owes a great debt to the Hunter, especially myself."
Regarding Han Xing’s response, the golden dragon didn’t seem surprised.
A moment later, it continued to ask, "If your own tribe were in crisis, would you be willing to step forward?"
Han Xing pondered for a bit and replied, "If the strength I received was in response to feedback from my tribe, then I would step in."
"However, in an impossible situation, I would still carefully consider."
Hearing this response, both the golden dragon and the other giant dragons seemed a bit surprised by Han Xing’s frankness.
However, the golden dragon did not pursue the matter further.
"Very well, your answer is acceptable, the stuff from the Hunter shall be given to you."
The next moment.
Two balls of golden light emerged from the golden dragon.
Everyone squinted, unable to discern what was inside.
Han Xing reached out to catch them, and in the next instant, these two items appeared directly in his bag.
The next moment, a system notification emerged.
[You have obtained, Skill Book: [Ultimate Skill - Sun-Destroying Arrow], Natural Divine Format *1.]
After hearing the system notification, Han Xing’s eyes immediately filled with intense surprise.
Just by their names, he could tell these items were extraordinary.
And of great significance!
Han Xing, somewhat breathless, clicked on the attributes of the first skill book.
[Ultimate Skill - Sunfall Arrow]: Demigod level skill, gathers the solar power drifting between heaven and earth, fires an Arrow of Destruction, inflicting terrifying explosive damage on enemies.

Ignores all defenses when dealing full damage to enemies below the demigod level, permanently reducing the hit enemy’s life value by 20%, with a damage coefficient of 5000%, damage range: agility * 100 meters.

Note: This skill is a demigod level skill, and severe side effects will occur if used below demigod level. Every time it is used, all attributes permanently decrease by 100 points, and the user falls into a day of weakness.
At this moment, Han Xing looked solemnly at the red skill book in his hand, involuntarily gasping!
This is the terror of an ultimate skill?
Even for someone like him right now, it could inflict terrifying damage on legendary level beings!
He must note, he is only at level 35, equivalent to the third transformation strength in this world!
But with this skill, he could even harm divine spirits with a mortal body!
Although, after firing this arrow, there are terrifying side effects.
Nevertheless, this means he now has an extremely formidable trump card.
A skill so defying of the heavens, truly deserving of the term ultimate skill!
Han Xing took a deep breath, then looked at the other item left behind for him by the Wild Ranger Spirit.

[Natural Divine Format: Contains powerful divine power and Power of Authority. When the Survivor levels up to 60 and reaches the level limit, this divine format can be used directly to obtain a divine position.
At the same time, the Survivor will automatically advance to: Wild Ranger·Demigod.]
At this time, Han Xing couldn’t conceal the shock in his eyes anymore.
Originally, he thought the skill book was already terrifying enough.
But this small rhombus-shaped crystal brought him even more shock!

chapters.title: Chapter 269 - 217: Witch Race Territory and the Storm Ripper!
paragraphs: Han Xing looked at the rhombic crystal in his hand, utterly shocked!
This is the Divine Format, an unbelievable divine artifact that allows one to attain a divine position!
From Wu Ling’Er’s description, they learned.
Outside, a Legend already represents a pinnacle level of power.
Many Legends, despite their lifelong pursuits, may never break through to the Demigod Level.
Is it that they don’t desire to?
No!
It’s because there’s a vast chasm between Legend and Demigod.
Countless Legends are stuck at the final step.
The key reason is the lack of a Divine Format.
Without a Divine Format, even if your power reaches such intensity, you cannot truly break through or possess the power of a divine spirit!
The two items left by the Hunter.
One could say, the path for Han Xing to become a demigod in the future has become clear and unobstructed!
At this moment, the Golden Dragon looked at Han Xing’s expression, and solemnly said: "You should now understand the importance of these two items the Hunter left you with."
"Try not to expose them before you’ve attained enough power."
"Especially, the second item."
The Golden Dragon emphasized.
Han Xing nodded, but there was a trace of worry in his eyes.
He glanced inconspicuously at the Red Dragon Nelos in the sky.
Although the Golden Dragon said not to expose these matters.
But from the Red Dragon’s resistant behavior.
It surely knows what these two items left by the Hunter are.
Even if I don’t mention it.
If that Red Dragon deliberately spreads the word...
If others were to find out.
That a mere Fourth Transformation human has such an item as a Divine Format.
Who knows how many Legendary Powerhouses might come frantically seeking to kill me.
At this point, the Golden Dragon noticed Han Xing’s concerns,
"Don’t worry about Nelos, under my constraint, it won’t reveal this matter."
"The same goes for other members of the Dragon Race."
In the sky, the Red Dragon let out a heated breath, seemingly disdainful.
Han Xing felt reassured.
It seemed the Golden Giant Dragon had indeed considered this for him.
At this moment, Han Xing asked: "Can we proceed now?"
The Golden Dragon intended to nod.
But just then, it looked at Han Xing, as if it had discovered something.
Golden light flickered slightly on the dragon’s body.
A moment later.
The Golden Dragon slowly said: "Interesting, I thought you were just a fortunate human who caught the Hunter’s favor."
"But now, I see an intense power of faith surrounding you."
"At least the faith of hundreds of millions is gathered on you."
"If it weren’t for you lacking the Human Emperor’s Destiny, I might even suspect you’re the chosen one of the contemporary Human Race!"
The Golden Dragon’s tone was filled with deep astonishment.
Including the Red Dragon Nelos beside it was also somewhat surprised.
They all turned their gaze towards Han Xing, but their expressions slightly changed.
Han Xing didn’t know what this so-called power of faith was.
He looked at himself but didn’t notice anything special about him.
However, seeing the serious demeanor of the Golden Dragon, it seemed to be true.
Han Xing speculated that the power of faith might be related to the extent of others’ admiration for him.
Recalling the fervent scene from his last broadcast with billions of viewers, Han Xing couldn’t help but think.
"Just the faith of a few hundred million? I thought by now, the remaining three billion people around the globe would already be worshipping me madly!"
Of course, Han Xing was overthinking it.
The power of faith is not that easily garnered.
Being worshipped by hundreds of millions is already an extremely difficult feat.
No chosen one of the Human Race in history has achieved such a level.
At this moment, the Golden Giant Dragon spoke again: "Although you’re not the contemporary Human Emperor, you are without a doubt a very important figure among the current Human Race.
"Before leaving the Path of the Giant Dragon, I have a small gift for you."
"A small gift?" Han Xing’s eyes were filled with curiosity.
The Golden Giant Dragon didn’t explain further.
Instead, it slowly exhaled a glowing golden bead from the sky.
This seemed to be the Golden Giant Dragon’s Dragon Pearl.
Under the astonished gaze of the other dragons, the Golden Dragon Pearl slowly entered Han Xing’s body.
Han Xing felt a domineering yet divine power surge through his body.
At this moment, the system notification appeared.
"For unknown reasons, a powerful force has appeared within your body, skill damage is permanently increased by 30%, constitution permanently increased by 20%."
Looking at the system notification and his suddenly enhanced constitution.
Han Xing looked up at the Golden Giant Dragon in the sky in shock.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er observed the golden light on Han Xing’s body, exclaiming: "Is that the Golden Dragon Blessing?"
"What is the Golden Dragon Blessing?" Han Xing asked.
"It’s a special opportunity granted to those with unique fortune, when they pass through the Land of the Giant Dragon."
However, Han Xing shook his head.
He didn’t know what this Golden Dragon Blessing was.
Yet, the Golden Giant Dragon’s pearl within him had indeed dramatically increased his damage significantly.
And it was a permanent increase.
This small gift was quite a valuable one.
After releasing that Dragon Pearl, the Golden Giant Dragon, along with the other dragon phantoms, slowly faded away.
After all those dragons left.
The surrounding storm seemed to have calmed down a bit.
Wu Ling’Er also looked in confusion at the departing backs of those dragons.
This journey on the Path of the Giant Dragon had events surpassing all her previous experiences combined.
And it seemed to have started with this man.
At this point, Wu Ling’Er felt something peculiar.
She didn’t know if it was by chance, or due to other reasons.
But her instincts as a Legendary Powerhouse told her.

chapters.title: Chapter 270 - 217: Witch Race Territory and the Storm Ripper!
paragraphs: This man, I fear he was born with such a trait, wherever he goes, a storm follows.
Thinking about it, she still has to lead Han Xing to the Witch Race Territory.
Wu Ling’Er herself doesn’t know if this is a good or bad thing.
After a moment, she sighed and thought to herself.
Whatever, the Holy Spirit Realm is already chaotic enough as it is now.
A little more chaos wouldn’t change much.
Moreover, perhaps the arrival of this strange man might bring some unexpected change to the chaos of the Holy Spirit Realm.
At this time, Wu Ling’Er shook her head gently and said, "Alright, we shouldn’t encounter any more trouble from here on."
"Here, we’re almost at the end of the Path of the Giant Dragon."
"We just need to move forward a bit more to pass through, and then we’ll leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
After hearing this, everyone nodded.
Then, they continued their journey.
Just as Wu Ling’Er said.
Indeed, they did not encounter any more trouble after that.
Until more than twenty hours later.
The long Path of the Giant Dragon seemed to finally come to an end.
The tearing storm gradually ceased.
Nor were any huge shadows flying by occasionally visible around.
The dim sky seemed to have a hint of color reappearing at this moment.
At this point, a system prompt appeared.
[You have left the Land of the Abandoned Gods, new map unlocked: Witch Race Territory.]
[Since you are the first Blue Star Human Race to leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods, world influence +107, legendary points +5.]
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong and the others also heard the related prompt.
Everyone’s faces showed joy.
Including Wu Ling’Er, who also chuckled softly.
After traveling for so many days.
They finally emerged from the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
This place is where Wu Ling’Er is most familiar with.
[Witch Race Territory]
In the next instant.
A terrifying power burst out from Wu Ling’Er.
It seemed because the suppression of the Land of the Abandoned Gods was lifted, her power began to gradually recover.
At this time, her dark hair flew like a spirit snake.
Terrifying blue energy burst from her body.
And this blue energy evolved into blue secret patterns that instantly extended for hundreds of miles!
In the next instant.
The nearly hundred-mile radius, the howling wind ceased instantly.
Even the bands of flowing rocks fell silent.
As if an invisible giant hand forcefully suppressed all chaotic phenomena!
Everyone was amazed at the power Wu Ling’Er displayed at this moment.
Then they simultaneously remembered one of her titles above her head.
’Storm Ripper’
Legendary Power unleashed unequivocally!
Everyone knew this wasn’t all of Wu Ling’Er’s strength yet.
Because she had just been liberated from being suppressed.
When she fully restores her legendary power, she would be many times stronger!
At this time, it was as if Wu Ling’Er did something trivial.
She looked back at Han Xing and the others and said softly, "Let’s go, pack up your territories."
"Next, I’ll lead you onward."
Han Xing and the others were stunned for a moment.
In the next moment, everyone felt a strange airflow suddenly appear beneath their feet, lifting them into mid-air.
It’s a feeling unlike standing firmly on a Sky Island.
Now they felt like stepping on a cloud, giving a sensation of riding on mist and fog.
Although a bit unexpected.
With Wu Ling’Er’s power, having such means wasn’t that surprising.
Then, the five of them relaxedly packed their core territories into their backpacks.
Yes, core territories can be stored.
Before you merge Sky Islands to expand your territory, you can store extra core territories in your backpack.
Seeing the five cooperate so well.
Wu Ling’Er also smiled slightly.
In the next instant, with a wave of her hand, an airflow enveloped everyone.
Then, the five were taken by Wu Ling’Er at speeds tens of times faster than Han Xingkong Island, accelerating forward!
The surrounding scenes rushed backward rapidly.
As they continued moving away from the Path of the Giant Dragon.
The surrounding scenes became increasingly rich.
Han Xing discovered that this world is indeed somewhat different from the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Here, although there are Sky Islands covered in clouds everywhere.
There are far more large Sky Islands already fully explored.
And there’s evidence of man-made alterations.
The islands are covered with buildings of various unique styles, each with a different layout.
On some of the islands, Han Xing saw large mechanical equipment and lifting devices.
Beside these islands, there were floating ships with wings on both sides hovering mid-air.
Like magical transport ships.
Besides these, nearby, occasionally, there were one or two Sky Islands spanning thousands of square kilometers each.
These islands were constantly billowing with thick smoke.
And this smoke was being absorbed into a giant pocket high above.
At this time, Han Xing couldn’t help asking, "What are those Sky Islands used for?"
Wu Ling’Er, knowing it was Han Xing’s first time seeing these, responded, "These are mostly our Witch Race’s resource islands, typically rich in mineral deposits."
"Once mined, our Witch Race transports these minerals to nearby processing points, those islands constantly emitting smoke."
"Then, all processed resources are transported back to several main cities of the Witch Race to produce various war tools."
After hearing this, everyone’s faces showed a sudden realization.
One cannot deny that such a group survival model achieves production efficiency and resource acquisition speed far beyond that of the current Human Race.
The Witch Race has established a systematic process for exploring Cloud Sky Islands.
First, battle-type soldiers go forth to conquer and explore the Sky Islands covered in clouds.
After clearing out the monsters and confirming the resource levels.
Various labor units and machinery are dispatched to mine stones.
Then move the island with established processing points over.
Such cycles.
In this mode, one can imagine.
The amount of resources the entire Witch Race can gather each day must be staggering.
At this time, Han Xing finally asked the question he most wanted to know.
"Wu... Wu Ling’Er, do you know how to obtain the Shimmering Terra Stone?"
As one of the main materials for crafting Divine Artifacts and Holy Artifacts, Wu Ling’Er agreed to bring the other two back from the Witch Race Main City for Han Xing.
But regarding the ’Shimmering Terra Stone’, Han Xing still had no clue.
So he wanted to get key information on this material from Wu Ling’Er.
At this point, Wu Ling’Er was somewhat surprised.
She asked with a hint of amazement: "You actually know about the Terra Stone?"
Han Xing paused, "Uh, is there a problem?"
"No, just a bit surprised, that’s all."
Wu Ling’Er shook her head, then slowly explained.
"Legend has it that countless millennia ago, this world was a single continent."
"The land was vast beyond measure, even at demigod’s speed, one couldn’t explore to the end of this continent in a lifetime."
"Later, on an ordinary day."
"A huge rock suddenly appeared in the sky."
"This rock, although far smaller than the entire continent, contained a terrifying power within."
"The rock collided with this continent, causing a cataclysmic explosion!"
"Ninety-nine percent of life forms perished in that explosion."
"Then, the world fell apart, and the rock shattered into many fragments that scattered across the Holy Spirit Realm."
"And the fragments of this rock became the Terra Stones."
This legend was also something Wu Ling’Er heard.
She isn’t sure if it’s true.
However, upon hearing more secrets about this world, everyone couldn’t help but marvel at its magical nature.

chapters.title: Chapter 271 - 218: Witch Race Continent Sky Island
paragraphs: After listening to Wu Ling’Er’s description, Han Xing had finally understood the source of the Terrastone.
It meant finding these special giant stone fragments, then mining them to get the ore, which is Terrastone.
Indeed, Legendary powerhouses know so much more.
For questions like these, asking Wu Ling’Er always yielded answers.
However, to verify, Han Xing continued to ask.
"What’s the difference between Terrastone and Shimmering Terrastone?"
Wu Ling’Er shook her head.
"There is no essential difference between the two. It is said that every piece of Terrastone contains the power of creation."
"And Shimmering Terrastone is a Terrastone crystal formed through a special device refinement process."
"About one hundred pieces of Terrastone can be refined into one piece of Shimmering Terrastone."
"Of course, during the refinement, some other special materials are also needed."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing pondered, "A special device?"
Wu Ling’Er nodded, "Yes, it was originally developed by the Dwarf Race, and later the technology was mastered by various major races."
"If you need it, when you return to the main city, I can give you the related technology and blueprints for free."
Han Xing’s eyes lit up, and he quickly said, "That’s great, thank you!"
Wu Ling’Er nodded, seemingly indifferent.
At this time, Wu Ling’Er continued to ask, "Do you need Terrastone?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, and I need a lot of it."
Wu Ling’Er listened, and regretfully shook her head, "That’s unfortunate. Even in our race, the reserves of Terrastone are not abundant."
"Moreover, the chances of finding such giant stones are very slim."
"However, you could try looking in those goblin caves."
"These shadowy creatures like to collect precious ores and store them in their dwellings."
Han Xing nodded, once again thanking Wu Ling’Er for her insights.
Wu Ling’Er waved off, indicating it was no big deal.
Han Xing couldn’t help but marvel at how amiable this Witch Race Saintess was.
On the road.
He also asked Wu Ling’Er about the sourcing methods for two other key materials.
Those were the Philosopher’s Stone and Shadow Divine Stone.
Although this time, Wu Ling’Er promised to give them thousands of these precious materials.
But, it still fell far short of Han Xing’s goal.
If possible, he still wanted to master the methods of producing these materials himself.
It seemed to be a repayment for the group helping her leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
For Han Xing’s questions, Wu Ling’Er was almost unreserved in her answers.
She softly replied, "The Philosopher’s Stone, in essence, is actually a crystal containing a trace of divine power."
"So, it can only be obtained from the bodies of entities that contain divine power, albeit at low probabilities."
Han Xing was surprised, "Does this mean I have to kill those entities with divine power to get the Philosopher’s Stone?"
Wu Ling’Er nodded.
"So what kind of entity possesses divine power?"
Wu Ling’Er shook her head at this time, "This... doesn’t have a specific standard."
"In terms of power levels, divine power is a type of power that can only be mastered at the Legendary Level."
"However, this world is never short of exceptionally gifted individuals, whom we call geniuses."
"These geniuses might start to slowly access a bit of divine power around the Fourth Transformation."
"But, this probability is very low."
"However, the likelihood of Fifth-Turned creatures dropping a Philosopher’s Stone is much greater."
"Fifth Transformation?"
Han Xing was puzzled, "Isn’t it said that after reaching the Fifth Transformation, it’s equivalent to stepping into the Legendary stage?
"Are you saying that only by defeating entities at the Legendary Level can you 100% drop the Philosopher’s Stone?"
Yet, Wu Ling’Er looked at him and laughed.
"I think you might have misunderstood something."
"Not all creatures of the Fifth Transformation are worthy of being granted the Legendary title."
This time, not only Han Xing, but Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, among others, were also shocked.
They had always thought that beings above level fifty were all at the Legendary Level.
But Wu Ling’Er’s implication was telling them.
Even among the Fifth Transformation, there seems to be differentiation in strength?
Are there other restrictions to acquire the Legendary title?
This completely upended their understanding.
Seeing their astonished expressions, Wu Ling’Er also chuckled.
"To advance from Fourth Transformation to Legendary, the first step is to master the Divine Power."
"Those who haven’t mastered the Divine Power are, at most, just pawns among the Fifth Transformation."
"Compared to the real Legends, they are mere ants."
After listening, Han Xing instantly understood.
It’s akin to how stepping into the Demigod class from Legend needs a Divine Format.
Advancing from Fourth Transformation to Legendary also requires mastering a key thing, which is the Divine Power.
If you can’t master the Divine Power, even if you reach level 50, you’re just an ordinary Fifth-Turned creature.
In other words, akin to the difference between ordinary monsters and Lords.
Of course, this gap might be bigger.
After listening to Wu Ling’Er’s descriptions.
The group had basically understood the power divisions in this world and felt greatly benefited.
As for the last material, ’Shadow Divine Stone,’ Wu Ling’Er also told Han Xing its origin.
That is related to the current enemies of the Witch Race, the Shadow Legion.
These monsters with the power of shadow have a small chance of dropping Shadow Divine Stones.
In other words, Han Xing needs to kill such creatures to acquire a large number of Shadow Divine Stones.
In the midst of everyone’s conversation.
Unknowingly, they have already advanced hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
As time passed, the deeper they delved into the Witch Race Territory, the more they could feel it.
Wu Ling’Er’s aura began to continuously rise, subtly once again exuding a legendary level of oppression.
Very soon.
A continent appeared before everyone.
Yes, a continent.
Until now, Han Xing and the others had never seen such a grand sky island.
It boasted a complete ecological terrain.
Vast forests, mountains, snowfields, lakes...
And various peculiarly shaped flying creatures circling overhead.
At intervals, one could see towns covering thousands to tens of thousands of square kilometers.
These towns were interconnected by numerous wide roads, leading to all directions.
Like the highways on Blue Star, facilitating traffic as well as cargo transportation.
Various vehicles could be seen shuttling among them.
They even saw large groups of Land Birds and Kodo Beasts hauling goods.
And in the very center of this continent.
There stood an even grander, more lavishly decorated large city.
This city, with its towering skyscrapers, yet its style starkly differed from the skyscrapers on Blue Star.
It leaned more towards a slightly dreamy medieval tower style.
Apart from these buildings.
There were many unique flying vehicles weaving back and forth above the entire city.
On the city’s streets, pedestrians were as busy as ants, coming and going in endless streams.
"Wow, this sky island is too magical..."
Cheng Jianyong swallowed and said, "It’s really hard to imagine how large this sky island is..."
Shen Yun estimated from the side and said seriously, "I estimate it to be at least several million square kilometers, no less than the area of our national territory, perhaps even larger."
Upon hearing this, everyone gasped in astonishment.
This area was not small at all.
Compared to this sky island.
Han Xing’s Xingyu City was as insignificant as a tiny pebble at the foot of a giant mountain.
Life on this sky island was already almost no different from living on Blue Star.
Listening to everyone’s exclamations, Wu Ling’Er’s lips curled into an imperceptible smile.
Wu Ling’Er then said, "This is our Witch Race’s main island."
"It is the result of the concerted efforts of billions of elite warriors of our Witch Race, continuously collecting scattered sky island fragments over these years."
"Of such scale, we have twenty main cities."
Her tone carried a slight sense of pride.
It was only then that everyone realized.
It turns out, these gigantic sky islands of the Witch Race.
Had been gradually expanded from a small block, just like Han Xing and the others.
Through the efforts of an entire race.
They transformed into the grand size they are today.
Moreover, as Wu Ling’Er mentioned, such enormous sky islands total twenty-one for the entire Witch Race.
This process must have taken a long time.
Possibly spanning several generations of Witch Race people.
At this point, Han Xing couldn’t help but yearn.
That one day in the future, he could also build a sky island of this scale.
In the next moment, Wu Ling’Er spoke with some disappointment: "Unfortunately, due to the Shadow Legion’s invasion, four of our main islands have fallen, leaving only 17 of such scale now."
"These detestable creatures, one day, I will drag out the mastermind behind the Shadow Legion and crush them into pulp!"
Hatred flared in Wu Ling’Er’s eyes.
Although she did not mention the casualties of the Witch Race.
But with four of such gigantic sky islands having been destroyed, one could imagine the brutality of the war.
Countless Witch Race people must have perished in the flames of war.
The number of deaths might even surpass the entire human population on Blue Star.
At that moment, Han Xing asked, "How many Witch Race people generally live on such a main island?"
Wu Ling’Er shook her head and said, "As you see, one main island can approximately accommodate twenty to sixty billion people for long-term living."
"Compared to our Witch Race population which has long surpassed tens of billions, seventeen main islands are naturally far from sufficient."
"However, besides these main islands, we also have many smaller subsidiary sky islands."
"Most of the Witch Race people live on those smaller islands."
Han Xing nodded, "Got it."
"Those who can live in the main city are people with status and background."
"Yes." Wu Ling’Er did not deny it.
"Although we have certain requirements for Witch Race people to live on the main island."
"But other Witch Race people are not treated differently."
"The Witch Race people outside the main city also have their responsibilities."
"Even though the Witch Race has declined, we still have quite an extensive territory that needs guarding."

sentences.text: After listening to Wu Ling’Er’s description, Han Xing had finally understood the source of the Terrastone.
It meant finding these special giant stone fragments, then mining them to get the ore, which is Terrastone.
Indeed, Legendary powerhouses know so much more.
For questions like these, asking Wu Ling’Er always yielded answers.
However, to verify, Han Xing continued to ask.
"What’s the difference between Terrastone and Shimmering Terrastone?"
Wu Ling’Er shook her head.
"There is no essential difference between the two.
It is said that every piece of Terrastone contains the power of creation."
"And Shimmering Terrastone is a Terrastone crystal formed through a special device refinement process."
"About one hundred pieces of Terrastone can be refined into one piece of Shimmering Terrastone."
"Of course, during the refinement, some other special materials are also needed."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing pondered, "A special device?"
Wu Ling’Er nodded, "Yes, it was originally developed by the Dwarf Race, and later the technology was mastered by various major races."
"If you need it, when you return to the main city, I can give you the related technology and blueprints for free."
Han Xing’s eyes lit up, and he quickly said, "That’s great, thank you!"
Wu Ling’Er nodded, seemingly indifferent.
At this time, Wu Ling’Er continued to ask, "Do you need Terrastone?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, and I need a lot of it."
Wu Ling’Er listened, and regretfully shook her head, "That’s unfortunate.
Even in our race, the reserves of Terrastone are not abundant."
"Moreover, the chances of finding such giant stones are very slim."
"However, you could try looking in those goblin caves."
"These shadowy creatures like to collect precious ores and store them in their dwellings."
Han Xing nodded, once again thanking Wu Ling’Er for her insights.
Wu Ling’Er waved off, indicating it was no big deal.
Han Xing couldn’t help but marvel at how amiable this Witch Race Saintess was.
On the road.
He also asked Wu Ling’Er about the sourcing methods for two other key materials.
Those were the Philosopher’s Stone and Shadow Divine Stone.
Although this time, Wu Ling’Er promised to give them thousands of these precious materials.
But, it still fell far short of Han Xing’s goal.
If possible, he still wanted to master the methods of producing these materials himself.
It seemed to be a repayment for the group helping her leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
For Han Xing’s questions, Wu Ling’Er was almost unreserved in her answers.
She softly replied, "The Philosopher’s Stone, in essence, is actually a crystal containing a trace of divine power."
"So, it can only be obtained from the bodies of entities that contain divine power, albeit at low probabilities."
Han Xing was surprised, "Does this mean I have to kill those entities with divine power to get the Philosopher’s Stone?"
Wu Ling’Er nodded.
"So what kind of entity possesses divine power?"
Wu Ling’Er shook her head at this time, "This... doesn’t have a specific standard."
"In terms of power levels, divine power is a type of power that can only be mastered at the Legendary Level."
"However, this world is never short of exceptionally gifted individuals, whom we call geniuses."
"These geniuses might start to slowly access a bit of divine power around the Fourth Transformation."
"But, this probability is very low."
"However, the likelihood of Fifth-Turned creatures dropping a Philosopher’s Stone is much greater."
"Fifth Transformation?"
Han Xing was puzzled, "Isn’t it said that after reaching the Fifth Transformation, it’s equivalent to stepping into the Legendary stage?
"Are you saying that only by defeating entities at the Legendary Level can you 100% drop the Philosopher’s Stone?"
Yet, Wu Ling’Er looked at him and laughed.
"I think you might have misunderstood something."
"Not all creatures of the Fifth Transformation are worthy of being granted the Legendary title."
This time, not only Han Xing, but Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, among others, were also shocked.
They had always thought that beings above level fifty were all at the Legendary Level.
But Wu Ling’Er’s implication was telling them.
Even among the Fifth Transformation, there seems to be differentiation in strength?
Are there other restrictions to acquire the Legendary title?
This completely upended their understanding.
Seeing their astonished expressions, Wu Ling’Er also chuckled.
"To advance from Fourth Transformation to Legendary, the first step is to master the Divine Power."
"Those who haven’t mastered the Divine Power are, at most, just pawns among the Fifth Transformation."
"Compared to the real Legends, they are mere ants."
