chapters.title: Chapter 272 - 219: The Saintess Returns and Special Services
paragraphs: After listening to Wu Ling’Er’s story, Han Xing nodded and stopped asking more questions.
Under her guidance,
the five people sped through the sky.
Occasionally, long slender vines could be seen rising from the ground.
On the tips of these vines hung deep, dark eyeballs.
These vines seemed to be the Witch Race’s defensive forces, specifically used to monitor outsiders like Han Xing.
Moreover, after the eyeballs on the vines locked onto the group,
plant cannons covered with vines adjusted their barrels underground in the forests or plains, simultaneously aiming at the group.
These plant cannons seemed to contain extremely strong destructive power.
Even Han Xing couldn’t help but feel his hair stand on end when those barrels locked onto him!
However, these plant cannons seemed to recognize Wu Ling’Er’s identity and did not take any offensive action.
The group passed through without danger.
The journey ahead was unobstructed.
In just two or three minutes, Wu Ling’Er led them across a thousand kilometers, heading straight to the center city of this giant Sky Island.
Then, as they approached the bustling main city, Wu Ling’Er guided everyone to slowly descend onto a nearby road.
Here seemed to be a major thoroughfare of the main city.
The defenses were very strict.
Han Xing saw.
At the intersection, many well-equipped Witch Race soldiers were guarding.
There was a faint blue secret pattern on their faces, which seemed to be a mark of their Witch Race.
Upon seeing Wu Ling’Er return,
these Witch Race soldiers froze for a moment.
A moment later, a Witch Race soldier in silver armor had his pupils shrink suddenly and exclaimed.
"Quickly go and tell the priest, the Saintess has returned!"
At this moment, all the Witch Race soldiers were taken aback.
They all looked at Wu Ling’Er with surprise and reverence.
However, they knelt in unison.
"Welcome back, Saintess!"
The Witch Race soldiers shouted in unison.
The commotion here seemed to have attracted the attention of the Witch Race citizens inside the city.
They all looked over with surprise, looking at Wu Ling’Er.
As the Witch Race Saintess, Wu Ling’Er was highly revered and had a huge following within the Witch Race.
This kind of scene was not unfamiliar to Wu Ling’Er, who calmly nodded.
Then, she led Han Xing and the others straight towards the city.
Under the gaze of a group of Witch Race soldiers, Wu Ling’Er quickly led them into the Witch Race Main City.
On the streets,
there were various shops and stores with fantasy-like decor on both sides.
Signs like ’Beast Noodle House,’ ’God of Food Canteen,’ and ’Crui Medicine Shop’ hung above.
Although Han Xing and the others couldn’t understand Witch Race text,
with the system’s assistance, they could still instantly translate the words above.
Apart from these shops,
on the streets, various Witch Race men and women in different outfits moved back and forth.
There were also many small vendors by the road, riding land birds and peddling along the street.
The five of them looked around curiously at this prosperous city like country bumpkins visiting a city for the first time.
Compared to the first-tier cities of Blue Star,
the prosperity of the Witch Race Main City was a completely different style.
There was no crowded traffic here; the main transportation equipment for goods was in the air.
Leaving the ground for the Witch Race living here.
This place was full of the breath of life.
Han Xing and the others looked curiously at everything around.
Of course, those Witch Race people were also curiously looking at Han Xing and the others.
Especially Su Xiaoyang and Zhang Lianmeng behind Han Xing, who attracted countless gazes from the Witch Race.
Many Witch Race men were watching mesmerized.
Compared to the generally shorter height and light brown skin of Witch Race women,
Su Xiaoyang and Zhang Lianmeng almost seemed like fairies descending to earth!
Although the aesthetic standards between different races might vary,
everyone’s feeling towards beautiful things is the same.
Just like a northerner seeing fine millet for the first time in the south.
The Witch Race people were directly captivated by the beauty of Su Xiaoyang and Zhang Lianmeng.
It could be said that if Wu Ling’Er wasn’t leading the group in front,
who knows how many Witch Race people would have swarmed over due to the beauty of the two women.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er seemed to notice the abnormal behavior of her clansmen as well.
She looked at Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, and then at Han Xing, as if realizing something.
Wu Ling’Er’s mouth curled into a slight, barely noticeable smile, and then she said softly,
"Your two wives are truly of national beauty and celestial appearance, making my clansmen fall head over heels."
Han Xing paused for a moment upon hearing this.
Behind him, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang also heard this.
Both women’s faces turned crimson with embarrassment, and they lowered their heads.
However, they didn’t refute it.
Han Xing hurriedly explained: "Uh, it’s not what you think."
But Wu Ling’Er interrupted with a soft laugh: "There’s no need to deliberately explain."
"In this world, this is a normal situation."
"And this is also one of the privileges of the strong."
Han Xing opened his mouth, realizing it was futile to explain to this woman, so he simply stopped talking.
They didn’t walk much further.
Wu Ling’Er led everyone to a magnificent building, towering over a hundred meters high.
At this moment, she spoke softly.
"Dear friends of the Human Race, this is our finest inn of the Witch Race, the Wind Inn. Please take a moment to rest here."
"Once I’ve handled my clan affairs, I will take you to receive your corresponding reward."
Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
Part of the reason he agreed to escort Wu Ling’Er to the Witch Race Territory.
Was due to the reward Wu Ling’Er promised.
That Ancient Weapon, the Demon Elephant War Chariot blueprint, was something he was truly interested in!
Wu Ling’Er instructed the reception staff at the door with a couple of words.
Moments later, two petite Witch Race maids with slightly full waists elegantly approached and said.
"Honored guests, the Saintess has instructed us to take you to the best guest rooms."
"Please follow us."
Under the expectant gaze of everyone.
The two Witch Race maids chuckled lightly, then turned to lead the way.
To speak of it, the Witch Race people seem to be rather short.
Most are between 1.4 to 1.6 meters tall.
It’s rare for heights to surpass 1.7 meters.
Especially the Witch Race women, they appear dainty and charming.
At this moment, the two Witch Race maids walked gracefully ahead, their hips subtly swaying, with their fitted cheongsam gowns accentuating their rounded outlines.
Moreover, they occasionally looked back at Han Xing and the others, with seductive smiles on their faces.
Shen Yun asked puzzledly, "Why do these two women keep looking at us?"
"Is there something on our faces?"
Han Xing and Cheng Jianyong shot him a glance.
Compared to them.
Shen Yun, who had been single for over twenty years, seemed somewhat clueless.
These two women, whether instructed by Wu Ling’Er or for other reasons, kept emitting a special signal to everyone.
Moments later, under their guidance, Han Xing and the others entered a peculiar wooden box.
This appeared to be the building’s lifting device, similar to Blue Star’s elevators.
Afterwards, everyone took the elevator and reached the mark of the 23rd floor.
Exiting the lifting device, the two Witch Race maids softly said, "Honored guests, this is the finest room in our Wind Inn."
"It’s usually used only for guests with high status, seldom opened."
"Recently, no other guests have arrived."
"In other words, this entire floor is at your disposal."
Everyone was taken aback; they hadn’t expected Wu Ling’Er’s arrangement.
Would give them free rein over an entire floor.
Such treatment was quite impressive.
At this moment, the two Witch Race maids chuckled lightly, "Honored guests, if there’s nothing else, we’ll take our leave."
"If you need anything, you can summon us at any time."
"The Saintess said to fulfill your requests as much as possible."
Saying this, the two maids cast a seductive glance at the three male guests, Han Xing included.
Then chuckled lightly, "Including some special requests we can also satisfy..."
At that moment, even the usually clueless Shen Yun understood their implication.
The three showed peculiar expressions.
Meanwhile, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang suddenly felt an inexplicable sense of crisis.
They glared reproachfully at the two Witch Race maids.
Then, each of the two girls grasped one of Han Xing’s hands.
In Han Xing’s surprised gaze, they pulled him into the room together with Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang...
Leaving Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun staring at each other in bewilderment.
At this moment, the two Witch Race maids smiled seeing this.
Then, they looked at the two men and asked, "So, dear guests, would you require any special services?"
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, two young men in their twenties, had never encountered such a situation.
They quickly waved their hands, "No, no need!"
"You’re busy, you’re busy..."
"If so, alright then, we’ll take our leave."
Amid the girls’ giggling.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun fled, finding any room to enter.
At this moment, Han Xing entered the room.
Also quite bewildered.
His hands were still enveloped by the two girls, he could feel the soft texture from both sides.
Compared to Zhang Lianmeng’s softness and fullness, Su Xiaoyang appeared more slender and tall.
His nose occasionally caught traces of two distinct fragrances.
Han Xing glanced at the two girls.
The next moment.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang realized their actions seemed excessively intimate.
Zhang Lianmeng was fine; after all, she had been with Han Xing for quite some time.
Sometimes, Zhang Lianmeng was even more proactive than Han Xing.
But that was in situations where they were alone.
Now, they had a third person, Su Xiaoyang, among them.
They were essentially three people in one room!
Considering they were in an inn.
Suddenly, both girls’ faces flushed even more with embarrassment.
Su Xiaoyang felt even more so, at this moment ashamed enough to want to dash out.
In this awkward atmosphere.
Han Xing suddenly spoke up, "Oh, this is actually a suite."
Upon hearing this, the two girls also looked around the room in bewilderment.

Under the expectant gaze of everyone.
The two Witch Race maids chuckled lightly, then turned to lead the way.
To speak of it, the Witch Race people seem to be rather short.
Most are between 1.4 to 1.6 meters tall.
It’s rare for heights to surpass 1.7 meters.
Especially the Witch Race women, they appear dainty and charming.
At this moment, the two Witch Race maids walked gracefully ahead, their hips subtly swaying, with their fitted cheongsam gowns accentuating their rounded outlines.
Moreover, they occasionally looked back at Han Xing and the others, with seductive smiles on their faces.
Shen Yun asked puzzledly, "Why do these two women keep looking at us?"
"Is there something on our faces?"
Han Xing and Cheng Jianyong shot him a glance.
Compared to them.
Shen Yun, who had been single for over twenty years, seemed somewhat clueless.
These two women, whether instructed by Wu Ling’Er or for other reasons, kept emitting a special signal to everyone.
Moments later, under their guidance, Han Xing and the others entered a peculiar wooden box.
This appeared to be the building’s lifting device, similar to Blue Star’s elevators.
Afterwards, everyone took the elevator and reached the mark of the 23rd floor.
Exiting the lifting device, the two Witch Race maids softly said, "Honored guests, this is the finest room in our Wind Inn."
"It’s usually used only for guests with high status, seldom opened."
"Recently, no other guests have arrived."
"In other words, this entire floor is at your disposal."
Everyone was taken aback; they hadn’t expected Wu Ling’Er’s arrangement.
Would give them free rein over an entire floor.
Such treatment was quite impressive.
At this moment, the two Witch Race maids chuckled lightly, "Honored guests, if there’s nothing else, we’ll take our leave."
"If you need anything, you can summon us at any time."
"The Saintess said to fulfill your requests as much as possible."
Saying this, the two maids cast a seductive glance at the three male guests, Han Xing included.
Then chuckled lightly, "Including some special requests we can also satisfy..."
At that moment, even the usually clueless Shen Yun understood their implication.
The three showed peculiar expressions.
Meanwhile, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang suddenly felt an inexplicable sense of crisis.
They glared reproachfully at the two Witch Race maids.
Then, each of the two girls grasped one of Han Xing’s hands.
In Han Xing’s surprised gaze, they pulled him into the room together with Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang...
Leaving Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun staring at each other in bewilderment.
At this moment, the two Witch Race maids smiled seeing this.
Then, they looked at the two men and asked, "So, dear guests, would you require any special services?"
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, two young men in their twenties, had never encountered such a situation.
They quickly waved their hands, "No, no need!"
"You’re busy, you’re busy..."
"If so, alright then, we’ll take our leave."
Amid the girls’ giggling.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun fled, finding any room to enter.
At this moment, Han Xing entered the room.
Also quite bewildered.
His hands were still enveloped by the two girls, he could feel the soft texture from both sides.
Compared to Zhang Lianmeng’s softness and fullness, Su Xiaoyang appeared more slender and tall.
His nose occasionally caught traces of two distinct fragrances.
Han Xing glanced at the two girls.
The next moment.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang realized their actions seemed excessively intimate.
Zhang Lianmeng was fine; after all, she had been with Han Xing for quite some time.
Sometimes, Zhang Lianmeng was even more proactive than Han Xing.
But that was in situations where they were alone.
Now, they had a third person, Su Xiaoyang, among them.
They were essentially three people in one room!
Considering they were in an inn.
Suddenly, both girls’ faces flushed even more with embarrassment.
Su Xiaoyang felt even more so, at this moment ashamed enough to want to dash out.
In this awkward atmosphere.
Han Xing suddenly spoke up, "Oh, this is actually a suite."
Upon hearing this, the two girls also looked around the room in bewilderment.

chapters.title: Chapter 273 - 220: The Main City and the King of Secret Elixirs
paragraphs: The first thing that caught Han Xing’s eye was an incredibly spacious hall.
The decor inside was quite rich in Witch Race style, with various crystal chandeliers and carpets made of animal leather.
On both sides of the hall, there were many rooms.
Only then did the two women find relief; each found a room and dived right in.
As the sound of the door closing echoed.
Han Xing also quietly let out a sigh of relief.
Then.
Han Xing walked to the sofa in the middle of the hall and lay down casually.
In front of him, there was a floor-to-ceiling window.
Once the curtains were drawn back, from this height, one could gaze upon the prosperity of the Witch Race Main City.
As a race with a billion population, its core main city is also the trade center of the Witch Tribe.
The daily foot traffic reached an astonishing figure.
The rooms in this area must be incredibly expensive, don’t even need to think.
At this time, Shen Yun sent a message in the team channel saying: "Brother Xing, Xiaoyongzi and I have already settled down. Is there anything else we need to do next?"
Han Xing replied, "There’s nothing more to do, just wait quietly."
"Alright!"
Cheng Jianyong also remarked pleasantly in the chat channel, "Speaking of which, these Witch Race people really know how to enjoy life."
"This treatment is almost like staying at a five-star hotel on Blue Star."
"Indeed." Shen Yun echoed.
While waiting, there wasn’t much for everyone to do.
Soon after, Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong said they were going to lie down for a while.
Han Xing also dozed off for a bit.
One hour later.
In his slumber, Han Xing heard a series of knocks at the door.
Han Xing immediately woke up.
Opening the door,
it was one of the two maids who had previously attended to them.
At this moment, her face bore a sweet smile, gently saying, "Dear esteemed guest."
"The Saintess asked me to pass on a message, saying she is currently dealing with some urgent matters and asks you all to wait a bit longer."
"She also said, if you’re feeling bored, you might go take a walk around the main city."
"Recently, the main city is holding a ’Secret Elixir King’ competition,"
Han Xing was taken aback for a moment and asked, "Secret Elixir King?"
The Witch Race maid nodded lightly, smiling faintly, "Yes, it’s something the guests might not know."
"Besides being adept at combat, secret elixirs are also one of the things we Witch Race people excel in."
"Over the centuries, our tribe has produced quite a few Secret Medicine Grandmasters!"
"Secret Medicine Grandmaster... what’s that?" Han Xing, being new, was completely ignorant of these things.
The Witch Race maid explained, "Secret elixirs, like forging, are divided into five levels: apprentice, disciple, expert, master, and grandmaster."
"Which correspond to the First to Fifth Transformation Levels."
"And Grandmaster level elixirs are those that can have effects even on legendary beings."
"Legendary?"
Han Xing’s eyes lit up, seeming quite intrigued.
Seeing Han Xing’s interest piqued, the Witch Race maid continued, "Indeed."
"And currently, during the ’Secret Elixir King’ competition period."
"Many shops are taking out their treasured secret elixirs from the bottom of their trunks, all to gain more votes and increase their shop’s popularity."
"The Saintess said that if you see any elixirs you fancy, feel free to take them, she will cover all costs."
"If you all need, I can lead you for a tour around the city."
At this moment, Han Xing pondered for a while.
Wu Ling’Er has been away from her tribe for a long time.
Having just returned, it’s certainly normal for her to have many important matters to deal with.
Then, Han Xing nodded and said, "No need, we’ll just go out for a walk ourselves after a while.
Hearing Han Xing’s refusal,
the maid at the door seemed a bit disappointed but didn’t say anything, bowing respectfully as she withdrew.
At this juncture, Han Xing also opened the team channel and said, "Wu Ling’Er mentioned she still has things to deal with and suggested we go take a look around the city on our own."
"Apparently, their main city is hosting some kind of ’Secret Elixir King’ event, where a lot of precious elixirs are on display."
"Furthermore, all expenses will be covered by Wu Ling’Er."
"The entire expense covered by Wu Ling’Er? Is there such a good thing?" Cheng Jianyong instantaneously replied.
"Secret Elixirs? Grandmaster’s treasures?" Shen Yun also showed keen interest.
Han Xing replied, "Yes, so, should we go out?"
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun answered excitedly in unison, "Let’s go! Of course, we should go!"
"How can we miss out on such a good opportunity!"
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang remained silent in their rooms without expressing any opinion.
In no time, the five of them geared up and walked out of the room together.
However, Su Xiaoyang and Zhang Lianmeng were particularly wearing veils and dressed in black robes this time.
Along the way, they attracted a lot of attention from the Witch Race people.
Though the veils and black robes could only slightly mask their peerless beauty and perfect figures,
the inherent aura they exuded still made it evident that these were two extraordinary beauties.
Nonetheless, this was the maximum effort the two women could make.
The five of them soon took the elevator down, leaving the ’Wind Inn’.
Then, they ventured into the streets of the Witch Race one after another.
Wu Ling’Er had mentioned earlier that they should feel free to explore.
Looks like the Witch Race Main City should have no particular restrictions.
Han Xing and the others strolled leisurely amidst the bustling main city.
And indeed.
Su Xiaoyang and Zhang Lianmeng’s change of attire, though still possessing a very distinctive aura, wasn’t as attention-grabbing as before.
As they walked through numerous streets, everything proceeded smoothly.

chapters.title: Chapter 274 - 220: The Main City and the King of Secret Elixirs
paragraphs: According to reason, as members of the Human Race, their physical characteristics should be immediately recognizable, showing they are not Witch Race people.
Moreover, such large tribes’ main cities naturally would not allow people of other races to enter freely.
The entire main city definitely has an extremely formidable defense system, similar to Han Xing’s Xingyu City.
In fact, that’s exactly the case.
Han Xing and the others casually glanced at the buildings in the city, discovering many impressive things.
[True Spirit Tower]: Releases a True Spirit Attack on all enemy creatures within its attack range while reducing their magic resistance by 30%.
Defense Value: 200,000, Attack Power: 20,000, Attack Range: 5,000 kilometers.
[Tower of Witch Soul]: Automatically releases a Witch Soul Attack upon identifying hostile creatures, causing severe psychic damage to the enemies.
Defense Value: 250,000, Attack Power: 25,000, Attack Range: 10,000 kilometers.
[Eye of Surveillance]: Activates the Eye of Surveillance every minute, able to discern disguises below the Demigod Level.
Defense Value: 100,000, Attack Power: 10,000, Attack Range: 10,000 kilometers
[Anti-Air Tower]...
Besides these formidable defense towers, Han Xing also noticed enormous structures floating in the air like interstellar ships.
The massive cannons on them, just looking at them, made one’s scalp tingle a bit.
Cheng Jianyong and the others swallowed hard, "These defense towers, they’re really terrifying..."
"And the city’s defense forces too."
"It feels like even if Legendary Powerhouses come, they’d still have to drink a cup."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
Although the Witch Race Main City’s fortifications are exceptionally robust.
However.
The patrols of Witch Race soldiers and the Eyes of Surveillance in the city did not react to their Human Race identities.
It seems Wu Ling’Er indeed made the necessary arrangements.
Everyone heaved a sigh of relief.
Besides these formidable defense towers.
They also found many interesting things in the city.
Various weapon shops, refining workshops, mercenary guilds, taverns, etc., all well-equipped.
Even those special places are abundant, with signs openly displayed.
This is a city with quite complete facilities.
Though, aside from these.
The most prevalent in the main city are various secret elixir shops.
The items sold in these secret elixir shops vary and each has its distinct character.
You can tell from their signs.
Names like ’Song of a Night,’ ’Walking on Clouds,’ ’Floating like Immortals,’ etc.
These shop names are enticing just at a glance.
The Witch Race maid was right; secret elixirs are a skill they excel at.
They have even formed a complete industry chain, described as a hundred flowers blossoming.
Of course, aside from various shops.
Along the way, they also saw many Witch Race people, both men and women.
Through the attributes above their heads, everyone could discern the Witch Race people’s strength and level.
Most of them were not even at the First Transformation, not yet Advanced Professionals.
In other words, they are equivalent to ordinary humans.
However, slightly stronger than ordinary humans.
Those who have undergone the First to Second Transformation as Witch Race Professionals would wear one or two pieces of refined purple Silver Equipment, along with some Blue Equipment.
Rarely seen in Golden Armor.
Even among the Witch Race clans.
Purple Silver Equipment and Golden Armor are rare commodities.
At this moment, Shen Yun couldn’t help but say, "Speaking of which, Brother Xing, Xiaoyongzi, have you noticed, these Witch Race women all have quite unique looks."
"Although not tall, their features are delicate, especially their eyes, sparkling like gems."
Upon hearing this, everyone couldn’t help but look curiously.
They saw many Witch Race women on the street staring with sparkling eyes, curiously watching Han Xing and the others.
This time, it was Cheng Jian Yong’s turn to say with a smirk, "Wow, Xiaoyunzi, so you like this type?"
"Could it be you fancy one of them?"
Shen Yun rolled his eyes at him and said, "What are you thinking? I just find Witch Race women quite unique."
"Their wheat-colored skin has a healthy beauty."
Cheng Jianyong shook his head saying, "Not good, Xiaoyunzi, this thinking is dangerous."
"You must know, once you start paying attention to a woman, it means you’re already interested in her."
"Moreover, it’s not just interest in one woman, but in an entire race, not good!"
"Xiaoyunzi, you should quickly abandon this thought!"
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun’s mouth couldn’t help but twitch.
If it weren’t for the fact that this is a public place, he’d have taken out a hammer right there and give Cheng Jianyong a whack.
Han Xing and the others were observing the Witch Race people.
The other side was similarly observing Han Xing and the others.
It seemed they were seeing Humans for the first time, their eyes filled with curiosity.
Yet, because they were in the main city, everyone was quite restrained, so they didn’t encounter any trouble.
At this time, as everyone continued walking, a three-story pavilion appeared ahead.
Above it was a sign with ’Nenier Secret Elixir Shop’ written on it.
The location here is extremely advantageous.
Situated at the intersection of a major road in the Witch Race Main City.
Opening a secret elixir shop here, its owner, Nenier, must have significant connections.
Of course, having connections isn’t enough.
To stabilize in such a prime Golden location long-term.
Their shop’s product resources have to be solid.
And obviously, they’ve accomplished this.
The queue of Witch Race Professionals already formed at the door shows it.
This shop’s secret elixirs must be quite popular.
Many refined equipment, those with strength between Second and Third Transformation, were orderly lined up at the entrance.
Recalling what the two maids said about the currently happening Secret Elixir King event.
Han Xing and the team also wanted to join the excitement.
At that moment, suddenly they heard a commotion behind them.
The Professionals lined up started turning their gaze.
Then they heard the calls of the guards from the rear.
"Lord Malik and his vanguard special force are back!"
"Malik?"
"Weren’t they sent to quell a Shadow Squad? They’re back so soon?"
These opinions were voiced by Professionals, seemingly puzzled.
Behind them, hearing this, the Main City’s guards arrived with proud smiles on their faces.
"Certainly so, Lord Malik is valiant and unparalleled in bravery, once lauded as one of the kingdom’s top ten young warriors!"
"Each member of his 13th Vanguard Team is exceptionally brave in battle too!"
"This time, it’s heard that Lord Malik not only found the Shadow Squad’s hideout but also vanquished tens of thousands of Shadow’s Fangs!"
Upon hearing this, a group of Witch Race Professionals were stunned.
It’s well known that Shadow Squad’s standard is at least Third Transformation strength.
Tens of thousands of Shadow Fangs equate to tens of thousands of Third Transformation powerhouses, a number that’s terrifying even to imagine.
Other Witch Race Professionals showed expressions of admiration.
That’s the gaze that observers powerful figures give.
"Lord Malik is indeed worthy, no wonder he’s one of the kingdom’s top ten warriors!"
"Definitely, the position of the future kingdom’s chief War Witch, Malik is a strong candidate!"
Under the praise from these Witch Race men and women.
A group of Witch Race soldiers, equipped with refined attire, marching in unison, slowly approached from a distant street.
At the forefront.
A burly Witch Race man clad entirely in Golden Armor was striding forward.
He seemed to be the Malik spoken of by everyone.
Standing around 1.7 meters tall, in a race averaging around 1.56 meters, he stood out.
Walking through the streets, he basked in the worshipful glances of numerous Witch Race men and women.
This invisibly emitted a forceful aura.
To put it in a mystical way, an invincible presence!

A group of Witch Race soldiers, equipped with refined attire, marching in unison, slowly approached from a distant street.
At the forefront.
A burly Witch Race man clad entirely in Golden Armor was striding forward.
He seemed to be the Malik spoken of by everyone.
Standing around 1.7 meters tall, in a race averaging around 1.56 meters, he stood out.
Walking through the streets, he basked in the worshipful glances of numerous Witch Race men and women.
This invisibly emitted a forceful aura.
To put it in a mystical way, an invincible presence!

chapters.title: Chapter 275 - 221: Mad Dog Malik
paragraphs: The approaching Malik was full of momentum.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong exaggeratedly said to the side, "This young man has the appearance of a king, if he doesn’t fall, he will surely accomplish great things in the future!"
Behind, the corners of everyone’s mouths also showed a knowing smile.
However, just as this imposing and grand man passed by Han Xing.
His gaze was instantly attracted by this group of humans.
After observing for a moment.
Malik’s eyes landed on Han Xing.
Moreover, when he noticed the armor Han Xing was wearing, his brow slightly twitched.
Although, once equipment reaches the Orange Level, its specific strength can’t be determined just by appearance.
However, the aura these equipment containing powerful strength emits invisibly can still be recognized by some experienced existence for its extraordinariness.
He could see that the armor on Han Xing was of an extraordinary grade.
A hint of greed appeared in Malik’s eyes but was quickly concealed by him.
At this time.
His eagle-like gaze swept over the five people around Han Xing, then he sneered disdainfully.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but murmur a few words, "Pretentious!"
However, at this time, Malik stopped in his tracks, looked at Cheng Jianyong, and said, "Human race, what did you just say?"
Cheng Jianyong said casually, "Why do you care what I say, I didn’t even mention you."
"I saw with my own eyes that you were talking to me and yet you deny it?" Malik said, glaring.
However, Cheng Jianyong still looked indifferent, spread his hands, and said:
"How do you know I was talking about you if you weren’t looking at me?"
"So many people on the street and you didn’t look at them, you just stared at us."
"Could it be that you want to get our attention?"
Cheng Jianyong looked shameless.
"You!"
Malik just wanted to burst out.
At this moment, a silver-armored soldier walked over and whispered a few words in his ear.
With everyone’s hearing, they naturally heard what was said.
It was nothing more than that these humans were guests brought back by the Saintess, and not to cause trouble with them.
At this moment, Malik heard the words ’Saintess’, and suddenly thought of something.
He looked at the distant, splendid palace.
That was the location of the Royal Palace of the Witch Race.
Malik snorted coldly and turned away.
It seemed he wasn’t going to continue to entangle with Han Xing and the others out of respect for the Saintess.
Other Witch Race onlookers also sighed, feeling it was a pity that there wasn’t going to be a good show.
However, right at this moment.
Malik, who had already turned away, seemed to receive some message.
His shoulder slightly trembled.
Malik, who had already walked several meters away, suddenly had a sunken expression on his face.
He turned around and shouted at Cheng Jianyong and the others, "Speak, what is your relationship with the Saintess!"
His tone had a sense of questioning, condescending.
Just like a superior questioning a subordinate.
At this time, other professionals turned their gaze over again.
Originally, they thought this storm was almost over.
As a result, Malik seemed unwilling to let it go?
Cheng Jianyong immediately yelled angrily, "Damn, are you a dog? Turning face faster than flipping a book!"
Malik, "Shut up, now I am questioning you, answer me honestly!"
However, upon hearing this, Han Xing and the others showed expressions as if they were looking at an idiot.
"Nonsense."
The three of them muttered and were all unwilling to pay attention to this mad dog, turning to leave.
Seeing everyone’s attitude, the anger in Malik’s heart seemed to ignite instantly.
"Stop! A few lowly humans dare to act recklessly in the Royal City!"
This sentence was already somewhat humiliating.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but retort, "Are you blind or deaf?"
"Didn’t you hear your subordinate say that we were personally brought back by the Saintess?"
"And you still ask what our relationship with the Saintess is?"
"Is this something a little captain like you can manage?"
Cheng Jianyong directly degraded Malik’s proud captain status to nothing.
Of course, what he said was also a fact.
As a Vanguard Captain, Malik indeed had no qualifications to interact with someone as prestigious as Wu Ling’Er regularly.
In terms of eloquence, how could these people of the Witch Race match up to them, who surf the internet intensively every day.
This sentence seemed to sting Malik’s pathetic self-esteem.
"A group of lowly humans from barbaric lands dare to speak disrespectfully to an officer of the Witch Race!"
"It seems necessary to give you some punishment!"
"All guards listen up, these humans dared to openly insult this captain within the Royal City, they have already violated Witch Race law!"
"Arrest them for me!"
Narrowly, the surrounding Witch Race soldiers had slightly changed expressions.
They weren’t fools.
Beforehand, they had already received the news.
These humans were personally brought back by the Saintess and seemed to be highly valued by her.
But now, their captain seemed to have gone mad, insisting on causing trouble for these humans.
For a moment, they were also caught in a dilemma, unsure of what to do.
Han Xing sneered at this moment, "Alright, don’t make it difficult for your subordinates."
"You intend to find trouble with us, but you don’t have the guts."
"If you truly have the skills, do it yourself."
"But before that, you should think carefully about the consequences."
"What did you say?"
Malik seemed to be hit at a sore point again and became instantly enraged.
At this moment, he no longer cared about the other guards’ obstruction.
He directly drew the golden longsword.
A Sword Qi infused with blue secret patterns suddenly slashed over!
Han Xing and the others’ expressions slightly changed.
This guy actually dared to make a move, and in front of so many people no less.
Malik doesn’t look like a fool, so why is he doing this?
Is it purely because he can’t stand them?
Han Xing sharply sensed that something was off.
Just as the Sword Qi was about to hit them.
A figure clad in heavy armor, radiating holy brilliance, instantly appeared in front of everyone.
It was none other than Shen Yun holding the golden shield.
His hidden profession after the third transformation: Radiant Knight, grants a passive skill.
[Radiant Will]: A passive skill that permanently increases the Radiant Knight’s spirit and constitution by 30%, reducing damage taken by 15%.
This skill fills him with a sense of divinity upon entering battle.
The next moment, the blue Sword Qi and the Shield of Yellow Sand collided head-on.
Buzz!
The street within a few hundred meters was swept as if by a violent wind.
Nearby spectators, those below the fourth transformation, took several steps back.
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
"Note, your team is being attacked by the Witch Race Vanguard Special Forces Captain, Malik."
Han Xing and his four companions remained motionless.
However, Malik, who had unleashed that Sword Qi, was somewhat surprised.
From his perception, these human race individuals, though their aura was formidable, were only at the third transformation strength.
With that last sword, he had already exerted all his strength.
Ordinary third transformation professionals couldn’t possibly withstand it.
However, it was easily neutralized by this human race Holy Knight holding a shield.
Malik realized.
These five humans were likely not simple characters.
At this time, Han Xing frowned and asked, "You just attacked us in the royal city."
"Wouldn’t that violate your kingdom’s laws?"
They were newcomers and didn’t understand the rules of the Witch Race.
But they thought that in such a crowded place in the center of a royal city, it shouldn’t allow for random attacks.
Malik’s expression remained unchanged as he said, "As a captain, I suspect you are spies disguised as members of the Shadow Race, so arresting you doesn’t violate the kingdom’s laws."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing nodded and said, "I see, so you’re just randomly making up a reason to attack us."
"In other words, we can now legitimately fight back against you?"
Malik’s face changed, a hint of disdain barely appeared on his face.
"Just with you guys?"
However, the next moment.
He saw Han Xing had already raised the Valkyrie Longbow.
Arrows imbued with piercing power shot out instantly.
[Multi-Shot]
Han Xing casually used the Hunter’s basic skills.
Each arrow carried terrifying lethality.
Malik’s expression changed as he wielded his sword, trying to block Han Xing’s arrow attack.
Clang! Clang clang!
The golden greatsword in Malik’s hand nearly left only afterimages, and he blocked three arrows.
Nonetheless, even so, two attacks still broke through his defense from a tricky angle.
The next moment, the arrows fiercely hit Malik’s abdomen and shoulder.
Thud! Thud!
These two arrows didn’t trigger the armor-piercing effect, blocked by his golden armor which absorbed most of the damage.
However, even so, with Han Xing’s top-grade equipment boost, his attack power had reached an extremely terrifying level.
Malik was sent flying by the immense impact, his whole body knocked back dozens of meters.
Amidst the shocked gazes of the surrounding Witch Race professionals.
Malik crashed to the ground, tumbling dozens of times before gradually coming to a stop.
The entire scene was silent.
Even the onlooking crowd found themselves holding their breath.
They never expected that the originally invincible-seeming Lord Malik was knocked down by this human in one move.
Meanwhile, Malik’s attributes also appeared in front of Han Xing and the others.
[Witch Race Vanguard Captain, Malik, Four-Star Elite Monster.]
Even the least combat-capable among them, Shen Yun, could easily defeat a four-star elite monster.
Even with a full set of golden equipment, Malik’s strength was far inferior to theirs.
So, from the beginning, they never took him seriously.
At that moment, Malik, knocked down with two arrows, suddenly spat out a mouthful of fresh blood.
Although those two arrows didn’t cause any external injuries, they still damaged his internal organs.
He glared at Han Xing with wolf-like eyes, filled with hatred.
But he also knew that he was no match for these humans.
At this moment, Malik’s face showed a complicated expression.
He seemed to be considering whether to escalate the situation...

chapters.title: Chapter 276 - 222: Fierce Battle in the Middle of the City!
paragraphs: At this moment, Malik felt a tremor from his chest.
He seemed to have received some news, and his expression became extremely grim once again.
"Humans, you’re dead today!"
When Malik said these words, Han Xing felt an ominous premonition.
Then, they saw Malik slowly take out a strange rune from his pocket.
And then, he pressed it directly.
The next moment.
Everyone looked up.
They saw a massive blue secret rune tower a few streets away, bursting with dazzling light at that moment.
Han Xing and the others’ expressions radically changed all at once.
Because the tower emitting that brilliant light was called the [Tower of Witch Soul].
It was an extremely high-level defense tower with tremendous attack power.
If attacked by it, even a four-star leader might not withstand it.
The surrounding Witch Race people watching were shocked that things had developed to this extent.
Malik had directly used the Tower of Witch Soul just to deal with those humans.
Even those Witch Race soldiers looked bewildered.
"Damn! What’s happening? Even the Tower of Witch Soul got activated!"
"What’s wrong with Mister Malik today? Who gave him the authority?"
"Forget about all that, let’s run quickly!"
"If we get caught in the Tower of Witch Soul’s attack later, we’ll be doomed too!"
With this reminder from the Witch Race soldier, the crowd watching scattered and fled in panic.
Malik’s eyes showed a contorted look and a sense of vindictive pleasure.
"Human race, you are sure to die today!"
"Blame yourselves for provoking someone you shouldn’t have!"
In the sky, the Tower of Witch Soul’s attack had already charged energy.
The five people did not flee.
Because they knew that with the Tower of Witch Soul’s attack range of tens of thousands of kilometers, escaping was useless.
The next moment, a dazzling blue beam, filled with numerous secret patterns, enveloped them directly.
A strong sense of crisis surged up.
At the crucial moment.
Shen Yun shouted, "Angelic Descent!"
Suddenly, a silhouette of a two-winged angel appeared in the sky.
The holy radiance enveloped the five, instantly multiplying everyone’s defense by two to three times.
Then, Shen Yun activated the legendary effect of the Shield of Yellow Sand: Yellow Sand Barrier.
And the epic effect on his epic-level weapon, the Triumph Knight’s Holy Hammer, Radiance of Triumph.
[Radiance of Triumph]: Shines the light of victory, covering all team members including oneself, and Radiance of Triumph can negate ten thousand points of damage!
’Angelic Descent’ is a range-enhancing skill, and the legendary effect of the Yellow Sand Barrier can reduce 30% of magic damage, combined with Radiance of Triumph, under threefold reinforcement.
Even if the Tower of Witch Soul has attack power of over ten thousand points, it cannot inflict significant damage on them.
The five felt a strong sense of security.
Buzz!
The blue beam carried terrifying energy, wreaking havoc above everyone’s head.
Around a dozen streets were directly shrouded by a sea of blue secret patterns at that moment.
As the Witch Race soldiers sensed the impending coverage of the Tower of Witch Soul’s attack, they evacuated the crowd immediately.
The terrifying commotion.
Made the Witch Race males and females watching from afar gasp and silently mourn for that unlucky group of the Human Race in their hearts.
"This group of humans is done for, angering Malik and then being hit by the Tower of Witch Soul’s attack."
"Yeah, they’re doomed. Except for strong figures like the commander, I’ve never seen anyone survive the Tower of Witch Soul’s attack!"
However.
When the Tower of Witch Soul’s attack ended and the raging blue secret patterns dissipated.
Five silhouettes appeared at the spot.
Contrary to their expectations, the scene of the five humans being blasted by the Tower of Witch Soul did not occur.
At this moment, Han Xing and the others were not only unharmed, but even their clothes were intact.
At this moment, not only did Malik widen his eyes.
The spectators who had already run far were even more astonished beyond words.
"Oh my god... Is this a ghost?"
"How did this group of humans survive the Tower of Witch Soul’s attack?"
Everyone’s eyes were filled with disbelief.
One must know that even a fourth transformation powerhouse like Malik would be instantly killed if forcibly taking the Tower of Witch Soul’s attack!
"Impossible!" Malik roared in fury with a twisted expression.
"Tell me, what demon technique did you guys use?"
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong wanted to lash out but was stopped by Han Xing.
Han Xing instead asked, "You, just now, tried to kill us, right?"
There was a cold trace in his tone.
Malik’s eyes widened, "So what if I wanted to kill you?"
Han Xing nodded, "Very well, since you admitted it with your own mouth, I don’t need to hold back anymore."
"Today, I’ll kill you!"
Malik seemed to have heard an immense joke.
"Just you?"
Han Xing didn’t speak but answered with actions.
The next moment.
A powerful arrow containing a fierce hurricane aura suddenly appeared in his hand.
The moment Han Xing drew the bowstring, every living creature within a dozen kilometers felt a tearing sensation on their skin!
The onlooking Witch Race people widened their eyes in shock.
"What technique is this?"
"Such terrifying power, just this ripping sensation is hard for me to bear!"
"Is this human really only a third transformation? How come the aura he is exuding now feels more terrifying than Mister Malik!"
At this moment, some professionals from the Witch Race reminded, "Stay away, so you won’t get caught in the crossfire!"
This arrow was a newly learned burst skill by Han Xing after his Third Transformation.
[Surprise Attack·Break]
With a 500% damage coefficient, coupled with Han Xing’s current attack power, if a special effect is triggered, it could even instantly kill a four-star leader monster.
Before this arrow was even shot, Malik sensed a fatal crisis.
At this moment, Han Xing was also filled with the intent to kill.
This guy actually dared to attempt murder on them in front of everyone.
And moreover, knowing full well that they were guests brought by the Saintess.
Upon further thought,
This Malik was just a Vanguard Captain. It should be impossible for him to have control over the Tower of Witch Soul in the Royal City.
Behind this, there might be something much larger at play, a complexity beyond Han Xing’s imagination.
However, Han Xing had no interest in these twisted relations.
All he knew was that this guy had just tried to kill him.
For those who harbor murderous intent towards him, Han Xing’s principle is to eliminate them today, not drag it to tomorrow.
Previously, when facing that Red Dragon,
Han Xing knew that resisting was suicidal, so he temporarily suppressed the killing intent in his heart.
But now, this little four-star elite dared to attempt a deadly attack on him.
At this moment, the skill: ’Surprise Attack·Break’, was fully charged.
Under this arrow, Malik felt a deadly crisis.
An alarm kept ringing in his heart.
Can’t block this!
Completely unblockable!
I’m going to die!
At the moment of crisis, Malik roared loudly.
"You want to kill me, I’ll take you down first, die!"
Malik pulled out a device from his pocket again, seemingly trying to use the defense tower against everyone.
However, how could Han Xing give him the chance?
The arrow in his hand shot out swiftly at this moment.
The crowd only saw a white flash, moving at an extreme speed, crossing two to three kilometers in an instant.
White lightning flashed in an instant!
Malik realized that before he could press the device, he would be hit by this human’s attack!
At the brink of life and death, Malik’s potential seemed to be unleashed.
"Witch Power, empower me!"
In the next moment, the blue secret patterns on Malik’s face instantly spread, covering his entire body.
His aura began to surge madly, and his body attributes soared suddenly at this moment.
Similarly, his reaction speed was also enhanced.
He stared intently at that white flash,
In the next moment, Malik’s face lit up with joy.
"Great, I’ve caught it!"
He had captured the trajectory of Han Xing’s arrow.
In an instant!
Malik let out a loud shout and slashed down with a sword.
"Ha!"
A golden longsword drew a silver arc.
Suddenly slashing toward that flash of lightning.
He swung the sword with full confidence, but the result was his weapon was knocked away in an instant.
With a clang,
In Malik’s incredulous gaze, the surprise attack arrow, encountering no resistance, went straight into his heart.
Then, with a piercing momentum, instantly penetrated his body.
Malik’s figure came to an abrupt halt.
"Clang!"
The golden greatsword that was knocked away hit the ground, and Malik fell down together.
So fast, too fast!
From Han Xing’s attack to Malik being hit.
When the arrow was shot, the air current it generated whipped up a gust, sweeping across.
At this moment, tens of streets nearby, countless Witch Race people stared blankly at the scene.
Then, they glanced at Malik twitching on the ground, their eyes filled with intense shock.
"Lord Malik, lost..."
"Unbelievable! He was a Fourth Transformation powerhouse!"
However, regardless of how hard this group of Witch Race people found it to believe, the Malik on the ground said it all.
He lost, defeated by this Third Transformation human in one strike.
"Is Lord Malik dead?" a Witch Race soldier asked in surprise.
"No, not yet, Lord Malik still has a breath left!"
It had to be said, Fourth Transformation powerhouses have formidable life force.
Even with his heart pierced, under such severe injury, Malik was still not immediately dead.
However, judging by the situation, he wouldn’t live much longer.
Nonetheless, Han Xing frowned.
He knew well that Malik had the authority to activate the Tower of Witch Soul.
To prevent this guy’s final counterattack.
Han Xing once again drew an arrow and aimed at Malik’s forehead!
Noticing Han Xing’s intent, the crowd around simultaneously showed a look of terror.
Although Malik was gravely injured now, with the Witch Race’s secret elixir techniques, there was still a chance to save him.
But if Han Xing attacked again now, Malik would surely die!
Malik sensed Han Xing’s murderous intent, it was then he realized, his opponent was serious.
He really intended to kill him!

sentences.text: At this moment, Malik felt a tremor from his chest.
He seemed to have received some news, and his expression became extremely grim once again.
"Humans, you’re dead today!"
When Malik said these words, Han Xing felt an ominous premonition.
Then, they saw Malik slowly take out a strange rune from his pocket.
And then, he pressed it directly.
The next moment.
Everyone looked up.
They saw a massive blue secret rune tower a few streets away, bursting with dazzling light at that moment.
Han Xing and the others’ expressions radically changed all at once.
Because the tower emitting that brilliant light was called the [Tower of Witch Soul].
It was an extremely high-level defense tower with tremendous attack power.
If attacked by it, even a four-star leader might not withstand it.
The surrounding Witch Race people watching were shocked that things had developed to this extent.
Malik had directly used the Tower of Witch Soul just to deal with those humans.
Even those Witch Race soldiers looked bewildered.
"Damn!
What’s happening?
Even the Tower of Witch Soul got activated!"
"What’s wrong with Mister Malik today?
Who gave him the authority?"
"Forget about all that, let’s run quickly!"
"If we get caught in the Tower of Witch Soul’s attack later, we’ll be doomed too!"
With this reminder from the Witch Race soldier, the crowd watching scattered and fled in panic.
Malik’s eyes showed a contorted look and a sense of vindictive pleasure.
"Human race, you are sure to die today!"
"Blame yourselves for provoking someone you shouldn’t have!"
In the sky, the Tower of Witch Soul’s attack had already charged energy.
The five people did not flee.
Because they knew that with the Tower of Witch Soul’s attack range of tens of thousands of kilometers, escaping was useless.
The next moment, a dazzling blue beam, filled with numerous secret patterns, enveloped them directly.
A strong sense of crisis surged up.
At the crucial moment.
Shen Yun shouted, "Angelic Descent!"
Suddenly, a silhouette of a two-winged angel appeared in the sky.
The holy radiance enveloped the five, instantly multiplying everyone’s defense by two to three times.
Then, Shen Yun activated the legendary effect of the Shield of Yellow Sand: Yellow Sand Barrier.
And the epic effect on his epic-level weapon, the Triumph Knight’s Holy Hammer, Radiance of Triumph.
[Radiance of Triumph]: Shines the light of victory, covering all team members including oneself, and Radiance of Triumph can negate ten thousand points of damage!
’Angelic Descent’ is a range-enhancing skill, and the legendary effect of the Yellow Sand Barrier can reduce 30% of magic damage, combined with Radiance of Triumph, under threefold reinforcement.
Even if the Tower of Witch Soul has attack power of over ten thousand points, it cannot inflict significant damage on them.
The five felt a strong sense of security.
Buzz!
The blue beam carried terrifying energy, wreaking havoc above everyone’s head.
Around a dozen streets were directly shrouded by a sea of blue secret patterns at that moment.
As the Witch Race soldiers sensed the impending coverage of the Tower of Witch Soul’s attack, they evacuated the crowd immediately.
The terrifying commotion.
Made the Witch Race males and females watching from afar gasp and silently mourn for that unlucky group of the Human Race in their hearts.
"This group of humans is done for, angering Malik and then being hit by the Tower of Witch Soul’s attack."
"Yeah, they’re doomed.
Except for strong figures like the commander, I’ve never seen anyone survive the Tower of Witch Soul’s attack!"
However.
When the Tower of Witch Soul’s attack ended and the raging blue secret patterns dissipated.
Five silhouettes appeared at the spot.
Contrary to their expectations, the scene of the five humans being blasted by the Tower of Witch Soul did not occur.
At this moment, Han Xing and the others were not only unharmed, but even their clothes were intact.
At this moment, not only did Malik widen his eyes.
The spectators who had already run far were even more astonished beyond words.
"Oh my god...
Is this a ghost?"
"How did this group of humans survive the Tower of Witch Soul’s attack?"
Everyone’s eyes were filled with disbelief.
One must know that even a fourth transformation powerhouse like Malik would be instantly killed if forcibly taking the Tower of Witch Soul’s attack!
"Impossible!" Malik roared in fury with a twisted expression.
"Tell me, what demon technique did you guys use?"
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong wanted to lash out but was stopped by Han Xing.
Han Xing instead asked, "You, just now, tried to kill us, right?"
There was a cold trace in his tone.
Malik’s eyes widened, "So what if I wanted to kill you?"
Han Xing nodded, "Very well, since you admitted it with your own mouth, I don’t need to hold back anymore."
"Today, I’ll kill you!"
Malik seemed to have heard an immense joke.
"Just you?"
Han Xing didn’t speak but answered with actions.
The next moment.
A powerful arrow containing a fierce hurricane aura suddenly appeared in his hand.
The moment Han Xing drew the bowstring, every living creature within a dozen kilometers felt a tearing sensation on their skin!
The onlooking Witch Race people widened their eyes in shock.
"What technique is this?"
"Such terrifying power, just this ripping sensation is hard for me to bear!"
"Is this human really only a third transformation?
How come the aura he is exuding now feels more terrifying than Mister Malik!"
At this moment, some professionals from the Witch Race reminded, "Stay away, so you won’t get caught in the crossfire!"
This arrow was a newly learned burst skill by Han Xing after his Third Transformation.
[Surprise Attack·Break]
With a 500% damage coefficient, coupled with Han Xing’s current attack power, if a special effect is triggered, it could even instantly kill a four-star leader monster.
Before this arrow was even shot, Malik sensed a fatal crisis.
At this moment, Han Xing was also filled with the intent to kill.
This guy actually dared to attempt murder on them in front of everyone.
And moreover, knowing full well that they were guests brought by the Saintess.
Upon further thought,
This Malik was just a Vanguard Captain.
It should be impossible for him to have control over the Tower of Witch Soul in the Royal City.
Behind this, there might be something much larger at play, a complexity beyond Han Xing’s imagination.
However, Han Xing had no interest in these twisted relations.
All he knew was that this guy had just tried to kill him.
For those who harbor murderous intent towards him, Han Xing’s principle is to eliminate them today, not drag it to tomorrow.
Previously, when facing that Red Dragon,
Han Xing knew that resisting was suicidal, so he temporarily suppressed the killing intent in his heart.
But now, this little four-star elite dared to attempt a deadly attack on him.
At this moment, the skill: ’Surprise Attack·Break’, was fully charged.
Under this arrow, Malik felt a deadly crisis.
An alarm kept ringing in his heart.
Can’t block this!
Completely unblockable!
I’m going to die!
At the moment of crisis, Malik roared loudly.
"You want to kill me, I’ll take you down first, die!"
Malik pulled out a device from his pocket again, seemingly trying to use the defense tower against everyone.
However, how could Han Xing give him the chance?
The arrow in his hand shot out swiftly at this moment.
The crowd only saw a white flash, moving at an extreme speed, crossing two to three kilometers in an instant.
White lightning flashed in an instant!
Malik realized that before he could press the device, he would be hit by this human’s attack!
At the brink of life and death, Malik’s potential seemed to be unleashed.
"Witch Power, empower me!"
In the next moment, the blue secret patterns on Malik’s face instantly spread, covering his entire body.
His aura began to surge madly, and his body attributes soared suddenly at this moment.
Similarly, his reaction speed was also enhanced.
He stared intently at that white flash,
In the next moment, Malik’s face lit up with joy.
"Great, I’ve caught it!"
He had captured the trajectory of Han Xing’s arrow.
In an instant!
Malik let out a loud shout and slashed down with a sword.
"Ha!"
A golden longsword drew a silver arc.
Suddenly slashing toward that flash of lightning.
He swung the sword with full confidence, but the result was his weapon was knocked away in an instant.
With a clang,
In Malik’s incredulous gaze, the surprise attack arrow, encountering no resistance, went straight into his heart.
Then, with a piercing momentum, instantly penetrated his body.
Malik’s figure came to an abrupt halt.
"Clang!"
The golden greatsword that was knocked away hit the ground, and Malik fell down together.
So fast, too fast!
From Han Xing’s attack to Malik being hit.
When the arrow was shot, the air current it generated whipped up a gust, sweeping across.
At this moment, tens of streets nearby, countless Witch Race people stared blankly at the scene.
Then, they glanced at Malik twitching on the ground, their eyes filled with intense shock.
"Lord Malik, lost..."
"Unbelievable!
He was a Fourth Transformation powerhouse!"
However, regardless of how hard this group of Witch Race people found it to believe, the Malik on the ground said it all.
He lost, defeated by this Third Transformation human in one strike.
"Is Lord Malik dead?" a Witch Race soldier asked in surprise.
"No, not yet, Lord Malik still has a breath left!"
It had to be said, Fourth Transformation powerhouses have formidable life force.
Even with his heart pierced, under such severe injury, Malik was still not immediately dead.
However, judging by the situation, he wouldn’t live much longer.
Nonetheless, Han Xing frowned.
He knew well that Malik had the authority to activate the Tower of Witch Soul.
To prevent this guy’s final counterattack.
Han Xing once again drew an arrow and aimed at Malik’s forehead!
Noticing Han Xing’s intent, the crowd around simultaneously showed a look of terror.
Although Malik was gravely injured now, with the Witch Race’s secret elixir techniques, there was still a chance to save him.
But if Han Xing attacked again now, Malik would surely die!
Malik sensed Han Xing’s murderous intent, it was then he realized, his opponent was serious.
He really intended to kill him!

chapters.title: Chapter 277 - 223: Slaying the Captain, the Lord Appears
paragraphs: At this moment, the arrogance in Malik’s eyes turned into fear.
He lowered himself and begged frantically: "No... no... don’t kill me!"
"It wasn’t me trying to cause trouble for you, I was just following orders from above!"
"Spare... spare me!"
Han Xing ignored him and gradually pulled back the bowstring.
In the distant Royal City, a sudden surge of aura rose up.
Its strength was even comparable to a Four-star Lord!
That aura was rushing toward here with madness.
Before the figure arrived, an angry shout was heard.
"Stop!"
However, by now, Han Xing had already committed to killing Malik.
Wouldn’t care who came to stop him!
The next moment.
The arrow was released from hand.
Thud!
An arrow was vertically inserted between Malik’s eyebrows!
Then, he slumped backward, his body stiffened, completely devoid of life.
The system prompt appeared.
[Successfully killed Witch Race Vanguard Captain: Malik, gained experience value: 6.42 million, Witch Race affinity -1.]
The surrounding crowd, seeing Malik’s rigid corpse, were filled with disbelief in their eyes.
"Dead... dead?"
"Lord Malik?"
However, their calls would receive no response.
Malik was indeed dead.
At this time, a look of terror was already in their eyes as they looked toward Han Xing and the others.
"It’s over, these humans killed Malik openly in the Royal City!"
"This is going to cause big trouble!
At the same time, a nearby blue light flashed.
Like a bolt of lightning suddenly descending.
A slim figure and weathered-looking Witch Race male suddenly arrived at this moment.
He didn’t look at Han Xing and the others.
But immediately rushed to Malik’s corpse to check his condition.
In front of Han Xing, the attributes of this middle-aged Witch Race male also appeared.
[Witch Race Seventh Legion Commander, Zefer, Four-star Lord.]
This middle-aged Witch Race was called Zefer, who seemed to be the one who had just ordered Han Xing to stop in the Royal City.
At this moment.
Zefer checked Malik’s corpse and confirmed he showed no signs of life.
His weathered eyebrows also furrowed deeply.
He crouched down, and before he could rise, a potent intent to kill burst from his body.
At this time, the system prompt appeared.
[You have been covered by Zefer’s ’Secret Technique Domain’, skill cooldown time increased by 20%, attack power decreased by 20%, movement speed decreased by 30%.]
Domain!
A means exclusive to Lord-level creatures!
This middle-aged Witch Race turned his head and looked at Han Xing with eyes full of anger and said: "Human, how bold!"
"Dared to carry out such an act of violence even after hearing my warning!"
"No matter what identity or background you have, today, no one can protect you!"
However, Han Xing was unafraid, and countered: "Just because you warned me, I must stop?"
"When Malik used the Tower of Witch Soul to attack us, why didn’t you issue a warning then?"
"Now we’re rightfully defending ourselves, Malik was unable to beat me and got taken down, you jump out now?"
Han Xing looked at him coldly.
"Or was it you who sent Malik to trouble us?"
Han Xing’s voice was clear, echoing in the ears of several tens of thousands of Witch Race people nearby, all of whom looked at the ground where Malik and Zefer stood with confusion.
Facing Han Xing’s questioning, Zefer’s expression remained unchanged.
"Malik misused the Tower of Witch Soul, indeed a mistake of his for which we will punish according to the law."
"However, you humans, not being of our kind, dared to mercilessly kill our important personnel within the Royal City!"
"Simply lawless!"
"All soldiers listen to my orders, arrest these few humans, and imprison them in the Thorny Iron Prison!"
"If they dare resist, kill them without mercy!"
Nearby, more and more Witch Race soldiers gathered here.
Previously, Malik gave the orders and due to Wu Ling’Er, they did not dare to act against Han Xing and the others.
But now, it was a command personally from the Witch Race’s Legion Commander, making these Witch Race soldiers unable to disobey.
Han Xing saw the difficulty in the eyes of these Witch Race soldiers, he sneered: "Are all Witch Race warriors like this?"
However, at this moment Zefer seemed unwilling to waste more words with Han Xing.
A golden giant axe appeared in his hand, he said coldly: "You’d better surrender yourself, otherwise, I’ll personally take action and capture you!"
Han Xing glanced at the distant Royal Palace and frowned.
Han Xing thought: "Wu Ling’Er, what is she plotting?"
"Such a commotion here, as a Legendary Powerhouse, how could she not sense it."
"Could it be that this situation is designed by her? She deliberately lured us here to deal with us?"
"Just, it shouldn’t be, with her strength, there were so many opportunities to kill us along the way without such elaborate efforts."
Han Xing shook his head, finding it hard to comprehend.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong asked from the side: "Brother Xing, what do we do now?"
Facing the fierce and intimidating Four-star Lord, and the Witch Race soldiers slowly surrounding him.
Han Xing shook his head and said: "Something went wrong with Wu Ling’Er’s side."
"But it seems we might have been caught in some sort of turmoil."
"Now, only two roads lie before us."
"The first, is to directly give up resisting, let these Witch Race soldiers capture us and wait for Wu Ling’Er to save us."
"But doing so, our lives and deaths won’t be within our control."
After hearing this, everyone also became awfully solemn, realizing the situation was somewhat out of control.

"Such a commotion here, as a Legendary Powerhouse, how could she not sense it."
"Could it be that this situation is designed by her?
She deliberately lured us here to deal with us?"
"Just, it shouldn’t be, with her strength, there were so many opportunities to kill us along the way without such elaborate efforts."
Han Xing shook his head, finding it hard to comprehend.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong asked from the side: "Brother Xing, what do we do now?"
Facing the fierce and intimidating Four-star Lord, and the Witch Race soldiers slowly surrounding him.
Han Xing shook his head and said: "Something went wrong with Wu Ling’Er’s side."
"But it seems we might have been caught in some sort of turmoil."

"The first, is to directly give up resisting, let these Witch Race soldiers capture us and wait for Wu Ling’Er to save us."
"But doing so, our lives and deaths won’t be within our control."
After hearing this, everyone also became awfully solemn, realizing the situation was somewhat out of control.

chapters.title: Chapter 278 - 223: Slaying the Captain, the Lord Appears (Part 2)
paragraphs: However, their eyes showed no trace of fear.
Before Han Xing could speak.
Cheng Jianyong said directly, "Brother Xing, we choose the second plan."
Han Xing’s face showed a hint of a smile, "Do you know what the second plan is?"
Cheng Jianyong shook his head, "I don’t know, but I know Brother Xing isn’t the kind of person who would entrust his life to others."
Han Xing also smiled.
"Alright, then we’ll choose the second plan."
"The second plan is that we completely let loose and cause a big ruckus in the Witch Race Royal City!"
"Let’s gamble that these people weren’t sent by Wu Ling’Er to deal with us!"
"Make a big fuss and force whatever’s behind the scenes to show itself."
"By then, Wu Ling’Er will probably come out too... "
Everyone understood Han Xing’s plan.
At this moment, Shen Yun showed an excited expression and said, "In that case, let’s have a big uproar!"
Watching the surrounding Witch Race soldiers slowly gather around.
The next moment.
Shen Yun immediately cast two blessing states on Han Xing.
Then cast a Holy Light Shield on everyone.
Seeing the actions of everyone.
Zefer knew that they were not planning to be captured without a fight.
Still, it had to be a real battle.
However, the plans of Han Xing and the others seemed to suit him just fine.
Zefer’s lips curled into a smile, "Good, since you seek death, I’ll fulfill your wish."
He glanced at the nearby Witch Race soldiers and ordered, "Attack!"
After Zefer spoke, he raised the Golden Giant Axe in his hand!
Charging ahead like a cannonball.
The Four-star Lord Level, already a peak strength below Legend.
At this moment, Zefer burst out fully, and the force was extremely terrifying.
Boom!
The ground of the entire street was instantly cracked like a spider web by his burst.
However, the five were unafraid.
Shen Yun rushed to meet him first.
He raised the Shield of Yellow Sand, shouted explosively, and fiercely blocked Zefer’s strike.
The two sides experienced their first wave of direct confrontation.
Clang!
The collision of the giant axe and shield.
The impact was akin to missiles clashing!
A muffled crash resounded.
Around them, those ordinary soldiers who were in their second and third transformations felt suffocated.
After the collision, Shen Yun retreated several steps.
But he gritted his teeth and blocked Zefer’s attack.
Zefer’s lips curled into a slight smile, "Interesting."
"For someone in a third transformation to withstand my attack, you’re worthy of pride."
The next moment, he raised the giant axe again and chopped down fiercely!
Clang! Clang clang!
The terrifying sound of impact echoed.
The sound made blood boil and the scalp tingle.
Those Witch Race soldiers felt their blood surging, their faces flushed red.
Seeing Zefer’s fierce combat prowess, these soldiers couldn’t help imagining.
If it were them, facing Zefer’s attack, they’d probably be minced by the first axe strike!
Han Xing and the others also had grave expressions.
This Zefer, indeed a Four-star Lord Level existence.
Just discussing attributes, he surpasses everyone by more than twice!
The actual combat power he’s showcasing now is far beyond everyone’s expectations.
Even though Shen Yun’s equipment was refined, he was continuously forced to retreat by Zefer’s axe strikes!
Zefer’s eyes grew more disdainful.
"Heh, you ant-like fools dare to openly challenge the authority of the Witch Race, today, I’ll show you how vast the heavens and the earth truly are!"
Right then, those Witch Race soldiers enclosing them already rushed forward with weapons.
Cheng Jianyong also directly entered battle stance, instantly rushing into the Witch Race soldiers’ ranks, reserving a battlefield for Shen Yun and Han Xing.
The formation of hundreds of Witch Race soldiers was scattered in an instant by Cheng Jianyong.
From the rear, Su Xiaoyang’s arrows shot out like machine gun fire.
With just the two of them, they made the Witch Race soldiers run for cover in panic.
Instantly causing heavy casualties.
With these Witch Race soldiers no longer in their way.
It was effectively Shen Yun, Han Xing, and Zhang Lianmeng dealing with the Four-star Lord.
Han Xing and Zhang Lianmeng’s attacks came forth.
Zefer glanced at them, seemingly indifferent.
He roared loudly.
"Great Witch’s Axe!"
The next moment, a spectral figure of a Great Witch appeared behind Zefer.
As soon as the specter appeared, Zefer’s aura surged once again, as if granting him fearsome power.
Han Xing and the others’ attacks were instantly blocked by this specter!
Then, Zefer’s giant axe slashed down!
Clang!
This strike carried the weight of ten thousand jins.
Shen Yun felt a mighty force rush in.
Then, he was instantly sent flying.
"Ants remain ants." Zefer said disdainfully.
Shen Yun landed, immediately standing up.
He wiped the blood off his lips and cursed, "Old man, what’s so arrogant?"
The next moment, Shen Yun charged again.
Han Xing also drew back the bowstring again.
Arrows instantly flew, aiming directly for the Four-star Lord’s brow.
From this arrow, even Zefer felt a sense of mortal danger.
However, although Zefer seemed somewhat elderly, his reaction speed was appallingly quick.
The giant axe originally meant for Shen Yun twisted back forcibly at that moment!
With a crisp ringing sound.
The arrow contacted the axe body and rebounded away.
This arrow didn’t cause any damage.
Zefer’s lips curled in a mocking smile.
However, before he could revel in his triumph.
Zhang Lianmeng’s Meteor Technique, Han Xing’s Weakness Strike, and Shen Yun’s Hammer of Repentance struck simultaneously.
Zefer’s face slightly changed.
Although he kept mocking their strength as akin to ants.
That was to undermine their morale, also a tactic in combat.
In fact, he felt a strong threat from these humans with only third transformation strength.
Even he didn’t dare face the combined assault of all three directly.
Yet.
At this moment, Han Xing had activated the epic effect on his Valkyrie Longbow, ’Valkyrie’s Fury.’
The next moment.
Several arrows, carrying a trace of destructive divine power, arrived instantly.
Zefer could clearly sense.
Compared to previous attacks, these arrows were even more terrifying.
He wanted to raise his hand and repeat his trick to block Han Xing’s attack.
But he found the piercing power carried by these arrows utterly unstoppable!
Fifty percent armor piercing, plus 300 armor ignore from Illusion-Breaking effect.
His giant axe was instantly deflected.
Puff! Puff puff!
The next moment, Zefer’s upper body was hit by these arrows, sending him flying.
On the side, the soldiers besieging Cheng Jianyong paused momentarily, their eyes showing shock.
As the captain of the Kingdom Vanguard Corps, Zefer represented the pinnacle of their Witch Race strength.
In previous large-scale battles, they had witnessed Zefer’s fighting stance firsthand.
Against the Shadow Legion, even elite teams with second or third transformations crumbled before Zefer!
But now, he was knocked back by a few third transformation humans!
Zefer also felt a wave of humiliation.
His face flushed red, then he roared explosively.
In mid-air, his body forcefully twisted eighty degrees, stabilizing himself with difficulty.
He glanced at the arrows embedded in his chest and arm.
Then he looked at Han Xing in the distance, his gaze gradually turning cold.
"Fine, very good!"
"You ants have thoroughly angered me!"
As Zefer spoke these words, his aura seemed to undergo a different transformation.
Han Xing saw the same blue secret patterns as Wu Ling’Er appear on his body, spreading like thousands of tiny blue lightning bolts.
However, unlike Wu Ling’Er’s application of the blue secret patterns.
Zefer took a deep breath and stuck these thousands of secret patterns directly onto himself.
At this moment, he resembled a monster completely covered in tattoo patterns.
Han Xing and the others could distinctly feel Zefer becoming even more terrifying!
With the Witch Race’s secret pattern technique, combined with Zefer’s Four-star Lord Level strength, he exhibited fearsome combat prowess.
