Shen Yun immediately cast two blessing states on Han Xing.
Then cast a Holy Light Shield on everyone.
Seeing the actions of everyone.
Zefer knew that they were not planning to be captured without a fight.
Still, it had to be a real battle.
However, the plans of Han Xing and the others seemed to suit him just fine.
Zefer’s lips curled into a smile, "Good, since you seek death, I’ll fulfill your wish."
He glanced at the nearby Witch Race soldiers and ordered, "Attack!"
After Zefer spoke, he raised the Golden Giant Axe in his hand!
Charging ahead like a cannonball.
The Four-star Lord Level, already a peak strength below Legend.
At this moment, Zefer burst out fully, and the force was extremely terrifying.
Boom!
The ground of the entire street was instantly cracked like a spider web by his burst.
However, the five were unafraid.
Shen Yun rushed to meet him first.
He raised the Shield of Yellow Sand, shouted explosively, and fiercely blocked Zefer’s strike.
The two sides experienced their first wave of direct confrontation.
Clang!
The collision of the giant axe and shield.
The impact was akin to missiles clashing!
A muffled crash resounded.
Around them, those ordinary soldiers who were in their second and third transformations felt suffocated.
After the collision, Shen Yun retreated several steps.
But he gritted his teeth and blocked Zefer’s attack.
Zefer’s lips curled into a slight smile, "Interesting."
"For someone in a third transformation to withstand my attack, you’re worthy of pride."
The next moment, he raised the giant axe again and chopped down fiercely!
Clang!
Clang clang!
The terrifying sound of impact echoed.
The sound made blood boil and the scalp tingle.
Those Witch Race soldiers felt their blood surging, their faces flushed red.
Seeing Zefer’s fierce combat prowess, these soldiers couldn’t help imagining.
If it were them, facing Zefer’s attack, they’d probably be minced by the first axe strike!
Han Xing and the others also had grave expressions.
This Zefer, indeed a Four-star Lord Level existence.
Just discussing attributes, he surpasses everyone by more than twice!
The actual combat power he’s showcasing now is far beyond everyone’s expectations.
Even though Shen Yun’s equipment was refined, he was continuously forced to retreat by Zefer’s axe strikes!
Zefer’s eyes grew more disdainful.
"Heh, you ant-like fools dare to openly challenge the authority of the Witch Race, today, I’ll show you how vast the heavens and the earth truly are!"
Right then, those Witch Race soldiers enclosing them already rushed forward with weapons.
Cheng Jianyong also directly entered battle stance, instantly rushing into the Witch Race soldiers’ ranks, reserving a battlefield for Shen Yun and Han Xing.
The formation of hundreds of Witch Race soldiers was scattered in an instant by Cheng Jianyong.
From the rear, Su Xiaoyang’s arrows shot out like machine gun fire.
With just the two of them, they made the Witch Race soldiers run for cover in panic.
Instantly causing heavy casualties.
With these Witch Race soldiers no longer in their way.
It was effectively Shen Yun, Han Xing, and Zhang Lianmeng dealing with the Four-star Lord.
Han Xing and Zhang Lianmeng’s attacks came forth.
Zefer glanced at them, seemingly indifferent.
He roared loudly.
"Great Witch’s Axe!"
The next moment, a spectral figure of a Great Witch appeared behind Zefer.
As soon as the specter appeared, Zefer’s aura surged once again, as if granting him fearsome power.
Han Xing and the others’ attacks were instantly blocked by this specter!
Then, Zefer’s giant axe slashed down!
Clang!
This strike carried the weight of ten thousand jins.
Shen Yun felt a mighty force rush in.
Then, he was instantly sent flying.
"Ants remain ants." Zefer said disdainfully.
Shen Yun landed, immediately standing up.
He wiped the blood off his lips and cursed, "Old man, what’s so arrogant?"
The next moment, Shen Yun charged again.
Han Xing also drew back the bowstring again.
Arrows instantly flew, aiming directly for the Four-star Lord’s brow.
From this arrow, even Zefer felt a sense of mortal danger.
However, although Zefer seemed somewhat elderly, his reaction speed was appallingly quick.
The giant axe originally meant for Shen Yun twisted back forcibly at that moment!
With a crisp ringing sound.
The arrow contacted the axe body and rebounded away.
This arrow didn’t cause any damage.
Zefer’s lips curled in a mocking smile.
However, before he could revel in his triumph.
Zhang Lianmeng’s Meteor Technique, Han Xing’s Weakness Strike, and Shen Yun’s Hammer of Repentance struck simultaneously.
Zefer’s face slightly changed.
Although he kept mocking their strength as akin to ants.
That was to undermine their morale, also a tactic in combat.
In fact, he felt a strong threat from these humans with only third transformation strength.
Even he didn’t dare face the combined assault of all three directly.
Yet.
At this moment, Han Xing had activated the epic effect on his Valkyrie Longbow, ’Valkyrie’s Fury.’
The next moment.
Several arrows, carrying a trace of destructive divine power, arrived instantly.
Zefer could clearly sense.
Compared to previous attacks, these arrows were even more terrifying.
He wanted to raise his hand and repeat his trick to block Han Xing’s attack.
But he found the piercing power carried by these arrows utterly unstoppable!
Fifty percent armor piercing, plus 300 armor ignore from Illusion-Breaking effect.
His giant axe was instantly deflected.
Puff!
Puff puff!
The next moment, Zefer’s upper body was hit by these arrows, sending him flying.
On the side, the soldiers besieging Cheng Jianyong paused momentarily, their eyes showing shock.
As the captain of the Kingdom Vanguard Corps, Zefer represented the pinnacle of their Witch Race strength.
In previous large-scale battles, they had witnessed Zefer’s fighting stance firsthand.
Against the Shadow Legion, even elite teams with second or third transformations crumbled before Zefer!
But now, he was knocked back by a few third transformation humans!
Zefer also felt a wave of humiliation.
His face flushed red, then he roared explosively.
In mid-air, his body forcefully twisted eighty degrees, stabilizing himself with difficulty.
He glanced at the arrows embedded in his chest and arm.
Then he looked at Han Xing in the distance, his gaze gradually turning cold.
"Fine, very good!"
"You ants have thoroughly angered me!"
As Zefer spoke these words, his aura seemed to undergo a different transformation.
Han Xing saw the same blue secret patterns as Wu Ling’Er appear on his body, spreading like thousands of tiny blue lightning bolts.
However, unlike Wu Ling’Er’s application of the blue secret patterns.
Zefer took a deep breath and stuck these thousands of secret patterns directly onto himself.
At this moment, he resembled a monster completely covered in tattoo patterns.
Han Xing and the others could distinctly feel Zefer becoming even more terrifying!
With the Witch Race’s secret pattern technique, combined with Zefer’s Four-star Lord Level strength, he exhibited fearsome combat prowess.

chapters.title: Chapter 279 - 224: I Am the Embodiment of Calamity!
paragraphs: Four-star Lord Zefer, instant burst!
In the next moment, a figure appeared in front of Shen Yun at nearly teleportation speed.
Giant axe slashed down!
In a critical moment, Shen Yun only had time to raise his shield to resist!
However, Zefer, in burst mode, was like a beast unleashed.
Clang!
Shen Yun’s Shield of Yellow Sand was instantly chopped away.
In the next moment, a golden giant axe rapidly enlarged in front of him!
Danger!
An alarm rose in Shen Yun’s heart!
With Zefer’s attack power, if this axe strike hit its mark, Shen Yun would be severely injured if not killed.
At this critical moment, he immediately activated the epic-level effect of the orange armor on him, the Demon Bone Battle Armor, ’Demon God Remains’.

[Demon God Remains]: Epic-level effect, once activated, instantly covers the wearer with a skeletal structure of a high-level demon, blocking damage equal to Constitution*20. When the skeleton shatters, it deals Spirit*10 true damage to all nearby enemies.
Effect cooldown time: 1 hour.
In the next moment, the holy radiance surrounding Shen Yun suddenly disappeared, replaced by a sinister white skeleton emitting demonic qi!
And Shen Yun was enveloped within this skeleton.
Like light and evil gathering on one person, the scene was indeed shocking.
However, facing Shen Yun’s transformation, Zefer showed no hesitation.
The giant axe in his hand slashed down upon Shen Yun.
Crack!
After a crisp sound of bones cracking.
The demon horns on Shen Yun’s head were shattered directly by this axe!
Zefer’s mouth showed a slight smile, "Playing tricks!"
"Taste my Stormbreaker Axe!"
The second axe struck down again.
Then came the third axe, the fourth axe!
Zefer’s attacks were like a fierce storm, swiftly chopping at the demon skeleton covering Shen Yun.
Crunch!
In less than two seconds, the seemingly indestructible demon skeleton was chopped apart by Zefer.
However, it didn’t go without any effect.
At least, it granted Shen Yun a brief moment to catch his breath.
Meanwhile, attacks from Han Xing and Zhang Lianmeng had already been launched.
But they were blocked by the blue secret pattern surrounding Zefer, forming an energy shield around his body.
Even Zhang Lianmeng’s Large Fireball, when blasted onto him, was instantly neutralized.
The power of a Lord-level creature was unmistakably displayed at this moment.
Zefer’s face revealed a victorious smile as he looked at Shen Yun and said, "Quick reaction, but next time, you won’t be so lucky."
At this moment, Shen Yun’s eyes showed a grave expression.
Just now, amidst the wave of attacks, he genuinely felt a sense of deadly danger.
If he hadn’t reacted timely, he would have been swept away by Zefer’s combo!
Next moment, Zefer, exuding terrifying killing intent, dashed at Shen Yun!
The overwhelming presence was like a beast unleashed!
The attacks from the others landed on him as if striking nothing, causing no effect.
Seeing this, Zefer once again aimed at Shen Yun.
Han Xing coldly said, "Old man, are you really seeking death!"
Zefer looked over, a disdainful smile in his eyes, "Oh? And what will you do?"
Han Xing did not answer, his gaze filled with icy killing intent.
In the next moment, a burning arrow appeared in his hand.
Zefer sensed the unusualness of this arrow, glancing at Han Xing with a sidelong gaze.
Then he only saw a spark burst forth in his vision.
The Blast Flame Arrow shot out in an instant!
Boom!
Like a missile thrown down on the spot.
A terrifying flame rose with a diameter exceeding hundreds of meters.
An entire street was directly engulfed by the flames of the Blast Flame Arrow!
Even the Witch Race Main City, not affected by the invasion of the Shadow Legion before.
Today, for the first time, it experienced the baptism of warfire!
Even Witch Race residents miles away felt this intense shock.
Some individuals unaware of the situation even thought the Shadow Legion had attacked, fleeing in panic.
When the soaring flames dissipated.
Within a radius of more than a hundred meters, all buildings were obliterated.
Even the ground was blackened by the explosion.
Left behind were only six silhouettes still standing in the same place.
At this moment.
Zefer was continuously emitting scalding smoke.
Han Xing’s Blast Flame Arrow, its destructive power was too vast and wide.
Moreover, he was still under the effect of ’Valkyrie’s Fury.’
Even Zefer, his defense was reduced to its lowest level.
The defense secret pattern on Zefer finally exceeded its damage tolerance limit!
Even for him, not to mention the Witch Race soldiers.
In this one explosion, Han Xing heard at least hundreds of kill notifications.
This means those hundreds of soldiers were all reduced to ashes in the bombing wave.
Zefer scanned his surroundings, a smile of triumph suddenly appeared at the corner of his mouth.
"Humans, you’ve caused an overwhelming calamity by killing so many of my soldiers!"
"Even the Saintess herself can’t protect you this time!"
Han Xing replied disdainfully, "Stop pretending, isn’t this the effect you wanted to see?"
"Overwhelming calamity?"
"Let me tell you, I am the incarnation of calamity!"
In the next moment, from Han Xing’s body.
A terrifying aura immediately rose up!
This aura was terrifying, dark, and malicious!
Like an ancient evil god descending.

[Calamity Incarnation]: Divine-level Effect. After activation, you will receive a portion of the God of Calamity’s divine power, becoming immune to and cleansing all curse effects on yourself, and all attacks will carry the power of calamity. Effect lasts for 120 seconds, with a cooldown of 120 minutes.
Han Xing could clearly feel hundreds of types of negative energy appear in his body.
Every attack he launched would release these negative energies, causing a negative effect on the enemy.
And he acted accordingly.
The bowstring of the Valkyrie Longbow was drawn until shadows appeared.
Whiz! Whiz whiz!
Arrows shot out one after another.
Zefer wanted to dodge, but saw that Shen Yun’s big hammer and Zhang Lianmeng’s group attacks had already blocked his escape route.
He had no choice but to deal with the troubles before him first.
Han Xing’s arrow attacks were too fast.
Zefer was hit by five or six arrows in an instant.
The system prompted,
"You attacked the Witch Race Vanguard Corps Captain Zefer, Calamity Incarnation effect activated, randomly added a negative state to him..."
A succession of prompts appeared.
Zefer was inflicted with many negative effects.
Such as poisoning, bleeding, blindness, slowing, and so on...
Zefer looked at his body in surprise, covered in patches of blue and purple.
In just a few seconds, he had been afflicted with over a dozen negative states, greatly reducing his attributes.
He realized he couldn’t allow this human hunter to continue attacking him.
Otherwise, before he could break out, he would be severely weakened by these negative states.
Zefer took a deep breath and once again burst out a powerful attack, sending Shen Yun flying.
Then he charged directly at Han Xing!
Seeing Zefer charging at him, Han Xing showed no fear in his eyes.
Instead, he scanned the nearby towns and the distant royal palace.
His eyes showed some confusion.
The battle’s might had almost overturned these streets.
If this continued, half the main city would be affected by everyone’s battle.
With such commotion.
Were those Witch Race experts still able to remain calm?
Han Xing always felt there were eyes watching them from behind.
But at this moment.
Zefer had already charged close.
With a grim smile, he said, "Kid, you’re distracted while fighting me, do you think you’re not dying fast enough?"
However, Han Xing casually glanced at him and said, "For someone about to die, what’s the point of paying attention?"
Zefer seemed to hear the biggest joke, "Arrogant! I hope when I chop you in half, you’ll still be so cocky."
"Great Witch’s Axe!"
Zefer once again used his powerful attack move.
He believed that no matter how strong this human was, he couldn’t withstand his axe.
It indeed seemed that way.
The four-star lord’s ultimate move, even when close to Han Xing, meant doom.
However, who ever said a hunter must fight a berserker up close?
Han Xing directly activated the legendary level effect on the orange medal.
[Breath of the Wild]: After activation, evasion rate increases by 99%, movement speed increases by 99%, attack power increases by 99%, effect lasts for 10 seconds.
Then, ’Instant Shadow Flash’ was executed.
Under Zefer’s stunned gaze.
He suddenly saw a shadow appear where Han Xing had stood.
His axe completely hit empty air.
The speed Han Xing exploded with far exceeded Zefer’s expectations!
He looked at Han Xing in shock and said, "Your burst of speed just now, you’ve actually touched that level..."
"Human, who exactly are you?"
However, Han Xing ignored him.
After gaining distance, he slowly drew the bowstring again, targeting Zefer.
"Though I don’t know what you Witch Race guys are up to."
"And I don’t know who exactly is plotting against us."
"But, since you’re a legion captain, if I take you down, those hiding in the shadows will surely be unable to resist showing themselves, right?"
Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and others’ faces were serious.
They knew.
When Han Xing said this, it meant he was going all out.
As the bowstring continued to be drawn back.
Zefer also felt a strong sense of crisis surging within him!
"Human! What did you do?" Zefer asked in fear.
Han Xing did not answer but took a long look at the distant royal palace.
The next moment.
Han Xing directly activated all sorts of equipment effects on his body.
[Wind of Calamity], [Shield of Calamity], [Evil Talisman]...
[Overwhelming Calamity], [Wind of Tie Ling], [Flame Roar], [Shadow of the Spirit Snake]...
A total of seventeen effects were all activated at this moment.
Originally, during the divine-level effect of ’Calamity Incarnation,’ the aura around Han Xing was already extremely complex.
And now, suddenly, more than a dozen different powers appeared.
His aura became increasingly chaotic and terrifying, like it could explode at any moment, yet maintained a delicate balance.
In just a moment.
Zefer felt a strong threat from him!
This human... is strange!
He must be interrupted, or else he will continue to grow stronger!

chapters.title: Chapter 280 - 225: The Legend Appears
paragraphs: Zefer realized that he must interrupt Han Xing as soon as possible.
The next moment, he roared fiercely.
"Giant Axe Mountain Splitter!"
Zefer instantly raised the giant axe, transforming into a blue lightning bolt!
However, in Han Xing’s eyes, he was already a dead man.
At this moment, Han Xing slowly drew back the bowstring.
The next moment.
Zefer suddenly felt a power of imprisonment enveloping the space around him.
His movement instantly stopped.
A bright full moon fixed him in mid-air.
Despite his Four-star Lord-level strength, he could not break free.
No, it wasn’t just breaking free, he couldn’t even move an inch!
Legendary Skill: Broken Moon.
Its domineering control ability was vividly displayed at this moment!
The existence sealed by the full moon had no chance at all to escape.
At this moment, Zefer felt a strong sense of crisis.
The calm on his face vanished, replaced with a fear of death!
He just wanted to speak, but discovered that after being covered by the full moon, he couldn’t even utter a word.
The next moment.
Han Xing suddenly said, "Do it!"
Cheng Jianyong, Zhang Lianmeng, and others immediately understood.
Then, they all began to muster their most powerful attacks.
Rumble!
Arrows with terrifying destructive power.
Large fireball, sword Qi, holy light.
Like a torrential downpour, all fiercely hit Zefer.
The change came too quickly.
Even Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong and the others hadn’t expected it.
Han Xing, after activating so many special effects, was already capable of completely crushing Zefer head-on.
However, to ensure a swift victory.
He didn’t hesitate to use his trump card.
Broken Moon!
This was a move to leave Zefer no way out at all!
After five seconds, as the duration of the Broken Moon skill ended.
With a crisp shattering sound.
The massive full moon crumbled at this moment.
A system prompt appeared.
"Successfully killed the leader of the Witch Race’s Vanguard Corps, Zefer, a Four-star Lord-level creature, gained Experience Value: 32.42 million..."
Until the commotion on Han Xing’s side ended.
The Witch Race people watching from a distance still hadn’t reacted.
They stretched their necks, seemingly wanting to see what the battle was like.
However, there was no trace of Zefer anymore.
The next moment, a strange look appeared in the eyes of these Witch Race people.
"What just happened?"
"Where did Lord Zefer go?"
Before this, they saw Zefer suppressing those humans unilaterally.
Yet.
One of the humans used some means to summon a moon.
Along with the burst attacks of the group, they disturbed this area, and they couldn’t see what happened inside at all.
At this moment, those Witch Race people, searching for Zefer’s figure, became even more puzzled.
"I didn’t see Lord Zefer, could it be that he ran away?"
"Impossible, Lord Zefer is the seventh legion’s leader, how could he be driven away by these humans?"
But what they didn’t know was that it wasn’t Zefer who ran away.
He had already been obliterated by the damage of Broken Moon, leaving no corpse behind.
Under Han Xing’s full burst, combined with the explosion of the legendary skill Broken Moon, that 1200% terrifying damage coefficient!
Even a Four-star Lord had absolutely no chance of surviving.
After waiting for a while, with no sign of Zefer appearing.
The bewildered crowd seemed to realize something.
A few Witch Race Professionals murmured, "Lord Zefer, could he be dead..."
The Witch Race person who spoke swallowed hard.
The others were also in disbelief.
Yet after all this time, Zefer had not appeared,
this guess was likely true!
The next moment, a chill went up their spines.
A Lord at the Four-star level was already one of the most terrifying existences under a legend.
No matter which major clan, they were a core strength.
However, today.
In the Royal City, such a powerhouse died, not to mention, dead in plain sight.
This was already a major event enough to shake the entire Witch Race!
They looked at Han Xing and the others with eyes full of fear.
A mature female voice suddenly came from the distant Royal Palace.
"How audacious!"
"To be so presumptuous within my Witch Race’s territory and even commit murder inside the Royal City!"
"Today, even if you are friends of the Saintess, you will not be spared!"
As soon as this female voice rang out, everyone suddenly felt as if they were being watched by a venomous snake.
Other Witch Race people also heard this voice, and their faces brightened.
"Is that... Lord Thirteen Priest?"
"Why is she here?"
There was some surprise and joy in the tone of these Witch Race people.
However, Han Xing and the others’ faces turned grim.
For they had already sensed the strength of this aura.
Legend!
Another legend!
A chill rose in Han Xing’s heart, "Finally, has it come out?"
"The one pulling all the strings behind the scenes."
Cheng Jianyong and the others were filled with intense shock upon hearing this.
"Brother Xing, are you saying, it’s this voice targeting us?"
Han Xing nodded, "Otherwise, who do you think has the authority to manipulate the Tower of Witch Soul within the Royal City and attack us?"
"Moreover, who else could get other Witch Race soldiers to willingly risk death just to capture us?"
Everyone’s expressions turned grim.
They knew that if this aura was targeting them, they were in big trouble!
After all, it’s a Legend!
If they really wanted to strike, there was almost no chance of escape for everyone!
Han Xing and the others were unsure why the owner of this voice was going to such great lengths.
With her power, killing them would be almost instantaneous.
In the next moment.
A figure wearing a black gauze outfit and an explosive figure that could not be concealed emerged into the air.
In terms of height, this woman was slightly shorter than Wu Ling’Er.
But her figure was exaggerated beyond proportion.
The most prominent feature of her petite figure was an impressive pair of breasts, almost bursting forth.
Even rivaling those of Zhang Lianmeng in scale.
Her hips were high and slender waist.
The whole person seemed like a carefully crafted doll, exuding an aura of desire.
In the next moment, a pair of eyes as bright as stars locked onto the group.
However, at this moment, Han Xing and the others were not focused on the woman’s figure.
Because a strong sense of crisis had already descended.
The black figure instantly covered several kilometers to appear above Han Xing and the others.
In the air, the woman locked her presence onto the five people.
At this moment, they once again felt the deathly oppression they experienced when facing the red giant dragon!
In the air, the woman coldly said, "Have you decided how you want to die?"
A sense of despair instantly enveloped everyone’s hearts.
Han Xing glanced at his skill bar.
There, lay his final trump card.
[Ultimate Skill - Sunfall Arrow]
This skill was the only one he had that could harm a Legend.
Though it carried severe side effects.
But at this critical juncture, he had no room for hesitation.
While the special effects on his body were still active.
Han Xing decided to fight it out with this woman!
At this time, a hint of ferocity also appeared in everyone’s eyes.
Even if a legendary powerhouse was present, they’d not go down without a fight.
In the air, the woman oozing an aura of temptation lightly laughed, "To face a Legend and still dare to make a move."
"I have to say, you humans are exceedingly bold!"
In the next moment, she extended a delicate hand.
However, to Han Xing and the others, that small hand seemed to eclipse the entire sky.
Han Xing took a deep breath, his right hand already on the bowstring.
A terrifying aura erupted from within him!
The legendary powerhouse looked surprised, sensing a dangerous aura from this man.
It’s a joke; she’s a Legend!
How could this not-even-fourth-transformation human possibly have a means to harm a Legend?
The woman in black gauze chuckled, "Human, you’re quite interesting. I’m almost reluctant to kill you now."
Han Xing was ready to use his ultimate skill at all costs, but just then.
From within the Royal Palace, an even more terrifying legendary aura surged upward.
At the same time, an angry female voice rang out.
"Feienna! How dare you deceive me!"
This voice was very familiar.
Upon hearing it, Han Xing’s hands gripping the longbow suddenly paused in mid-air.
Although not knowing what happened.
But the owner of this voice was undoubtedly Wu Ling’Er.
Moreover, compared to one or two hours ago.
The intensity of Wu Ling’Er’s aura had risen sharply, now truly possessing Legendary Level strength.
In the air, the woman exuding desire changed her expression upon hearing Wu Ling’Er’s voice.
"Wu Ling’Er... already out so soon?"
She glanced in the direction of the Royal Palace, then at Han Xing and the others.
In the next moment.
She seemed to make some sort of decision.
The right hand suspended in mid-air pressed down once more.
A terrifying blue secret pattern instantly enveloped Han Xing and the others.
Han Xing and the others’ hair stood on end.
"Not good, this woman insists on killing us!"
"Let’s fight her!"
In that instant, all five of Han Xing’s group felt a deadly sense of crisis!
In the distance, Wu Ling’Er also noticed Feienna’s action.
"Feienna! You’re courting death!"
Her voice was filled with intense killing intent and a hint of urgency.
In a moment of peril.
Suddenly, a brilliant blue light erupted from within the Royal Palace.
Countless Witch Clan secret patterns emerged.
The whole Witch Race Main City was enveloped in a sea of blue secret patterns at that moment.
When the woman’s attack was about to descend.
A familiar figure suddenly appeared before Han Xing and the others, who were prepared for a desperate struggle.
Wu Ling’Er.
Her face was somewhat pale.
Seemingly due to using some forbidden means and suffering a backlash.
Then.
At the moment when the sky was filled with secret patterns, she waved a single hand.
An equally terrifying aura surged upwards.
The two types of Witch Clan secret patterns began to counteract and explode!
Boom!
The entire Royal City strongly trembled at this moment.
However, the woman’s descending attack was also intercepted by Wu Ling’Er.
In the air, the woman in black gauze changed her expression in surprise and said, "Witchcraft — Witch Spirit Transfer!"

chapters.title: Chapter 281 - 226: Wu Ling’Er’s Wrath and the Legendary Battle
paragraphs: "I didn’t expect that for these few humans, you would even use this forbidden technique."
"Wu Ling’Er, you really do value them."
In the eyes of the Witch Race’s Thirteenth Priest, Feienna, there was a trace of surprise and disdain.
However, when she saw the eyes of Wu Ling’Er filled with killing intent, the disdain in her eyes vanished instantly.
She knew that Wu Ling’Er was angry, and it was an extremely severe murderous intent!
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er asked coldly, "Feienna, have I been away for so long that you think you can try me again?"
"Hmm?"
"While I was recovering, you set up so many layers of sealing power around me, blocking my perception."
"Was it just to deal with these friends of mine?"
The woman named Feienna did not deny it.
In the next moment, a terrifying aura erupted from Wu Ling’Er.
Then, she directly dashed into the sky, suddenly rushing towards Feienna.
Feienna exclaimed, "Wu Ling’Er! You’re going to fight me for these insignificant humans?"
Wu Ling’Er sneered, "Fight?"
"No! Today, I’m going to kill you!"
Feienna saw the killing intent in Wu Ling’Er’s eyes, her face full of disbelief, "Wu Ling’Er, you’ve gone mad! Stop it!"
"Shut up! You bitch! Today, either you die or I live!"
Wu Ling’Er’s voice echoed throughout the universe; she did not deliberately conceal it, and several billion Witch Race people heard it clearly.
The entire Witch Race Main City was shaking violently at this moment.
On this day, the Witch Race Saintess and the Witch Race’s Thirteenth Priest started a legendary battle!
Two legendary powerhouses instantly unleashed the divine powers within them.
Buzz!
On Wu Ling’Er’s body, a dazzling blue sphere of light suddenly emitted, like an intensely blooming blue sun!
The next moment, Wu Ling’Er charged at Feienna’s Secret Pattern Domain with a force of destruction!
The Secret Pattern Domain constructed by Feienna with divine power was torn apart in an instant!
The crisis approached.
Feienna exclaimed, "Wu Ling’Er, stop!
However, Wu Ling’Er paid no attention, and in the next moment, she went directly to Feienna’s side.
Aiming at her abdomen, she punched fiercely.
Puff!
Feienna’s eyes suddenly widened!
A sharp pain came from the abdomen, and then she was carried flying, retreating tens of thousands of meters in an instant!
However, this was not the end.
In the process of Feienna flying backward, Wu Ling’Er caught up again.
With cold eyes, she extended a slender jade hand, suddenly gripping Feienna’s jade neck.
Then, she extended another hand, and slapped hard!
Feienna just wanted to resist but found her blue secret pattern being thoroughly suppressed by Wu Ling’Er, and she couldn’t even release it.
Pow!
With a crisp sound of flesh.
Feienna took a heavy slap from Wu Ling’Er, and the veil on her face fell off.
Then, a childlike face that did not match her mature voice was revealed.
The face was both pure and alluring.
For some with certain fetishes, it instantly triggered the strongest desire deep in their hearts.
However, Han Xing and others also saw the swelling on the other side of Feienna’s face.
In front of several billion Witch Race people, Feienna was slapped by Wu Ling’Er until her face was bruised and swollen.
The dignity of a legendary powerhouse was swept away at this moment.
Feienna covered her swollen cheek, saying angrily, "Wu Ling’Er, how dare you hit me!"
Yet, possibly because of her reason, even in an angry state, Feienna appeared extremely wronged.
"Shut up!"
Wu Ling’Er directly stopped her and prepared to slap again.
Feienna also entered a frenzied state.
She shouted, "Ahhh!"
"Damn Wu Ling’Er! I’m going to kill you!"
The secret pattern domain of Feienna, which had been suppressed inside her body, erupted once again!
From a small sphere, it instantly expanded to the size of a small planet, contending with Wu Ling’Er’s Secret Pattern Domain.
Two dazzling blue suns covered everyone’s vision.
The legendary battle erupted again!
And it was two legends fighting with true fire.
They both wanted to kill the other.
Han Xing and others witnessed another side of Wu Ling’Er again.
An incredibly frenzied side!
Legendary powerhouses have already attained another level of power.
Divine power.
Two blue suns continued to collide, constantly changing positions.
The entire Witch Race Continent was affected by the energy waves overflowing from the two women, continuously shaking.
In this terrifying aura, several billion Witch Race people were trembling.
As the battlefield of the two women shifted.
The remaining various secret patterns lingered for a long time and emitted an aura of destruction, constantly colliding.
The entire sky was filled with these scattered blue secret patterns, even blocking the sun.
These remnants of the secret patterns also carried terrifying lethality.
Han Xing and others watched in a daze as the sky had completely turned into a blue sea, then swallowed nervously.
Is it true that they truly deserve to be legendary powerhouses?
The momentum of this battle is simply too terrifying!
The aftermath alone, and the remaining Witch Clan Secret Patterns, are enough to kill an unknown number of Third and Fourth Transformation powerhouses.
Including Han Xing stepping up, it’s the same!
Watching the battle between the two legends grow more intense.
If they didn’t deliberately control it, the entire Witch Race Continent would have already collapsed!
In the sky.
Wu Ling’Er is worthy of being the current Saintess of the Witch Race.
Even though she had just recovered to legendary power, and used a forbidden technique to rescue Han Xing and others.
But even so, she continued to suppress the other legendary member of the Witch Race, Feienna.
Feienna was beaten by Wu Ling’Er, constantly spitting blood.

chapters.title: Chapter 282 - 226: Wu Ling’Er’s Fury and the Legendary Battle (Part 2)
paragraphs: Their battlefield had moved from the main island of the Witch Race to the sky.
Even Feienna didn’t expect that a Legendary Battle would erupt today.
Moreover, it was with Wu Ling’Er in such a crazed state.
Compared to Wu Ling’Er’s full battle attire.
Feienna’s already scant clothing was being destroyed piece by piece by the cataclysmic energy clashing.
For a moment, a large expanse of spring scenery was exposed.
Some with good eyesight could even see Feienna’s full waist and flat abdomen.
Looking up, there were those exaggerated proportions.
With each violent collision, they kept trembling.
Feienna’s face went pale, gradually unable to hold on; she was no match for Wu Ling’Er.
"Wu Ling’Er, stop, I am the Witch Clan Priest, do you really intend to kill me?"
"Lord Saint Master and the High Priest won’t let you get away with this!"
Wu Ling’Er did not stop and instead sneered, "Trying to scare me with the Saint Master and High Priest?"
"Feienna, do you think that’s possible?"
Feienna’s complexion turned pale white; she understood Wu Ling’Er’s meaning.
Because this woman was hailed as the only one in millennia whose combat talent matched that of the first Saintess!
The entire tribe placed their hopes on her.
Even if Wu Ling’Er truly killed her, at most, she’d receive only minor punishment.
Not to mention, they wouldn’t trouble Wu Ling’Er for a dead legend.
For a moment, despair welled up in Feienna’s heart.
Wu Ling’Er taunted, "Feienna, do you really want to become the Witch Race Saintess so badly?"
"Since you lost the last election, you’ve been scheming to take my Saintess position."
"I ignored you before, but now, you’ve even targeted my friends!"
"Unforgivable!"
Feienna hastily explained, "It’s not like that, Wu Ling’Er, listen to me!"
However, Wu Ling’Er’s killing intent had already been stirred.
She had no interest in hearing Feienna’s excuses.
Wu Ling had always despised this power struggle.
However, the selection process for the Witch Race Saintess involves picking the most popular and talented women from within the tribe for a long selection process.
The competition for Witch Race Saintess has always been fierce.
After all, it’s one of the few known paths to demigod status for the Witch Race.
Once the number of Saintess is determined, other competitors have no more chances.
Unless the current Saintess commits a grave error, leading to her removal and a new selection.

Wu Ling’Er usually ignored her.

This completely infuriated Wu Ling’Er.
For the first time, Feienna felt such terrifying anger from Wu Ling’Er!
She was being beaten back step by step, her Secret Pattern Domain relentlessly suppressed!
Feienna roared in frustration, "Why! We are both legends, but why is there such a gap between us?
However, Wu Ling’Er coldly replied from the sky, "I’ll tell you after I kill you!"
Upon hearing this, Feienna’s face showed panic, "No, Wu Ling’Er, you can’t kill me!"
"I’m a Legendary Powerhouse of the Witch Race; without me, there will be one less top-tier Power!"
"The Witch Race is already no match for the Shadow Legion, and then the situation will be even harder to sustain!"
However, Wu Ling’Er sneered, "Feienna, you think I care about a legendary power like you?"
"Today, I will kill you!"
At this moment, Feienna finally realized Wu Ling’Er’s determination.
This woman was definitely going to kill her today.
"Poof!!!"
Feienna was constantly coughing up blood from Wu Ling’Er’s furious attacks.
If this continued, she truly faced the danger of falling.
Feienna’s face was full of grievance and confusion.
I am a legend...Why, in Wu Ling’Er’s eyes, am I not as significant as some outsiders?
Wu Ling’Er ignored her pleas, a cold voice emerged.
"Great Witchcraft..."
In the next moment, Feienna felt darkness surge around her like a tide.
She seemed to be sucked into some dark abyss, where all light vanished.
Fear showed on Feienna’s face for the first time.
It was the fear of death.
Feienna said with confidence, "Wu Ling’Er! What are you doing? You dared to use another Witch Clan Forbidden Technique!"
"Don’t you know, using the Forbidden Technique is a massive burden on us, you will die doing this!"
However, Wu Ling’Er scorned, "You think I’m useless like you?"
"Just two Forbidden Techniques..."
Wu Ling’Er’s tone was full of pride and disdain.
Then, she said coldly.
"Witchcraft—Forbidden Abyss!"
"No!"
Feienna cried out in despair.
She tried desperately, using all her means.
But it was to no avail.
The terrifying darkness completely covered her Secret Pattern Domain, and Feienna herself was on the brink of being devoured by it.
She clearly knew the horror of this Forbidden Technique.
Once devoured by darkness, one ends up in a completely unknown space.
There is no energy, no air, no light.
A purely void world.
Even a legend entering there has no chance of survival!
The fear of death seeped into her bones!
Feienna regretted immensely in her heart.
However, at this critical moment.
In the distance, another legendary aura emerged.
Its strength rivaled the enraged state of Wu Ling’Er, perhaps even slightly exceeding it.
And it was fast approaching the battlefield where Wu Ling’Er and the others clashed.
"Ling’Er, yield..."
The voice arrived before the person did.
However, Wu Ling’Er had already initiated the Forbidden Technique, and even she couldn’t stop it.
From afar, the silhouette seemed to sense the current situation and frowned.
Next, a burst of light erupted from his body, and within the light, dense Witch Clan Secret Patterns appeared.
But unlike those of Wu Ling’Er and Feienna.
His energy was red.
Then, this ball of red energy enveloped the two women.
As a dazzling light appeared.
Billions of Witch Race People watching the sky duel simultaneously closed their eyes.
Once the light dissipated.
The dark vortex engulfing Feienna vanished as well.
Meanwhile, Han Xing and the others saw the figure clearly.
This was a man, a male member of the Witch Race.
He had shoulder-length long hair, well-defined features, and a very delicate appearance, looking like a fifteen or sixteen-year-old boy.
Yet Feienna, upon seeing him, exclaimed with joy, "High Priest!"
Yes, this person was the Witch Race High Priest: Xiao.
Xiao released a powerful aura that separated the two women.
He frowned and said, "Explain yourselves, Wu Ling’Er, Feienna, what are you doing?"
Upon hearing this, Feienna’s eyes shifted continuously.
The next moment, her childlike face wore a pitiful expression, looking extremely plaintive.
Feienna said aggrievedly, "High Priest... Even I don’t know what happened, Wu Ling’Er suddenly attacked me,"
"As if she’d gone mad."
Wu Ling’Er stared at her, sneering, "Bitch! Do you think that just because the High Priest is here, I won’t dare kill you?"
Feienna’s body trembled slightly.
She realized Wu Ling’Er was serious.
During her encounter with Wu Ling’Er just now, she had felt the sensation of near-death.
Wu Ling’Er truly had the means and the power to kill a legend!
Feienna hurriedly closed her mouth, truly afraid of Wu Ling’Er now.
In fact, there was no need for Feienna to say more.
From above, the Witch Race High Priest could sense and deduce what had happened below.
A moment later, he sighed and said, "Ling’Er, I know Feienna’s character."
"This is her fault, and she has caused damage to the seventeenth main city under your jurisdiction."
"However, infighting is the most strictly forbidden thing for the Witch Race, and I hope you can stop at the right time."
Wu Ling’Er snorted lightly, seemingly unconvinced.

From the air, Xiao’s tone changed, continuing, "However, since this started because of Feienna, when the Witch Race is facing a crisis, and Feienna disregarded the bigger picture, attacking our Saintess..."

chapters.title: Chapter 283 - 227: The High Priest’s Judgment
paragraphs: At this moment, Feienna, upon hearing, the grievance on her face disappeared, replaced by a trace of fear.
She detected the seriousness in the High Priest’s tone.
She realized that this time, the trouble she had caused seemed really significant.

The High Priest of the Witch Race, Xiao spoke again: "According to the laws of the Witch Race, for such acts of harming fellow tribesmen and disregarding royal laws, the penalty should be execution on the spot!"
His tone revealed a chilling coldness.
Fear filled Feienna’s eyes as she continuously shook her head.
The High Priest continued: "However, considering this is Feienna’s first offense and her legendary level of strength, the punishment will be..."
The High Priest seemed hesitant as he reached this point.
After a moment, he slowly said: "The punishment will be for her to guard the boundaries of the Witch Race, to fend off the Shadow Legion’s invasion."
"Unless she slays ten legendary powerhouses, she will never be allowed to return to the Witch Race!"
"Otherwise, she will have the divine power granted to her by the Witch Race’s god stripped away by the ten high priests in unison."
"Ling’Er, what do you think of this judgment?"
Feienna’s face turned pale as paper in an instant.
Such a punishment is already quite severe.
In terms of personal combat strength, Feienna is not powerful among the legends.
She has only barely broken through to that level.
However, the High Priest demands that she kills ten legendary members of the Shadow Legion!
This task is as difficult as ascending the heavens, with a high chance of losing her life.
Yet, Feienna does not dare to disobey.
Because if she is stripped of the divine power granted by the Witch Race’s god.
It would mean a fall from legendary level to an ordinary fifth transformation.
More unbearable than being killed.
Wu Ling’Er also understood that the High Priest’s ruling was not biased towards Feienna.
After pondering for a moment, she said: "It’s acceptable."
Seeing Wu Ling’Er agreeing, the High Priest of the Witch Race also nodded.
"You have just returned, there must be many matters to handle in the city."
"My first main city is closest to the edge of the Witch Race territory and must constantly guard against the Shadow Legion’s invasion, so I cannot be disengaged."
"This matter ends here."
"Feienna will be taken to the first main city by me for handling, and within days, I will announce the results of this judgment to the entire tribe, how does that sound?"
Wu Ling’Er nodded to show no objections.
The High Priest had nothing more to say.
All priests of the Witch Race have their own tasks.
This time, he received an urgent message, learning about the battle between Wu Ling’Er and Feienna.
He spared no cost to cross the vast territory of the Witch Race in a very short time to arrive here.
Now, the High Priest dragged Feienna and disappeared over the horizon.
Three strong auras as radiant as the sun dissipated.
At that moment, billions of Witch Race people breathed a sigh of relief.
A legendary battle concluded thusly.
At this moment.
Wu Ling’Er’s figure flashed and instantly returned to the Royal City.
The next moment, innumerable Witch Race soldiers knelt down as a whole.
They shouted in unison: "Please forgive us, Lady Saintess!"
The onlooking Witch Race civilians looked bewildered.
However, upon hearing, Wu Ling’Er revealed a slight cold smile.
She clearly understood why these Witch Race soldiers voluntarily pleaded for forgiveness.
"Feienna caused such a commotion in the city, and you all pretended not to see it."
"So, have you forgotten who the master of this Royal City is, as I’ve been away for a while?"
Wu Ling’Er’s tone was icy, revealing a hint of menacing intent.
Below.
All Witch Race soldiers lay prostrate, not daring to breathe.
At this moment, several Golden Armor Warriors seemed unable to withstand the oppressive atmosphere,
They raised their heads with difficulty and said: "Rep-... report to Lady Saintess.
"We did not pretend not to see it, but the Thirteen Priests used legendary power to coerce us..."
However, Wu Ling’Er did not want to hear their explanation, she directly interrupted them.
"Don’t tell me you had no choice."
"You should know that as long as I appear, the so-called threat of Feienna has no effect at all."
"Ultimately, you took benefits from Feienna, right?"
Upon hearing this, these Golden Armor Warriors’ faces changed instantly, their bodies trembling like chaff.
Wu Ling’Er actually knew everything!
Seeing their expressions, Wu Ling’Er sneered.
"Anyone involved in Feienna’s plan should come forward and confess clearly now. If I find out afterwards..."
"You weigh the consequences yourself!"
Wu Ling’Er’s tone held murder and decisiveness.
After all, she is the queen who governs a cardinal city of tens of billions of lives and deaths.
Wu Ling’Er indeed possesses the needed courage.
Below, countless Witch Race soldiers turned pale.
They knew Wu Ling’Er meant business this time.
Next, surely a large number of people would be unearthed and held accountable.
Malik and Zefer may be dead.
But everyone knew that the impact of this incident would continue.
This royal city of the Witch Race, with a population comparable to a nation, was going to be in chaos for a while.
Disregarding the kneeling Witch Race soldiers.
Wu Ling’Er’s figure flashed again, appearing beside Han Xing.
Wu Ling’Er said with heartfelt remorse, "Apologies for dragging you all into this, making you witness such a fiasco."
Her face showed none of the pride she had when facing those Witch Race soldiers.
Instead, there was some guilt and helplessness.
Then, she deeply bowed to everyone.
Listening to Wu Ling’Er’s sincere apology.
Han Xing and the others just shrugged indifferently.
Although, this time they were indeed forced into an unforeseen disaster.
That Feienna wanted to deal with Wu Ling’Er but had no excuse.
So she set her sights on Han Xing and his group.
Her plan was quite well thought out.
She intended for Malik to cause trouble for Han Xing and the others, forcing them to act in the main city.
Then, she would wait to secure critical evidence and capture Han Xing and his group with undeniable proof.
She would report the matter to the Witch Race’s council, thus tarnishing Wu Ling’Er’s career as a Lady Saintess.
However, she never expected that these humans, who seemingly only had the aura of a Third Transformation, would be so powerful and decisive!
Malik was slain on the spot.
Even Zefer, with the strength of a Four-star Lord, couldn’t capture them.
Forcing Feienna to take action herself!
But she didn’t foresee that the energy fluctuation from her action would be sensed by Wu Ling’Er, who was in a state of recovery, and cause her to rush out early.
Feienna’s plan ended in failure.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er sincerely spoke.
"This time, because of me, you all were involved in a storm without cause."
"This is my mistake, and thank you for forgiving us."
"To make up for my fault, I’ll give you an additional one thousand Philosopher’s Stones as compensation."
"Consider it a small token of my sincerity, is that okay?"
Wu Ling’Er’s eyes held a hint of anticipation and plea.
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s eyes immediately lit up.
One thousand Philosopher’s Stones, that’s not a meager compensation!
In fact, it’s incredibly generous!
In the last Blood Tide battle, such a major event, the top of the leaderboard only received one hundred Philosopher’s Stones.
You can imagine how precious this material is.
Wu Ling’Er also mentioned that Philosopher’s Stones can only be obtained by slaying beings imbued with Divine Power, and even then, there’s only a chance they’ll drop.
This precious material, perhaps even the entire Witch Race, has limited stock.
In the last escort mission, Wu Ling’Er promised him a thousand Philosopher’s Stones.
This time, the offer is doubled, showing her sincere intentions.
Han Xing naturally recognized that Wu Ling’Er truly wished to mend their relationship.
So he nodded and said, "Alright."
Wu Ling’Er genuinely smiled and softly said, "Thank you."
"Let’s not delay, I’ll take you to collect this reward right now, yes?"
Han Xing and the others’ eyes lit up, and they nodded repeatedly.
"Of course!"
Wu Ling’Er chuckled softly and waved her hand once more.
Then, a current of wind enveloped the five of them and carried them into the air.
On the way to the Royal Palace.
Han Xing learned from the mouth of the Witch Race High Priest just now.
The entire main city belongs to Wu Ling’Er.
The dozen or so priests of the Witch Race each control a main city of this scale.
Han Xing roughly estimated in his mind.
By this calculation, the legendary powerhouses of the Witch Race number no less than twenty.
Sounds like a lot.
But it’s important to know, this is a clan with a population of hundreds of billions, accumulated over thousands, even tens of thousands of years!
The movement speed of legendary powerhouses is extremely fast.
In less than ten seconds.
The group arrived at the Royal Palace in the heart of the main city.
As Wu Ling’Er’s residence and the face of a city, its interior design is also extremely magnificent.
Walking through the long corridors.
Wu Ling’Er led the group into a hall.
Here, it seemed to be a private meeting room.
Besides them, there were no signs of other activities inside,
At this time, Wu Ling’Er turned her head and softly said, "Please wait a moment."
"I’ll go to the warehouse to retrieve your reward."
Han Xing and the others nodded and waited silently in the meeting room.
A few minutes later, Wu Ling’Er returned, dressed in a pure white plain dress, and appeared before them.
In the recent battle, Wu Ling’Er’s equipment was affected by the legendary-level power, causing some wear and tear.
Now, this daily-style outfit, along with her long hair trailing the ground, gave her a fairy-like beauty.
Even compared to Su Xiaoyang, she was no less stunning.
For a moment, Han Xing, Shen Yun, and the others were a bit entranced.
Zhang Lianmeng gasped softly beside them, "So beautiful..."
Seeing everyone’s reactions, Wu Ling’Er gave a gentle smile.
At her signal.
A few Witch Race guards appeared from behind.
They were in pairs, each carrying a large golden chest, which they placed before the group.
Then silently retreated.
Now, the entire meeting hall was left with only the six of them again.
Wu Ling’Er said, "Everything is here; feel free to check them."
Cheng Jianyong, hearing this, didn’t hold back.
He stepped forward and opened the golden chests one by one.
Before them appeared a heap of stones and peculiar metals, shining with various lights, a dazzling display.
Han Xing cast his glance.
First.
The first chest contained mostly stones that appeared drenched in blood, dark red in color.

She intended for Malik to cause trouble for Han Xing and the others, forcing them to act in the main city.
Then, she would wait to secure critical evidence and capture Han Xing and his group with undeniable proof.
She would report the matter to the Witch Race’s council, thus tarnishing Wu Ling’Er’s career as a Lady Saintess.
However, she never expected that these humans, who seemingly only had the aura of a Third Transformation, would be so powerful and decisive!
Malik was slain on the spot.
Even Zefer, with the strength of a Four-star Lord, couldn’t capture them.
Forcing Feienna to take action herself!
But she didn’t foresee that the energy fluctuation from her action would be sensed by Wu Ling’Er, who was in a state of recovery, and cause her to rush out early.
Feienna’s plan ended in failure.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er sincerely spoke.
"This time, because of me, you all were involved in a storm without cause."
"This is my mistake, and thank you for forgiving us."
"To make up for my fault, I’ll give you an additional one thousand Philosopher’s Stones as compensation."
"Consider it a small token of my sincerity, is that okay?"
Wu Ling’Er’s eyes held a hint of anticipation and plea.
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s eyes immediately lit up.
One thousand Philosopher’s Stones, that’s not a meager compensation!
In fact, it’s incredibly generous!
In the last Blood Tide battle, such a major event, the top of the leaderboard only received one hundred Philosopher’s Stones.
You can imagine how precious this material is.
Wu Ling’Er also mentioned that Philosopher’s Stones can only be obtained by slaying beings imbued with Divine Power, and even then, there’s only a chance they’ll drop.
This precious material, perhaps even the entire Witch Race, has limited stock.
In the last escort mission, Wu Ling’Er promised him a thousand Philosopher’s Stones.
This time, the offer is doubled, showing her sincere intentions.
Han Xing naturally recognized that Wu Ling’Er truly wished to mend their relationship.
So he nodded and said, "Alright."
Wu Ling’Er genuinely smiled and softly said, "Thank you."
"Let’s not delay, I’ll take you to collect this reward right now, yes?"
Han Xing and the others’ eyes lit up, and they nodded repeatedly.
"Of course!"
Wu Ling’Er chuckled softly and waved her hand once more.
Then, a current of wind enveloped the five of them and carried them into the air.
On the way to the Royal Palace.
Han Xing learned from the mouth of the Witch Race High Priest just now.
The entire main city belongs to Wu Ling’Er.
The dozen or so priests of the Witch Race each control a main city of this scale.
Han Xing roughly estimated in his mind.
By this calculation, the legendary powerhouses of the Witch Race number no less than twenty.
Sounds like a lot.
But it’s important to know, this is a clan with a population of hundreds of billions, accumulated over thousands, even tens of thousands of years!
The movement speed of legendary powerhouses is extremely fast.
In less than ten seconds.
The group arrived at the Royal Palace in the heart of the main city.
As Wu Ling’Er’s residence and the face of a city, its interior design is also extremely magnificent.
Walking through the long corridors.
Wu Ling’Er led the group into a hall.
Here, it seemed to be a private meeting room.
Besides them, there were no signs of other activities inside,
At this time, Wu Ling’Er turned her head and softly said, "Please wait a moment."
"I’ll go to the warehouse to retrieve your reward."
Han Xing and the others nodded and waited silently in the meeting room.
A few minutes later, Wu Ling’Er returned, dressed in a pure white plain dress, and appeared before them.
In the recent battle, Wu Ling’Er’s equipment was affected by the legendary-level power, causing some wear and tear.
Now, this daily-style outfit, along with her long hair trailing the ground, gave her a fairy-like beauty.
Even compared to Su Xiaoyang, she was no less stunning.
For a moment, Han Xing, Shen Yun, and the others were a bit entranced.
Zhang Lianmeng gasped softly beside them, "So beautiful..."
Seeing everyone’s reactions, Wu Ling’Er gave a gentle smile.
At her signal.
A few Witch Race guards appeared from behind.
They were in pairs, each carrying a large golden chest, which they placed before the group.
Then silently retreated.
Now, the entire meeting hall was left with only the six of them again.
Wu Ling’Er said, "Everything is here; feel free to check them."
Cheng Jianyong, hearing this, didn’t hold back.
He stepped forward and opened the golden chests one by one.
Before them appeared a heap of stones and peculiar metals, shining with various lights, a dazzling display.
Han Xing cast his glance.
First.
The first chest contained mostly stones that appeared drenched in blood, dark red in color.

chapters.title: Chapter 284 - 228: Mission Complete, Generous Rewards!
paragraphs: These stones are the Philosopher’s Stones, a total of two thousand!
Han Xing’s breath hitched.
He clearly knew the value inside this box!
At this stage, even if all of humanity’s Philosopher’s Stones were combined, they probably wouldn’t be as many as those in this box.
Wu Ling’Er, as the Saintess of a great clan, indeed had astonishing resources.
After examining the Philosopher’s Stones.
Han Xing once again gazed with an excited look at the large box beside him.
Inside, half a box was filled with items emitting a faint glow, appearing both like stones and crystals.
In front of Han Xing also appeared the attributes of this material.
[Shadow Divine Stone]: A stone containing the power of the Shadow God, an extremely precious material.
Item Remarks.
[In an extremely ancient era, there was a deity governing shadows.
One day, he picked up a strange stone in the void, and since then, the Shadow God’s life changed.
He discovered that the stone seemed to harbor life and intelligence, along with a strong desire for attack.
This stone had a special ability, that is, it could assimilate all objects radiated by its power into a crystal form.
Even the Shadow God couldn’t resist the assimilation of this power.
His body began to mutate, despite using various methods, he couldn’t recover.
The Shadow God realized this crystal was an evil item, and even a being of his level couldn’t resist.
Even when he unleashed all his divine power, it could only delay the effect, not eliminate it.
His divine body was corroded day by day... his divine sense growing weaker.
The Shadow God sought help from other gods, but to no avail.
This made the Shadow God feel desperate and even more fearful.
He knew that once he was completely assimilated by the crystal, his body would be beyond his control.
An uncontrolled deity would bring terrible disaster to the entire world.
Forced by circumstances, the Shadow God decided to seal his divine power and exile himself to a forbidden land.
However, despite this.
The Shadow God could still feel the stone continually corroding his body, his divine power leaking out.
The divine power that leaked out condensed into crystal forms.
These crystals became the Shadow Divine Stones.]
Seeing the introduction of the Shadow Divine Stone, Han Xing’s eyes also showed a thoughtful expression.
Though he knew the origins of the Shadow Divine Stone were extraordinary, he didn’t expect it to involve a deity.
The Shadow God.
As an extremely ancient deity.
He seemed to have been polluted by something strange to the point of degenerating into a twisted and evil being.
To avoid losing control and causing disaster in the Holy Spirit Realm.
The Shadow God willingly sealed himself and exiled himself to a forbidden land.
And the divine power he released, condensed into crystals, became these stones.
Wu Ling’Er previously mentioned that the Shadow Divine Stones could only be dropped by these monsters.
Is there a necessary connection with the current enemies of the Witch Race, the Shadow Legion?
Han Xing fell into contemplation.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er’s voice sounded.
"Han Xing, what’s wrong?"
During the journey, both parties had introduced themselves.
So Wu Ling’Er knew their names.
Han Xing heard this and retracted his thoughts, shook his head and said, "Nothing."
He didn’t know if Wu Ling’Er was aware of the source of the Shadow Divine Stones.
But the Witch Race has dealt with the Shadow Legion for so many years, presumably they have deeper understanding than Han Xing.
Then, Han Xing’s gaze turned to the last Golden Treasure Chest.
Inside, it was filled with exotic metal appearing dark blue, like liquid flowing.
Rhythm Black Iron.
As one of the main materials for forging Divine Artifacts and Holy Artifacts, gather enough and you could exchange with the Dwarf Race for Ancient Weapon Blueprints.
Extremely precious.
On this pile of Rhythm Black Iron, there quietly lay a golden blueprint and a white blueprint.
The golden blueprint should be the Ancient Weapon Blueprint from Wu Ling’Er’s task commission: Demon Elephant War Chariot.
As for the white blueprint, it’s something Wu Ling’Er mentioned on the way: Shimmering Terra Stone Extraction Device.
Faced with so many precious materials.
Even someone like Han Xing who’s seen much of the world, couldn’t help but breathe heavily at this moment.
At this time, Wu Ling’Er spoke: "Alright, everything is here."
"To make it easier for you to carry, I’ll give you something else."
Wu Ling’Er took off a ring from her hand.
Then solemnly said: "This ring is a rare space storage item."
"Normally it looks no different from a regular ring, but inside, it contains a highly stable power of space, capable of holding quite a lot."
"Such space rings are scarce even in the entire Holy Spirit Realm."
"Even Legendary Powerhouses don’t all have space storage items."
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er reminded again: "If possible, please try not to expose the existence of this ring."
"Otherwise, it might cause you many troubles."
Listening to Wu Ling’Er’s description, Han Xing couldn’t help but look slightly bizarre.
This thing, isn’t it just like those space rings from novels?
Moreover, I also have space-type storage items!
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly asked, "Can I take a look at the ring first?"
Wu Ling’Er nodded, then handed the ring to Han Xing.
After receiving it, the corresponding attributes appeared before Han Xing.
[Space Ring (Blue), Quality: Rare, Space: 100, Attached Effect: None.]
After reading the attributes of the ring, Han Xing’s expression became more peculiar.
This thing is clearly the same type of equipment as his space backpack.
It’s just that the space backpack is special equipment and does not occupy the ring’s equipment slot.
Moreover, the attributes of this ring aren’t considered top-grade, with only a hundred slots of space, yet it’s treasured by a powerhouse like Wu Ling’Er.
Seeing Han Xing’s peculiar expression, Wu Ling’Er couldn’t help but ask, "What’s wrong? Is there something wrong with this ring?"
"No, there’s nothing wrong with the ring."
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Can I ask where you got a ring like this?"
Wu Ling’Er thought for a moment, then replied, "This was left behind by the previous generation Witch Race Saintess."
However, Han Xing shook his head and said, "That’s not what I’m asking."
"I’m asking if the origin of this ring is related to our Human Race?"
Wu Ling’Er’s shoulders trembled, and she gave Han Xing a deep look.
Then, she nodded again and said, "You’re right, this ring was brought out by the Human Race from the previous generation who left the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
"These people from the Human Race seem to have unique technology that allows them to create this kind of space storage item."
Everyone was taken aback.
Han Xing, however, thought to himself, as expected.
Han Xing continued to ask, "Do you know how many years it has been since the last generation of the Human Race left the Land of the Abandoned Gods?
Upon hearing this, Wu Ling’Er slightly raised her eyebrows, seemingly recalling something.
After a moment, she softly replied, "I’m not too sure about the exact time."
"Because ever since I was born, you all are the first batch of Human Race I’ve brought out of the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
"According to the Witch Race records, the last batch of Human Race to come out was approximately thirteen hundred years ago."
Thirteen hundred years.
Upon hearing this number, the confusion in everyone’s eyes grew stronger.
That’s when Han Xing nodded, "I understand."
Wu Ling’Er, along with Cheng Jianyong and the others, were all taken aback.
They didn’t know what Han Xing understood.
Han Xing didn’t explain and returned the ring to Wu Ling’Er.
"You should keep this ring yourself."
"As a member of the Human Race, I naturally have this kind of item too."
Wu Ling’Er was also surprised.
She knew that the space ring originated from the previous generation of the Human Race.
But according to the records, these space rings were extremely difficult to create.
Even those from the batch that came out of the Land of the Abandoned Gods had very few in their possession.
Thus, the number of space rings circulating in the Holy Spirit Realm was exceedingly rare.
Combined with the consumption over the years and the fall of some powerhouses, space rings became even more rare.
The space ring she held could even arouse the covetousness of Legendary Level powerhouses.
So, she never considered that Han Xing also had such an item.
Han Xing’s eyes once again revealed a contemplative look.
A blue-grade space ring could evoke the covetousness of Legendary Level powerhouses.
This indicates that its value is at least equivalent to that of an orange epic equipment!
If I were to take out a purple backpack, wouldn’t it be comparable to a Divine Artifact?
Han Xing’s pupils shranked.
Clearly, this is possible.
Judging from Wu Ling’Er’s reaction.
This kind of space item is immensely precious to them.
It even counts as a Witch Race heritage item.
If Han Xing proposed at this moment to trade a blue top-grade backpack for a few, even hundreds of Philosopher’s Stones or Shadow Divine Stones,
Wu Ling’Er would undoubtedly agree immediately.
If he could trade in bulk, Han Xing could earn enormous profits!
After the Blood Tide ended, Han Xing stopped producing the Blood Curse Antidote.
The backend interface now hangs 24/7 with the Destruction Rune (Gold) and blue-purple grade backpacks.
So, the number of backpacks he currently owns is very plentiful, already reaching tens of thousands.
If Wu Ling’Er could take them all, Han Xing doesn’t know how much precious resource he could exchange for.
At that point, he could mass-produce equipment of even Divine Artifact Level.
This would be far more profitable than trading with human survivors.
Even if the Witch Race can’t consume so many backpacks, Han Xing could still trade with other major races of this world.
Moreover, Han Xing suspects that the last generation of Human Race who left the Land of the Abandoned Gods did the same.
It’s imaginable that they must have made a huge profit through these space ring trades!
This is a rare opportunity.
Before other Human Race members leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods, Han Xing can again possess a unique advantage!
But after contemplating for a moment, Han Xing still forced himself to suppress his excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 285 - 229: Affinity Unlock and Legendary Backing
paragraphs: Then, he slowly took out a blue beast hide backpack from his space backpack and tossed it to Wu Ling’Er.
When Wu Ling’Er received the backpack, her eyes were still somewhat puzzled.
But when she sensed the rich power of space contained within it.
The confusion in her eyes vanished and turned directly into shock.
Wu Ling’Er stared dumbfounded at the backpack in her hand, then looked at Han Xing and said, "This, this, this... this backpack is actually a kind of space storage tool!"
"The power of space contained within it even exceeds my ring by twice!"
"Inside, I also sensed a slight amplification of power!"
Wu Ling’Er’s tone was extremely shocked.
As the Witch Race Saintess and a Legendary Powerhouse.
She clearly knew how precious this backpack was.
Even among the Legendary Level of the tribe, not everyone could own a space storage tool.
At this moment, she hesitantly said, "Do you Human Race have many such space storage tools?"
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Not quite, even for us, it’s not easy to get a backpack."
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong, upon hearing this, took a discreet glance at Han Xing.
However, no one displayed it outwardly.
Wu Ling’Er believed him without a doubt and hurriedly said, "Then I can’t take this backpack. You should keep it for yourself!"
"This time, I was the one troubling you all, and now taking such a precious item from you makes me feel uneasy."
Han Xing shook his head and said, "It’s fine, I happen to have an extra one. Consider it a gift to you."
Seeing the determination in Han Xing’s eyes, Wu Ling’Er hesitated for a moment and then nodded solemnly.
She didn’t refuse anymore and instead held the blue backpack in her hand, looking gratefully at Han Xing.
Han Xing then said, "Although this kind of backpack is quite rare, when I return to the Land of the Abandoned Gods, I’ll find a way to bring out a few more."
Upon hearing this, Wu Ling’Er’s surprise grew.
She spoke with breathless excitement, "If you can bring out more space backpacks in the future, can you prioritize providing them to me if possible?"
"I will give you generous rewards, and the price will certainly satisfy you!
Wu Ling’Er looked at Han Xing with great anticipation.
Han Xing was also very excited.
He had been waiting for Wu Ling’Er to say this.
This would open a trade route between him and the indigenous people of this world.
Then, Han Xing would be able to reap immense profits from it!
However, Han Xing did not show it and simply nodded, saying, "Alright, if I acquire more of these backpacks later, I’ll contact you first."
Wu Ling’Er gratefully looked at Han Xing and said, "Thank you, Han Xing."
Han Xing casually nodded.
Then, in front of Wu Ling’Er, he directly stored all the materials from the three large boxes into his backpack.
The system notification appeared.
"Quest completed: Wu Ling’Er’s Request."
"Rewards obtained: Ancient Weapon: Demon Elephant War Chariot Blueprint *1, Philosopher’s Stone *1000, Shadow Divine Stone *1000, Rhythm Black Iron *10000."
As this pile of precious materials added up, Han Xing’s mouth curled into a satisfied smile.
All the unpleasant experiences at the Witch Race Royal City instantly vanished.
Nothing feels more satisfying than actual gains.
This journey to the Witch Race was really fruitful for them.
At this point, another system notification arrived.

"Due to your successful task completion, receive additional rewards: Philosopher’s Stone *1000, Shimmering Terra Stone Refinement Device Blueprint *1, Witch Race Affinity +1000, Wu Ling’er’s Affinity +20."
"Race Affinity interface unlocked..."
"Character Affinity interface unlocked..."
Han Xing was a bit surprised, "Oh? The affinity interface got unlocked?"
He looked at the system panel.
And noticed two new options appeared.
One was Race Affinity and the other was Character Affinity.
Currently, both interfaces had only one option.
[Witch Race Affinity]: 732 (Friendly)
[Wu Ling’er’s Affinity]: 80 (Trust)
Previously, when Han Xing fought in the main city, he had taken down quite a few Witch Race Soldiers, which had caused his Witch Race Affinity to drop to negative.
However, with this boost, it had been pulled back to a friendly level.
And what Han Xing hadn’t expected was that, besides the affinity, Wu Ling’er’s Affinity had also been unlocked.
And the affinity level wasn’t low.
points—it’s already a trustworthy level.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er asked with a smile, "The entrusted task is completed."
"What are your plans next?"
The group exchanged glances and then shook their heads.
Wu Ling’Er saw this and seemed to have a hint of joy in her eyes.
She asked in a slightly probing tone, "Then... Han Xing, would you like to join our Witch Race? I can offer you the position of Vanguard Captain, commanding a million Witch Race soldiers."
"For your other companions, I can also offer them the position of Vanguard Corps leader."
Everyone’s eyes brightened up.
Han Xing asked, "Vanguard Captain, is it the same position as Zefer’s?"
Wu Ling’Er nodded gently.
"Yes, once you become a Vanguard Captain, you will be among the highest-ranked people in the entire Witch Race."
"You will have the right to move freely in and out of any major city of the Witch Race. Moreover, when purchasing things in any major city, you can enjoy a 30% discount."
"Besides, you will have a million elite Witch Race Soldiers at your command."
The more Wu Ling’Er spoke, the more it made everyone’s breath catch.
It must be said, the conditions she offered were truly enticing.
