"The power of space contained within it even exceeds my ring by twice!"
"Inside, I also sensed a slight amplification of power!"
Wu Ling’Er’s tone was extremely shocked.
As the Witch Race Saintess and a Legendary Powerhouse.
She clearly knew how precious this backpack was.
Even among the Legendary Level of the tribe, not everyone could own a space storage tool.
At this moment, she hesitantly said, "Do you Human Race have many such space storage tools?"
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Not quite, even for us, it’s not easy to get a backpack."
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong, upon hearing this, took a discreet glance at Han Xing.
However, no one displayed it outwardly.
Wu Ling’Er believed him without a doubt and hurriedly said, "Then I can’t take this backpack.
You should keep it for yourself!"
"This time, I was the one troubling you all, and now taking such a precious item from you makes me feel uneasy."
Han Xing shook his head and said, "It’s fine, I happen to have an extra one.
Consider it a gift to you."
Seeing the determination in Han Xing’s eyes, Wu Ling’Er hesitated for a moment and then nodded solemnly.
She didn’t refuse anymore and instead held the blue backpack in her hand, looking gratefully at Han Xing.
Han Xing then said, "Although this kind of backpack is quite rare, when I return to the Land of the Abandoned Gods, I’ll find a way to bring out a few more."
Upon hearing this, Wu Ling’Er’s surprise grew.
She spoke with breathless excitement, "If you can bring out more space backpacks in the future, can you prioritize providing them to me if possible?"
"I will give you generous rewards, and the price will certainly satisfy you!
Wu Ling’Er looked at Han Xing with great anticipation.
Han Xing was also very excited.
He had been waiting for Wu Ling’Er to say this.
This would open a trade route between him and the indigenous people of this world.
Then, Han Xing would be able to reap immense profits from it!
However, Han Xing did not show it and simply nodded, saying, "Alright, if I acquire more of these backpacks later, I’ll contact you first."
Wu Ling’Er gratefully looked at Han Xing and said, "Thank you, Han Xing."
Han Xing casually nodded.
Then, in front of Wu Ling’Er, he directly stored all the materials from the three large boxes into his backpack.
The system notification appeared.
"Quest completed: Wu Ling’Er’s Request."
"Rewards obtained: Ancient Weapon: Demon Elephant War Chariot Blueprint *1, Philosopher’s Stone *1000, Shadow Divine Stone *1000, Rhythm Black Iron *10000."
As this pile of precious materials added up, Han Xing’s mouth curled into a satisfied smile.
All the unpleasant experiences at the Witch Race Royal City instantly vanished.
Nothing feels more satisfying than actual gains.
This journey to the Witch Race was really fruitful for them.
At this point, another system notification arrived.

"Due to your successful task completion, receive additional rewards: Philosopher’s Stone *1000, Shimmering Terra Stone Refinement Device Blueprint *1, Witch Race Affinity +1000, Wu Ling’er’s Affinity +20."
"Race Affinity interface unlocked..."
"Character Affinity interface unlocked..."
Han Xing was a bit surprised, "Oh?
The affinity interface got unlocked?"
He looked at the system panel.
And noticed two new options appeared.
One was Race Affinity and the other was Character Affinity.
Currently, both interfaces had only one option.
[Witch Race Affinity]: 732 (Friendly)
[Wu Ling’er’s Affinity]: 80 (Trust)
Previously, when Han Xing fought in the main city, he had taken down quite a few Witch Race Soldiers, which had caused his Witch Race Affinity to drop to negative.
However, with this boost, it had been pulled back to a friendly level.
And what Han Xing hadn’t expected was that, besides the affinity, Wu Ling’er’s Affinity had also been unlocked.
And the affinity level wasn’t low.
points—it’s already a trustworthy level.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er asked with a smile, "The entrusted task is completed."
"What are your plans next?"
The group exchanged glances and then shook their heads.
Wu Ling’Er saw this and seemed to have a hint of joy in her eyes.
She asked in a slightly probing tone, "Then...
Han Xing, would you like to join our Witch Race?
I can offer you the position of Vanguard Captain, commanding a million Witch Race soldiers."
"For your other companions, I can also offer them the position of Vanguard Corps leader."
Everyone’s eyes brightened up.
Han Xing asked, "Vanguard Captain, is it the same position as Zefer’s?"
Wu Ling’Er nodded gently.
"Yes, once you become a Vanguard Captain, you will be among the highest-ranked people in the entire Witch Race."
"You will have the right to move freely in and out of any major city of the Witch Race.
Moreover, when purchasing things in any major city, you can enjoy a 30% discount."
"Besides, you will have a million elite Witch Race Soldiers at your command."
The more Wu Ling’Er spoke, the more it made everyone’s breath catch.
It must be said, the conditions she offered were truly enticing.

chapters.title: Chapter 286 - 229: Affinity Unlock and Legendary Backer_2
paragraphs: Now, as long as they agree, it’s equivalent to establishing a firm foothold directly within the Witch Race.
And they will have the right to command a million soldiers!

However, after pondering for a moment, Han Xing asked, "Do you mean that after we leave this time, if we do not hold a position within your Witch Race, we won’t be able to freely enter and exit the Witch Race Main City in the future?"
He’s quite concerned about this issue.
Because next, they are definitely planning to develop for a period within the Witch Race Territory.
If they cannot freely enter and exit these main cities, it will definitely impact Han Xing’s development plans.
Wu Ling’Er nodded: "According to the rules of our clan, that’s correct."

"Once you’ve taken on the role of the Vanguard Corps leader, you’ll become an important member of the Witch Race. While enjoying privileges, you’ll also have to shoulder corresponding responsibilities."
"Though I can give you maximum freedom here, you won’t be required to manage the clan’s trivial matters."
"However, in special circumstances such as when the Shadow Legion invades, it still requires everyone to act dutifully."
After hearing this, everyone fell into contemplation.
Han Xing thought for a moment, shook his head, and said, "Forget it, we prefer to develop on our own and don’t really want to be bound."
"Eventually, I still have to return to the Land of the Abandoned Gods and can’t stay in one place forever."
"I apologize, Wu Ling’Er."
Listening to this, Wu Ling’Er’s tone had a hint of disappointment, "Is that so..."
"Alright then, I also respect your choice."
Everyone felt a bit regretful too.
However, they agreed that Han Xing’s choice was the right one.
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.

"Witch Race Saintess: Wu Ling’Er has granted permissions to you and your team. Henceforth, wherever you go on any Witch Race Sky Island, you won’t be attacked by the Witch Race Defense Tower, and you may travel freely within the main city."
Including Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong, everyone heard this prompt.
Everyone was somewhat surprised and looked towards Wu Ling’Er.
Han Xing asked, "Uh, didn’t you say that if we don’t join your Witch Race, we won’t be able to freely enter and exit the main city later?"
Wu Ling’Er chuckled softly, "That’s indeed the rule."
"However, you are my friends, people I trust."
"Even if you don’t join the Witch Race, you can freely enter any Sky Island within the Witch Race Territory."
"As the Witch Race Saintess, I have such rights."
Wu Ling’Er’s face showed a confident smile.
After hearing this, everyone also smiled sincerely.
Han Xing earnestly said, "Thank you."
Wu Ling’Er shook her head, "You’re welcome."
After speaking, Wu Ling’Er carelessly tossed a green stone to the five people.
The five people looked at the stone in their hands, and relevant attributes appeared before them.
[Token of Wu Ling’Er]: Can use this token to communicate with Wu Ling’Er.
The smiles on everyone’s faces turned into shock.
This thing is actually a communication tool!
And it allows direct contact with Wu Ling’Er, the Legendary Powerhouse.
Seeing the surprised expressions of everyone, Wu Ling’Er spoke softly.
"Next, I must handle clan affairs and may not be able to look after you."
"If you encounter any issues or danger within the Witch Race Territory, you can use this item to contact me."
"I will also arrive at the first opportunity."
Wu Ling’Er’s words left everyone profoundly shocked.
Looking at the stunned crowd, Wu Ling’Er also smiled softly.
Then she continued.
"I have some matters to handle next, so I won’t be entertaining you for now."
"You can move freely and even leave this main city."
"Whenever you have time in the future, you are always welcome to visit my Witch Race Main City."
Having said this, Wu Ling’Er left the reception hall.
After Wu Ling’Er left.
Everyone looked at each other.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but exclaim, "This Wu Ling’Er, she’s quite nice."
"She granted us permissions, gave us tokens, and promised that we could contact her if there were issues—it’s truly babysitter-level service!"
Shen Yun also sighed, "Indeed, this escort mission is really worth it."
Everyone nodded.
Cheng Jianyong then asked, "Do you think, with this, we now have a Legendary Powerhouse as our backing?"
Everyone thought of this.
Needless to say, Wu Ling’Er’s promise carries a significant weight.
In the outside world, legendary figures are already considered top forces.
And having a legendary figure as a backing, not to mention the Holy Spirit Realm, they could at least walk boldly in the entire Witch Race Territory.
At this moment, Han Xing smiled and said, "Don’t overthink. Though Wu Ling’Er treats us nicely."
"We shouldn’t rely on her for everything."
"Didn’t you hear her say the entire Witch Race Territory is under the threat of the Shadow Legion? If war breaks out, she would struggle to even look after herself."
"Our priority now is to enhance our strength."
After hearing this, everyone agreed with Han Xing’s perspective wholeheartedly.
Then, Shen Yun seemed to think of something and softly asked, "Brother Xing, our backpacks seem extremely valuable in Wu Ling’Er’s eyes."
"It appears that space storage items are very scarce outside."
"Should we trade these backpacks with the native residents of the Holy Spirit Realm to obtain many precious resources?
Han Xing glanced at him, shook his head, and said, "We can, but now is not the time."
"Not the time?" Shen Yun was puzzled.
Han Xing nodded, "You know these backpacks in Wu Ling’Er’s eyes are extremely precious."
"With Wu Ling’Er, it’s okay as we can trust her, and she agreed to trade some precious materials with us."
"But if other Legendary Powerhouses get wind that a few under-fourth transformation human weaklings have many of these precious space items."
"How many legendary figures do you think will come after us for treasure?"
Upon Han Xing’s reminder, Shen Yun also realized this.
The joy in his eyes vanished, quickly replaced by fear.
Indeed!
The principle of innocents courting disaster by possessing treasures has been heard too many times.
Without having sufficiently strong power, possessing these things and exposing them is virtually suicidal!
A single Witch Race has more than ten Legendary Powerhouses!
Switching to other large tribes, that number surely increases.
Not to mention there are even more terrifying Demigod-Level Powerhouses above.
The means of these powerhouses are strong and eerie.
Once targeted, even Wu Ling’Er couldn’t protect them!
"Oh damn!"
Cheng Jianyong was shocked, recalling something and quickly said, "So, Brother Xing, did you only give Wu Ling’Er one backpack just because of this reason?"
Han Xing nodded. "That’s right."
"Until we have sufficiently powerful strength, these things should never be exposed!"
Everyone profoundly agreed and nodded.
They simultaneously felt admiration for Han Xing’s meticulous thought process.
Han Xing dared to expose to Wu Ling’Er.
On one hand, it was to test her reaction; on the other hand, it was due to seeing the 80 points of affinity on the system interface.
Otherwise, Han Xing would never reveal the space backpack.
After calming down a bit.
Cheng Jianyong continued to ask, "Brother Xing, what should we do now?"
"Should we continue browsing the Secret Elixir shop in the Witch Race Main City?"
Currently, the Witch Race Main City is holding a ’Secret Elixir King’ selection event.
Many precious secret elixirs have appeared.
However, Han Xing and the others hadn’t got a chance to glance when Malik interrupted.
After contemplating, Han Xing shook his head again and said, "No, let’s talk about it later."
"Now, we need to leave the city quickly and start building the territory!"

chapters.title: Chapter 287 - 230: Territory Expansion
paragraphs: Han Xing said at this moment: "This time, we caused quite a stir in the Witch Race Main City."
"Even with Wu Ling’Er’s deterrence, behind us, I bet there are quite a few eyes watching us."
"Our every move will tug at many people’s nerves."
Everyone agreed it made sense upon hearing this.
Han Xing continued: "So, we should leave the Witch Race Main City immediately."
"Then find a safe place, establish our territory first, and restore our strength."
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun nodded together.
Then.
In the afternoon of that day.
Han Xing and the others sneaked out of the main city.
Then they summoned their own core territory in the wild, rising straight into the air, leaving the Witch Race’s main island.
Five figures gradually flew into the sky, turning into several small black dots.
At this time, Wu Ling’Er, sitting on the throne, seemed to sense their departure.
She looked in the direction where everyone left, sighed with some regret and reluctance.
As night gradually fell.
Into the night.
Five figures appeared at an altitude of ten thousand meters.
Each of them stepped on a small block.
This peculiar feeling seemed to remind everyone of the first day they entered Sky Island Paradise.
But compared to that time, they appeared much more composed.
At least, they no longer had to worry about certain living resources.
Moreover, their strength is now several times greater than it was three months ago.
If they were to reestablish a territory, the speed would be far beyond before.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong suddenly laughed: "Do you all feel like you’ve returned to Newbie Village after reaching full level?"
Han Xing and others laughed as well.
Five small blocks floated freely in the air.
Although most of the Sky Islands within the Witch Race Territory had already been explored by the Witch Race People.
However, this world is vast beyond measure.
Numerous Sky Island fragments were scattered throughout the Holy Spirit Realm.
And these Sky Islands were constantly moving.
It is very possible that this area was explored by them today.
But the next day, a new Sky Island may float over from a great distance.
Therefore, everyone was not worried about not having Sky Islands around to explore.
Indeed.
Soon, they found a Sky Island covered by clouds in front of them.
Roughly estimated, it was at least ten thousand square meters.
Upon closer proximity, a system prompt appeared.
"Inside, a group of irritable plants is stationed here, enter?"
Regarding this prompt, everyone understood that there were likely monsters inside.
However, with their strength, the monsters in such a small area of the Sky Island posed no threat whatsoever.
Han Xing didn’t think twice and directly clicked yes.
Next moment.
The clouds dissipated, revealing a similarly lush green scenery inside.
Here, it appeared to be an inclined small hill.
Surrounding it was soft grassland, where moonlight flowers occasionally grew.
Halfway up the hill, a crooked tree stood five to six meters tall.
Under the moonlight, this small hill had a fairytale-like charm.
"Wow, this place looks pretty nice!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
Everyone nodded in agreement.
Zhang Lianmeng said beside Su Xiaoyang: "Little Sister Yang, see under the tree, isn’t it perfect for hanging two ropes to make a swing?"
Su Xiaoyang looked up after hearing this.
Zhang Lianmeng was right.
This crooked tree had strong and thick branches and lush foliage, very solid.
It indeed seemed perfect for hanging a swing beneath it.
Imagine sitting on a swing, swaying gently in the breeze, amidst a green hilltop, above the clouds, enjoying the scenery. How delightful would that be?
Shen Yun’s focus was slightly different than theirs.
He observed the entire hill and questioned, "Didn’t the system prompt say there were a group of irritable plants inside?"
"Where are the monsters?"
Everyone looked puzzled.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong patted Shen Yun’s shoulder and said: "Who cares where the monsters are."
"With our level, do we really need to worry about all this?"
"Just charge right in!"
Shen Yun paused but smiled along.
He was thinking too much.
Then, the five of them jumped onto the Sky Island.
As everyone landed.
The seemingly ordinary hill.
Several small grass piles suddenly showed movement.
Rustle... rustle...
These small grass piles began to grow rapidly, as if something was about to emerge from the ground.
Next moment.
In front of everyone emerged some familiar creatures with round bodies like jade, appearing fresh and juicy...
"Wow... such big radishes!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise.
Everyone couldn’t help but twitch at the corner of their mouths.
Yes, these monsters looked exactly like a plant on Blue Star, the white radish.
However, their size was much larger, over a meter tall, and they were more robust.
Furthermore, these radishes had eyes and noses.
Not knowing what to call these monsters, for now, let’s call them radish spirits.
At this moment, those radish spirits, seeing Han Xing and others, instantly entered an attack state.
And their attack method was quite unique.
That is, they frantically spun their bodies, using the inertia to fling their sharp-leafed heads.
Causing penetrating damage to their enemies.
Whoosh! Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
With the sound, streaks of green shadows with a whooshing sound flew towards them.
No one dodged or evaded.
Because none of them felt any danger from these leaves.
Thud! Thud thud thud!
The leaves hit everyone.
Like a breeze passing by, they didn’t cause any harm.
At this moment, that group of carrot spirits seemed to be stunned as well.
The enemies before them seemed surprisingly strong.
However, they did not give up.
Instead, they continued to spin madly, determined to knock down Han Xing and the others.
As they spun wildly, the leaves above their heads kept falling.
Until the carrot spirits spun so much they were dizzy, their once lush tops almost bald.
Even so, it still didn’t cause any harm to Han Xing and the others.
At this point, watching the carrot spirits whose faces turned red, everyone couldn’t help but laugh.
At this moment, Han Xing shook his head and said, "Let’s do it, tonight we’re having carrot soup!"
A heartfelt smile appeared on everyone’s face.
The next moment, Shen Yun jumped in first, into the center of the carrot spirits.
Then, with one hammer each, he smashed down fiercely.
Thud! Thud thud!
Like playing Whack-a-Mole.
He smashed all the carrot spirits back into the ground.
System prompts appeared.
[Kill Two-Star Creature: Berserk Carrot, Gain Experience Value 4763...]
[Kill...]
With a few hammer blows, Shen Yun sent all the carrot spirits to their end.
Once the system announced the monsters on this Sky Island were cleared and could be merged.
Han Xing immediately annexed this Sky Island.
System prompts appeared.
"Merge successful, your Sky Island area has expanded...
Looking at the 10,000 square meter island beneath their feet, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
Three months of Sky Island living had gotten them accustomed to life on these islands.
This time, having emerged from the Path of the Giant Dragon, they only brought out a core territory.
Because the area was so small, they felt somewhat uncomfortable.
Now, it’s better.
Though the hill isn’t large, it’s enough for their free activities.
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but sigh.
Thinking back to the beginning.
His territory expanded from one square meter to 10,000 square meters, taking over half a month.
But now, it took less than five minutes to reach the same goal.
Next.
Han Xing instructed Cheng Jianyong and the others, to store their core territory in their backpacks.
Han Xing then controlled this little hill, starting to speed forward.
Along the way.
They scarcely let any Sky Island pass by.
System prompts appeared continuously.
"This is a snowfield drifting from afar, inhabited by snowfield creatures, do you wish to enter?"
"Inside is a peculiar forest, its unique structure and patterns can be used to craft precious furniture, once loved by Elf nobility, do you wish to enter?"
"Inside..."
Han Xing chose ’Yes’ each time.
Monsters on each Sky Island were cleared, then merged one after another.
After four to five hours of battle.
Han Xing’s territory area increased several tens of times again.
Now, it directly reached three to four square kilometers.
Various terrains appeared on it as well.
Snowfields, mountains, lakes, mangroves...
Five hours.
Equivalent to two months of effort in Han Xing’s past!
Everyone was excited and even wanted to fight through the night.
However, Han Xing looked up at the sky.
Now, it was late at night.
After pondering for a moment, he said, "Alright, let’s call it a day."
"Let’s find somewhere to eat and rest, and continue the battle tomorrow."
Upon hearing this, everyone calmed down their excitement.
Today was just their first day expanding their territory.
Some territory buildings, such as accommodation and some life equipment, had yet to be built.
So, they had to make do for now.
However, simple tools like those could be quickly crafted.
For example water buckets, benches, wooden tables, bookshelves, etc.
Han Xing opened the crafting interface and used five pieces of refined iron to make an iron pot.
The ten-second progress bar ended.
With a clang.
A shiny and intricately made large iron pot appeared before Han Xing.
Its one-and-a-half-meter diameter pot could even stew a Big-beaked Bird.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong approached and said, "Oh wow, that’s a big iron pot!"
Han Xing glanced at him.
Then he opened the tool encyclopedia and found a stove-making blueprint.
With some stone blocks and rare earth consumed.
In front of everyone, a rural-style clay stove appeared.
Its size was just right to fit this large pot.
Han Xing then looked at the small hill in the distance and said, "Lian’Er, get the ingredients ready."
Upon hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng’s face instantly lit up with a joyful smile.
She quickly replied, "Okay, Brother Xing!"
After speaking, Zhang Lianmeng happily headed towards the small hill...

In the afternoon of that day.
Han Xing and the others sneaked out of the main city.
Then they summoned their own core territory in the wild, rising straight into the air, leaving the Witch Race’s main island.
Five figures gradually flew into the sky, turning into several small black dots.
At this time, Wu Ling’Er, sitting on the throne, seemed to sense their departure.
She looked in the direction where everyone left, sighed with some regret and reluctance.
As night gradually fell.
Into the night.
Five figures appeared at an altitude of ten thousand meters.
Each of them stepped on a small block.
This peculiar feeling seemed to remind everyone of the first day they entered Sky Island Paradise.
But compared to that time, they appeared much more composed.
At least, they no longer had to worry about certain living resources.
Moreover, their strength is now several times greater than it was three months ago.
If they were to reestablish a territory, the speed would be far beyond before.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong suddenly laughed: "Do you all feel like you’ve returned to Newbie Village after reaching full level?"
Han Xing and others laughed as well.
Five small blocks floated freely in the air.
Although most of the Sky Islands within the Witch Race Territory had already been explored by the Witch Race People.
However, this world is vast beyond measure.
Numerous Sky Island fragments were scattered throughout the Holy Spirit Realm.
And these Sky Islands were constantly moving.
It is very possible that this area was explored by them today.
But the next day, a new Sky Island may float over from a great distance.
Therefore, everyone was not worried about not having Sky Islands around to explore.
Indeed.
Soon, they found a Sky Island covered by clouds in front of them.
Roughly estimated, it was at least ten thousand square meters.
Upon closer proximity, a system prompt appeared.
"Inside, a group of irritable plants is stationed here, enter?"
Regarding this prompt, everyone understood that there were likely monsters inside.
However, with their strength, the monsters in such a small area of the Sky Island posed no threat whatsoever.
Han Xing didn’t think twice and directly clicked yes.
Next moment.
The clouds dissipated, revealing a similarly lush green scenery inside.
Here, it appeared to be an inclined small hill.
Surrounding it was soft grassland, where moonlight flowers occasionally grew.
Halfway up the hill, a crooked tree stood five to six meters tall.
Under the moonlight, this small hill had a fairytale-like charm.
"Wow, this place looks pretty nice!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
Everyone nodded in agreement.
Zhang Lianmeng said beside Su Xiaoyang: "Little Sister Yang, see under the tree, isn’t it perfect for hanging two ropes to make a swing?"
Su Xiaoyang looked up after hearing this.
Zhang Lianmeng was right.
This crooked tree had strong and thick branches and lush foliage, very solid.
It indeed seemed perfect for hanging a swing beneath it.
Imagine sitting on a swing, swaying gently in the breeze, amidst a green hilltop, above the clouds, enjoying the scenery.
How delightful would that be?
Shen Yun’s focus was slightly different than theirs.
He observed the entire hill and questioned, "Didn’t the system prompt say there were a group of irritable plants inside?"
"Where are the monsters?"
Everyone looked puzzled.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong patted Shen Yun’s shoulder and said: "Who cares where the monsters are."
"With our level, do we really need to worry about all this?"
"Just charge right in!"
Shen Yun paused but smiled along.
He was thinking too much.
Then, the five of them jumped onto the Sky Island.
As everyone landed.
The seemingly ordinary hill.
Several small grass piles suddenly showed movement.
Rustle... rustle...
These small grass piles began to grow rapidly, as if something was about to emerge from the ground.
Next moment.
In front of everyone emerged some familiar creatures with round bodies like jade, appearing fresh and juicy...
"Wow... such big radishes!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise.
Everyone couldn’t help but twitch at the corner of their mouths.
Yes, these monsters looked exactly like a plant on Blue Star, the white radish.
However, their size was much larger, over a meter tall, and they were more robust.
Furthermore, these radishes had eyes and noses.
Not knowing what to call these monsters, for now, let’s call them radish spirits.
At this moment, those radish spirits, seeing Han Xing and others, instantly entered an attack state.
And their attack method was quite unique.
That is, they frantically spun their bodies, using the inertia to fling their sharp-leafed heads.
Causing penetrating damage to their enemies.
Whoosh!
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
With the sound, streaks of green shadows with a whooshing sound flew towards them.
No one dodged or evaded.
Because none of them felt any danger from these leaves.
Thud!
Thud thud thud!
The leaves hit everyone.
Like a breeze passing by, they didn’t cause any harm.
At this moment, that group of carrot spirits seemed to be stunned as well.
The enemies before them seemed surprisingly strong.
However, they did not give up.
Instead, they continued to spin madly, determined to knock down Han Xing and the others.
As they spun wildly, the leaves above their heads kept falling.
Until the carrot spirits spun so much they were dizzy, their once lush tops almost bald.
Even so, it still didn’t cause any harm to Han Xing and the others.
At this point, watching the carrot spirits whose faces turned red, everyone couldn’t help but laugh.
At this moment, Han Xing shook his head and said, "Let’s do it, tonight we’re having carrot soup!"
A heartfelt smile appeared on everyone’s face.
The next moment, Shen Yun jumped in first, into the center of the carrot spirits.
Then, with one hammer each, he smashed down fiercely.
Thud!
Thud thud!
Like playing Whack-a-Mole.
He smashed all the carrot spirits back into the ground.
System prompts appeared.
[Kill Two-Star Creature: Berserk Carrot, Gain Experience Value 4763...]
[Kill...]
With a few hammer blows, Shen Yun sent all the carrot spirits to their end.
Once the system announced the monsters on this Sky Island were cleared and could be merged.
Han Xing immediately annexed this Sky Island.
System prompts appeared.
"Merge successful, your Sky Island area has expanded...
Looking at the 10,000 square meter island beneath their feet, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
Three months of Sky Island living had gotten them accustomed to life on these islands.
This time, having emerged from the Path of the Giant Dragon, they only brought out a core territory.
Because the area was so small, they felt somewhat uncomfortable.
Now, it’s better.
Though the hill isn’t large, it’s enough for their free activities.
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but sigh.
Thinking back to the beginning.
His territory expanded from one square meter to 10,000 square meters, taking over half a month.
But now, it took less than five minutes to reach the same goal.
Next.
Han Xing instructed Cheng Jianyong and the others, to store their core territory in their backpacks.
Han Xing then controlled this little hill, starting to speed forward.
Along the way.
They scarcely let any Sky Island pass by.
System prompts appeared continuously.
"This is a snowfield drifting from afar, inhabited by snowfield creatures, do you wish to enter?"
"Inside is a peculiar forest, its unique structure and patterns can be used to craft precious furniture, once loved by Elf nobility, do you wish to enter?"
"Inside..."
Han Xing chose ’Yes’ each time.
Monsters on each Sky Island were cleared, then merged one after another.
After four to five hours of battle.
Han Xing’s territory area increased several tens of times again.
Now, it directly reached three to four square kilometers.
Various terrains appeared on it as well.
Snowfields, mountains, lakes, mangroves...
Five hours.
Equivalent to two months of effort in Han Xing’s past!
Everyone was excited and even wanted to fight through the night.
However, Han Xing looked up at the sky.
Now, it was late at night.
After pondering for a moment, he said, "Alright, let’s call it a day."
"Let’s find somewhere to eat and rest, and continue the battle tomorrow."
Upon hearing this, everyone calmed down their excitement.
Today was just their first day expanding their territory.
Some territory buildings, such as accommodation and some life equipment, had yet to be built.
So, they had to make do for now.
However, simple tools like those could be quickly crafted.
For example water buckets, benches, wooden tables, bookshelves, etc.
Han Xing opened the crafting interface and used five pieces of refined iron to make an iron pot.
The ten-second progress bar ended.
With a clang.
A shiny and intricately made large iron pot appeared before Han Xing.
Its one-and-a-half-meter diameter pot could even stew a Big-beaked Bird.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong approached and said, "Oh wow, that’s a big iron pot!"
Han Xing glanced at him.
Then he opened the tool encyclopedia and found a stove-making blueprint.
With some stone blocks and rare earth consumed.
In front of everyone, a rural-style clay stove appeared.
Its size was just right to fit this large pot.
Han Xing then looked at the small hill in the distance and said, "Lian’Er, get the ingredients ready."
Upon hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng’s face instantly lit up with a joyful smile.
She quickly replied, "Okay, Brother Xing!"
After speaking, Zhang Lianmeng happily headed towards the small hill...

chapters.title: Chapter 288 - 231: Lian Meng’s Murmurs, A New Direction for Sky Island’s Development!
paragraphs: Zhang Lianmeng still remembered what Han Xing had said a few hours ago, "Tonight, we’ll have radish soup!"
So, she went up to the hillside and randomly picked a large, snow-white radish and pulled it out.
Then Zhang Lianmeng, holding the radish over a meter long, walked over to them with excitement written all over her face.
The group worked together, Han Xing opened his backpack and took out some clean drinking water, pouring it into the pot.
He then placed a few pieces of Dark Fire Stone at the bottom of the pot, heat constantly emanating.
Once the water began to boil.
Zhang Lianmeng had also prepared various ingredients on her side.
With a sizzling sound.
White radish, mixed with some beast meat, was all poured into the pot.
Before long, the big iron pot started bubbling and steaming.
The entire territory was filled with a delicious aroma of meat.
This also whetted everyone’s appetite.
At this time, Zhang Lianmeng, wearing an apron, began to ladle the meat soup for everyone.
Cheng Jianyong took it and, without caring about the scalding broth, began to gobble it down, making odd noises.
"Slurp! Slurp!"
"Delicious! Damn, this is delicious!"
"I want to drink ten more bowls!"
Seeing him like this, everyone couldn’t help but laugh.
After a hearty meal.
They each found a place to rest.
In the stillness of the night,
Han Xing also found a small grove at the foot of the mountain to use as a resting place.
Looking at the surrounding environment.
Han Xing thought for a moment, then opened the crafting interface,
first using some wood to build a small wooden house.
This simple structure had no defensive capability, so it didn’t take much time.
In eight minutes, the small wooden house in the woods was built.
Then, Han Xing spent a few more minutes making wooden beds, tables, pumpkin lamps, rugs, and other furniture...
Soon, the interior of the small wooden house became very cozy.
After laying out the bedding.
Han Xing clapped his hands in satisfaction, "Great, now I can sleep comfortably."
With that, he lay back on the bed.
Just then, Han Xing seemed to remember something.
He opened his friend list, found Zhang Lianmeng’s name, and sent her a message asking, "Have you found a place to rest?"
Zhang Lianmeng immediately replied, "Not yet, I’m chatting with Little Sister Yang."
Han Xing thought for a moment and said, "I built a small wooden house in the woods, you guys come over first. I’ll build another one nearby."
Zhang Lianmeng replied, "Okay, I’ll ask Little Sister Yang."
A moment later, Zhang Lianmeng sent another message back.
"Little Sister Yang says she’s not sleepy yet, so she’ll stay there for now."
Seeing the message, Han Xing nodded and was about to reply.
Suddenly, Zhang Lianmeng sent another message: "I... I’m coming over..."
Han Xing: "..."
In the stillness of the night,
Han Xing heard a knock on the door of the small wooden house.
Opening the door, he immediately saw a blushing beauty standing there, full of charm.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng was tightly hugging her arms, her two legs as white and smooth as jade, with a bit of plumpness, seemingly clasped together out of nervousness.
She raised her pretty eyes, looking shyly at Han Xing.
Her rapid breathing carried a hint of expectation and nervousness.
This look could almost instantly stir up the desires in a man’s heart.
Han Xing also felt his throat go dry.
Then, he took Zhang Lianmeng’s small hand and led her into the small wooden house.
As the door closed behind them,
the shyness in Zhang Lianmeng’s eyes vanished, instantly turning into a blaze of passion.
She took the initiative to kiss him, whispering,
"Brother Xing... Lian’er missed you so much..."
After a burst of passion,
Zhang Lianmeng lay exhausted, like a puddle of mud, snuggling against Han Xing.
She reached out her fair, slender hands, touching Han Xing’s body, gently squeezing his arms, and pressing on his chest.
Speaking in a dreamy, soft voice, "Brother Xing... you’ve become more and more amazing."
"I can hardly take it..."
Listening to Zhang Lianmeng’s dreamy murmurings, Han Xing chuckled and hugged her tightly.
Zhang Lianmeng rested her pretty face against Han Xing’s chest, feeling his warm body temperature, a look of satisfaction in her eyes.
Then, Zhang Lianmeng said softly, "Brother Xing, what do you think of Little Sister Yang?"
Han Xing was taken aback, "Uh, she’s nice, why?"
Zhang Lianmeng seemed a bit embarrassed, but after a moment, she looked at Han Xing and said softly, "Brother Xing, would you like to have Little Sister Yang... join us..."
Han Xing widened his eyes, looking at Zhang Lianmeng in disbelief.
"Do you know what you’re saying?"
Zhang Lianmeng nodded, shyly saying, "Of course I know."
"It’s just that, this is no longer Blue Star. As Wu Ling’er said before, for an outstanding man like Brother Xing, having a few women around is quite normal."
"Besides, we can all tell that Little Sister Yang likes you quite a bit too."
Zhang Lianmeng wanted to say more, but was stopped by Han Xing.
"What are you saying, Lian’er? I’m content with just you."
Upon hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng’s body trembled slightly, and sweet emotions welled up within her heart.
She cuddled closer to Han Xing.
Han Xing could feel her skin heating up again.
Then, Zhang Lianmeng, blushing, took the initiative to move atop him.
Late night.
Zhang Lianmeng, who had been tormented for several hours, fell into a deep sleep, exhausted.
However, at this moment, Han Xing did not feel the slightest bit sleepy.
As his attributes continued to rise, Han Xing could clearly feel that his physical condition was evolving more and more towards the superhuman.
He was still full of spirit now.
After getting out of bed and tucking Zhang Lianmeng in.
Han Xing tiptoed out of the small wooden house.
Then.
He came to the small hill.
The view here was excellent.
Han Xing opened the pet space and released Coal Ball.
Since entering the Path of the Giant Dragon, Coal Ball had been staying in the pet space.
This little wolf cub also suffocated terribly.
No, now it couldn’t be called a little wolf cub anymore.
Coal Ball had grown up, its body length surpassing three meters.
Standing upright, it could even reach four meters high.
It was now a true giant wolf!
Under the moonlight, the Void Ghost Wolf emitted a faint glow, exuding the aura of a kingly fierce beast.
However, upon seeing Han Xing.
The pride on Coal Ball’s face instantly disappeared, replaced by a look of surprise and joy.
It leaped forward and pounced onto Han Xing.
Coal Ball’s level had now reached level 32, and after the Third Transformation, its attributes had increased significantly once more.
Even though Han Xing’s attributes were a notch above, he was still instantly knocked down by this wolf cub.
Of course, Coal Ball didn’t really use force.
After taking Han Xing down.
Coal Ball excitedly extended its tongue and began licking his chest armor.
Although Coal Ball had grown up, it was still as clingy to Han Xing as it was when it was young.
Of course, Coal Ball was a noble Void Ghost Wolf.
Usually, when there were others around, Coal Ball maintained an aloof image, seeming somewhat unapproachable.
Only when it was alone with Han Xing would it reveal its true nature.
However, whether it was because Coal Ball had been cooped up for too long or because it was too excited.
It was not only licking Han Xing’s chest armor but even started to lick Han Xing’s cheeks.
Han Xing felt like his whole head was about to be swallowed by this giant wolf.
The slick saliva soaked his hair.
Han Xing quickly held Coal Ball’s head and stopped it, saying.
"All right, all right, Coal Ball, stop it now."
Upon hearing this, Coal Ball reluctantly stopped its licking action.
After Coal Ball calmed down, it lay down directly beside Han Xing.
The man and the wolf leaned against the crooked tree, quietly admiring the night sky.
They both seemed to enjoy this quiet time.
Before long, Han Xing heard a slight snoring sound from Coal Ball.
This guy had actually fallen asleep so quickly.
Han Xing shook his head helplessly.
However, he still did not feel the slightest bit sleepy.
This was their first night after leaving the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
So much had happened in a single day.
It also allowed Han Xing to witness the vastness and magic of this world.
As well as uncover more secrets.
For the sake of future development.
Han Xing still had many things to consider and plan for now.
Such as rebuilding the territory, constructing various defense towers, and other future developments.
At this moment, Han Xing murmured softly to himself.
"This time coming out, I left Lanlan and the others in the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
"There are still several billion materials reserved in Xingyu City."
"At my current pace, rebuilding Xingyu City’s scale would only take a few days."
Han Xing felt assured.
The last Blood Tide battle had provided him with a huge amount of resources.
These material reserves gave him strong confidence.
Then, he thought again.
"However, since it’s a reconstruction, perhaps this Sky Island could be developed in a different direction."
"For instance, creating a purely combat-oriented Sky Island!"
"I want to build a lot of defense towers and various fortifications on it."
"Such as hidden triggered traps and various combat units."
"In this way, even if monsters rush onto my Sky Island, they will be held up by various traps and then gradually defeated."
Thinking of this, Han Xing found this plan feasible!
Xingyu City had already started transforming into a commercial city.
What he needed to do now was quickly get the second Sky Island up and running, achieving mutual development on both sides.
The prerequisite was that Han Xing’s second Sky Island must gain a foothold in this world.
That is, possessing the power capable of contending with legends.
However, this required more advanced defense tower blueprints, as well as more resources and time.
Han Xing was in no rush.
Things had to be taken step by step.
As long as he developed steadily, he would achieve his goal one day.
At this moment, he looked at the pile of precious materials in his backpack, thinking.
"For this mission commission, Wu Ling’Er indeed gave quite a few good things. Let’s see if they can be converted into combat power first."
Then, Han Xing opened the blueprint interface to check the production requirements for that Divine Artifact blueprint.
[Materials needed to create the Oracle Throne]: Philosopher’s Stone*1000, Shadow Divine Stone*500, Shimmering Terra Stone*500, Rhythm Black Iron*1000, Divine Oracle Scripture*5.

chapters.title: Chapter 289 - 232: Ancient Weapon: Demon Elephant War Chariot Blueprint
paragraphs: Han Xing’s face also showed a hint of joy.
"Very good, out of the five materials needed to create the Oracle Throne, I’ve already gathered three."
"There is already news on the Shimmering Terra Stone."
"Currently, I just need to find the last material, the clue for the Divine Oracle Scripture."
"Then I can start crafting the Oracle Throne!"
Han Xing couldn’t help but clench his fist.
The attribute boost from the Oracle Throne is undeniably formidable.
However, the attribute boost is not its primary use.
Its most important function is its unique effect, ’Divine Oracle Summon.’
A group teleport over a million kilometers, it’s truly extraordinary!
Though it can only be used once a day, the effect it can exert far exceeds everyone’s expectations.
For example, today, if Han Xing had the Oracle Throne, he wouldn’t have to worry about Feienna’s raid at all.
He could simply teleport away with his people.
Even as a legendary powerhouse,
it wouldn’t be easy for Feienna to find them in a short time.
At that point, he would truly have a means of survival under a legendary powerhouse’s hands.
At this moment, Han Xing felt a movement in his mind.
He opened his backpack again, and a golden blueprint appeared in his hand.
It’s the Ancient Weapon Blueprint, the Demon Elephant War Chariot, given to him by Wu Ling’Er!
Speaking of which, this was the first Ancient Weapon Blueprint Han Xing had encountered since entering the Sky Island Paradise.
The blueprint depicted a tall, majestic, and extremely fierce-looking war chariot with tusks!
Engraved on the gilded surface of the chassis was an angry mammoth.
Sharp spikes adorned both sides of the tall chassis, resembling the teeth of some ancient fierce beast.
In front of the chariot was a giant cannon muzzle, serving as an elephant’s trunk.
Besides the trunk, there were two sharp tusks, their tips emitting a chilling gleam.
One can imagine the terror caused when such a ferocious war machine charges into the enemy and wreaks havoc!
This is practically a life-reaper!
Then, the attributes of this blueprint appeared before Han Xing.
[Ancient Weapon: Demon Elephant War Chariot Blueprint]: Can forge a Demon Elephant War Chariot combining mobility and lethality.
[Defense Value]: 50000.
[Attack Power]: 10000.
Possesses Skills: Floating, Tank Charge, Demon Elephant Roar, Flaming Strike.
[Floating]: Possesses flight capability, allowing agile movement in the air.
[Tank Charge]: Instantly charges forward a short distance, doubling the chariot’s defense value during the charge.
And deals 15000 points of slashing damage to all enemies along the path, with a cooldown of 30 seconds.
[Demon Elephant Roar]: Summons the spirit of the demon elephant to emit a mental shock dealing 20000 damage.
And restores 2000 points of defense value to the chariot, cooldown: 60 seconds.
[Flaming Strike]: Controls the cannon muzzle at the front of the chassis to unleash a destructive attack dealing 20000 damage to the enemy.
And causes the hit enemy to be burned, dealing 1000 damage per second for 10 seconds, cooldown: 120 seconds.
After reviewing the attributes of this ancient weapon, Han Xing couldn’t help but gasp.
This thing is truly worthy of the name ancient weapon!
attack power, even more mighty than the Hellfire by a significant margin.
The four skills are each more incredible than the last.
Comprising mobility, mental attack, area damage, continuous damage, and recovery ability.
This war chariot’s functionality is simply too comprehensive.
To deal with groups of monsters below the fourth transformation, just one Demon Elephant War Chariot is enough to charge in and slaughter!
The high defense value of 50000, along with the recovery skills, completely negates the need to worry about the damage caused by these low-level monsters.
At this moment, Han Xing noticed a note below the Demon Elephant War Chariot.
[Note: The Demon Elephant War Chariot can switch between automatic and manual modes.]
[In automatic mode, the Demon Elephant War Chariot will perform only basic offensive actions, without performing damage evasion actions.]
"Oh? There’s also a manual mode?"
Han Xing’s tone carried a hint of surprise, "Does this mean I can control the Demon Elephant War Chariot like operating a tank?"
Han Xing thought this idea might be feasible.
After all, the system indicated that in automatic mode, the Demon Elephant War Chariot would only execute attack actions.
In other words, it’s akin to a simple AI command.
Facing lower-level monsters, it would be fine; its sturdy defense could handle it effortlessly.
But against enemies beyond the fourth transformation, it would be troublesome.
Without dodging, it becomes a moving target.
No matter how high the defense value, it would still be blown apart in a short time.
But if controlled by intelligent beings, it would be different.
At that time, a single Demon Elephant War Chariot would pose a considerably rising threat.
At this moment, Han Xing once again appreciated the intelligence and power of ancient weapons.
It’s safe to say that even the weakest being, controlling this Demon Elephant War Chariot, could challenge a Four-star Lord-level creature.
Of course, saying it so boldly might be exaggerated.
But it could certainly withstand a Four-star Lord for some time.
However, the system wouldn’t leave such an apparent loophole for one to exploit.
There is another note at the bottom.
[Note: The Demon Elephant War Chariot is a high-grade ancient weapon, needing creatures above the fourth transformation to operate.]
Above the fourth transformation.
This means a creature must be at least level 40 to operate the Demon Elephant War Chariot.
However, this won’t be a problem for Han Xing.
All it requires is for him to reach level 40 and then set up a Wolf Cavalry Camp.

chapters.title: Chapter 290 - 232: Ancient Weapon: Demon Elephant War Chariot Blueprint 2
paragraphs: Then boost the technology to the maximum.
By then, the Wolf Cavalry he summons will all be level 40.
The task of operating the Demon Elephant War Chariot can be directly handed over to them.
After all, as a race on horseback,
it’s reasonable that they would know both Riding Skill and war chariot operation, right?
Thinking of this, Han Xing also nodded in satisfaction.
"Wu Ling’Er was right, Ancient Weapons can harm Legendary Powerhouses."
"Even though one might not pose a big threat, as long as there are enough, a hundred or eighty can surround Legendary Powerhouses and give them a hard time."
"Moreover, if a hundred doesn’t work, then two hundred; if two hundred doesn’t work, then a thousand!"
"Someday, relying on these territory devices, I’ll be able to crush legends head-on!"
Han Xing thought ambitiously.
Then, he clapped his hands and clicked to learn the blueprint.
"Successfully learned Ancient Weapon Blueprint: Demon Elephant War Chariot."
With a bit of apprehension, Han Xing began to check the materials needed to craft the chariot.
[Materials needed to craft Demon Elephant War Chariot]: Permanent Gold Ingot*10000, Rhythm Black Iron*1000, Mithril*100,000, Philosopher’s Stone*50, Heroic Spirit*10.
[Success Rate]: 30% (Due to Divine-level Talent, success rate is 100%)
Han Xing couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
Luckily, they are all relatively common materials.
Except for the last material, ’Heroic Spirit’, which is rather special.
He still had quite a bit of the other four in reserve.
If possible, Han Xing really wanted to craft a few Demon Elephant War Chariots to try them out.
However, after searching through the entire trade channel and not finding any ’Heroic Spirit’ materials,
Han Xing could only temporarily give up the idea.
"It seems that crafting Ancient Weapons right now isn’t so easy after all."
"However, although I can’t craft the Demon Elephant War Chariot, I can at least build other things first."
Han Xing scanned through his blueprint interface, flipping through hundreds of blueprints.
The first to be crafted, naturally, was the core territory acceleration device.
This thing can boost his territory speed by several times, it’s a Divine Artifact for escaping.
However, constructing the ’Territory Core Device’ requires a large amount of Mithril and Refined Iron.
During use, it also requires a continuous input of large amounts of Spirit Cores for acceleration.
Han Xing didn’t bring much material with him this time.
So, he opened his friend interface.
Found a name called Zhou Yingying.
This is Lanlan’s real name.
Then, Han Xing directly sent her a message.
At this time, in Xingyu City, constantly managing the territory interface,
Lanlan suddenly said with surprise, "Oh? It’s the Lord!"
She immediately put down her work and excitedly opened the private chat window.
"Lord, has your side stabilized?"
Han Xing nodded and said, "Yes, it’s somewhat stabilized.
Lanlan breathed a sigh of relief after hearing this.
When they parted last time, they knew the dangers of the Path of the Giant Dragon.
So before Han Xing contacted them, Lanlan didn’t dare to send a message, for fear of disturbing them.
Now that Han Xing contacted her,
it eased some of her worried emotions.
At this moment, Lanlan said excitedly, "That’s great!"
"Lord, let me tell you, the past two days you weren’t here, but we didn’t slack off."
"Mu Qing and I explored the Sky Island, expanding the territory."
"In just two days, we’ve doubled the size of Xingyu City!"
Lanlan’s tone was excited, like a child hoping for praise from their parents.
"Lord, aren’t we amazing?"
"Yes, well done, you all are incredible!"
Han Xing genuinely praised her.
Receiving Han Xing’s praise, Lanlan giggled.
"Hehehe, it’s not that incredible, it’s the power of the Defense Towers you left behind; we didn’t even have to lift a finger against the monsters."
Han Xing also laughed, "Lanlan, for the foreseeable future, I’ll need you all to manage Xingyu City."
"It won’t be long before I initiate the next phase of the plan."
Hearing this, Lanlan straightened her expression.
She knew what Han Xing’s next phase plan was about.
At the time of parting on the Path of the Giant Dragon, Han Xing had briefed her on the future path of Xingyu City.
"Yes! I’ll do my best, Lord!"
"I guarantee to complete the task!"
Listening to Lanlan’s voice, which was somewhat formal yet slightly playful, Han Xing was amused.
He then said, "Alright, now I’ll need to trouble you a bit to go to the warehouse and trade some materials over to me."
Upon hearing this, Lanlan readily agreed.
She seemed extremely excited.
Immediately, she ran to the warehouse of the Lord’s Mansion and began to trade various materials in bulk to Han Xing.
A smile appeared on Han Xing’s face.
This is the privilege of us Survivors.
To bypass distance and space, directly transferring resources!
This method is simply too incredible!
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
"Survivor ’Lanlan’ has initiated a trade request to you."
Han Xing immediately clicked to accept.
In the trade window, Lanlan followed Han Xing’s instructions and kept placing various precious materials.
With the system’s continuous trade success prompts.
Various precious materials piled up in front of Han Xing again.
After about ten minutes.
This trade finally ended.
Han Xing also acquired a lot of resources.
After closing the trade interface.
Looking at the pile of materials stacked like a small mountain on the ground, Han Xing’s eyes were filled with excitement.
"Great, with this, in just a few days, I can restore Xingyu City’s firepower strength!"
Thinking of this, Han Xing went to a plain on the territory, preparing to build various Defense Towers.
The first one to be built is naturally the Hellfire Missile Silo, which has the strongest Attack Power!
This time, Lanlan had traded all the Abyssal Magic Stones from the warehouse.
Currently, the resources Han Xing has can build a batch of four thirty Hellfire Missile Silos, plus five hundred Thunderbolt Towers at once.
Although these Defense Towers won’t have much effect on the Legendary before building the [Holy Artifact: Sun Crown Stele],
but with enough numbers, even a Four-star Lord group attacking would be annihilated by firepower!
Han Xing selected a valley and began clicking to build.
A system prompt appeared.
[Building Hellfire Missile Silo, remaining time required: 59 hours 01 minute...]
Listening to the system prompt, Han Xing wondered again, "Hmm, why does it take so much longer than when I last built a Silo?"
After a moment of thought, Han Xing quickly understood the reason.
This is because.
This piece of territory is a brand-new territory.
There are no buildings on it.
Including the construction acceleration function of the City Lord’s Mansion, all of it is missing.
Thinking of this, Han Xing also smiled wryly and shook his head.
"Looks like I still need to build those basic structures."
Then, he began to rearrange the entire territory.
First, he changed the surrounding terrain in the center of the territory.
Shifted mountains, leveled lakes.
Soon, a large flat area of one or two kilometers appeared in the territory center.
This is the foundation of the new city.
Here, Han Xing also started to consume a large amount of materials to build the Lord’s Mansion.
Of course, besides the Lord’s Mansion, there are many other buildings that need to be constructed quickly.
Such as various Goddess Statues, Refining Workshops, Smelting Workshops, Wolf Cavalry and Minotaur Camp, and so on...
With so many territory buildings.
Han Xing knows he will be kept busy.
After a whole night of hard work.
With the consumption of a large number of materials.
Plumes of smoke appeared on the plain he developed.
The new territory is booming.
The next day.
As dawn broke.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun saw the changes in the territory.
They also knew that while they were resting, Han Xing was still busy.
For a moment, everyone could not help but feel emotional...

chapters.title: Chapter 291 - 233: The Second Main City, Ten Thousand Stars City Founded!
paragraphs: Looking at the flourishing scenery of the territory.
Cheng Jianyong smiled and said, "Brother Xing, did you battle all night last night? Want the brothers to give you a shoulder massage?"
Han Xing rolled his eyes at him.
To be honest, with their current attributes and physical condition,
they wouldn’t have any problems even if they didn’t sleep for days or even for half a month.
Han Xing directly said, "Alright, our next task is to continue expanding the territory and leveling up."
"The goal is for everyone to reach Fourth Transformation!"
Upon hearing this, everyone was excited and invigorated.
Then, they set off again, beginning to explore the vast Witch Race Territory.
With their strength, challenging those few square kilometers of Sky Islands was not an issue.
However, anything larger was a bit risky.
Before the Defense Towers were built, Han Xing didn’t want to take risks.
So, they proceeded with caution and steadiness.
The second day quickly came to an end.
The area of Han Xing’s Sky Island expanded several times over again.
Now, it had reached a size of more than a dozen square kilometers.
Moreover, there were many more peculiar terrains.
Such as mountain-like red crystal ore, a small lake full of Spiritual Spring Water.
There was even a Gold Mountain with surfaces covered in golden light.
What Wu Ling’Er said was indeed true.
The external Sky Islands were indeed much richer in resources than the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Many rare ores and other resources were abundant here.
Looking at his increasingly vast Sky Island, Han Xing nodded in satisfaction.
Two days later.
Just as Han Xing got up, he heard a system prompt.
[Your territory building, City Lord’s Mansion has been successfully constructed, please name it.]
Han Xing was a bit surprised, "Oh? Another naming?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment.
His first main city was called Xingyu City.
For this second one, he intended to make it a pure mobile war fortress.
In the future, the territory would certainly have thousands of advanced buildings.
These buildings would be his means to deter the Legendary Powerhouses.
Thinking of this, Han Xing simply said.
"In that case, I’ll name you Ten Thousand Stars City."
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
"Your territory building ’Ten Thousand Stars City’ has been successfully named."
"City Lord’s Mansion’s acceleration function is now effective, attribute enhancement function is now effective."
At this moment, not only did Han Xing hear the prompt,
everyone staying in the territory heard this prompt.
Shen Yun and the others were also a bit surprised, not expecting Han Xing to build the new Lord’s Mansion so quickly.
They murmured the name Ten Thousand Stars City, seemingly not understanding its meaning.
Of course, Han Xing didn’t explain.
With the City Lord’s Mansion built, the other buildings like the Refining Workshop were all completed.
Next.
He could start constructing various Arrow Towers and Thunderbolt Towers, as well as Hellfire Missile Silo.
At this point, Han Xing came to the center of Ten Thousand Stars City’s territory, in a giant valley.
A large amount of materials were consumed.
The prototype of hundreds of Thunderbolt Towers appeared.
In the coming days.
Nothing unexpected happened.
Han Xing led everyone, continuously exploring those Sky Islands.
Their personal levels, as well as the territory’s area, kept growing at a rapid pace.
During this time.
Han Xing adhered to the principle of being cautious, not taking unnecessary risks.
Constantly wandering in the Witch Race Territory.
This ensured that if anything unexpected happened, Wu Ling’Er could be called for help.
So, they didn’t encounter any problems afterward.
Occasionally they ran into a few Witch Race vanguard special forces, who quickly identified them and chose to leave.
Time flew by, and a month passed.
On this day.
Five people and a wolf stood in front of a gigantic island that looked like an entire continent.
A month of development.
Their strength had also qualitatively improved.
They had all reached Level 40 and completed their advancement tasks.
Now, they were all Fourth Transformation Hero Level powerhouses.
Apart from the increase in strength, there was an even more astonishing development.
That was the area of Han Xing’s territory.
Now, his Ten Thousand Stars City as a whole had surpassed a thousand square kilometers.
What concept does this represent?
Some small counties on Blue Star have a total area of only about a thousand square kilometers.
Now, Han Xing essentially controlled an entire airborne city, moving rapidly in the sky.
Moreover, due to his power enhancement.
The movement speed of the territory experienced another qualitative change.
Previously, propelled by accelerators, it reached nearly six thousand kilometers per hour.
After completing the Fourth Transformation, the speed directly doubled.
It had now reached over twelve thousand kilometers per hour!
This large Sky Island appeared bulky but actually had extremely high maneuverability.
Now, his Ten Thousand Stars City officially surpassed Xingyu City in firepower.
Of course, Xingyu City wasn’t falling behind either.
This past month.
Through the efforts of Lanlan and others, Xingyu City’s scale also began rapid expansion.
Now, it has already reached a scale of over a thousand square meters.
Because of the foundation that Han Xing left behind.
Therefore, Xingyu City’s expansion speed is also extremely fast.
According to Wu Ling’Er, the Land of the Abandoned Gods doesn’t allow Legendary Level powers to appear.
That is to say, at the current stage, Xingyu City is basically invincible.
In the entire Land of the Abandoned Gods, they can walk with confidence.
Under the firepower coverage of the Hellfire and Thunderbolt Towers, no matter what Sky Island they encounter, they almost sweep through it.
At this moment.
Zhou Yingying, aka Lanlan, was in a voice call with Han Xing, excitedly reporting the progress.
"Lord, now the territory of Xingyu City is sufficient!"
"This past month, besides expanding our territory, we’ve been continuously optimizing the terrain, building more houses and streets."
"Now, the entire territory is transforming towards modernization!"
After saying this, Lanlan sent a picture to Han Xing.
The picture showed a huge Sky Island no less impressive than Ten Thousand Stars City.
This is the current Xingyu City.
Compared to a month ago, Xingyu City has undergone earth-shattering changes!
The picture was taken from an aerial view.
From this angle.
The original landscapes on Xingyu City have vanished.
It looks as if mountains have been leveled, and various tall buildings erected.
Now it’s filled with buildings and cozy pavilions, brightly lit.
Neatly planned streets, rows of aesthetically pleasing houses with a magical style.
Additionally, one could occasionally see Thunderbolt Towers and rows of Arrow Towers, providing a strong sense of security!
At this moment, Han Xing asked, "Eh, where did you put those catapults and Hellfire missile silos?"
Lanlan seemed to know Han Xing would ask this, so she said proudly, "I hid them!"
"Hid them?" Han Xing was puzzled.
"Yes, yes."
Lanlan replied, "I sectioned off several areas in the city and built several layers of Thorny Shield Walls around them."
"Then I placed all the catapults in these areas.
"And those Hellfire missile silos, I also placed them outside the city to make it convenient for us to take them during future battles."
After hearing this, Han Xing also showed a look of realization.
Then, he sighed with emotion at the diligence of Lanlan and her group of young girls.
After all, replanning the entire Xingyu City and constructing a large number of houses.
The scale of this project is enough to make one’s scalp tingle just hearing about it.
In addition to that, they’ve also been constantly expanding the territory and filling it with new terrains.
And then finding ways to integrate these terrains into the city is also a headache-inducing task.
Han Xing then said, "You’ve worked hard, thank you, Lanlan."
"And thank your friends too."
Hearing Han Xing’s serious thanks, Lanlan, who initially had a hint of pride on her face, suddenly felt a bit embarrassed.
Her face turned red, and she whispered like a mosquito, "No... no need to thank me, it’s my duty to work for the Lord..."
"Besides, I also really like..."
The last sentence was too soft for Han Xing to hear clearly what she was saying.
After chatting a few more words with Lanlan, Han Xing ended the call.
Lanlan, with her cheeks nearly burning, returned to Xingyu City.
At this time, the other young girls saw Lanlan’s state and quickly gathered around.
"Eh, Sister Lanzhi, what’s wrong? Why is your face so red, as if you just got off the phone with a boyfriend?"
Beside her, the curvaceous female assassin chuckled, "Eh, I thought Sister Lanzhi went to report work to the Lord?"
"Could it be, Sister Lanzhi’s boyfriend..."
Hearing this, Lanlan hurriedly covered her mouth,
"You, you, Xiaozhi, you hush!"
"You can’t just say such things!"
"The... the Lord has so many beautiful women around him, how could I possibly match up to him..."
This female assassin named Xiaozhi also realized that her joke had gone a bit too far.
So she changed her tone and said softly,
"By the way, Sister Lanzhi, what did the Lord say to make you so happy?"
Lanlan quickly replied, "Noth... nothing at all!"
At this moment, the young girls, with a meaningful smile, said.
"Really? Did the Lord really say nothing?"
"We know how hard Sister Lanzhi worked this month~"
"Should we tell the Lord about Sister Lanzhi’s efforts to give him a surprise?"
Faced with the teasing of a bunch of girls, Lanlan, holding her burning red cheeks, whispered.
"You, you guys stop teasing me..."
Seeing Lanlan almost embarrassed beyond words.
The young girls also stopped teasing her.
A few minutes later.
Lanlan let out a long sigh of relief, adjusting her emotions.
She then said again, "Al... alright, everyone, get ready."
"Check the number and codes of the Teleportation Arrays. In a while, the Lord is going to announce something big."
The girls’ eyes lit up.
"Something big..."
"Could it be?"
Lanlan nodded.
The young girls’ eyes became even more excited.
In Ten Thousand Stars City.
Han Xing had a thought.
He opened the friends interface and clicked on the add button.
Then he entered the characters ’Zhou Huang’.
Yes, Han Xing wanted to add Zhou Huang as a friend.
This guy used his real name directly.
So, adding him as a friend is quite a simple task.

sentences.text: Looking at the flourishing scenery of the territory.
Cheng Jianyong smiled and said, "Brother Xing, did you battle all night last night?
Want the brothers to give you a shoulder massage?"
Han Xing rolled his eyes at him.

they wouldn’t have any problems even if they didn’t sleep for days or even for half a month.
Han Xing directly said, "Alright, our next task is to continue expanding the territory and leveling up."

There was even a Gold Mountain with surfaces covered in golden light.
What Wu Ling’Er said was indeed true.
The external Sky Islands were indeed much richer in resources than the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Many rare ores and other resources were abundant here.
Looking at his increasingly vast Sky Island, Han Xing nodded in satisfaction.
Two days later.

Han Xing was a bit surprised, "Oh?
Another naming?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment.
His first main city was called Xingyu City.
For this second one, he intended to make it a pure mobile war fortress.
In the future, the territory would certainly have thousands of advanced buildings.
These buildings would be his means to deter the Legendary Powerhouses.
Thinking of this, Han Xing simply said.
"In that case, I’ll name you Ten Thousand Stars City."

"Your territory building ’Ten Thousand Stars City’ has been successfully named."
"City Lord’s Mansion’s acceleration function is now effective, attribute enhancement function is now effective."

everyone staying in the territory heard this prompt.
Shen Yun and the others were also a bit surprised, not expecting Han Xing to build the new Lord’s Mansion so quickly.
They murmured the name Ten Thousand Stars City, seemingly not understanding its meaning.
Of course, Han Xing didn’t explain.
With the City Lord’s Mansion built, the other buildings like the Refining Workshop were all completed.

He could start constructing various Arrow Towers and Thunderbolt Towers, as well as Hellfire Missile Silo.

A large amount of materials were consumed.
The prototype of hundreds of Thunderbolt Towers appeared.
