chapters.title: Chapter 292 - 234: I Want to Be a Mod Dog!
paragraphs: At this moment, Zhou Huang was leading a group of survivors, besieging a Three-star Lord.
This batch of survivors was equipped with refined equipment, and their combat quality was quite good.
Over a hundred people, all completed the Third Transformation, making this team exceptionally strong.
Now, at the front of the battlefield, a Holy Professional was loudly commanding.
"This is a Dual Elements monster, an Ice Dark Ghost. Do not use Ice Element and Dark Element attacks as they will heal it!
"Use Flame Magic and Light Element damage, quickly!"
Beside him, a human Berserker swung an axe but found it had no effect.
He frowned and quickly reminded, "No, this monster’s healing speed is too fast. Who here has suppression skills? Throw a few over."
"I got blinded, Holy Profession! Throw me a Purification Technique!"
To the current survivors, who have just completed Third Transformation, a Three-star Lord is still somewhat beyond their capabilities.
As the monster grew more ferocious, this elite team found it increasingly hard to endure.
However, these survivors weren’t too nervous.
Because they knew that if they couldn’t hold out, Zhou Huang would step in.
Zhou Huang’s goal was also to train this group’s combat awareness and coordination skills.
After observing for a while and confirming there were no major issues, Zhou Huang withdrew his gaze.
At this moment, Zhou Huang looked into the distance at that enormous Sky Island.
There lies his territory, the current base of the ’Huayi Alliance.’
Nowadays, it spans several tens of kilometers.
To speed up expansion, Zhou Huang crafted several additional squads during this time.
The task of these squads was to explore the Sky Island and expand territory everywhere.
Then, collect Sky Island fragments and send them all to Zhou Huang’s territory.
This way, rapid expansion can be achieved.
It must be said, Zhou Huang’s strategy was quite clear and direct.
His method now parallels the Witch Race’s development model.
Also, it is one of the modes best suited to group expansion.
Yet even so, the expansion speed of the ’Huayi Alliance’ still far lags behind Han Xing and the others.
Even ’Xingyu City’ under Lanlan’s control doesn’t compare.
At this moment, seeing the system’s flashing interface, Zhou Huang wasn’t surprised.
These days, he received thousands of friend requests daily, not quite reaching ten thousand.
This is the price of online identity verification.
Zhou Huang originally intended to ignore them.
However, seeing the applicant’s ID, he found himself unexpectedly curious.
"Han Xing... Star River..."
"Is it him?"
Suddenly, Zhou Huang’s pupils contracted.
"What’s he looking for me for?"
With a perplexed look, Zhou Huang clicked agree.
After adding as a friend, even before Zhou Huang could speak,
Han Xing directly sent a message and straightforwardly said, "Give me admin permissions."
Listening to Han Xing’s blunt tone, Zhou Huang didn’t get angry but asked,
"Why do you need admin permission?"
Han Xing replied, "Mute, act as a guard dog, what else could it be?"
Zhou Huang was speechless at Han Xing’s directness.
Nevertheless, he patiently explained, "This system permission isn’t something I can just give away."
"I have admin permission due to certain special reasons, but it comes with many responsibilities."
"If my decision errors cause fluctuations in the Human Race’s fate, I will suffer severe backlash..."
Han Xing didn’t want to listen to his lengthy explanation and directly asked, "Just say whether you’ll give it or not!
Zhou Huang fell silent.
A moment later, he responded with a single word.
"Give."
Han Xing laughed.
Then, he received a system notification.
"You have been granted special permission (permanent), and can now speak freely in chat channels and enable global muting functionality."
Hearing the system notification, Han Xing was somewhat surprised.
He initially intended to say a few words, just a short-term mute like last time.
However, Zhou Huang directly gave him permanent permission.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Thanks."
"No problem, just a casual gesture." Zhou Huang replied blandly.
Han Xing was speechless.
You just said the permission couldn’t be given casually, and now say it’s a casual gesture.
Indeed, this guy isn’t as upright and righteous as he seems.
The next moment, Zhou Huang received a system notification.
"Survivor Star River requests to trade with you."
Zhou Huang sent a message asking, "What’s the deal?"
Han Xing directly said, "Don’t waste words, just click agree."
After hearing this, Zhou Huang clicked confirm.
Then, Zhou Huang saw ten golden runes appear in the trade column.
In his puzzled gaze, Zhou Huang examined the attributes of these runes.
The next moment, he immediately held his breath.
Yes, these runes.
These are the reward blueprints Han Xing received the last time he first killed a Dominator-level creature.
[Destruction Rune (Gold)]
As the leader of the world’s largest team, Zhou Huang’s personal strength is beyond doubt, equally formidable.
He certainly understands the importance and rarity of these runes.
However, before Zhou Huang could say much more.
Han Xing directly clicked confirm.
After completing the transaction, Han Xing closed the private chat window.
Zhou Huang, looking at the ten robust attribute Destruction Runes in his backpack, also said with a smile.
"Star River is indeed an interesting person."
Beside him, a middle-aged man called Military Soul, hearing Zhou Huang talking to himself, asked: "Commander, what’s up with Star River?"
Zhou Huang shook his head and didn’t answer.
"It’s nothing."
"Next, keep an eye on the chat channel, he should have some big moves soon."
Military Soul, hearing this, was also slightly surprised in his eyes.
"Big moves?"
Zhou Huang nodded, "Although I don’t know what yet, according to my understanding of him, it should be something that can affect the global survivor situation greatly."
Military Soul also understood the importance of this matter and nodded, "Understood, Commander."
After Han Xing gained admin privileges.
He immediately went to the chat channel.
At this time, the survivors were chatting enthusiastically inside.
A survivor named Old Cat said: "Brothers, I’ve completed the Third Transformation, today, I officially ascend to Master Cat, be more polite in the future when talking to me!"
"Damn! Brother, you’re so fast? I just reached level 28! At this rate, it’ll take at least another five or six days to reach level 30.
"Indeed very fast, at this time, professionals completing the Third Transformation will all be sought after by the big groups!"
A survivor called ’Cute Newbie’ said: "Master Cat is amazing, please take care of this newbie!"
This person sent a voice message, sounding like they were speaking from the throat, pretentious and affected.
At this point, another survivor named Jinfu said: "Above, are you a girl?"
Cute Newbie immediately replied: "Yeah, yeah, I’m a cute chick, can big brother take me to Cloud Secret Realm?"
Jinfu, hearing this, shouted angrily: "Get out, I hate chicks the most!"
"If you were a guy, I might consider taking you."
Other survivors, hearing this, also laughed heartily.
"Brother Jinfu, well said."
"Exactly, exactly, men leave coordinates, women stand strong."
The survivor named Cute Newbie was instantly infuriated.
As they continued chatting, the topic was again steered to Cloud Secret Realm.
"By the way, brothers, have any of you encountered a Three-Star Secret Realm recently?"
"I did, damn it, the difficulty of the Three-Star Secret Realm is just insane! At the end, we’re supposed to take down three leaders, is this a difficulty that humans can challenge?"
"Yeah, every ten levels is a hurdle, without a whole Third Transformation team, there’s simply no hope of clearing the Three-Star Secret Realm."
At this point, a survivor named Sun Xiaolei said: "Don’t mention it, we almost lost our lives in Abyssal Rift too."
"In Abyssal Rifts above level 30, the monsters inside are at least level 30, and there are also a lot of Elite Monsters and Leader Monsters hidden inside."
Everyone, hearing this, was also surprised: "So outrageous?"
"Yeah, can you imagine, in a group of Skeleton Soldiers, there’s a hidden Skeleton Major?"
"Damn it, that Skeleton Major, holding a bone spear, almost poked me in the throat."
The entire chat channel was immediately filled with speechless symbols.
"Dude, explain exactly how it poked, on top or below."
After this person finished speaking, they also led to a burst of laughter in the chat channel.
Currently, many survivors haven’t been to the Abyssal Rift.
As the price of Abyssal Rift entry tickets, namely ’Strong Fragments’, continues to rise.
Many survivors prefer to consign these materials for sale rather than using them themselves.
So, their topic naturally also attracted a lot of attention.
Sun Xiaolei at this moment continued: "Although the higher you go in Abyssal Rifts, the tougher the difficulty, the rewards after level 20 get better."
"Abyssal Magic Stones basically always drop 5 to 10 pieces, and besides that, we also picked up some Elite Spirits in there."
Han Xing heard a key term.
Elite Spirit.
Han Xing murmured softly: "I remember, to forge that Ancient Weapon, the Demon Elephant War Chariot, it requires Heroic Spirit."
"Are these two materials in any way related?"
Other survivors, hearing this, also asked: "Master, what is Elite Spirit used for?"
"Yeah, yeah, show us, please."
Hearing the praise from everyone, the survivor named Sun Xiaolei also became slightly proud.
"Alright, today I’ll let you all have a look."
After saying this, he directly posted the attributes of Elite Spirit on the public screen.
Han Xing was also curious and clicked to check.
[Elite Spirit]: Contains the spirit of a powerful warrior, can directly summon a Three-Star Elite Level creature to assist in battle, or be used to create some special tools.
After reading the attributes of this spirit, the survivors were amazed.
"Damn? It can directly summon a Three-Star Elite, this thing is that crazy?"

"Yes, a little unbelievable! A Three-Star Elite requires at least three or four Third Transformation survivors cooperating to take it down. If you have more of these spirits, you can practically summon an elite army!"
"Terrifying!"

Hearing the system notification, Han Xing was somewhat surprised.
He initially intended to say a few words, just a short-term mute like last time.
However, Zhou Huang directly gave him permanent permission.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Thanks."
"No problem, just a casual gesture." Zhou Huang replied blandly.
Han Xing was speechless.
You just said the permission couldn’t be given casually, and now say it’s a casual gesture.
Indeed, this guy isn’t as upright and righteous as he seems.
The next moment, Zhou Huang received a system notification.
"Survivor Star River requests to trade with you."
Zhou Huang sent a message asking, "What’s the deal?"
Han Xing directly said, "Don’t waste words, just click agree."
After hearing this, Zhou Huang clicked confirm.
Then, Zhou Huang saw ten golden runes appear in the trade column.
In his puzzled gaze, Zhou Huang examined the attributes of these runes.
The next moment, he immediately held his breath.
Yes, these runes.
These are the reward blueprints Han Xing received the last time he first killed a Dominator-level creature.
[Destruction Rune (Gold)]
As the leader of the world’s largest team, Zhou Huang’s personal strength is beyond doubt, equally formidable.
He certainly understands the importance and rarity of these runes.
However, before Zhou Huang could say much more.
Han Xing directly clicked confirm.
After completing the transaction, Han Xing closed the private chat window.
Zhou Huang, looking at the ten robust attribute Destruction Runes in his backpack, also said with a smile.
"Star River is indeed an interesting person."
Beside him, a middle-aged man called Military Soul, hearing Zhou Huang talking to himself, asked: "Commander, what’s up with Star River?"
Zhou Huang shook his head and didn’t answer.
"It’s nothing."
"Next, keep an eye on the chat channel, he should have some big moves soon."
Military Soul, hearing this, was also slightly surprised in his eyes.
"Big moves?"
Zhou Huang nodded, "Although I don’t know what yet, according to my understanding of him, it should be something that can affect the global survivor situation greatly."
Military Soul also understood the importance of this matter and nodded, "Understood, Commander."
After Han Xing gained admin privileges.
He immediately went to the chat channel.
At this time, the survivors were chatting enthusiastically inside.
A survivor named Old Cat said: "Brothers, I’ve completed the Third Transformation, today, I officially ascend to Master Cat, be more polite in the future when talking to me!"
"Damn!
Brother, you’re so fast?
I just reached level 28!
At this rate, it’ll take at least another five or six days to reach level 30.
"Indeed very fast, at this time, professionals completing the Third Transformation will all be sought after by the big groups!"
A survivor called ’Cute Newbie’ said: "Master Cat is amazing, please take care of this newbie!"
This person sent a voice message, sounding like they were speaking from the throat, pretentious and affected.
At this point, another survivor named Jinfu said: "Above, are you a girl?"
Cute Newbie immediately replied: "Yeah, yeah, I’m a cute chick, can big brother take me to Cloud Secret Realm?"
Jinfu, hearing this, shouted angrily: "Get out, I hate chicks the most!"
"If you were a guy, I might consider taking you."
Other survivors, hearing this, also laughed heartily.
"Brother Jinfu, well said."
"Exactly, exactly, men leave coordinates, women stand strong."
The survivor named Cute Newbie was instantly infuriated.
As they continued chatting, the topic was again steered to Cloud Secret Realm.
"By the way, brothers, have any of you encountered a Three-Star Secret Realm recently?"
"I did, damn it, the difficulty of the Three-Star Secret Realm is just insane!
At the end, we’re supposed to take down three leaders, is this a difficulty that humans can challenge?"
"Yeah, every ten levels is a hurdle, without a whole Third Transformation team, there’s simply no hope of clearing the Three-Star Secret Realm."
At this point, a survivor named Sun Xiaolei said: "Don’t mention it, we almost lost our lives in Abyssal Rift too."
"In Abyssal Rifts above level 30, the monsters inside are at least level 30, and there are also a lot of Elite Monsters and Leader Monsters hidden inside."
Everyone, hearing this, was also surprised: "So outrageous?"
"Yeah, can you imagine, in a group of Skeleton Soldiers, there’s a hidden Skeleton Major?"
"Damn it, that Skeleton Major, holding a bone spear, almost poked me in the throat."
The entire chat channel was immediately filled with speechless symbols.
"Dude, explain exactly how it poked, on top or below."
After this person finished speaking, they also led to a burst of laughter in the chat channel.
Currently, many survivors haven’t been to the Abyssal Rift.
As the price of Abyssal Rift entry tickets, namely ’Strong Fragments’, continues to rise.
Many survivors prefer to consign these materials for sale rather than using them themselves.
So, their topic naturally also attracted a lot of attention.
Sun Xiaolei at this moment continued: "Although the higher you go in Abyssal Rifts, the tougher the difficulty, the rewards after level 20 get better."
"Abyssal Magic Stones basically always drop 5 to 10 pieces, and besides that, we also picked up some Elite Spirits in there."
Han Xing heard a key term.
Elite Spirit.
Han Xing murmured softly: "I remember, to forge that Ancient Weapon, the Demon Elephant War Chariot, it requires Heroic Spirit."
"Are these two materials in any way related?"
Other survivors, hearing this, also asked: "Master, what is Elite Spirit used for?"
"Yeah, yeah, show us, please."
Hearing the praise from everyone, the survivor named Sun Xiaolei also became slightly proud.
"Alright, today I’ll let you all have a look."
After saying this, he directly posted the attributes of Elite Spirit on the public screen.
Han Xing was also curious and clicked to check.
[Elite Spirit]: Contains the spirit of a powerful warrior, can directly summon a Three-Star Elite Level creature to assist in battle, or be used to create some special tools.
After reading the attributes of this spirit, the survivors were amazed.
"Damn?
It can directly summon a Three-Star Elite, this thing is that crazy?"
"Yes, a little unbelievable!
A Three-Star Elite requires at least three or four Third Transformation survivors cooperating to take it down.
If you have more of these spirits, you can practically summon an elite army!"
"Terrifying!"

chapters.title: Chapter 293 - 235: Xingyu City Opens!
paragraphs: After listening to the introductions from the above Survivors, everyone understood the function of this Elite Spirit.
Although for Han Xing, a Three-Star Elite Monster is of no real use.
But for those ordinary Survivors, this help is significant, and can even allow them to challenge some high-difficulty BOSS battles.
At this time, a Survivor named "Darkest Frequency" said: "Brother, I am the leader of the Celestial Dragon Gang. How many Elite Spirits do you have? I’ll take them all!"
"Is your Celestial Dragon Gang really that impressive? We at the Heaven Patrol Gang also want these Spirits!"
"That’s right, that’s right, fair competition for everyone."
At this time, the Survivor named Sun Xiaolei seemed to have foreseen the current situation.
He smiled and said: "Everyone, the quantity of Spirits I have is not much, so I can only supply them in limited quantities."
"How about this, you all privately message me your offers, and I will decide whether to sell based on the situation."
Upon hearing this, a multitude of Survivors began to frantically message Sun Xiaolei privately.
Compared to what these Survivors were focused on, Han Xing noticed the remark at the end.
[Can be used to create some special items]
"Oh? Special items?"
"Ancient Weapons should also belong to the category of special items, right?"
"So... the origin of Heroic Spirits is most likely related to the Abyssal Rift?"
Han Xing felt that this speculation was very likely to be true.
The reason why Survivors haven’t yet uncovered Heroic Spirits.
Is because their levels are still quite low, and they haven’t explored deeper layers of the Abyssal Rift.
So naturally, they haven’t come into contact with high-level materials like Heroic Spirits.
However, just because the Survivors can’t explore it doesn’t mean Han Xing can’t.
He pondered: "Currently, most Survivors have just completed the Third Transformation."
"And my level is already at 41, which is the Fourth Transformation."
"Even though after the Fourth Transformation, a large amount of experience is needed to level up, making it difficult to widen the gap afterwards."
"But now, I should be about two to three months ahead of them."
"And Cheng Jianyong and the others have also completed the Fourth Transformation."
"With the strength of our small team, we should be able to explore higher-level layers of the Abyssal Rift."
Thinking of this, Han Xing made a decision.
"It seems it’s necessary to make a trip to the Abyssal Rift soon."
At this moment, Han Xing seemed to remember something, slapped his thigh, and said.
"Damn, I was so focused on watching them chat that I forgot what I came here to do!"
"Damn, I’m here to announce something."
So, Han Xing directly opened the chat channel interface.
At this time, he noticed a difference at the edge of the chat box.
There was an additional number.
Online Users: 47.62 million.
Han Xing was somewhat surprised as well.
Unexpectedly, after Zhou Huang granted him administrator privileges, he could also see the number of online users in the chat channel.
As these Survivors were happily chatting away.
Suddenly, they received a notification.
[Administrator has turned on the total mute function, you can no longer speak in the chat channel.]
The Survivors were suddenly interrupted and froze for a moment.
Then, they each shouted within their small groups.
"What the heck! Total mute!"
"Which dog administrator did this, stand out!"
"Down with the dog administrator, give me back my freedom of speech!"
Among the indignation of these Survivors, a familiar name appeared.
"Hello everyone, I am Star River."
"I also turned on the total mute."
After Han Xing spoke, all the Survivors shut their mouths in private.
After all, now Star River’s fame was known worldwide!
Moreover, many among them were fans of Han Xing.
Those Survivors who had spoken too quickly now wished they could slap themselves twice.
At this moment, Han Xing continued.
"I am very sorry to interrupt you this evening.
"But no need to worry, everyone, I have something to announce here as well."
"After I finish speaking, the chat channel will return to normal."
Hearing Han Xing’s speech instantly caused a sensation among the Survivors.
Although they couldn’t speak, they began to quickly spread the news within their small groups.
"Brothers, come out quickly, Star God is speaking in the chat channel and seems to be announcing something big!"
"Something big? Let me take a look!"
"Gosh, I’m coming right away!"
"Quickly inform the squad leader, saying that Star God might be up to something big again."
Because they had experienced this a few times before.
They all knew that every time Han Xing was up to something big, he would let many Survivors know in advance.
For example, when trading Blood Curse Antidote and a large amount of Golden Equipment,
many Survivors who got the news in advance made a fortune trading with Star River!
So, they didn’t want to miss any opportunities.
In an instant, countless Survivors flocked to the chat channel this night.
At this moment, Military Soul, who had been watching the chat channel, didn’t expect Han Xing’s actions to be so fast.
He hurriedly dialed Zhou Huang’s voice call and said, "Leader, Star River is already speaking in the chat channel."
"As you expected, he seems to indeed have something big to announce. Do you want to check it out?"
Zhou Huang was also taken aback for a moment, then shook his head and said, "I understand."
At the same time.
Boundless, Luo Chan, Dragon Abyss, and some other large group leaders all received the news.
After more than a month, Star River appeared in everyone’s sight again.
Then, they all flocked to the chat channel.
Three minutes later.
At this time, Han Xing looked at the online users in the chat channel.

chapters.title: Chapter 294 - 235: Xingyu City Opens!
paragraphs: The population has surged from the original sixty million to over four hundred million, and it’s still growing at this rate.
After waiting for another two minutes.
The number of online users has exceeded one billion.
Truly a spectacle that captures everyone’s attention!
At this figure, the growth rate has slowed down.
Han Xing also knew it was almost time.
Because of the last Blood Tide disaster, too many of the Human Race perished.
Now, these one billion people nearly amount to one-third of the entire human population.
Everyone has something to do, whether it’s exploring the Secret Realm or the Sky Island.
Such a high online rate is entirely due to the reputation of his Star River.
At this moment, Han Xing spoke again.
"Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for coming to the chat channel tonight to hear me out."
"You are all fellow Blue Star compatriots. Although you’ve experienced over three months of Sky Island life, now, many of you still might not have fully adapted."
"Humans are ultimately social animals, still accustomed to living firmly based on the ground."
Han Xing’s words gained recognition from many survivors.
At this moment, Han Xing continued: "However, you might foresee that this phenomenon is only temporary."
"With our development, as our territory continues to expand."
"In the future, there will undoubtedly come a day when we can build a vast land again, allowing all humanity to live freely on it."
"Even rebuilding on the scale of Blue Star!"
"Including our descendants, all will live together on that continent."
"There, we’ll have vast rivers, lakes, mountains, just like on Blue Star."
Han Xing’s words made many survivors start to ponder.
Will there really be such a day?
Knowing that humanity has been in this world for almost four months, they have gradually accepted the fact that Blue Star has become history.
They can no longer run freely on the vast land as before.
Yet now.
Star River tells them there is still hope.
That life on Blue Star can also be recreated in this world.
This shocked countless people.
There were also some survivors with doubtful expressions.
They discussed in their small groups,
"Star God... is joking, right?"
"Rebuilding Blue Star, how is that possible!?"
"That’s a planet! It would require an immense land area! How much time would it take?"
Other survivors also looked incredulous.
However, before Han Xing left the Land of the Abandoned Gods, he might have thought this was sheer fantasy.
But now, he’s seen the Witch Race’s Sky Island with his own eyes.
That enormous Sky Island that one could not see the end of.
This confirmed his thoughts.
Rebuilding Blue Star is possible!
At this time, some insightful survivors said, "What Star God said might be possible."
"According to our development pace, each person’s Sky Island will become larger and larger. If they can merge, the speed of expansion will be even faster."
"But even so, wanting to rebuild Blue Star’s scale is very difficult."
"It requires many people and a lot of time and effort."
"Even if it can be recreated, it will be a distant future."
Yet now, Star River suddenly brought it up.
Could it be...
Just as some people speculated.
Han Xing continued.
"As you have guessed, my territory, which is Xingyu City, has now taken shape after this period of development."
"Although it’s still a long way from rebuilding on the Blue Star scale."
"But now, it already spans a thousand square kilometers."
"It has become a modern city, built with countless resources and efforts by me and my companions."
"Next, Xingyu City will be fixed in a certain area."
"Meanwhile, it will open up to all of you."
When Han Xing finished this sentence, some survivors were still confused.
"What does it mean to open up Xingyu City?"
"I don’t know. Does it mean for us to visit?"
The survivors speculated.
However, the leaders of large groups suddenly had a realization.
Han Xing seemed to guess what the survivors were thinking.
He continued: "Perhaps, you don’t quite understand my meaning."
"Xingyu City is vast, with enough houses to accommodate millions of people."
"The maximum flow of people in this city can accommodate thirty million."
"And by opening it means, you can not only freely move and trade in Xingyu City, but also conduct commercial activities on it."
"For example, you can purchase store spaces in our Xingyu City for business."
"You can also buy residences in Xingyu City to secure a safe place for yourself."
Upon hearing these words, the leaders of large groups couldn’t remain calm.
Because since entering the Sky Island Paradise, they’ve already understood some of the operating rules.
That is, Sky Islands can merge and expand, and different survivors can concentrate their strengths to jointly operate a Sky Island.
Hereafter, if there is no crisis.
When the Human Race stabilizes, it will inevitably develop toward a clustering model.
Just like the lifestyle of the Witch Race.
Then, it will be the time for commerce to rise.
If they can establish a Sky Island and manage it, the daily profit would be enormous!
However, according to these leaders of large groups’ estimates, to achieve this model would take at least one or two years.
But now, Star River directly announces that his Xingyu City is ready to officially open at this time!
For a moment, a sense of urgency filled the hearts of these leaders.
This kind of thing, they fear others getting ahead.
It would mean losing all the influence and resources.
Yet, their anxiety is futile.
After all, the size and construction level of their Sky Islands have not reached the qualification to open.
Nor do they have Star River’s level of appeal.
Han Xing continued speaking again at this moment.
"You should all know, the defensive power of my territory, Xingyu City, is quite formidable."
"But what you might not know, is that during this period, the strength of Xingyu City has increased several times."
"I can guarantee you that as long as you’re within the Land of the Abandoned Gods, as long as you’re inside Xingyu City, your safety will be assured without any intrusion."
After speaking, Han Xing also posted the pictures Lanlan sent him.
Seeing the pictures, the survivors were even more astounded.
"Oh my! In just a month, Star God’s territory has grown so massive!"
"Yes, this is terrifying!"
"Look at it; so many beautiful buildings and houses!"
Upon seeing this picture.
These survivors finally understood his meaning.
At this moment, within the territory of the ’Huayi Alliance.’
The survivor named Military Soul, after hearing Han Xing speak, hurriedly found Zhou Huang with a panicked expression.
"Chief, did you see? This Star River, his territory has already been built to such a scale!"
"Moreover, he wants to open it up and make it into a city for survivors!"
"Isn’t this what we initially aimed for?"
Zhou Huang helplessly shook his head, "Yes."
"But there’s nothing we can do."
"At this stage, whoever’s territory can first reach this scale and then open up will have an immeasurable impact on all humanity."
"It might even become the first main city of humanity, who knows!"
Military Soul was suddenly startled: "Should we now also open up our territory and massively recruit those low-level survivors?"
Zhou Huang sighed and said, "I wish we could."
"But now, the Huayi Alliance has spread too far and wide, with millions of brothers waiting impatiently for development."
"Fixing our territory in one place not only can’t speed up our development, but would severely slow down our progress."
"Moreover, even if we open it up now, we can’t compete with him."
"Who do you think those survivors will choose between the Huayi Alliance and Xingyu City?"
Military Soul, upon hearing this, could only smile wryly.

After speaking, Han Xing also posted the pictures Lanlan sent him.
Seeing the pictures, the survivors were even more astounded.
"Oh my!
In just a month, Star God’s territory has grown so massive!"
"Yes, this is terrifying!"
"Look at it; so many beautiful buildings and houses!"
Upon seeing this picture.
These survivors finally understood his meaning.
At this moment, within the territory of the ’Huayi Alliance.’
The survivor named Military Soul, after hearing Han Xing speak, hurriedly found Zhou Huang with a panicked expression.
"Chief, did you see?
This Star River, his territory has already been built to such a scale!"
"Moreover, he wants to open it up and make it into a city for survivors!"
"Isn’t this what we initially aimed for?"
Zhou Huang helplessly shook his head, "Yes."
"But there’s nothing we can do."
"At this stage, whoever’s territory can first reach this scale and then open up will have an immeasurable impact on all humanity."
"It might even become the first main city of humanity, who knows!"
Military Soul was suddenly startled: "Should we now also open up our territory and massively recruit those low-level survivors?"
Zhou Huang sighed and said, "I wish we could."
"But now, the Huayi Alliance has spread too far and wide, with millions of brothers waiting impatiently for development."
"Fixing our territory in one place not only can’t speed up our development, but would severely slow down our progress."
"Moreover, even if we open it up now, we can’t compete with him."
"Who do you think those survivors will choose between the Huayi Alliance and Xingyu City?"
Military Soul, upon hearing this, could only smile wryly.

chapters.title: Chapter 295 - 236: Settlement Agreement
paragraphs: Han Xing, after waiting for a moment, continued to speak.
"That’s all I wanted to say."
"If anyone is interested in moving to Xingyu City, you can visit the forum later, where I will post a thread."
"The post will list in detail the conditions for purchasing or leasing Xingyu City’s shops and houses, along with the teleportation array numbers."
"You can use the teleportation array to travel to Xingyu City."
After finishing his speech, Han Xing disabled the mute function.
The chat channel again started a heated discussion.
"Guys! What’s your take? Should we go check out the Star God’s territory?"
"Of course, I’ve been wanting to see what this legendary figure’s territory looks like."
"Exactly, even if we don’t buy property from the Star God, a visit is worthwhile."
"Haha, I’ll go and see too!"
Suddenly, a large number of Survivors flooded into the forum, checking Han Xing’s opening requirements.
Han Xing quickly posted the thread.
In just half a minute, Han Xing’s post reached billions of views and continued to soar.
They also saw the conditions set by Han Xing.
[Xingyu City Opening Treaty Article One: All visitors must not damage any buildings in Xingyu City; otherwise, they will face immediate retaliation from Xingyu City.]

[Opening Treaty Article Two: Except in some special venues, Survivors cannot engage in combat within the city or attack neutral creatures or other Survivors, or they will face sanctions from the Defense Tower.]
[Note: The above are two treaty articles for general Survivors. Below are three articles for settling in Xingyu City.]
At this point, those Survivors, after reading, seemed to find Han Xing’s conditions rather strict.
Thus, they began posting in the forum below.
"No combat allowed? Are the requirements really this strict?"
"Yeah, what if we encounter danger in the city?"
"Exactly, I think removing this restriction would be better."
These replies quickly attracted hundreds of comments.
However, below, replies quickly shot up.
"Are you guys out of your minds? Asking the Star God to lift the combat restriction, letting you in to wreak havoc?"
"That’s right, I think these folks don’t have pure intentions."
"I advise some of you not to have any bad ideas; the Star God’s Defense Towers are no joke, losing your life there wouldn’t be good."
These comments gained a lot of approval and were quickly liked to the top.
While the posts asking Han Xing to lift the restrictions received tens of thousands of dislikes and were completely hidden away.
At this time, another Survivor reminded:
"Brothers, if anyone wants to buy houses or shops on the Star God’s territory, make sure to read the treaty below carefully, so there are no regrets later."
This comment drew everyone’s attention.

[Xingyu City Residency Article One: Survivors intending to purchase ordinary or high-end residences need to sign a Lord Contract according to the year (The contract content includes handing over 30% of resources obtained during combat, territory, etc.).]

[Xingyu City Residency Article Two: Survivors who wish to purchase shops must sign a lifelong Lord Contract (equally handing over 30% resources). Shops are for long-term use and cannot be transferred (If due to poor management causing losses, resources obtained during combat can compensate).]

[Residency Article Three: Survivors intending to lease shops for business can sign a Lord Contract according to the year. If during business, the profitability standard is not met, resources obtained during combat can be used to compensate for losses, or they can choose to sign a new contract, relinquishing the business qualification.]
These three conditions cover the majority.
Everyone finished reading, and many began discussing below: "Wow, the Star God’s rules are clear-cut."
"Directly signing the Lord Contract,"
"Indeed, although he doesn’t charge us rent, we have to give him 30% of our business share."
"Wait, look at the back; if the business standard is not met, we have to go fight to earn resources to offset the loss!"
"Wow, that’s really strict."
These conditions from Han Xing are indeed quite demanding.
However, since he chose to open Xingyu City, he meant to profit from it.
Han Xing provides them with security and business opportunities; if they can’t bring him any return, would he not be doing charity?
Han Xing thinks, there’s still no point in being so kind and big-hearted.
At this point, another Survivor posted below:
"Honestly, handing over 30% of resources is quite fair. We know those big groups are giving up half their resources and still don’t have the freedom here."
"That’s right, using battle resources to offset losses is reasonable. Otherwise, a big group would just sign contracts, occupy shop spaces, and do nothing, and the Star God would lose big time."
"Yeah, the Star God’s territory is safer, exchanging 30% resources for an absolutely secure residence is worth it."
"Stop debating, let’s head to Xingyu City first!"
"There are only more than three thousand teleportation arrays; once they cool down, we’ll have to wait for the next batch!"
Upon saying this, these Survivors also realized this fact.
All at once, everyone scrolled down the post, checking the three thousand plus teleportation array numbers Han Xing released.
Next moment.
All three thousand plus teleportation arrays in Xingyu City lit up.
Calculating with one Intermediate Teleportation Array teleporting ten people at a time.
After each teleport, it enters a half-hour cooldown period.
Meaning, only sixty-four thousand people can be teleported over per hour.
In a day, the number of people able to be teleported only numbers a little over a million.
For the number of global Survivors, this figure doesn’t sound like much.
However, the Xingyu City will continue to expand in the future, and the number of Teleportation Arrays will keep increasing.
Furthermore, once Han Xing finds the Void Soul Stone and builds the High-Level Teleportation Array,
at that time, the daily number of people that can be teleported will reach tens of millions, or even billions.
At this moment, Lanlan and others who are waiting have eyes filled with anticipation and apprehension.
A few seconds later.
Over thirty thousand Survivors appeared from the Teleportation Array.
They were just like the group from the ’All Gods Daily’ column.
The first thing upon arriving at Xingyu City was looking around with curious eyes at everything inside.
When they saw this colossal city that was so vast its end couldn’t be seen, they all marveled.
"Wow... such a big city!"
"These houses, these clean and tidy streets, are freaking impressive!"
"Is this the power of the world’s first?"
Some Survivors couldn’t help but exclaim.
More people started using recording and photo-taking features.
They wanted to share their experiences in Xingyu City with friends or their team as soon as possible.
Of course, some mischievous Survivors uploaded these pictures to the chat channel.
Suddenly, the chat channel was flooded with pictures of Xingyu City.
Compared to the panoramic view Han Xing posted earlier.
These Survivors’ first-person perspectives let people feel the grandeur of Xingyu City even more!
And, all kinds of details!
As these Survivors started exploring,
the unique buildings of Xingyu City were discovered.
Such as the Star River Beast Fighting Arena, the Star River Tavern, the Star River Weapon Shop, the Star River Secret Medicine Shop, etc...
These locations are currently in business.
Managed by a group of little girls led by Lanlan, each person managing one store.
Although not as well-equipped as the main facilities of the Witch Race’s capital city,
it has already formed the prototype of a business city.
Furthermore, as more Survivors settle in,
the commercial model of the entire city will become more mature and usher in a flourishing era.
At this time.
Lanlan stood at a high spot in the City Lord’s Mansion,
This position allows one to overlook the layout of the entire Xingyu City.
While giving Han Xing a live broadcast, she nervously watched the flowing crowds,
Due to the restrictions set up in advance,
other Survivors were not allowed to enter the roadside shops before merchants settle in.
This rule applies to other buildings as well.
Currently, most Survivors can only walk back and forth on the streets, which makes them somewhat unsatisfied.
However, there are still some places already open.
Such as the massive volcano hidden on the outskirts of the city.
Upon closer inspection, it turns out to be not a real volcano, but a colossal Celestial Pool!
Hot steam is still rising from the Celestial Pool.
It turns out, this is a natural volcanic hot spring!
It attracted countless Survivors to stop by.
Then, they began climbing the mountain, finding the entrance to the hot spring.
Above it hangs a sign called ’Starry Sky Hot Spring.’
As a natural volcanic hot spring.
Survivors only need to pay fifty Spirit Cores to soak in it for an entire night.
At this time, several Survivors arrived at the hot spring entrance, eager to try.
A well-built Survivor glanced at the sign and the marked price at the door, nodding.
"Fifty Spirit Cores to experience a volcanic hot spring, this price isn’t bad!"
"That’s right, I’m a Third Transformation Professional now; I can earn over two thousand Spirit Cores a day. Fifty Spirit Cores are a piece of cake."
"Hehe, then I’ll go try it out too."
At the entrance, the one responsible for business was the female Assassin named Xiaozhi.
Seeing the first group of customers coming over, Xiaozhi also wore a professional smile on her face.
"Are you here for the hot spring, dear guests?"
These Survivors nodded.
Looking at Xiaozhi’s fiery figure, everyone’s eyes were drawn to her.
However, in their hearts, none dared to have any other thoughts.
After all, this place is the territory of the legendary Star River.
The women appearing here must be connected to him, possibly even being his.
Moreover, the contract clearly states that no one may touch any neutral beings, including business personnel, within Xingyu City.
Otherwise, they will be directly blasted to death by the Defense Tower

chapters.title: Chapter 296 - 237: The Grand Spectacle of Xingyu City
paragraphs: At this moment, the group of survivors also politely replied, "Yes... Yes."
"We’re here for the hot springs."
Seeing their polite demeanor, Xiaozhi covered her face and giggled.
"Dear guests, please follow me."
Then, guided by her, they arrived at the entrance of the volcanic hot springs.
Above, it was marked ’Gentlemen’.
At this point, Xiaozhi said from behind, "Guests, once you enter from here, it’s the volcanic hot springs,"
"You need to be aware that upon entering, the system will automatically deduct 50 Spirit Cores from your backpack, so please ensure your account has sufficient resources~"
Listening to Xiaozhi’s reminder, the survivors all nodded, indicating their understanding.
Then, Xiaozhi chuckled and returned to the reception area at the door.
The group of survivors, with curious eyes, lifted the curtain.
The Starry Sky Hot Spring is located in a remote part of the city, preserving the shape of the giant volcano.
When the survivors came up, they also climbed a section of mountain road.
However, once Han Xing acquires the Witch Race’s elevator blueprint, there won’t be a need to climb anymore.
With an apprehensive mindset, these male survivors lifted the curtain.
Then, before them, a vast volcanic celestial pool appeared.
Steam continuously rose from the lake’s surface, and before even getting close, waves of warmth rushed at them.
Moreover, from this angle, they could see the nightscape of Xingyu City’s central district.
At this moment, the survivors let out a heartfelt exclamation.
"Whoa... This scenery is absolutely stunning."
"Yeah, it’s so beautiful... I never imagined I could see such a night view!"
"Now, I kind of understand what it feels like to dream of returning to the Tang Dynasty."
Most of the city’s buildings were expanded by Lanlan and a few young girls.
And, when they were decorating Xingyu City, the details were almost impeccable.
Magic stone lanterns, red crystal ribbons, and various pavilions and towers.
With a mix of ancient and magical beauty.
At this moment, a male Holy Profession said.
"Say no more, this hot spring is so large, it could soak at least tens of thousands of people, right? We’ve got it all to ourselves today!"
"Brothers, what are we waiting for, jump in quickly!"
With that, these survivors started taking off their armor and jumped straight into the water.
Accompanied by a series of splashes.
The survivors who jumped in immediately let out a heartfelt expression.
"Wuhu... This heat is just amazing!"
"Yeah, since coming to this world, I’ve never had such a comfortable bath."
The comfortable temperature of the volcanic hot springs makes one almost unaware of their body, feeling light as if floating in a cloud.
Then, a survivor suddenly exclaimed.
"Brothers! Why do I feel like my energy is constantly recovering? I feel like I have endless energy now!"
With this reminder, the other survivors also realized this.
"What the hell! It’s true, my physical strength is recovering too!!"
"This is so amazing, what’s going on?"
What they don’t know is that for optimal effect, Lanlan infused the hot springs with a large amount of Spiritual Spring Water.
Even though it’s diluted, the life-recovering effect has become quite weak.
However, since the group of survivors are not in an injured state, the surplus life value transformed into energy and physical strength recovery.
Moreover, this life force is directly absorbed by the body, the tingling sensation makes people almost unable to resist indulging in it.
"This is just awesome!"
"Damn, soaking in the hot springs can also restore energy, hit the jackpot!"
"Quickly, go tell Little Wolf and Xiaoli to come over too! Let them experience what heavenly enjoyment is!
For a while, these survivors eagerly opened their friend lists and started bragging about the wonders of the volcanic hot springs.
However, for such special places, Lanlan and the others also made some restrictions, such as not allowing the recording or photography functions.
But this doesn’t prevent the oral spread among the survivors.
Soon, one spurred ten, and ten spurred a hundred.
A large number of survivors began flocking to the Starry Sky Hot Spring.
At the door, Xiaozhi, who was in charge of collecting money, was also extremely busy.
In just over ten minutes, she collected over twenty thousand Spirit Cores, equivalent to over four thousand people flocking to the Starry Sky Hot Spring.
Apart from the Starry Sky Hot Spring, several other operating venues were also well-received by many survivors.
"Brothers, come quickly to the Star River Beast Fighting Arena! There’s a good show to watch!"
"What show?"
"Two three-star elite monsters are about to engage in a life-and-death battle! We can bet on who wins and who loses!"
"What, this is so thrilling? I’m coming right away!"
"Hurry to the Star Universe Tavern, with a limited supply of 760-year-old Black Vine Wine! Remember to bring enough Spirit Cores!"
"Holy crap, did I hear wrong? 760-year-old?"
"Black Vine Wine, I’ve heard of it once, it’s a favorite brew of the dwarf nobility, very precious."
"I didn’t expect the Star Universe Tavern to have such wine!"
"The Star River Weapon Shop has a large number of high-level golden equipment for sale! First come, first served!"
"Damn, what did I just see?"
"Epic Magic Staff! Flame Dominator! There’s also an epic Holy Hammer! Triumph Knight!"
"This is insane! Star River actually displayed such weapons!"
To leave a profound impression on these survivors, Han Xing even brought out the treasures he had kept hidden.
The first batch of survivors who arrived in Xingyu City were having a great time.
They were excitedly sharing their experiences in the chat channel.
This made the survivors painfully waiting for the teleportation array’s cooldown even more impatient.
"Damn, why is this teleportation array cooldown so long?"
"Hurry, hurry, hurry, I’m about to die of impatience! I feel like there are ants crawling all over me!"
"Me too, I really wanna soak in that volcanic hot spring, I’m so envious!"
After a dozen minutes.
The teleportation array’s cooldown finally ended.
The survivors rushed forward, frantically clicking to teleport.
The next moment.
Over three thousand teleportation arrays lit up with white light again.
However, at the same time, at least tens of millions of people clicked.
In the end, only a little over thirty thousand survivors managed to teleport over.
"Hahaha! I made it, Star River Tavern, here I come!"
"Volcanic hot spring, where’s the volcanic hot spring? Hurry!"
Once these survivors entered Xingyu City, they began searching everywhere for the famous spots.
At this moment, the survivors who hadn’t teleported over were furious.
"Damn it, can’t you slow down your fingers? My fingers are numb from clicking, and I still can’t beat you guys."
"Exactly, exactly! What a bunch of animals!"
At this time, Lanlan was still live-streaming everything for Han Xing.
Seeing the flood in the chat channel.
Lanlan spoke with a trace of nervousness: "L-Lord, it seems like there aren’t enough teleportation arrays..."
"The survivors’ emotions seem a bit off."
Han Xing also noticed the current situation.
However, he wasn’t too surprised.
In a large city like this, it’s natural to face various issues right after opening.
Han Xing replied: "I see it, but don’t worry, I’ll send Xingyu City’s coordinates to the chat channel, let those survivors try to operate their Sky Islands to come over."
Upon hearing this, Lanlan also breathed a sigh of relief.
Han Xing promptly went to the chat channel and announced the coordinates of Xingyu City.
A large number of survivors checked the coordinate location, then said in unison.
"These coordinates are a bit far from me! It’ll take two or three days to get there!"
"It’ll take me more than half a month... outrageous!"
"Yeah, but there’s no helping it, after all, the Land of the Abandoned Gods is too vast..."
Of course, there were survivors nearby who were excitedly exclaiming.
"Damn! I’m nearby, just an hour or two to get there!"
"Haha, same for me!"
Those who were far away were extremely envious.
Then, another survivor spoke.
"Is anyone heading to Xingyu City? Our team is nearby, the teleportation array hasn’t entered cooldown yet, if you come over now, I can give you a lift!"
Upon hearing this, some survivors’ eyes lit up.
They hadn’t thought of this method!
Although the Xingyu City’s teleportation array was on cooldown, other survivors’ Sky Islands weren’t!
They could completely teleport to those survivors’ Sky Islands first, then transfer over.
In a moment, a large number of survivors shouted.
"Really, godfather!"
"I’m coming right away, godfather please PM me!"
Other nearby survivors also imitated and said: "We have several intermediate and basic teleportation arrays, we can also take a few people."
"Same here..."
After racking their brains, the survivors came up with many ways to quickly reach Xingyu City.
In no time, the tense atmosphere in the chat channel eased a bit.
Then, it returned to the normal half-hour wave-by-wave teleportation rhythm.
Time continued to pass.
That night, another bustling scene emerged among the survivors.
Countless survivors poured into Xingyu City through various channels.
Time flew by, and two and a half hours passed.
However, Lanlan and Han Xing, who had been live-streaming the entire time, started frowning a bit.
So far, the teleportation array had transported five waves of people.
That’s nearly 160,000 people.
Plus, the survivors who rushed over from the vicinity.
The active population of Xingyu City had reached 200,000.
However, even with this many people, Han Xing hadn’t received a single piece of information about signing lord contracts.
This meant that none of their shops or houses had been sold.
Lanlan hurriedly sent Han Xing a message: "L-Lord, the situation seems a bit off."
"These survivors are all here to hang out, no one is signing contracts with us."
"Our shops don’t seem to be so popular..."
After hearing this, Han Xing nodded and said: "I see."
Though a bit surprised, his reaction wasn’t too great.
Han Xing also understood that so far, most survivors were still accustomed to living on Sky Islands.
The way to acquire resources was through fighting monsters in the wild.
They hadn’t yet thought about earning resources through a commercial model.

sentences.text: At this moment, the group of survivors also politely replied, "Yes...
Yes."
"We’re here for the hot springs."
Seeing their polite demeanor, Xiaozhi covered her face and giggled.
"Dear guests, please follow me."
Then, guided by her, they arrived at the entrance of the volcanic hot springs.
Above, it was marked ’Gentlemen’.
At this point, Xiaozhi said from behind, "Guests, once you enter from here, it’s the volcanic hot springs,"
"You need to be aware that upon entering, the system will automatically deduct 50 Spirit Cores from your backpack, so please ensure your account has sufficient resources~"
Listening to Xiaozhi’s reminder, the survivors all nodded, indicating their understanding.
Then, Xiaozhi chuckled and returned to the reception area at the door.
The group of survivors, with curious eyes, lifted the curtain.
The Starry Sky Hot Spring is located in a remote part of the city, preserving the shape of the giant volcano.
When the survivors came up, they also climbed a section of mountain road.
However, once Han Xing acquires the Witch Race’s elevator blueprint, there won’t be a need to climb anymore.
With an apprehensive mindset, these male survivors lifted the curtain.
Then, before them, a vast volcanic celestial pool appeared.
Steam continuously rose from the lake’s surface, and before even getting close, waves of warmth rushed at them.
Moreover, from this angle, they could see the nightscape of Xingyu City’s central district.
At this moment, the survivors let out a heartfelt exclamation.
"Whoa...
This scenery is absolutely stunning."
"Yeah, it’s so beautiful...
I never imagined I could see such a night view!"
"Now, I kind of understand what it feels like to dream of returning to the Tang Dynasty."
Most of the city’s buildings were expanded by Lanlan and a few young girls.
And, when they were decorating Xingyu City, the details were almost impeccable.
Magic stone lanterns, red crystal ribbons, and various pavilions and towers.
With a mix of ancient and magical beauty.
At this moment, a male Holy Profession said.
"Say no more, this hot spring is so large, it could soak at least tens of thousands of people, right?
We’ve got it all to ourselves today!"
"Brothers, what are we waiting for, jump in quickly!"
With that, these survivors started taking off their armor and jumped straight into the water.
Accompanied by a series of splashes.
The survivors who jumped in immediately let out a heartfelt expression.
"Wuhu...
This heat is just amazing!"
"Yeah, since coming to this world, I’ve never had such a comfortable bath."
The comfortable temperature of the volcanic hot springs makes one almost unaware of their body, feeling light as if floating in a cloud.
Then, a survivor suddenly exclaimed.
"Brothers!
Why do I feel like my energy is constantly recovering?
I feel like I have endless energy now!"
With this reminder, the other survivors also realized this.
"What the hell!
It’s true, my physical strength is recovering too!!"
"This is so amazing, what’s going on?"
What they don’t know is that for optimal effect, Lanlan infused the hot springs with a large amount of Spiritual Spring Water.
Even though it’s diluted, the life-recovering effect has become quite weak.
However, since the group of survivors are not in an injured state, the surplus life value transformed into energy and physical strength recovery.
Moreover, this life force is directly absorbed by the body, the tingling sensation makes people almost unable to resist indulging in it.
"This is just awesome!"
"Damn, soaking in the hot springs can also restore energy, hit the jackpot!"
"Quickly, go tell Little Wolf and Xiaoli to come over too!
Let them experience what heavenly enjoyment is!
For a while, these survivors eagerly opened their friend lists and started bragging about the wonders of the volcanic hot springs.
However, for such special places, Lanlan and the others also made some restrictions, such as not allowing the recording or photography functions.
But this doesn’t prevent the oral spread among the survivors.
Soon, one spurred ten, and ten spurred a hundred.
A large number of survivors began flocking to the Starry Sky Hot Spring.
At the door, Xiaozhi, who was in charge of collecting money, was also extremely busy.
In just over ten minutes, she collected over twenty thousand Spirit Cores, equivalent to over four thousand people flocking to the Starry Sky Hot Spring.
Apart from the Starry Sky Hot Spring, several other operating venues were also well-received by many survivors.
"Brothers, come quickly to the Star River Beast Fighting Arena!
There’s a good show to watch!"
"What show?"
"Two three-star elite monsters are about to engage in a life-and-death battle!
We can bet on who wins and who loses!"
"What, this is so thrilling?
I’m coming right away!"
"Hurry to the Star Universe Tavern, with a limited supply of 760-year-old Black Vine Wine!
Remember to bring enough Spirit Cores!"
"Holy crap, did I hear wrong?
760-year-old?"
"Black Vine Wine, I’ve heard of it once, it’s a favorite brew of the dwarf nobility, very precious."
"I didn’t expect the Star Universe Tavern to have such wine!"
"The Star River Weapon Shop has a large number of high-level golden equipment for sale!
First come, first served!"
"Damn, what did I just see?"
"Epic Magic Staff!
Flame Dominator!
There’s also an epic Holy Hammer!
Triumph Knight!"
"This is insane!
Star River actually displayed such weapons!"
To leave a profound impression on these survivors, Han Xing even brought out the treasures he had kept hidden.
The first batch of survivors who arrived in Xingyu City were having a great time.
They were excitedly sharing their experiences in the chat channel.
This made the survivors painfully waiting for the teleportation array’s cooldown even more impatient.
"Damn, why is this teleportation array cooldown so long?"
"Hurry, hurry, hurry, I’m about to die of impatience!
I feel like there are ants crawling all over me!"
"Me too, I really wanna soak in that volcanic hot spring, I’m so envious!"
After a dozen minutes.
The teleportation array’s cooldown finally ended.
The survivors rushed forward, frantically clicking to teleport.
The next moment.
Over three thousand teleportation arrays lit up with white light again.
However, at the same time, at least tens of millions of people clicked.
In the end, only a little over thirty thousand survivors managed to teleport over.
"Hahaha!
I made it, Star River Tavern, here I come!"
"Volcanic hot spring, where’s the volcanic hot spring?
Hurry!"
Once these survivors entered Xingyu City, they began searching everywhere for the famous spots.
At this moment, the survivors who hadn’t teleported over were furious.
"Damn it, can’t you slow down your fingers?
My fingers are numb from clicking, and I still can’t beat you guys."
"Exactly, exactly!
What a bunch of animals!"
At this time, Lanlan was still live-streaming everything for Han Xing.
Seeing the flood in the chat channel.
Lanlan spoke with a trace of nervousness: "L-Lord, it seems like there aren’t enough teleportation arrays..."
"The survivors’ emotions seem a bit off."
Han Xing also noticed the current situation.
However, he wasn’t too surprised.
In a large city like this, it’s natural to face various issues right after opening.
Han Xing replied: "I see it, but don’t worry, I’ll send Xingyu City’s coordinates to the chat channel, let those survivors try to operate their Sky Islands to come over."
Upon hearing this, Lanlan also breathed a sigh of relief.
Han Xing promptly went to the chat channel and announced the coordinates of Xingyu City.
A large number of survivors checked the coordinate location, then said in unison.
"These coordinates are a bit far from me!
It’ll take two or three days to get there!"
"It’ll take me more than half a month... outrageous!"
"Yeah, but there’s no helping it, after all, the Land of the Abandoned Gods is too vast..."
Of course, there were survivors nearby who were excitedly exclaiming.
"Damn!
I’m nearby, just an hour or two to get there!"
"Haha, same for me!"
Those who were far away were extremely envious.
Then, another survivor spoke.
"Is anyone heading to Xingyu City?
Our team is nearby, the teleportation array hasn’t entered cooldown yet, if you come over now, I can give you a lift!"
Upon hearing this, some survivors’ eyes lit up.
They hadn’t thought of this method!
Although the Xingyu City’s teleportation array was on cooldown, other survivors’ Sky Islands weren’t!
They could completely teleport to those survivors’ Sky Islands first, then transfer over.
In a moment, a large number of survivors shouted.
"Really, godfather!"
"I’m coming right away, godfather please PM me!"
Other nearby survivors also imitated and said: "We have several intermediate and basic teleportation arrays, we can also take a few people."
"Same here..."
After racking their brains, the survivors came up with many ways to quickly reach Xingyu City.
In no time, the tense atmosphere in the chat channel eased a bit.
Then, it returned to the normal half-hour wave-by-wave teleportation rhythm.
Time continued to pass.
That night, another bustling scene emerged among the survivors.
Countless survivors poured into Xingyu City through various channels.
Time flew by, and two and a half hours passed.
However, Lanlan and Han Xing, who had been live-streaming the entire time, started frowning a bit.
So far, the teleportation array had transported five waves of people.
That’s nearly 160,000 people.
Plus, the survivors who rushed over from the vicinity.
The active population of Xingyu City had reached 200,000.
However, even with this many people, Han Xing hadn’t received a single piece of information about signing lord contracts.
This meant that none of their shops or houses had been sold.
Lanlan hurriedly sent Han Xing a message: "L-Lord, the situation seems a bit off."
"These survivors are all here to hang out, no one is signing contracts with us."
"Our shops don’t seem to be so popular..."
After hearing this, Han Xing nodded and said: "I see."
Though a bit surprised, his reaction wasn’t too great.
Han Xing also understood that so far, most survivors were still accustomed to living on Sky Islands.
The way to acquire resources was through fighting monsters in the wild.
They hadn’t yet thought about earning resources through a commercial model.

chapters.title: Chapter 297 - 238: Luo Chan’s Terms
paragraphs: Han Xing replied, "It’s okay, starting is always difficult."
"If we want them to accept this new model immediately, it will still take some time."
Lanlan felt a bit more at ease after hearing this.
As time passed.
Finally, survivors gradually signed the Lord Contract, securing hundreds of shops or residences.
Since today is the first day, they did not open the shops in the central district.
That area is the prime location of the future Xingyu City.
However, the surrounding shops were also constructed quite well.
Countless efforts of Lanlan and others have been invested in them.
As dawn approached.
Han Xing received over a thousand contract messages in total.
However, most of these survivors signed a one-year contract, seemingly wanting to operate for a while to test the effect.
Han Xing understood that without a major existential crisis like the Blood Tide, survivors were unwilling to bind their freedom to others.
However, the result still fell short of his expectations.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "It seems relying on these survivors to help me run the shops and earn profits in a short time isn’t feasible."
This left him somewhat disappointed.
Because, to retain people in a city, there must be diverse commerce and plenty of job opportunities.
Even though Xingyu City has some shops in operation now.
Relying solely on them to keep a large number of survivors isn’t realistic.
Once the novelty for survivors fades away, they will forget about Xingyu City.
At this moment, Han Xing frowned and muttered to himself.
"Now, the issue I face is the lack of people to operate the entire city."
"Without a crisis like the Blood Tide, survivors won’t easily sign Lord Contracts, so they can’t be depended on."
Han Xing shook his head, "But it’s okay, I still have an alternative route.
"Which is, to seek help from the natives of this world."
Han Xing’s eyes suddenly lit up.
Their journey to the Witch Race Main City provided them insights into the ecological environment and population distribution of such a large race.
That is, not all members of the Witch Race are professionals above the First Transformation.
Many ordinary people are stuck in the Witch Race Main City, earning meager incomes through labor.
Exploring the Sky Islands is a privilege of professionals.
Han Xing plans to discuss with Wu Ling’Er when he gets a chance.
He intends to sign contracts directly with these Witch Race people using Contract Scrolls and pay them a certain monthly compensation.
Han Xing doesn’t expect much from them, just looking after his shops should be fine.
Presumably, Wu Ling’Er would be happy to accept this.
However, realizing this goal will take a long time.
The first issue to resolve is how these Witch Race people can enter the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Prior to this, Han Xing had already learned.
Natives from outside find it extremely difficult to enter or exit the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Even strong individuals like Wu Ling’Er were trapped inside for over half a month.
But there is a solution to this issue.
That is establishing a High-Level Teleportation Array.
The High-Level Teleportation Array has a special effect that allows teleportation regardless of space, similar to the Oracle Summoning Effect.
So naturally, it can also bypass the space turbulence at the edge of the Land of the Abandoned Gods, enabling long-distance teleportation.
And this will serve as a channel connecting the Land of the Abandoned Gods to the outside world.
Han Xing whispered, "It seems opening Xingyu City now is indeed a bit premature."
"Before the High-Level Teleportation Array is built, many issues arise."
However, it was at this moment that Han Xing suddenly received a friend request.
"Survivor ’Luo Chan’ is requesting to add you as a friend."
Han Xing’s eyes showed confusion; this name sounded familiar to him.
It was the same Luo Chan who had a brief encounter with him before, the Immortal Mansion leader.
During the Blood Tide, Han Xing had saved them once.
"How does this woman know my real name?"
With a puzzled expression, Han Xing clicked to accept.
The next moment, Luo Chan immediately sent a message.
"Finally added you as a friend, Star God!"
Her tone was somewhat excited.
Han Xing inquired curiously, "Uh, how did you know my name?"
Luo Chan hurriedly replied, "Sorry, Star God, because I’m quite anxious here, I used some unconventional means to find out your real name."
"I sincerely apologize! I didn’t ask for your permission!"
Luo Chan sincerely apologized once again.
After listening, Han Xing nodded knowingly.
So far, his friend list already included quite a few people,
and inevitably, someone might unintentionally or intentionally leak his real name.
However, he wasn’t bothered by these things.
At this moment, Han Xing said, "It’s fine, you urgently wanted to find me; is there something you need?"
Seeing Han Xing not insisting further, Luo Chan also breathed a sigh of relief.
She thought for a moment, seemingly organizing her words and thoughts.
Then, Luo Chan spoke softly, "This time contacting Star God is for two reasons."
"One is to thank you for saving us last time."
"And the second is that I want to discuss some matters with Star God."
Han Xing remained silent, patiently waiting for Luo Chan to continue.
Luo Chan slowly continued.
"Honestly, this time Star God suddenly opened Xingyu City, venturing into a commercial model, surprised some of us."
"Because you’ve disrupted plans, including mine and others."

chapters.title: Chapter 298 - 238: Luo Chan’s Terms (2)
paragraphs: Han Xing was somewhat surprised, "What do you mean by that?"
Luo Chan replied, "Because, in our plan, we were preparing to merge the Sky Islands of seven large teams such as Immortal Mansion, Kyushu, and Shaking Light in a year."
"Then, like today’s Star God, open the territory and build it into a city of Survivors."
"So, the sudden announcement by Star God today also disrupted our plan."
At this point, Han Xing understood what she meant.
It seems that the thoughts of these large group leaders are the same as his own.
In the end, they all aim towards urbanization.
And Han Xing announced it today, which is equivalent to advancing their timeline by a year.
Han Xing nodded, "So, what do you mean?"
Luo Chan chuckled, "So, we decided."
"All members of Immortal Mansion will move into Xingyu City!"
"And this is the second reason I came to find Star God."
The first was still within Han Xing’s expectations.
As for the second, it was completely beyond Han Xing’s expectations.
Han Xing was a bit surprised, "What did you say? Immortal Mansion is moving into Xingyu City?"
Luo Chan heard the shock in Han Xing’s tone and chuckled, "Yes."
"Moreover, it’s not just a part but all members of Immortal Mansion, nearly a million people in total, will move in!"
"They are all willing to sign a Lord Contract with Star God and contribute to the development of Xingyu City."
Han Xing was shocked, "Do you know what you’re saying?"
"Once you sign the Lord Contract, you can’t repent for at least a year."
"This means that the over a million Survivors of Immortal Mansion will be working for me for a year."
However, Luo Chan earnestly said, "Star God, we certainly understand what this represents."
"But, I believe, this will be the best decision we have ever made in our lives."
"We have witnessed the power of Star God."
"Without a doubt, your Xingyu City is the safest place among the global Survivors.
"If it can develop, the future potential is limitless!"
There was excitement in Luo Chan’s tone, and she highly praised Xingyu City.
In the next moment, she changed the subject.
"But we also understand that your development path is different from ours. You are taking the elite route and have not recruited a large number of ordinary Survivors."
"Therefore, there aren’t many people in your territory."
"To develop the whole city, first, you need a group of trustworthy people."
"Whether it’s to run shops for you or help expand the territory, you need a lot of manpower."
Luo Chan spoke at length.
Han Xing also fell into contemplation.
It must be said that Luo Chan’s insight is unique and she clearly sees the current problem Han Xing faces.
Han Xing replied, "You’re right, I do need a lot of manpower, so...
"So, we are here to help Star God solve this problem!" Luo Chan’s voice was laced with joyful laughter.
"I believe, with the help of our Immortal Mansion members, the development speed of your territory will experience explosive growth!"
After hearing this woman speak, Han Xing was indeed moved.
However, he also knew that there’s no such thing as a free lunch.
Therefore, Han Xing asked, "So, what are the conditions?"
Hearing Han Xing’s straightforward question, Luo Chan also directly said, "The condition is... we hope to stay in Xingyu City permanently and assist Star God in development."
"Also, we hope that Star God can sincerely accept all our brothers and sisters of Immortal Mansion."
Han Xing was silent.
This condition is tantamount to saying nothing at all.
Luo Chan essentially handed over the faction she painstakingly built to Han Xing.
Of course, saying ’handed over’ is a bit severe.
After all, Han Xing would not let them suffer losses; on the contrary, he provided them with a perfect platform.
Now, anyone with insight can see the prospects of Xingyu City.
It’s just that some concerns have prevented those Survivors from betting everything like Luo Chan did.
Luo Chan’s decision can be considered a win-win situation.
After a moment, Han Xing said, "To be honest, I am very surprised."
"After all, I never imagined that one day I would have any interaction with your Immortal Mansion.
"But of course, if you can move into Xingyu City, it will undoubtedly be a good decision, and I will give you the greatest support."
"As for what you said about sincerely accepting all of Immortal Mansion’s members..."
"Since you have come to my Xingyu City, as long as there are no ulterior motives, I will naturally accept you sincerely."
Luo Chan solemnly said, "With those words from Star God, we are at ease."
"From now on, all members of Immortal Mansion will fully support the development of Star God’s territory."
Han Xing also nodded.
Then, the two discussed some specific cooperation matters.
Such as the housing allocation for Immortal Mansion members, the profit standards for each year, and other welfare policies, etc.
Soon, half an hour passed.
Both of them felt there was nothing else to add.
Luo Chan said, "Let’s happily decide this way, Star God!"
"The territory of Immortal Mansion is heading towards the coordinates where Xingyu City is located and will arrive in about seventeen hours."
Han Xing nodded, "Okay, when you arrive at Xingyu City, directly contact a girl named Lanlan."
"I’m currently... not in Xingyu City and won’t be returning for the short term."
Hearing this, Luo Chan was also a little surprised, "Star God, you... are not in Xingyu City?"
She seemed to realize something instantly.
In the Land of the Abandoned Gods, even if you are far away, you can directly return to your territory through the Teleportation Array.
But Han Xing said he wouldn’t return for the short term; there’s only one possibility.
Star River has left the Land of the Abandoned Gods!
Thinking of this, Luo Chan’s delicate body trembled, and she exclaimed, "Has Star God already..."
Han Xing replied, "You guessed correctly, but it’s best if you keep this confidential for me."
Luo Chan took a deep breath, "Understood, Star God!"
Luo Chan spoke solemnly, then said regretfully, "It’s a pity, I still wanted to witness Star God’s elegance once more..."
Listening to this woman’s strange tone, Han Xing was also somewhat puzzled.
Then, he hung up the communication.
At this time, Xingyu City still maintained an extremely high flow of people.
More and more Sky Islands converged here from all directions.
They temporarily connected their Sky Islands to Xingyu City and then entered the city.
Already, over a thousand Sky Islands floated near Xingyu City.
These Sky Islands ranged from a few hundred thousand square meters to one or two square kilometers.
But compared to Xingyu City, they seemed very small.
Over a dozen hours later.
A massive Sky Island, covering dozens of square kilometers, came speeding in from afar.
On it stood a dense crowd of over a million Survivors.
Their equipment varied; most were a mix of Blue Armor and Purple Armor, with a piece of Golden Equipment here and there.
These people were members of Immortal Mansion led by Luo Chan.
At this moment.
The over a million Survivors on Immortal Mansion’s territory curiously observed this massive city.
In the Immortal Mansion chat channel, other Survivors couldn’t help but ask.
"Leader, are we really going to sign a Lord Contract with Star River?"
Luo Chan chuckled, "Didn’t we decide this already?"
"We all move into Xingyu City and develop together."
That Survivor hurriedly said, "But Leader, this way, we’ll all have to follow Star River’s arrangements."

"Moreover, we don’t know much about Star River’s character. What if we sign the Lord Contract with him and then he immediately assigns us high-difficulty tasks or finds ways to hinder our development?"
This person’s words were agreed upon by many Survivors in Immortal Mansion.
"Yes, Fairy Luo Chan, we still want to follow you."
However, Luo Chan explained, "What are you talking about? Of course, you will follow me in the future."
"Don’t forget, not only you but I will also sign a contract with Star River and develop together."
"Your direct superior will still be me, Star God will be like our big boss, so you will still listen to me in the future."
