"Without a doubt, your Xingyu City is the safest place among the global Survivors.
"If it can develop, the future potential is limitless!"
There was excitement in Luo Chan’s tone, and she highly praised Xingyu City.
In the next moment, she changed the subject.
"But we also understand that your development path is different from ours.
You are taking the elite route and have not recruited a large number of ordinary Survivors."
"Therefore, there aren’t many people in your territory."
"To develop the whole city, first, you need a group of trustworthy people."
"Whether it’s to run shops for you or help expand the territory, you need a lot of manpower."
Luo Chan spoke at length.
Han Xing also fell into contemplation.
It must be said that Luo Chan’s insight is unique and she clearly sees the current problem Han Xing faces.
Han Xing replied, "You’re right, I do need a lot of manpower, so...
"So, we are here to help Star God solve this problem!" Luo Chan’s voice was laced with joyful laughter.
"I believe, with the help of our Immortal Mansion members, the development speed of your territory will experience explosive growth!"
After hearing this woman speak, Han Xing was indeed moved.
However, he also knew that there’s no such thing as a free lunch.
Therefore, Han Xing asked, "So, what are the conditions?"
Hearing Han Xing’s straightforward question, Luo Chan also directly said, "The condition is... we hope to stay in Xingyu City permanently and assist Star God in development."
"Also, we hope that Star God can sincerely accept all our brothers and sisters of Immortal Mansion."
Han Xing was silent.
This condition is tantamount to saying nothing at all.
Luo Chan essentially handed over the faction she painstakingly built to Han Xing.
Of course, saying ’handed over’ is a bit severe.
After all, Han Xing would not let them suffer losses; on the contrary, he provided them with a perfect platform.
Now, anyone with insight can see the prospects of Xingyu City.
It’s just that some concerns have prevented those Survivors from betting everything like Luo Chan did.
Luo Chan’s decision can be considered a win-win situation.
After a moment, Han Xing said, "To be honest, I am very surprised."
"After all, I never imagined that one day I would have any interaction with your Immortal Mansion.
"But of course, if you can move into Xingyu City, it will undoubtedly be a good decision, and I will give you the greatest support."
"As for what you said about sincerely accepting all of Immortal Mansion’s members..."
"Since you have come to my Xingyu City, as long as there are no ulterior motives, I will naturally accept you sincerely."
Luo Chan solemnly said, "With those words from Star God, we are at ease."
"From now on, all members of Immortal Mansion will fully support the development of Star God’s territory."
Han Xing also nodded.
Then, the two discussed some specific cooperation matters.
Such as the housing allocation for Immortal Mansion members, the profit standards for each year, and other welfare policies, etc.
Soon, half an hour passed.
Both of them felt there was nothing else to add.
Luo Chan said, "Let’s happily decide this way, Star God!"
"The territory of Immortal Mansion is heading towards the coordinates where Xingyu City is located and will arrive in about seventeen hours."
Han Xing nodded, "Okay, when you arrive at Xingyu City, directly contact a girl named Lanlan."
"I’m currently... not in Xingyu City and won’t be returning for the short term."
Hearing this, Luo Chan was also a little surprised, "Star God, you... are not in Xingyu City?"
She seemed to realize something instantly.
In the Land of the Abandoned Gods, even if you are far away, you can directly return to your territory through the Teleportation Array.
But Han Xing said he wouldn’t return for the short term; there’s only one possibility.
Star River has left the Land of the Abandoned Gods!
Thinking of this, Luo Chan’s delicate body trembled, and she exclaimed, "Has Star God already..."
Han Xing replied, "You guessed correctly, but it’s best if you keep this confidential for me."
Luo Chan took a deep breath, "Understood, Star God!"
Luo Chan spoke solemnly, then said regretfully, "It’s a pity, I still wanted to witness Star God’s elegance once more..."
Listening to this woman’s strange tone, Han Xing was also somewhat puzzled.
Then, he hung up the communication.
At this time, Xingyu City still maintained an extremely high flow of people.
More and more Sky Islands converged here from all directions.
They temporarily connected their Sky Islands to Xingyu City and then entered the city.
Already, over a thousand Sky Islands floated near Xingyu City.
These Sky Islands ranged from a few hundred thousand square meters to one or two square kilometers.
But compared to Xingyu City, they seemed very small.
Over a dozen hours later.
A massive Sky Island, covering dozens of square kilometers, came speeding in from afar.
On it stood a dense crowd of over a million Survivors.
Their equipment varied; most were a mix of Blue Armor and Purple Armor, with a piece of Golden Equipment here and there.
These people were members of Immortal Mansion led by Luo Chan.
At this moment.
The over a million Survivors on Immortal Mansion’s territory curiously observed this massive city.
In the Immortal Mansion chat channel, other Survivors couldn’t help but ask.
"Leader, are we really going to sign a Lord Contract with Star River?"
Luo Chan chuckled, "Didn’t we decide this already?"
"We all move into Xingyu City and develop together."
That Survivor hurriedly said, "But Leader, this way, we’ll all have to follow Star River’s arrangements."
"Moreover, we don’t know much about Star River’s character.
What if we sign the Lord Contract with him and then he immediately assigns us high-difficulty tasks or finds ways to hinder our development?"
This person’s words were agreed upon by many Survivors in Immortal Mansion.
"Yes, Fairy Luo Chan, we still want to follow you."
However, Luo Chan explained, "What are you talking about?
Of course, you will follow me in the future."
"Don’t forget, not only you but I will also sign a contract with Star River and develop together."
"Your direct superior will still be me, Star God will be like our big boss, so you will still listen to me in the future."

chapters.title: Chapter 299 - 239: Great Sword Master and Entering the Abyssal Rift
paragraphs: After listening to Luo Chan’s explanation, the group of survivors also breathed a sigh of relief.
Before this, they were very worried about what would happen after the Immortal Mansion settled in Xingyu City.
They feared Star River would be too wary of the Immortal Mansion’s powerful influence and could resort to various means to divide or suppress them.
Such incidents haven’t been absent in history.
However, they were indeed overthinking it.
Not to mention whether Han Xing would have such intentions to suppress them, the strength of millions in the Immortal Mansion would not be something he’d worry about at all.
At this moment, Luo Chan also smiled and said,
"You’re thinking too much. With the strength of the Star God, there’s really no reason for them to be wary of our Immortal Mansion."
"Star God is willing to let us all settle here; we should actually be sincerely grateful to him."
"You should have noticed before that the living environment in the Immortal Mansion’s territory was too congested."
"Over a million people crowded on a large platform, mainly gaining resources through combat—development was too slow this way."
"Having Xingyu City provides me with a more complete and safer territory for development."
"This means we’re borrowing the skin of Xingyu City, which gives us a great advantage."
After Luo Chan finished speaking, millions of survivors fell into contemplation.
They also felt that what Luo Chan said had merit.
At this moment, a survivor analyzed.
"The leader makes sense. Now most teams sign contracts with at least a 30% resource handover."
"Star River does the same, at 30%."
"And, he also offers accommodation and safety assurances, much better than most leaders currently."
His words gained recognition from many people.
After such an analysis, impressions across the Immortal Mansion about settling in Xingyu City improved.
Luo Chan spoke again,
"There’s no need to worry, and please trust me, Luo Chan. From now on, we will rely on Xingyu City."
"The Immortal Mansion is about to undergo an unprecedented transformation!"
Then, Luo Chan led millions of survivors from the Immortal Mansion into Xingyu City.
Having already informed Lanlan.
So, Lanlan wasn’t surprised by Luo Chan and the others’ arrival.
After mutual introductions,
Luo Chan first signed the Lord Contract.
Other survivors from the Immortal Mansion quickly followed suit.
For a time, Han Xing was bombarded with contract notifications.
Then, Han Xing ceased to focus on them.
With the addition of millions from the Immortal Mansion and Han Xing’s assistance,
Xingyu City’s development would enter a new leap-forward phase.
Meanwhile,
Han Xing, having been busy for two days, finally relaxed.
At this time, the crowd waiting in Ten Thousand Stars City was constantly monitoring the recent happenings in the chat channel.
Shen Yun couldn’t help but be amazed: "Brother Xing surely acts fast, developing to this scale in just a month."
"That way, we’re far ahead of all other survivors."
"Xingyu City as the first main city of the Human Race is already certain."
Everyone understood the significance of a race having its first main city.
Han Xing also chuckled and said: "It’s also thanks to those diligent little girls."
"When we return to the Land of the Abandoned Gods, let’s see if we can help them level up as well."
Cheng Jianyong responded heartily, patting his chest: "No problem, I’m an expert at helping out!"
"I’m now a Fourth Transformation Sword Master, you should call me Great Sword Master from now on!"
Upon reaching Fourth Transformation, the Swordsman becomes a Hero Level Professional, also known as Great Sword Master.
Cheng Jianyong was very pleased with his title, insisting people call him that daily.
Shen Yun rolled his eyes at him: "What’s so impressive about being a Great Sword Master? I’m also a Fourth Transformation Radiant Bishop now."
Cheng Jianyong, barely able to contain his excitement, retorted: "A Radiant Bishop can’t compare to my Great Sword Master title."
Upon reaching Fourth Transformation, everyone found their profession names had changed.
Zhang Lianmeng had become a Great Mage.
Su Xiaoyang was the Elf Master.
And for Han Xing, an additional Hero Level title appeared after Wild Ranger.
The change in titles made everyone feel the growth in their power.
Compared to before Third Transformation, their strength had undergone a profound transformation.
Not only had their basic attributes increased dramatically, but they had also each learned two powerful burst skills.
It’s worth mentioning that Zhang Lianmeng’s newly acquired skills are Elemental Affinity and Forbidden Curse—Heaven-Burning Fire Rain.
[Elemental Affinity]: Drastically reduces casting time and enhances magic damage based on the Great Mage’s spirit intensity.

[Forbidden Curse—Heaven-Burning Fire Rain]: Summons a rain of fire to annihilate the target area, with a damage coefficient of spirit*7.5, a damage range of spirit*5 meters, skill duration of 30 seconds, and a cooldown time of 24 hours.
Note: After using Forbidden Curse, the Great Mage enters a minute of weakened state (chanting time increases by 50%, magic damage decreases by 50%).
The first ’Elemental Affinity’ skill, without further explanation, reduces casting time and increases damage based on spirit intensity.
With Zhang Lianmeng’s current spirit intensity, many skills, like Large Fireball, Ice Cone Technique, Lightning Technique, etc., can now be cast instantly.
This skill truly changes the Mage’s combat mode.
No longer needing to stand still, chant magic slowly, and then attack.
It’s a qualitative change.
The second Forbidden Curse skill is also incredibly formidable.
Given Zhang Lianmeng’s current spirit level of over 2500, the skill delivers 19,000 magic damage, along with its impressive range.
Even more fearsome is the skill’s continuous damage.
A sustained bombardment for 30 seconds could potentially obliterate even the same-level Lord Creatures.
This skill truly lives up to the name of Forbidden Curse.
At this time, Han Xing also smiled and said.
"Alright, now that we have all completed the Fourth Transformation, our strength has greatly increased."
"Next, prepare yourselves, as you will accompany me on a trip to the Abyssal Rift later."
Upon hearing the words ’Abyssal Rift’, everyone’s eyes lit up.
They had long known about the existence of this instance.
Since the early opening of the Cloud Secret Realm, they had uncovered related materials, ’Strong Fragment’.
It is said that countless treasures and powerful equipment are hidden within.
Previously, Han Xing had planned several times to explore, but it was interrupted by various matters.
Having been in the Witch Race Territory for over a month.
Han Xing has been using every moment to continuously expand his territory and enhance everyone’s strength.
He had no opportunity to explore the Abyssal Rift.
However, the results were clearly visible.
In just a month’s time, Han Xing had built over a hundred Hellfire Missile Silos, in addition to two thousand Thunderbolt Towers, and over ten thousand Arrow Towers.
Additionally, there was an army of six hundred thousand Wolf Cavalry and three hundred thousand Minotaur Army.
Add in the Big-beaked Birds, the number of troop types on Han Xing’s territory exceeded one million.
In terms of firepower strength, Ten Thousand Stars City already surpassed Xingyu City.
Now, Han Xing could confidently say.
Below Legend, I am already invincible!
So, even if everyone entered the Abyssal Rift, there would be no need to worry about Ten Thousand Stars City being attacked.
Then, Han Xing directly took out many materials from his backpack.
[Strong Fragment]: After gathering 100 fragments, they can be synthesized into a Stronger’s Mark, which can be used for the ’Abyssal Rift’ challenge.
Han Xing had a large reserve of such fragments on hand.
Previously, before the price increase, Han Xing began to collect these fragments in bulk.
Now, as numerous survivors continue to explore the Abyssal Rift, bringing back all sorts of precious items from within.
The price of Strong Fragments has risen significantly.
Currently, the market price for one fragment has reached 2000 Spirit Cores, meaning it would take 200,000 Spirit Cores to challenge the Abyssal Rift once.
And when Han Xing was purchasing in bulk, it was less than 200 Spirit Cores.
Even considering the depreciation of Spirit Cores, he still made over five times the profit!
Han Xing glanced slightly at his warehouse.
[Strong Fragment] *12.43 million.
million!
This number is shocking.
Synthesizing them all into Stronger’s Marks would allow him to enter the Abyssal Rift hundreds of thousands of times.
Even if Han Xing couldn’t use them all, selling them on the trade channel would still bring in a large amount of resources.
And this is just the value of one type of material in Han Xing’s warehouse.
He has more and even more precious materials stockpiled in the warehouse.
Looking at his warehouse, a spontaneous sense of satisfaction and confidence arose from within him.
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but exclaim, "This is the joy of being a pack rat!"
He then took out 50,000 Strong Fragments and synthesized 500 Stronger’s Marks.
Then, distributed a hundred each to Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and others.
Han Xing at this time said, "Alright, check your backpack and try to bring as many supplies as possible."
Upon hearing this, everyone checked their backpacks.
A moment later, Cheng Jianyong responded, "No problem on my end, Brother Xing."
Shen Yun also nodded, "I have no problem either."
"Good."
The next moment, just as Han Xing was about to teleport, he seemed to remember something.
He quickly put Coal Ball into the Pet Space.
With this, he could bring along the pet to enter the Abyssal Rift together.
After completing these preparations.
Everyone also simultaneously crushed the Stronger’s Marks in their hands.
The next moment.
A system prompt appeared.
[Would you like to enter the special scene: Abyssal Rift?]
"Yes."
At the moment Han Xing clicked to confirm.
A black mist simultaneously appeared on all five of them.
Moreover, this black mist continued to spread and rise, completely enveloping the five.
A system prompt appeared.
[Teleporting to ’Abyssal Rift’...]
A few seconds later, everyone’s vision went dark.
After a bout of dizziness.
Everyone could distinctly feel a change in the surrounding environment.
A few seconds later, Han Xing finally regained some vision.
When he opened his eyes, he found himself in a dimly lit environment.
Here, true to its name.
Abyssal Rift.
It was as if everyone was truly in an abyss.
Heavy mist was everywhere, and even with Han Xing’s eyesight, he couldn’t see beyond five meters...

chapters.title: Chapter 300 - 240: The Power of the Great Mage!
paragraphs: "Damn... it’s so dark?" Cheng Jianyong’s voice was the first to be heard.
The surroundings seemed very empty.
Besides Cheng Jianyong’s voice.
There were still whispers coming from the mist, echoing above and around everyone.
These voices were like the whispers and curses of vengeful spirits, from which they felt waves of malice.
As if they were plotting how to deal with everyone.
Due to the overly dark environment.
Han Xing directly took out a dark fire stone torch from his backpack.
With a hissing sound.
The torch was lit.
Red light dispersed the mist.
The visibility around increased somewhat, but it was still limited to within ten meters.
Shen Yun frowned and said, "Is this place really so strange?"
"We can’t even see the scenes in the mist, it’s like some kind of rule."
Cheng Jianyong tried to make contact with the mist.
Then, he was stopped by an invisible wall, unable to enter the mist.
Cheng Jianyong said, "Brother Xing, there’s a restriction in these mists, we can’t enter, we can only move within the visible area."
Han Xing nodded, he had also realized this.
At this moment, a system notification appeared.
"New scene, Abyssal Rift has been loaded..."
"Since your squad is entering for the first time, with no recorded Abyssal Rift challenge levels, you must start from the first level this time."
"Now, please name your squad."
Hearing the system notification, everyone looked at each other.
Cheng Jianyong was stunned, "What? We have to name our squad?"
Then, everyone turned their gaze towards Han Xing.
Han Xing understood they were asking for his opinion.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing said directly, "Let’s just call it the Star River Squad."
He really didn’t want to waste brainpower thinking of a name.
Everyone showed a knowing smile.
The system notification appeared.
"Squad: Star River Squad has been successfully named."
"Captain: Star River, Members: Lone Brave, Yun Tianming, Qing Meng, Clever Little Sheep."
"Please take a short break, in three minutes, the Abyssal Rift challenge will begin..."
Shen Yun thought for a moment, and said softly, "Three minutes preparation time, this dungeon is quite considerate."
Everyone also nodded.
However, each of them held a dark fire stone torch, and began to explore within this limited range.
The ground was composed of an unknown material, soft underfoot, like stepping on grass, yet also like stepping on rotting cloth.
The air was filled with a decaying scent.
Whispers of the undead came from within the mist.
And piles of white bones could be seen occasionally on the ground.
The atmosphere here was extremely eerie.
At this moment, Shen Yun suddenly said, "Brother Xing, come quickly, there’s something here."
"What? Let me see!" Cheng Jianyong rushed over immediately.
Upon hearing this, everyone moved closer to where Shen Yun was.
Then, they saw what Shen Yun was referring to.
It was a two-meter-high stone tablet, half buried in the ground, covered in black spots, exuding an ominous aura.
There were also some inscriptions on it.
[Brave Monument: Records the achievements of the Brave Squad in exploring the Abyssal Rift.]
"Oh? Brave Monument?"
Cheng Jianyong was surprised, "Recording squad achievements, are these from other survivor squads?"
They continued to look below.
[Monument Reward: The first survivor squad to clear specific levels of the Abyssal Rift will receive exclusive rewards; specific levels are 10, 20, 30... up to 100.]
"So, this monument means we receive an exclusive reward for every 10 levels we clear?" Cheng Jianyong asked.
Shen Yun, after carefully reading it, shook his head and said, "No, only the first squad to clear will get the reward, and it’s only once.
"Huh? What do you mean?" Cheng Jianyong asked.
Shen Yun explained, "It means there’s an exclusive reward at levels like 10, 20, 30."
"But only the first squad to clear these levels gets it."
After listening to Shen Yun’s explanation, everyone understood the exclusive reward rule.
At this moment, when they looked back at the monument, they found three lines of text recorded on it.
[Abyssal Rift level 10 first clear squad]: Huayi.
This squad, without a doubt, was Zhou Huang.
Beneath this, there was another.
[Abyssal Rift level 20 first clear squad]: Kunlun.
This one was certainly Boundless.
The strength of these two was indeed formidable.
And below, there was one more.
[Abyssal Rift level 30 first clear squad]: Kunlun.
Both levels 20 and 30 were first cleared by Boundless.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong asked, "Boundless got two rewards in a row, the reward for level 40 should still be unclaimed, right?"
Han Xing looked at the last line of numbers at the bottom of the monument and nodded.
[Current highest challenge level of Abyssal Rift: Level 39, clear squad: Kunlun.]
Another by Boundless.
His strength was indeed formidable.
During the Blood Tide Period, Boundless could already solo a Dominator.
However, that Dominator’s level was 29 at the time.
And Boundless had not completed the third transformation.
Now, after so long, his strength could only have increased.
"Even Boundless only cleared up to level 39, stopping at level 40, it seems the difficulty of this Abyssal Rift is extremely high." Cheng Jianyong sighed.
Shen Yun thought for a moment and analyzed, "It probably isn’t that bad."
"Although Boundless is strong, his level lags behind us significantly."
"The fourth transformation compared to the third is another qualitative leap."
"So, the difficulty of the 40th floor shouldn’t be a problem for us."
Everyone listened and found some sense in it.
At the same time, they also had some expectations.
Entering the Abyssal Rift this time might yield some unexpected gains.
At this moment, the three-minute preparation time had passed.
The system prompt appeared.
"The Abyssal Rift challenge will commence in ten seconds. Survivors, please prepare."
Everyone’s expressions turned serious.
When the ten-second countdown ended.
They found that the surrounding mist instantly retreated a dozen meters.
Leaving them with a spacious area.
The next moment.
They only heard a constant creaking sound echoing in their ears.
It was as if bones were colliding with each other.
Then, they witnessed with their own eyes, skeletal hands drilling out from the soil, breaking through the ground.
The next moment, a number of Skeleton Soldiers, fierce and menacing, appeared before them.
These Skeleton Soldiers still held a rusty short sword or carried a small wooden round shield,
However, everyone couldn’t sense any danger from these monsters.
The attributes of the Skeleton Soldiers appeared before their eyes.
[Skeleton Soldier: Abyssal Monster]
[Level]: Level 1.
[Attributes]: Power 5, Agility 8, Spirit 6, Constitution: 7.
[Skills]: Shield Strike, Chop.
Looking at the attributes of these monsters, everyone twitched their mouths.
A Level 1 monster was indeed rather frail.
With everyone’s current attributes, even if they stood there and let them hit for a year, it might still not break through their defense.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly smiled and said, "Lian’Er, finish them off!"
Zhang Lianmeng understood.
She revealed a slight smile, lightly moving her lotus steps, twisting her waist.
Then raised the Flame Dominator Staff high, terrifying power of flame converging within.
After completing the Fourth Transformation and becoming a Great Mage, Zhang Lianmeng had already mastered instant casting of minor skills.
And indeed, it was so.
From the time Zhang Lianmeng lifted her hand until the Fireball condensed, it took no more than 0.1 seconds.
With a light chant.
A Large Fireball, with a diameter of over ten meters, blazing like the Sun, suddenly plummeted down.
Boom!
The terrifying flames surged upward, enveloping Han Xing and the others as well.
The dark Mist Space was instantly illuminated.
The next moment, everyone heard the system prompt.
[Successfully killed Skeleton Soldier lv1, ordinary Abyssal Monster, gained Experience Value...]
For such low-level monsters, they basically yielded no experience anymore.
At this time, everyone noticed that the place where these Skeleton Soldiers stood seemed to have left behind some strange things.
Several faint Ghost Fires hovered in the air.
On the ground, there was also some black soil.
Han Xing stepped forward, attempting to touch these Ghost Fires.
In front of him appeared the attributes of these faint Ghost Fires.
[Dim Spirit]: A spirit containing a faint soul aura, can summon a Level 1 ordinary Abyssal Monster to assist in battle.
This item seemed to belong to the same series as Elite Spirit and Heroic Spirit.
Han Xing collected these spirits, along with all the loot on the ground.
[Obtained materials: Dim Spirit*4, Rare Earth*11, Refined Iron*3...]
This was only the first layer of the Abyssal Rift, and the materials obtained were relatively low-grade.
However, those few Dim Spirits were still pretty decent.
If Han Xing had entered before reaching Level 10, by farming several times, he might be able to raise an army of Abyssal Monsters.
Of course, he had no use for them now.
After gathering all the materials on the ground.
A passage suddenly appeared in the mist ahead.
The system prompt appeared.
[The first-layer challenge has ended, the battle time this round was 1.32 seconds...]
[Brave Squad, please enter the Mist Passage to commence the next-layer challenge of the Abyssal Rift.]
After hearing this, everyone followed the guide and headed to the next area.
Upon entering the Mist Passage.
The area behind was once again enveloped by mist.
Once they fully entered a new area, the system prompt appeared again.
[Abyssal Rift, the 2nd-layer challenge is about to start...]
A few seconds later.
Several Skeleton Soldiers crawled up from the ground once more.
However, compared to the first layer, the number of monsters was slightly more.
Furthermore, the level of these Skeleton Soldiers increased by 1, with slightly enhanced attributes.
Still, it was a matter of one Large Fireball from Zhang Lianmeng.
Boom!
Flames rose.
Taking two seconds, everyone ended the battle on the second layer once more.
Then came the third layer, the fourth layer...
The Large Fireball bombarded all the way, instantly clearing the field.
Until they reached the tenth layer.
In front of everyone finally appeared a slightly stronger monster.
[Skeleton General: Elite Creature]
[Level]: Level 10.
[Attributes]: Power 84, Agility 73, Spirit 61, Constitution 71.
[Skills]: Skeleton Armor, Giant Axe Frenzy, Breaking Army.

sentences.text: "Damn... it’s so dark?" Cheng Jianyong’s voice was the first to be heard.
The surroundings seemed very empty.
Besides Cheng Jianyong’s voice.
There were still whispers coming from the mist, echoing above and around everyone.
These voices were like the whispers and curses of vengeful spirits, from which they felt waves of malice.
As if they were plotting how to deal with everyone.
Due to the overly dark environment.
Han Xing directly took out a dark fire stone torch from his backpack.
With a hissing sound.
The torch was lit.
Red light dispersed the mist.
The visibility around increased somewhat, but it was still limited to within ten meters.
Shen Yun frowned and said, "Is this place really so strange?"
"We can’t even see the scenes in the mist, it’s like some kind of rule."
Cheng Jianyong tried to make contact with the mist.
Then, he was stopped by an invisible wall, unable to enter the mist.
Cheng Jianyong said, "Brother Xing, there’s a restriction in these mists, we can’t enter, we can only move within the visible area."
Han Xing nodded, he had also realized this.
At this moment, a system notification appeared.
"New scene, Abyssal Rift has been loaded..."
"Since your squad is entering for the first time, with no recorded Abyssal Rift challenge levels, you must start from the first level this time."
"Now, please name your squad."
Hearing the system notification, everyone looked at each other.
Cheng Jianyong was stunned, "What?
We have to name our squad?"
Then, everyone turned their gaze towards Han Xing.
Han Xing understood they were asking for his opinion.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing said directly, "Let’s just call it the Star River Squad."
He really didn’t want to waste brainpower thinking of a name.
Everyone showed a knowing smile.
The system notification appeared.
